```js
  // --- Batches: much work on a thread of Mono's own, in C ----------------
  // Running JavaScript on a thread of our own for thousands of methods, with
  // the agent's thread waiting for it (onMonoThread), can deadlock inside
  // Frida, and blocks every script of the agent meanwhile. A batch runs
  // plain C instead, and the agent's thread only looks at its progress.

  const BATCH_COMPILE = 0;
  const BATCH_LOCATE = 1;
  const BATCH_CHECK = 2;
  const BATCH_POLL = 50;
  const BATCH_SOURCE = `
#include <glib.h>

typedef struct {
  gpointer domain;
  gint kind;
  gint count;
  gpointer * input;
  gpointer * first;
  gpointer * second;
  volatile gint done;
  volatile gint cancel;
  volatile gint finished;
} Batch;

extern gpointer mono_thread_attach (gpointer domain);
extern void mono_thread_detach (gpointer thread);
extern gpointer mono_compile_method (gpointer method);
extern gpointer mono_jit_info_table_find (gpointer domain, gpointer address);
extern gpointer mono_get_root_domain (void);
extern gpointer mono_jit_info_get_code_start (gpointer info);
extern gint mono_jit_info_get_code_size (gpointer info);
extern gpointer mono_jit_info_get_method (gpointer info);
extern gpointer mono_method_get_header (gpointer method);
extern const guint8 * mono_method_header_get_code (gpointer header, guint32 * size,
    guint32 * max_stack);
extern void mono_metadata_free_mh (gpointer header);
extern gpointer mono_method_get_class (gpointer method);
extern guint32 mono_class_get_flags (gpointer klass);
extern gpointer mono_class_get_image (gpointer klass);
extern gpointer mono_get_method (gpointer image, guint32 token, gpointer klass);
extern gpointer mono_class_get (gpointer image, guint32 token);

#define TYPE_ATTRIBUTE_IMPORT 0x1000
#define TOKEN_METHOD 1
#define TOKEN_TYPE 2
#define TOKEN_ANY 3

/* The length of the IL instruction at ip (0: cannot tell), and which kind
   of token its operand is (0: none). */
static guint32 instruction (const guint8 * ip, const guint8 * end, gint * kind) {
  guint8 op = ip[0];
  *kind = 0;
  if (op == 0xfe) {
    if (ip + 1 >= end)
      return 0;
    switch (ip[1]) {
      case 0x06: case 0x07:                       /* ldftn, ldvirtftn */
        *kind = TOKEN_METHOD;
        return 6;
      case 0x15: case 0x16: case 0x1c:            /* initobj, constrained., sizeof */
        *kind = TOKEN_TYPE;
        return 6;
      case 0x09: case 0x0a: case 0x0b: case 0x0c: case 0x0d: case 0x0e:
        return 4;
      case 0x12: case 0x19:
        return 3;
      default:
        return 2;
    }
  }
  if ((op >= 0x0e && op <= 0x13) || op == 0x1f || (op >= 0x2b && op <= 0x37) || op == 0xde)
    return 2;
  if (op == 0x20 || op == 0x22 || op == 0x29 || op == 0x72 || (op >= 0x38 && op <= 0x44)
      || (op >= 0x7b && op <= 0x80) || op == 0xdd)
    return 5;
  if (op == 0x21 || op == 0x23)
    return 9;
  if (op == 0x27 || op == 0x28 || op == 0x6f || op == 0x73) {  /* jmp, call, callvirt, newobj */
    *kind = TOKEN_METHOD;
    return 5;
  }
  if (op == 0x70 || op == 0x71 || op == 0x74 || op == 0x75 || op == 0x79 || op == 0x81
      || op == 0x8c || op == 0x8d || op == 0x8f || op == 0xa3 || op == 0xa4 || op == 0xa5
      || op == 0xc2 || op == 0xc6) {
    *kind = TOKEN_TYPE;
    return 5;
  }
  if (op == 0xd0) {                                           /* ldtoken */
    *kind = TOKEN_ANY;
    return 5;
  }
  if (op == 0x45) {                                           /* switch */
    if (ip + 5 > end)
      return 0;
    guint32 count = ip[1] | ip[2] << 8 | ip[3] << 16 | (guint32) ip[4] << 24;
    if (count > (guint32) (end - ip) / 4)
      return 0;
    return 5 + 4 * count;
  }
  return 1;
}

static gboolean is_import (gpointer klass) {
  return klass != NULL && (mono_class_get_flags (klass) & TYPE_ATTRIBUTE_IMPORT) != 0;
}

/* Whether a method uses COM interop ([ComImport] classes or interfaces).
   Compiling such code makes Mono set up COM support, which hangs on Linux. */
static gboolean uses_com (gpointer method) {
  gpointer own = mono_method_get_class (method);
  if (is_import (own))
    return TRUE;
  gpointer header = mono_method_get_header (method);
  if (header == NULL)
    return FALSE;
  guint32 size = 0, max_stack = 0;
  const guint8 * code = mono_method_header_get_code (header, &size, &max_stack);
  const guint8 * end = code + size;
  gpointer image = mono_class_get_image (own);
  gboolean found = FALSE;
  const guint8 * ip = code;
  while (code != NULL && ip < end && !found) {
    gint kind;
    guint32 length = instruction (ip, end, &kind);
    if (length == 0 || length > (guint32) (end - ip))
      break;
    if (kind != 0) {
      const guint8 * operand = ip + length - 4;
      guint32 token = operand[0] | operand[1] << 8 | operand[2] << 16
          | (guint32) operand[3] << 24;
      guint32 table = token >> 24;
      gpointer klass = NULL;
      if (kind != TOKEN_TYPE && (table == 0x06 || table == 0x0a || table == 0x2b)) {
        gpointer callee = mono_get_method (image, token, NULL);
        klass = callee == NULL ? NULL : mono_method_get_class (callee);
      } else if (kind != TOKEN_METHOD && (table == 0x01 || table == 0x02 || table == 0x1b)) {
        klass = mono_class_get (image, token);
      }
      found = is_import (klass);
    }
    ip += length;
  }
  mono_metadata_free_mh (header);
  return found;
}

static gpointer find_info (Batch * batch, gpointer root, gpointer address) {
  gpointer info = mono_jit_info_table_find (batch->domain, address);
  if (info == NULL && root != batch->domain)
    info = mono_jit_info_table_find (root, address);
  return info;
}

/* compile: input methods -> first code start, second code size (or NULL)
   locate: input addresses -> first method, second code start (or NULL)
   check: input methods -> first non-NULL if the method uses COM interop */
gpointer run_batch (gpointer data) {
  Batch * batch = data;
  gpointer thread = mono_thread_attach (batch->domain);
  gpointer root = mono_get_root_domain ();
  for (gint i = 0; i < batch->count && !batch->cancel; i++) {
    if (batch->kind == 2) {
      batch->first[i] = GSIZE_TO_POINTER ((gsize) uses_com (batch->input[i]));
      batch->done = i + 1;
      continue;
    }
    gpointer address = batch->input[i];
    if (batch->kind == 0)
      address = mono_compile_method (address);
    gpointer info = address == NULL ? NULL : find_info (batch, root, address);
    if (info == NULL) {
      batch->first[i] = NULL;
    } else if (batch->kind == 0) {
      batch->first[i] = mono_jit_info_get_code_start (info);
      batch->second[i] = GSIZE_TO_POINTER ((gsize) mono_jit_info_get_code_size (info));
    } else {
      batch->first[i] = mono_jit_info_get_method (info);
      batch->second[i] = mono_jit_info_get_code_start (info);
    }
    batch->done = i + 1;
  }
  mono_thread_detach (thread);
  batch->finished = 1;
  return NULL;
}
`;
  // Offsets in Batch: pointers are 4 bytes in a 32-bit game (Wine), 8 otherwise.
  const P = Process.pointerSize;
  const B_DOMAIN = 0, B_KIND = P, B_COUNT = P + 4, B_INPUT = P === 8 ? 16 : 12,
    B_FIRST = B_INPUT + P, B_SECOND = B_FIRST + P, B_DONE = B_SECOND + P,
    B_CANCEL = B_DONE + 4, B_FINISHED = B_CANCEL + 4,
    B_SIZE = Math.ceil((B_FINISHED + 4) / P) * P;
  let batchCode = null;
  const batches = new Set();

  function batchFunctions() {
    if (batchCode === null) {
      const symbols = {};
      for (const name of ['mono_thread_attach', 'mono_thread_detach', 'mono_compile_method',
                          'mono_jit_info_table_find', 'mono_get_root_domain',
                          'mono_jit_info_get_code_start', 'mono_jit_info_get_code_size',
                          'mono_jit_info_get_method', 'mono_method_get_header',
                          'mono_method_header_get_code', 'mono_metadata_free_mh',
                          'mono_method_get_class', 'mono_class_get_flags',
                          'mono_class_get_image', 'mono_get_method', 'mono_class_get'])
        symbols[name] = api.module.getExportByName(name);
      const cm = new CModule(BATCH_SOURCE, symbols);
      batchCode = { cm };
    }
    return batchCode;
  }

  function runBatch(kind, inputs, progress) {
    // A promise of [[first, second], ...] for the inputs (see BATCH_SOURCE).
    if (!refresh())
      return Promise.reject(hermesError('error.mono.no_runtime'));
    const code = batchFunctions();
    const count = inputs.length;
    const size = Process.pointerSize * Math.max(count, 1);
    const batch = Memory.alloc(B_SIZE);
    const input = Memory.alloc(size);
    const first = Memory.alloc(size);
    const second = Memory.alloc(size);
    inputs.forEach((value, i) => input.add(i * Process.pointerSize).writePointer(value));
    batch.add(B_DOMAIN).writePointer(scriptDomain());
    batch.add(B_KIND).writeS32(kind);
    batch.add(B_COUNT).writeS32(count);
    batch.add(B_INPUT).writePointer(input);
    batch.add(B_FIRST).writePointer(first);
    batch.add(B_SECOND).writePointer(second);
    try {
      spawnThread(code.cm.run_batch, batch);
    } catch (error) {
      return Promise.reject(error);
    }
    // Should the session be cut meanwhile, Frida must not unload the C code
    // the batch thread runs: the script stays until the batch has finished.
    Script.pin();
    const entry = { batch, input };
    batches.add(entry);
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const poll = () => {
        if (batch.add(B_FINISHED).readS32() === 0) {
          if (progress)
            progress(batch.add(B_DONE).readS32());
          entry.timer = setTimeout(poll, BATCH_POLL);
          return;
        }
        batches.delete(entry);
        Script.unpin();
        if (batch.add(B_CANCEL).readS32() !== 0) {
          reject(new Error('cancelled'));
          return;
        }
        // The closure keeps the buffers alive until here.
        resolve(inputs.map((_value, i) => [
          first.add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer(),
          second.add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer()
        ]));
      };
      poll();
    });
  }

  function cancelBatches() {
    // Ask running batches to stop; their promises reject once they have.
    for (const entry of batches)
      entry.batch.add(B_CANCEL).writeS32(1);
    return batches.size;
  }

  function batchesRunning() {
    return batches.size > 0;
  }

  async function checkAll(methods, progress) {
    // Whether each method uses COM interop (see uses_com): [true/false].
    const results = await runBatch(BATCH_CHECK, methods, progress);
    return results.map(([found]) => !found.isNull());
  }

  async function compileAll(methods, progress) {
    // The code of many methods: [{ start, size } or null], see runBatch.
    const results = await runBatch(BATCH_COMPILE, methods, progress);
    return results.map(([start, size]) =>
      (start.isNull() ? null : { start, size: size.toInt32() }));
  }

  async function describeAll(addresses) {
    // ``describe`` for many addresses of JIT code, from the agent's thread.
    const results = await runBatch(BATCH_LOCATE, addresses);
    return results.map(([method, start], i) => {
      if (method.isNull())
        return null;
      const key = method.toString();
      let text = names.get(key);
      if (text === undefined) {
        text = cString(api.fullName(method, 0));
        names.set(key, text);
      }
      return text === null ? null : `${text}+${addresses[i].sub(start)}`;
    });
  }

  async function compile(identity) {
    // A promise of { start, size }.
    if (!refresh())
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_runtime');
    return onMonoThread(domain => {
      const { start, size } = compileOnThread(domain, identity);
      return { start, size };
    });
  }

  // --- Signatures: what the method monitor needs to decode arguments ------

  const TYPE = {
    VOID: 0x01, BOOLEAN: 0x02, CHAR: 0x03, I1: 0x04, U1: 0x05, I2: 0x06, U2: 0x07,
    I4: 0x08, U4: 0x09, I8: 0x0a, U8: 0x0b, R4: 0x0c, R8: 0x0d, STRING: 0x0e,
    VALUETYPE: 0x11, GENERICINST: 0x15, I: 0x18, U: 0x19
  };

  function typesApi() {
    if (!refresh())
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_runtime');
    if (api.types === null)
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_signatures');
    return api.types;
  }

  function typeInfo(t, type) {
    // { kind, byref, name, enumName?, structSize? }: enums become their base
    // type, value types that are no enum are structs ('VALUETYPE').
    const info = {
      kind: t.typeKind(type),
      byref: t.isByref(type) !== 0,
      name: cString(t.typeName(type)) || '?'
    };
    if (info.kind === TYPE.VALUETYPE || info.kind === TYPE.GENERICINST) {
      const klass = t.typeClass(type);
      if (!klass.isNull() && t.isEnum(klass) !== 0) {
        info.enumName = info.name;
        info.kind = t.typeKind(t.enumBase(klass));
      } else if (!klass.isNull() && t.isValueType(klass) !== 0) {
        info.kind = TYPE.VALUETYPE;
        info.structSize = t.valueSize(klass, NULL);
        info.klass = klass;
      }
    }
    return info;
  }

  async function prepare(identity) {
    // Compile the method like compile() and describe its signature (a
    // promise): { start, size, instance, params: [{ name, type }], returns: type }.
    typesApi();
    return onMonoThread(domain => {
      const { method, start, size } = compileOnThread(domain, identity);
      return { start, size, ...signatureOf(method) };
    });
  }

  const signatures = new Map();

  function signatureOf(method) {
    // { instance, params: [{ name, type }], returns: type } of a method (cached).
    const key = method.toString();
    let result = signatures.get(key);
    if (result !== undefined)
      return result;
    const t = typesApi();
    const signature = t.methodSignature(method);
    if (signature.isNull())
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_signature', { method });
    const count = t.paramCount(signature);
    const names = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize * Math.max(count, 1));
    t.paramNames(method, names);
    const iterator = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    iterator.writePointer(NULL);
    const params = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
      const type = t.params(signature, iterator);
      const name = names.add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
      params.push({
        name: name.isNull() ? `arg${i}` : name.readUtf8String(),
        type: typeInfo(t, type)
      });
    }
    result = {
      params,
      instance: t.isInstance(signature) !== 0,
      returns: typeInfo(t, t.returnType(signature))
    };
    signatures.set(key, result);
    return result;
  }

  // --- Objects: classes, their fields, arrays -----------------------------

  const FIELD_STATIC = 0x10;
  const FIELD_LITERAL = 0x40;
  // The offset Mono gives a thread or context static field: it has no place
  // in the class's static data.
  const SPECIAL_STATIC_OFFSET = 0xffffffff;
  const layouts = new Map();
  let knownImages = new Set();

  function isLoadedImage(image) {
    if (knownImages.has(image.toString()))
      return true;
    if (api.catalog === null)
      return false;
    // Assemblies may have been loaded since.
    knownImages = new Set(loadedImages(api.catalog).map(String));
    return knownImages.has(image.toString());
  }

  function classOf(object) {
    // The class of a managed object, or null if ``object`` is none (any
    // more): a MonoObject starts with its vtable, which starts with the
    // class, and a real class belongs to a loaded assembly. Only plain
    // memory reads until then, so a stale address cannot mislead Mono.
    typesApi();
    try {
      const klass = object.readPointer().readPointer();
      return isLoadedImage(api.classImage(klass)) ? klass : null;
    } catch (_error) {
      return null;
    }
  }

  function layout(klass) {
    // { name, valueType, rank, fields: [{ name, type, offset, static }] }
    // with inherited fields first; for arrays also element type and size.
    // Static fields also have ``owner`` (the class whose static data holds
    // them, see staticData) and ``storage``: 'data' there, 'const' (no
    // storage; the value is in the metadata only) or 'thread' (per thread).
    const key = klass.toString();
    let result = layouts.get(key);
    if (result !== undefined)
      return result;
    const t = typesApi();
    const chain = [];
    for (let current = klass; !current.isNull(); current = t.classParent(current))
      chain.unshift(current);
    const fields = [];
    const iterator = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    for (const current of chain) {
      iterator.writePointer(NULL);
      for (;;) {
        const field = t.classFields(current, iterator);
        if (field.isNull())
          break;
        const flags = t.fieldFlags(field);
        const entry = {
          name: t.fieldName(field).readUtf8String(),
          type: typeInfo(t, t.fieldType(field)),
          offset: t.fieldOffset(field),
          static: (flags & FIELD_STATIC) !== 0
        };
        if (entry.static) {
          entry.owner = current;
          entry.storage = (flags & FIELD_LITERAL) !== 0 ? 'const'
            : entry.offset === SPECIAL_STATIC_OFFSET ? 'thread' : 'data';
        }
        fields.push(entry);
      }
    }
    result = {
      name: cString(t.typeName(t.classType(klass))) || '?',
      valueType: t.isValueType(klass) !== 0,
      rank: t.classRank(klass),
      fields
    };
    if (result.rank > 0) {
      const element = t.elementClass(klass);
      result.element = typeInfo(t, t.classType(element));
      result.elementSize = t.elementSize(klass);
    }
    layouts.set(key, result);
    return result;
  }

  // domain|class -> the class's static data; Mono allocates it once (fixed,
  // the garbage collector does not move it).
  const staticAreas = new Map();

  function staticData(klass) {
    // Where the static fields of ``klass`` are (their offsets count from
    // here) in the domain of the calling thread, or null: no such functions,
    // a thread Mono does not know, or a class that failed to load. Before its
    // static constructor ran the fields read as zero.
    if (!refresh() || api.statics === null)
      return null;
    const domain = api.currentDomain();
    if (domain.isNull())
      return null;
    const key = `${domain}|${klass}`;
    let data = staticAreas.get(key);
    if (data === undefined) {
      const vtable = api.statics.classVtable(domain, klass);
      data = vtable.isNull() ? NULL : api.statics.fieldData(vtable);
      if (staticAreas.size >= MAX_CACHE)
        staticAreas.clear();
      staticAreas.set(key, data);
    }
    return data.isNull() ? null : data;
  }

  // --- Unity object names ----------------------------------------------------
  // GameObjects and components keep their name on Unity's native side; the
  // managed object only holds a pointer to it (m_CachedPtr). Reading it means
  // calling UnityEngine.Object.get_name, which Unity only allows on its main
  // thread: call unityName only on a game thread that runs game code. Threads
  // where it never worked are not asked again.

  const MAX_FAILURES = 3;
  const nameMethods = new Map();
  const nameThreads = new Map();
  const naming = new Set();

  function nameMethod(klass) {
    // UnityEngine.Object.get_name if ``klass`` derives from UnityEngine.Object.
    const key = klass.toString();
    let method = nameMethods.get(key);
    if (method !== undefined)
      return method;
    const t = typesApi();
    method = null;
    for (let current = klass; !current.isNull(); current = t.classParent(current)) {
      if (layout(current).name === 'UnityEngine.Object') {
        const found = api.invoke.methodFromName(current, Memory.allocUtf8String('get_name'), 0);
        method = found.isNull() ? null : found;
        break;
      }
    }
    nameMethods.set(key, method);
    return method;
  }

  function unityName(object) {
    // The name of a GameObject or component, or null.
    if (api === null || api.types === null || api.invoke === null)
      return null;
    const thread = Process.getCurrentThreadId();
    const state = nameThreads.get(thread) || { ok: 0, failed: 0 };
    if ((state.ok === 0 && state.failed >= MAX_FAILURES) || naming.has(thread))
      return null;
    const klass = classOf(object);
    const method = klass === null ? null : nameMethod(klass);
    if (method === null)
      return null;
    const exception = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    exception.writePointer(NULL);
    naming.add(thread);  // get_name could run a monitored method
    let result;
    try {
      result = api.invoke.runtimeInvoke(method, object, NULL, exception);
    } finally {
      naming.delete(thread);
    }
    // An exception: not the main thread, or the object was destroyed.
    const failed = !exception.readPointer().isNull() || result.isNull();
    if (failed)
      state.failed++;
    else
      state.ok++;
    nameThreads.set(thread, state);
    if (failed)
      return null;
    const length = result.add(2 * Process.pointerSize).readS32();
    return result.add(2 * Process.pointerSize + 4).readUtf16String(Math.min(length, 120));
  }

  // --- Unity's main thread ----------------------------------------------------
  // Game code that Unity only allows on its main thread (Unity API, game
  // logic) runs there via onMainThread: the next time the main thread starts
  // a script method through mono_runtime_invoke, the queued work runs first.
  // Which thread that is, see mainThreadId (platform layer).

  const MAIN_TIMEOUT = 3000;
  const mainQueue = [];
  let mainHook = null;
  let draining = false;

  function isMainThread() {
    return Process.getCurrentThreadId() === mainThreadId();
  }

  function drainMain() {
    // Run the queued work; call it on any thread, it only acts on the main one.
    if (draining || !isMainThread())
      return;
    draining = true;  // our own invocations pass mono_runtime_invoke, too
    try {
      while (mainQueue.length > 0) {
        const job = mainQueue.shift();
        clearTimeout(job.timer);
        try {
          job.resolve(job.work());
        } catch (error) {
          job.reject(error);
        }
      }
    } finally {
      draining = false;
    }
    if (mainHook !== null) {
      const hook = mainHook;
      mainHook = null;
      setTimeout(() => hook.detach(), 0);  // not from within its own callback
    }
  }

  function onMainThread(work) {
    // A promise of work()'s result, computed on Unity's main thread.
    if (api === null || api.invoke === null)
      return Promise.reject(hermesError('error.mono.no_invoke'));
    mainThreadId();  // found here, not first in the hook on a game thread
    return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
      const job = { work, resolve, reject };
      job.timer = setTimeout(() => {
        const index = mainQueue.indexOf(job);
        if (index >= 0)
          mainQueue.splice(index, 1);
        reject(hermesError('error.mono.main_thread_timeout'));
      }, MAIN_TIMEOUT);
      mainQueue.push(job);
      if (mainHook === null)
        mainHook = Interceptor.attach(api.invoke.runtimeInvokeAddress, {
          onEnter() {
            drainMain();
          }
        });
    });
  }

  // --- Properties: parameterless getters ---------------------------------------

  const propertyLists = new Map();

  function classChain(klass) {
    const chain = [];
    for (let current = klass; !current.isNull(); current = api.types.classParent(current))
      chain.push(current);
    return chain;  // the class first, System.Object last
  }

  function properties(klass) {
    // [{ name, method, static, type, setter }] of the getters of ``klass``
    // and its base classes (overridden ones once); ``setter`` is the
    // property's set_ method or null. A GameObject also lists its
    // components (``special: 'components'``). Cached.
    const key = klass.toString();
    let result = propertyLists.get(key);
    if (result !== undefined)
      return result;
    const t = typesApi();
    result = [];
    if (api.invoke === null) {
      propertyLists.set(key, result);
      return result;
    }
    const seen = new Set();
    const iterator = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    const chain = classChain(klass);
    if (chain.some(current => layout(current).name === 'UnityEngine.GameObject'))
      result.push({ name: 'GetComponents()', special: 'components', static: false,
                    type: { kind: 0x1d, byref: false, name: 'UnityEngine.Component[]' } });
    const setters = new Map();
    for (const current of chain) {
      iterator.writePointer(NULL);
      for (;;) {
        const method = api.invoke.classMethods(current, iterator);
        if (method.isNull())
          break;
        const name = api.invoke.methodName(method).readUtf8String();
        if (name.startsWith('set_')) {
          const signature = t.methodSignature(method);
          if (!setters.has(name) && !signature.isNull() && t.paramCount(signature) === 1)
            setters.set(name, method.toString());
          continue;
        }
        if (!name.startsWith('get_') || seen.has(name))
          continue;
        const signature = t.methodSignature(method);
        if (signature.isNull() || t.paramCount(signature) !== 0)
          continue;
        seen.add(name);
        result.push({
          name: name.substring(4),
          method: method.toString(),
          static: (api.invoke.methodFlags(method, NULL) & METHOD_STATIC) !== 0,
          type: typeInfo(t, t.returnType(signature))
        });
      }
    }
    for (const property of result)
      if (property.special === undefined)
        property.setter = setters.get(`set_${property.name}`) || null;
    propertyLists.set(key, result);
    return result;
  }

  // --- Methods: what the object inspector offers to call ------------------------

  const methodLists = new Map();

  function methods(klass) {
    // [{ name, method, static, owner }] of the methods of ``klass`` and its
    // base classes, the most derived first (an override once); no
    // constructors and no property accessors (see properties). Cached.
    const key = klass.toString();
    let result = methodLists.get(key);
    if (result !== undefined)
      return result;
    result = [];
    if (api.invoke === null) {
      methodLists.set(key, result);
      return result;
    }
    const t = typesApi();
    const seen = new Set();
    const iterator = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    for (const current of classChain(klass)) {
      const owner = layout(current).name;
      iterator.writePointer(NULL);
      for (let method = api.invoke.classMethods(current, iterator); !method.isNull();
           method = api.invoke.classMethods(current, iterator)) {
        const name = api.invoke.methodName(method).readUtf8String();
        const signature = t.methodSignature(method);
        if (signature.isNull() || name === '.ctor' || name === '.cctor')
          continue;
        const count = t.paramCount(signature);
        if ((name.startsWith('get_') && count === 0) || (name.startsWith('set_') && count === 1))
          continue;
        // Overloads differ in their parameters: "Name (int,string)"
        const full = signatureName(method) || name;
        const id = `${name}${full.substring(Math.max(0, full.indexOf(' (')))}`;
        if (seen.has(id))
          continue;
        seen.add(id);
        result.push({ name, method, owner,
                      static: (api.invoke.methodFlags(method, NULL) & METHOD_STATIC) !== 0 });
      }
    }
    methodLists.set(key, result);
    return result;
  }

  function invoke(method, object, params) {
    // { result, exception } of calling a managed method; main thread only.
    const exception = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    exception.writePointer(NULL);
    const result = api.invoke.runtimeInvoke(method, object, params, exception);
    return { result, exception: exception.readPointer() };
  }

  function getProperty(object, property, isStruct) {
    // Call a getter of ``object`` (an unboxed value for a struct).
    if (property.special === 'components')
      return components(object);
    let method = ptr(property.method);
    if (!property.static && !isStruct)
      method = api.invoke.virtualMethod(object, method);  // the override
    return invoke(method, property.static ? NULL : object, NULL);
  }

  function methodTakingType(klass, name) {
    // The method ``name`` of ``klass`` itself taking one System.Type, or null.
    const iterator = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    const paramIterator = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    iterator.writePointer(NULL);
    let found = null;
    for (let method = api.invoke.classMethods(klass, iterator); !method.isNull();
         method = api.invoke.classMethods(klass, iterator)) {
      if (api.invoke.methodName(method).readUtf8String() !== name)
        continue;
      const signature = api.types.methodSignature(method);
      paramIterator.writePointer(NULL);
      if (!signature.isNull() && api.types.paramCount(signature) === 1
          && cString(api.types.typeName(api.types.params(signature, paramIterator)))
             === 'System.Type')
        found = method;
    }
    return found;
  }

  function components(gameObject) {
    // GameObject.GetComponents(typeof(Component))
    const klass = classOf(gameObject);
    let getComponents = null;
    for (const current of classChain(klass))
      getComponents = methodTakingType(current, 'GetComponents') || getComponents;
    if (getComponents === null)
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_get_components');
    const image = api.classImage(klass);
    const component = api.invoke.classFromName(image, Memory.allocUtf8String('UnityEngine'),
                                               Memory.allocUtf8String('Component'));
    if (component.isNull())
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_component_class');
    const params = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    params.writePointer(api.invoke.typeObject(api.currentDomain(), api.types.classType(component)));
    return invoke(getComponents, gameObject, params);
  }

  // --- Calling game methods by name ---------------------------------------------

  const classesByName = new Map();

  function findClass(fullName) {
    // A class of a loaded assembly by its full name, e.g. "Game.PartyHelper".
    let klass = classesByName.get(fullName);
    if (klass !== undefined)
      return klass;
    if (api.catalog === null || api.invoke === null)
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_class_lookup');
    const dot = fullName.lastIndexOf('.');
    const space = Memory.allocUtf8String(dot < 0 ? '' : fullName.substring(0, dot));
    const name = Memory.allocUtf8String(fullName.substring(dot + 1));
    klass = null;
    for (const image of loadedImages(api.catalog)) {
      const found = api.invoke.classFromName(image, space, name);
      if (!found.isNull()) {
        klass = found;
        break;
      }
    }
    if (klass === null)
      throw hermesError('error.mono.class_not_found', { name: fullName });
    classesByName.set(fullName, klass);
    return klass;
  }

  function findMethod(klass, name, argumentCount, wantStatic) {
    // The first method ``name`` of the class or a base class taking
    // ``argumentCount`` arguments; ``wantStatic`` true/false or null for any.
    const iterator = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    for (const current of classChain(klass)) {
      iterator.writePointer(NULL);
      for (let method = api.invoke.classMethods(current, iterator); !method.isNull();
           method = api.invoke.classMethods(current, iterator)) {
        if (api.invoke.methodName(method).readUtf8String() !== name)
          continue;
        const isStatic = (api.invoke.methodFlags(method, NULL) & METHOD_STATIC) !== 0;
        if ((wantStatic === null || isStatic === wantStatic)
            && signatureOf(method).params.length === argumentCount)
          return method;
      }
    }
    const values = { class_name: layout(klass).name, method: name, count: argumentCount };
    throw wantStatic ? hermesError('error.mono.no_static_method', values)
      : hermesError('error.mono.no_method', values);
  }

  function findObject(className, named = null) {
    // A live Unity object (GameObject, component, ScriptableObject ...) of the
    // class ``className`` or a subclass, e.g. findObject("Game.PlayerController");
    // with ``named`` the one of that name, e.g. findObject(
    // "UnityEngine.GameObject", "Player(Clone)"). null if none. Asks
    // UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType(Type), so only on Unity's main
    // thread, and objects of inactive GameObjects are not found.
    const [object] = findObjects(className, named, 1);
    return object === undefined ? null : object;
  }

  // (Frida's JavaScript on Windows has no Infinity: it is NaN there.)
  function findObjects(className, named = null, limit = Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER) {
    // Up to ``limit`` of the objects findObject could give
    const klass = findClass(className);
    const unityObject = classChain(klass).find(
      current => layout(current).name === 'UnityEngine.Object');
    if (unityObject === undefined)
      throw hermesError('error.mono.not_unity_object', { class_name: className });
    const findObjects = methodTakingType(unityObject, 'FindObjectsOfType');
    if (findObjects === null)
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_find_objects');
    const params = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    params.writePointer(api.invoke.typeObject(api.currentDomain(), api.types.classType(klass)));
    const { result, exception } = invoke(findObjects, NULL, params);
    if (!exception.isNull())
      throw hermesError('error.mono.find_objects_failed');
    const found = [];
    if (result.isNull())
      return found;
    // A managed array: header, bounds, length, then the elements
    const length = result.add(3 * Process.pointerSize).readU32();
    const data = result.add(4 * Process.pointerSize);
    for (let i = 0; i < length && found.length < limit; i++) {
      const object = data.add(i * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
      if (!object.isNull() && (named === null || unityName(object) === named))
        found.push(object);
    }
    return found;
  }

  function writeReference(object, field, value) {
    // Store reference ``value`` in the field at ``field`` of ``object``.
    if (api.writeBarrier !== null && object !== null)
      api.writeBarrier(object, field, value);
    else
      field.writePointer(value);
  }

  function newString(text) {
    if (api.stringNew === null)
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_strings');
    return api.stringNew(api.currentDomain(), Memory.allocUtf8String(text));
  }

  const classNames = new Map();

  function objectClassName(object) {
    // Class of a managed object; metadata only, any thread will do.
    const t = typesApi();
    const klass = t.objectClass(object);
    const key = klass.toString();
    let text = classNames.get(key);
    if (text === undefined) {
      text = cString(t.typeName(t.classType(klass))) || '?';
      classNames.set(key, text);
    }
    return text;
  }

  // --- Catalog: the classes and methods of the loaded assemblies ----------

  const TYPEDEF_TABLE = 2;
  const TYPEDEF_TOKEN = 0x02000000;
  const METHOD_STATIC = 0x10;

  function catalogApi() {
    if (!refresh())
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_runtime');
    if (api.catalog === null)
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_catalog');
    return api.catalog;
  }

  function loadedImages(c) {
    const images = [];
    const collect = new NativeCallback(assembly => {
      images.push(c.assemblyImage(assembly));
    }, 'void', ['pointer', 'pointer']);
    c.assemblyForeach(collect, NULL);
    return images;
  }

  async function assemblies() {
    // Loading classes needs a thread Mono knows.
    const c = catalogApi();
    return onMonoThread(() => loadedImages(c).map(image => ({
      name: api.imageName(image).readUtf8String(),
      file: api.imageFile(image).readUtf8String(),
      classes: Math.max(0, c.tableRows(image, TYPEDEF_TABLE) - 1),
      mvid: imageGuid(image)
    })));
  }

  function imageGuid(image) {
    // Mono keeps the string; it is not to be freed.
    const guid = api.imageGuid === null ? NULL : api.imageGuid(image);
    return guid.isNull() ? null : guid.readUtf8String();
  }

  function methodEntry(c, method) {
    // [name, parameters, return type, static, token, full signature]
    const full = signatureName(method) || '';
    const open = full.indexOf(' (');
    const signature = c.methodSignature(method);
    return [
      c.methodName(method).readUtf8String(),
      open < 0 ? '()' : full.substring(open + 1),
      signature.isNull() ? '' : cString(c.typeName(c.returnType(signature))) || '',
      (c.methodFlags(method, NULL) & METHOD_STATIC) !== 0,
      api.methodToken(method),
      full
    ];
  }

  function parameterNames(method) {
    const t = api.types;
    if (t === null)
      return [];
    const signature = t.methodSignature(method);
    if (signature.isNull())
      return [];
    const count = t.paramCount(signature);
    const names = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize * Math.max(count, 1));
    t.paramNames(method, names);
    return Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => {
      const name = names.add(index * Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
      return name.isNull() ? `arg${index}` : name.readUtf8String();
    });
  }

  function flagsOf(c, method, implFlags) {
    // [flags, implementation flags] as Mono has them; implFlags: 4 bytes.
    implFlags.writeU32(0);
    const flags = c.methodFlags(method, implFlags);
    return [flags, implFlags.readU32()];
  }

  function imageNamed(c, assembly) {
    const image = loadedImages(c).find(
      candidate => api.imageName(candidate).readUtf8String() === assembly);
    if (image === undefined)
      throw hermesError('error.mono.assembly_not_loaded', { assembly });
    return image;
  }

  function eachClass(c, assembly, visit) {
    // visit(class name, [method, ...]) for the classes of one assembly; row
    // 1 of its type table is the <Module> pseudo class. On a Mono thread.
    const image = imageNamed(c, assembly);
    const iterator = Memory.alloc(Process.pointerSize);
    const rows = c.tableRows(image, TYPEDEF_TABLE);
    for (let row = 2; row <= rows; row++) {
      const klass = c.classGet(image, TYPEDEF_TOKEN | row);
      if (klass.isNull())
        continue;
      const methods = [];
      iterator.writePointer(NULL);
      for (;;) {
        const method = c.classMethods(klass, iterator);
        if (method.isNull())
          break;
        methods.push(method);
      }
      visit(cString(c.typeName(c.classType(klass))), methods);
    }
  }

  async function classes(assembly) {
    // [[class name, [method entry + flags + implementation flags, ...]], ...]
    // of one assembly; the trace chooses by the flags.
    const c = catalogApi();
    return onMonoThread(() => {
      const result = [];
      const implFlags = Memory.alloc(4);
      eachClass(c, assembly, (className, methods) => {
        result.push([className, methods.map(
          method => [...methodEntry(c, method), ...flagsOf(c, method, implFlags),
                     parameterNames(method)])]);
      });
      return result;
    });
  }

  async function methodsByToken(assembly, tokens) {
    // [{ className, method, entry, flags, implFlags }] of the methods with
    // these tokens, for the trace: ``entry`` as in classes.
    const c = catalogApi();
    return onMonoThread(() => {
      const image = imageNamed(c, assembly);
      const implFlags = Memory.alloc(4);
      const result = [];
      for (const token of tokens) {
        const method = api.getMethod(image, token, NULL);
        if (method.isNull())
          continue;
        const [flags, impl] = flagsOf(c, method, implFlags);
        result.push({ className: cString(c.typeName(c.classType(api.methodClass(method)))),
                      method, entry: methodEntry(c, method), flags, implFlags: impl });
      }
      return result;
    });
  }

  // --- Call graph: the IL code of methods and what its tokens name ------------

  async function methodBodies(assembly, tokens) {
    // The IL code of the methods with these tokens in one buffer of records:
    // token (u32), size (u32), code. Size 0: no code (abstract, native, ...).
    const c = catalogApi();
    if (api.il === null)
      throw hermesError('error.mono.no_il');
    return onMonoThread(() => {
      const image = imageNamed(c, assembly);
      const sizes = Memory.alloc(8);
      const bodies = tokens.map(token => [token, ilCode(image, token, sizes)]);
      const total = bodies.reduce((sum, [, code]) => sum + 8 + (code ? code.byteLength : 0), 0);
      const out = new Uint8Array(total);
      const view = new DataView(out.buffer);
      let at = 0;
      for (const [token, code] of bodies) {
        view.setUint32(at, token, true);
        view.setUint32(at + 4, code ? code.byteLength : 0, true);
        at += 8;
        if (code) {
          out.set(new Uint8Array(code), at);
          at += code.byteLength;
        }
      }
      return out.buffer;
    });
  }

  function ilCode(image, token, sizes) {
    // A method's IL code (ArrayBuffer), null if it has none. On a Mono thread.
    const method = api.getMethod(image, token, NULL);
    if (method.isNull())
      return null;
    const header = api.il.header(method);
    if (header.isNull())
      return null;
    try {
      const code = api.il.code(header, sizes, sizes.add(4));
      const size = sizes.readU32();
      return code.isNull() || size === 0 ? null : code.readByteArray(size);
    } finally {
      api.il.free(header);  // frees only a header Mono made for the call
    }
  }

  async function resolveTokens(assembly, tokens) {
    // [assembly, token, signature] of the methods that tokens in the code of
    // ``assembly`` name (MethodDef, MemberRef, MethodSpec); null for one Mono
    // cannot resolve. A generic instance keeps its definition's token and
    // names its type arguments in the signature (see resolveMethod).
    const c = catalogApi();
    return onMonoThread(() => {
      const image = imageNamed(c, assembly);
      return tokens.map(token => {
        const method = api.getMethod(image, token, NULL);
        if (method.isNull())
          return null;
        const owner = api.classImage(api.methodClass(method));
        return [api.imageName(owner).readUtf8String(), api.methodToken(method),
                signatureName(method) || ''];
      });
    });
  }

  refresh();
  return {
    id: 'mono',
    refresh, locate, name, describe, identify, compile, assemblies, classes, methodsByToken,
    methodBodies, resolveTokens,
    checkAll, compileAll, describeAll, cancelBatches, batchesRunning, prepare,
    // compileAll changes nothing in the game that would need undoing
    releaseCode() {},
    objectClassName, classOf, layout, staticData, onRuntimeThread: onMonoThread, unityName,
    onMainThread, drainMain, properties, getProperty, methods, signatureOf, findClass,
    findMethod, findObject, findObjects, newString, invoke, classChain, writeReference, resolve: resolveMethod,
    virtualMethod: (object, method) => api.invoke.virtualMethod(object, method)
  };
})();

registerEngine(mono);

```

`hermes/engines/mono/agent.py`:

```py
"""C# method names for JIT code of Mono games (e.g. Unity games using Mono).

Mono compiles C# methods into anonymous memory, so a code address there has
no module + offset. The Mono runtime knows which method it belongs to. The
agent snippet in agent.js asks it through Mono's embedding API, which the runtime
library (``libmonobdwgc-2.0.so``, ``libmonosgen-2.0.so``, ``libmono.so``;
under Wine/Proton ``mono-2.0-bdwgc.dll``, ``mono-2.0-sgen.dll``, ``mono.dll``)
exports.

``MONO_AGENT_SOURCE`` is the Mono engine adapter of the agent: it defines
``mono`` and registers it (see hermes/engines/base.py for the contract the
features use through ``engine``; ``onMonoThread`` is exported there as
``onRuntimeThread``). ``mono`` has:

``mono.refresh()``
    Look for the Mono runtime (again, at most every two seconds) and return
    whether it is loaded. Call it from the agent's own thread.
``mono.locate(address)``
    Find the JIT method containing ``address`` and remember it. Returns the
    location, ``null`` (no JIT code) or ``undefined`` (unknown: no Mono
    runtime, or this thread is no Mono thread; ask again later). Only call it
    on a thread that runs managed code: Mono's lock-free JIT table expects a
    thread it knows, and the thread's domain is the one its code lives in.
    That makes it usable in an exception handler for a trap in JIT code.
``mono.name(address)``
    ``Namespace.Class:Method+0x1a`` for an address ``locate`` found, from
    any thread, else ``null``. It never searches the JIT table itself.
``mono.describe(address)``
    ``locate`` and ``name`` in one, for threads that run managed code.
``mono.identify(address)``
    What finds the code again after a restart, for an address ``locate``
    found: ``{image, file, token, method, offset}`` (assembly name and path,
    metadata token, ``Namespace.Class:Method (params)``, offset in its code),
    else ``null``. Token and offset stay valid while the game is unchanged.
``mono.assemblies()`` / ``mono.classes(assembly)``
    The catalog: the loaded assemblies (``{name, file, classes}``) and the
    classes of one with their methods (see ``classes`` below).
``mono.methods(assembly)`` / ``mono.compileAll(methods, progress)``
    For the trace: the methods of an assembly with their flags, and (a
    promise of) the code of many methods at once (``{start, size}`` or null
    each); ``mono.checkAll(methods)`` tells which use COM interop, whose
    compilation hangs on Linux. ``mono.describeAll(addresses)`` names many addresses like
    ``describe`` does. Both run C on a thread of Mono's own (a batch) and
    keep the agent's thread free; ``mono.cancelBatches()`` stops them.
``mono.prepare(identity)`` / ``mono.objectClassName(object)``
    For the method monitor: ``compile`` plus the method's signature, and
    the class name of a managed object.
``mono.classOf(object)`` / ``mono.layout(klass)``
    For inspecting objects: the class of an object (null for an address
    that holds none) and the fields of a class (cached).
``mono.unityName(object)``
    The name of a GameObject or component, by calling Unity's
    ``UnityEngine.Object.get_name``; only on the game's main thread.
``mono.onMainThread(work)`` / ``mono.drainMain()``
    Run game code on Unity's main thread, as soon as it runs a script
    method (a promise); ``drainMain`` runs queued work if called there.
``mono.findClass(name)`` / ``mono.findMethod(klass, name, count, static)``
    Look up game code by name, to call it with ``mono.invoke(method, this,
    params)`` (main thread); ``mono.signatureOf(method)`` describes it.
``mono.findObject(className, name)``
    A live Unity object of a class, optionally the one of that Unity name,
    through ``UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType`` (main thread).
``mono.resolve(identity)``
    The method of an ``identify`` result (or ``CatalogMethod.identity()``),
    to call it; on a thread Mono knows.
``mono.properties(klass)`` / ``mono.getProperty(object, property, isStruct)``
    The parameterless getters of a class (and a GameObject's components),
    and calling one on the main thread: ``{result, exception}``.
``mono.compile(identity)``
    Look up the method of an ``identify`` result, let Mono compile it (or
    return the code it has) and return (a promise of) ``{start, size}`` of
    its code. Rejects if the assembly is not loaded or the method has changed.

``onMonoThread``, ``compile``, ``prepare``, ``assemblies``, ``classes`` and
``methods`` return promises: the work runs on a thread Mono knows while the
agent's thread stays free (see ``onMonoThread``).

The agent's own thread is deliberately not attached to Mono: an attached
thread is stopped by every garbage collection, also while it holds the
agent's lock, which a game thread trapped in an exception handler may wait
for. ``compile`` runs on a short-lived thread of its own instead, which
Mono forgets again when it ends.
"""

from hermes.agent.source import load_agent_source


MONO_AGENT_SOURCE = load_agent_source(__file__)


```

`hermes/engines/registry.py`:

```py
"""The engine adapters hermes knows, and the agent source built from them.

To add an engine, write an adapter (see base.py) and list it in ``ENGINES``;
the order is the order in which the agent looks for their runtimes.
"""

from hermes.engines.base import ENGINE_FACADE_SOURCE, ENGINE_PRELUDE_SOURCE
from hermes.engines.il2cpp.adapter import Il2CppAdapter
from hermes.engines.mono.adapter import MonoAdapter
from hermes.agent.platform import PLATFORM_AGENT_SOURCE
from hermes.engines.unreal.adapter import UnrealAdapter

ENGINES = (MonoAdapter(), Il2CppAdapter(), UnrealAdapter())

# Agents that work with managed code start with this: the platform helpers,
# every adapter, and ``engine``.
ENGINE_AGENT_SOURCE = (PLATFORM_AGENT_SOURCE + ENGINE_PRELUDE_SOURCE
                       + "".join(adapter.agent_source for adapter in ENGINES)
                       + ENGINE_FACADE_SOURCE)


def detect_engine(pid, proc_root="/proc"):
    """Return the adapter of the engine runtime ``pid`` has loaded, or None."""
    return next((adapter for adapter in ENGINES if adapter.detect(pid, proc_root)), None)


def engine_by_id(engine_id):
    """Return the adapter with ``engine_id`` (identities without one are Mono's)."""
    engine_id = engine_id or "mono"
    return next((adapter for adapter in ENGINES if adapter.id == engine_id), None)


def resolve_engine(pid, engine=None):
    """Return ``engine``, else the adapter detected in ``pid``, else the first one.

    The runtime may load only after hermes attached; the agent finds it then
    by itself, so a feature can start before detection succeeds.
    """
    return engine or detect_engine(pid) or ENGINES[0]

```

`hermes/engines/unreal/adapter.py`:

```py
"""The Unreal Engine adapter (Unreal Engine 4.23 and later, 64-bit)."""

import re

from hermes.engines import base
from hermes.engines.unreal.agent import UNREAL_AGENT_SOURCE

# A monolithic game is one executable, <Project>-<Platform>-<Configuration>;
# a modular build loads the engine as libraries (UE4-CoreUObject.dll ...).
_RUNTIME_NAMES = re.compile(
    r"-(Win64|Win32|WinGDK|Linux|LinuxArm64)-(Shipping|Test|Development|DebugGame)(\.exe)?$"
    r"|^(UE4|UE5|UnrealEditor)-CoreUObject",
    re.IGNORECASE)

# Packages of the engine and its plugins rather than of the game: the C++
# modules of /Script/ and the content of /Engine/ and engine plugins.
_ENGINE_MODULES = (
    "CoreUObject", "Engine", "AIModule", "AnimGraphRuntime", "AnimationBudgetAllocator",
    "AnimationLocomotionLibrary", "AnimationSharing", "ACLPlugin", "ActorLayerUtilities",
    "ActorSequence", "AnalyticsBlueprintLibrary", "AppleImageUtils", "AssetRegistry", "AssetTags",
    "Audio", "AutomationUtils", "BinkMediaPlayer", "CableComponent", "Chaos", "CinematicCamera",
    "ClothingSystem", "ColorCorrectRegions", "Common", "ConsoleVariables", "Constraints",
    "ControlRig", "CustomMeshComponent", "Dataflow", "DataRegistry", "DatasmithContent",
    "DeveloperSettings", "DLSS", "EngineSettings", "EnhancedInput", "EyeTracker", "FieldSystem",
    "Foliage", "GameFeatures", "GameplayAbilities", "GameplayCameras", "GameplayTags",
    "GameplayTasks", "Geometry", "GLTF", "HeadMountedDisplay", "Houdini", "IKRig",
    "ImageWriteQueue", "ImgMedia", "InputCore", "Interchange", "InteractiveToolsFramework",
    "Json", "Landscape", "LevelSequence", "LocalizableMessage", "LocationServices", "Mass",
    "Media", "MeshDescription", "MeshModeling", "Metasound", "ModelingComponents",
    "ModelViewViewModel", "ModularGameplay", "MobilePatchingUtils", "Movie", "MRMesh",
    "MultiUserClient", "NavigationSystem", "NetCore", "Niagara", "NIS", "Online",
    "OpenColorIO", "Paper2D", "PCG", "PhysicsCore", "ProceduralMeshComponent", "PropertyPath",
    "ReplicationGraph", "ResonanceAudio", "RigVM", "SequencerScripting", "Slate",
    "SmartObjects", "StateTree", "StaticMeshDescription", "Streamline", "StructUtils",
    "Synthesis", "TemplateSequence", "TimeManagement", "TraceUtilities", "TypedElement", "UMG",
    "VariantManagerContent", "Water", "Xe",
)


class UnrealAdapter(base.EngineAdapter):
    """Unreal's reflection: packages, classes and UFunctions found in memory."""

    id = "unreal"
    display_name = "Unreal Engine"
    capabilities = frozenset({base.NAMING, base.CATALOG, base.TRACE, base.MONITOR,
                              base.METHOD_HOOKS, base.CALL, base.CALL_FOUND, base.GAS})
    agent_source = UNREAL_AGENT_SOURCE
    # All its code is ordinary machine code in modules; the native trace ran
    # in EVERSPACE (UE4).
    native_tools = True
    framework_prefixes = (tuple(f"/Script/{module}" for module in _ENGINE_MODULES)
                          + ("/Engine/", "/Paper2D/", "/Niagara/", "/Wwise", "/Script/AkAudio"))

    def is_runtime_path(self, path):
        # A packaged game runs from <Project>/Binaries/<Platform>/; an
        # executable of the same name in the game's root only starts it.
        parts = _path_parts(path)
        return (len(parts) >= 3 and parts[-3].lower() == "binaries"
                and self.is_runtime_file(parts[-1]))

    def is_runtime_file(self, name):
        return _RUNTIME_NAMES.search(name) is not None


def _path_parts(path):
    return [part for part in re.split(r"[\\/]", path) if part]


def bootstrapped_game(path, paths):
    """Return the running game that the bootstrap executable ``path`` started.

    A packaged Unreal game's root holds a small executable that only starts
    the real one in <Project>/Binaries/<Platform>/ (Gothic 1 Remake gives both
    the same name). Returns the entry of ``paths`` that is such a game below
    ``path``'s directory, or None if ``path`` is no bootstrap of a running game.
    """
    root = [part.lower() for part in _path_parts(path)[:-1]]
    if not root or (len(root) >= 2 and root[-2] == "binaries"):
        return None
    for candidate in paths:
        parts = _path_parts(candidate)
        if (len(parts) == len(root) + 4
                and [part.lower() for part in parts[:len(root)]] == root
                and parts[-3].lower() == "binaries"
                and _RUNTIME_NAMES.search(parts[-1])):
            return candidate
    return None

```

`hermes/engines/unreal/agent.js`:

```js
const unreal = (() => {
  // The game's executable (<Project>-<Platform>-<Configuration>), or the
  // CoreUObject library of a modular build.
  const RUNTIME_NAME = new RegExp('-(Win64|Win32|WinGDK|Linux|LinuxArm64)-' +
    '(Shipping|Test|Development|DebugGame)(\\.exe)?$|^(UE4|UE5|UnrealEditor)-CoreUObject', 'i');
  const SEARCH_INTERVAL = 2000;
  // How long a snapshot of the object table serves before it is read anew
  const SNAPSHOT_AGE = 15000;
  const TWO32 = 4294967296;
  let module = null;
  let lastSearch = -Infinity;
  let ue = null;
  let snapshot = null;
  // package group -> its classes (see packageIndex)
  let packages = null;

  function refresh() {
    // Cheap: only the module's name. The object table is looked for when a
    // feature first needs it (see reflection).
    if (module !== null)
      return true;
    const now = Date.now();
    if (now - lastSearch < SEARCH_INTERVAL)
      return false;
    lastSearch = now;
    module = Process.enumerateModules().find(candidate => RUNTIME_NAME.test(candidate.name))
      || null;
    return module !== null;
  }

  // --- Finding the name pool and the object table ---------------------------
  // Both are globals in the module's data (FNamePool, GUObjectArray), found by
  // their shape rather than by code signatures, so game updates rarely matter.

  function u64(view, at) {
    return view.getUint32(at, true) + view.getUint32(at + 4, true) * TWO32;
  }

  function dataRanges() {
    // The module's writable data. On Linux most of .bss is an anonymous
    // mapping right after the module, which Frida does not count to it.
    const own = module.enumerateRanges('rw-');
    const ends = new Set(own.map(range => range.base.add(range.size).toString()));
    const following = Process.enumerateRanges('rw-').filter(range =>
      range.file === undefined && ends.has(range.base.toString()));
    const ranges = [];
    for (const range of own.concat(following)) {
      try {
        ranges.push({ base: range.base, view: new DataView(range.base.readByteArray(range.size)) });
      } catch (_error) {
        // a guard page or the like
      }
    }
    return ranges;
  }

  function latin1(pointer, length) {
    return String.fromCharCode(...new Uint8Array(pointer.readByteArray(length)));
  }

  function entryText(entry) {
    // An FNameEntry: a 16-bit header (wide flag, probe hash, length) and the text.
    const header = entry.readU16();
    const length = header >> 6;
    return (header & 1) ? entry.add(2).readUtf16String(length) : latin1(entry.add(2), length);
  }

  // FNamePool: a lock, CurrentBlock, CurrentByteCursor, Blocks[8192]. The
  // first block starts with "None" and "ByteProperty".
  const MAX_BLOCKS = 8192;
  const BLOCK_BYTES = 0x20000;

  function findNamePool(ranges) {
    for (const { base, view } of ranges) {
      for (let at = 8; at + 16 <= view.byteLength; at += 8) {
        const current = view.getUint32(at - 8, true);
        if (current >= MAX_BLOCKS || view.getUint32(at - 4, true) > BLOCK_BYTES
            || u64(view, at) === 0)
          continue;
        const last = at + 8 * current;
        if (last + 8 > view.byteLength || u64(view, last) === 0
            || (last + 16 <= view.byteLength && u64(view, last + 8) !== 0))
          continue;
        try {
          const first = ptr(u64(view, at));
          if (entryText(first) === 'None' && entryText(first.add(6)) === 'ByteProperty')
            return base.add(at);
        } catch (_error) {
          // not readable: no pool
        }
      }
    }
    throw hermesError('error.unreal.no_name_pool');
  }

  // FChunkedFixedUObjectArray: Objects, PreAllocatedObjects, MaxElements,
  // NumElements, MaxChunks, NumChunks. Chunks hold 65536 FUObjectItems, whose
  // size differs between versions and games (Object pointer first).
  const CHUNK = 0x10000;
  const ITEM_SIZES = [0x18, 0x10, 0x14, 0x20, 0x28];
  // UObjectBase: vtable, ObjectFlags, InternalIndex, ClassPrivate, NamePrivate, OuterPrivate
  const OBJECT_FLAGS = 0x08, OBJECT_INDEX = 0x0c, OBJECT_CLASS = 0x10, OBJECT_NAME = 0x18,
    OBJECT_OUTER = 0x20;

  function findObjectArray(ranges) {
    for (const { base, view } of ranges) {
      for (let at = 0; at + 0x20 <= view.byteLength; at += 4) {
        const max = view.getInt32(at + 0x10, true), count = view.getInt32(at + 0x14, true);
        if (count <= 0x1000 || max < count || max > 0x4000000
            || view.getInt32(at + 0x18, true) !== Math.ceil(max / CHUNK)
            || view.getInt32(at + 0x1c, true) !== Math.ceil(count / CHUNK)
            || u64(view, at) === 0)
          continue;
        const table = base.add(at);
        const itemSize = objectItemSize(table.readPointer());
        if (itemSize !== null)
          return { table, itemSize };
      }
    }
    throw hermesError('error.unreal.no_object_array');
  }

  function objectItemSize(chunks) {
    // The item size for which the objects know their own index.
    const items = chunks.readPointer();
    let best = null;
    for (const size of ITEM_SIZES) {
      let found = 0;
      for (let i = 1; i <= 32; i++) {
        try {
          const object = items.add(i * size).readPointer();
          if (!object.isNull() && object.add(OBJECT_INDEX).readS32() === i)
            found++;
        } catch (_error) {
          // not this size
        }
      }
      if (found >= 16 && (best === null || found > best.found))
        best = { size, found };
    }
    return best === null ? null : best.size;
  }

  // --- Names and objects --------------------------------------------------------

  const names = new Map();

  function nameText(index, number) {
    let text = names.get(index);
    if (text === undefined) {
      const block = ue.names.add(8 * (index >>> 16)).readPointer();
      text = entryText(block.add((index & 0xffff) * 2));
      names.set(index, text);
    }
    return number > 0 ? `${text}_${number - 1}` : text;
  }

  function fieldName(pointer) {
    return nameText(pointer.readU32(), pointer.add(4).readU32());
  }

  function readSnapshot() {
    // Every live object: address, class, name, outer (numbers, so that maps
    // can key by them). Read in one go per object; an object freed meanwhile
    // is skipped.
    const table = ue.objects.table;
    const size = ue.objects.itemSize;
    const chunks = table.readPointer();
    const count = table.add(0x14).readS32();
    const s = { address: [], klass: [], name: [], number: [], outer: [], index: new Map(),
                read: Date.now() };
    for (let chunk = 0; chunk * CHUNK < count; chunk++) {
      const inChunk = Math.min(CHUNK, count - chunk * CHUNK);
      const items = chunks.add(8 * chunk).readPointer();
      if (items.isNull())
        continue;
      const view = new DataView(items.readByteArray(inChunk * size));
      for (let i = 0; i < inChunk; i++) {
        const address = u64(view, i * size);
        if (address === 0)
          continue;
        let object;
        try {
          object = new DataView(ptr(address).readByteArray(OBJECT_OUTER + 8));
        } catch (_error) {
          continue;
        }
        s.index.set(address, s.address.length);
        s.address.push(address);
        s.klass.push(u64(object, OBJECT_CLASS));
        s.name.push(object.getUint32(OBJECT_NAME, true));
        s.number.push(object.getUint32(OBJECT_NAME + 4, true));
        s.outer.push(u64(object, OBJECT_OUTER));
      }
    }
    return s;
  }

  function objects() {
    if (snapshot === null || Date.now() - snapshot.read > SNAPSHOT_AGE) {
      snapshot = readSnapshot();
      packages = null;
    }
    return snapshot;
  }

  function objectName(s, i) {
    return nameText(s.name[i], s.number[i]);
  }

  function nameOfAddress(address) {
    const s = objects();
    const i = s.index.get(address);
    return i === undefined ? null : objectName(s, i);
  }

  // --- Layout: where the reflection structures keep their fields -----------------
  // Found on objects every game has (CoreUObject's Class, Object, Vector,
  // Transform), since engine versions and build settings move them.

  function reflection() {
    if (ue !== null && ue.layout !== undefined)
      return ue;
    if (!refresh())
      throw hermesError('error.unreal.no_game');
    const ranges = dataRanges();
    ue = { names: findNamePool(ranges), objects: findObjectArray(ranges) };
    ue.layout = findLayout();
    return ue;
  }

  function findLayout() {
    const s = objects();
    const core = s.address.find((address, i) => s.outer[i] === 0
                                && objectName(s, i) === '/Script/CoreUObject');
    if (core === undefined)
      throw hermesError('error.unreal.no_core_package');
    const inCore = new Map();
    s.address.forEach((address, i) => {
      if (s.outer[i] === core)
        inCore.set(`${objectName(s, i)}|${s.klass[i]}`, address);
    });
    const classClass = s.address.find((address, i) =>
      s.outer[i] === core && s.klass[i] === address && objectName(s, i) === 'Class');
    if (classClass === undefined)
      throw hermesError('error.unreal.no_core_class', { name: 'Class' });
    const coreClass = name => {
      const found = inCore.get(`${name}|${classClass}`);
      if (found === undefined)
        throw hermesError('error.unreal.no_core_class', { name });
      return found;
    };
    const struct = coreClass('Struct'), functionClass = coreClass('Function');
    const objectClass = coreClass('Object'), scriptStruct = coreClass('ScriptStruct');
    const coreStruct = name => {
      const found = inCore.get(`${name}|${scriptStruct}`);
      if (found === undefined)
        throw hermesError('error.unreal.no_core_struct', { name });
      return ptr(found);
    };
    const L = { classClass, functionClass, structClass: struct, scriptStruct, packageClass:
                coreClass('Package'), enumClass: coreClass('Enum') };
    const pointerAt = (base, offset) => u64(new DataView(ptr(base).add(offset).readByteArray(8)), 0);
    const search = (from, to, step, test, what) => {
      for (let at = from; at < to; at += step) {
        try {
          if (test(at))
            return at;
        } catch (_error) {
          // not there
        }
      }
      throw hermesError('error.unreal.unknown_layout', { what });
    };
    L.next = 0x28;  // UField::Next, right after UObjectBase
    L.superStruct = search(0x30, 0x90, 8, at => pointerAt(classClass, at) === struct,
                           'UStruct::SuperStruct');
    L.children = search(L.superStruct + 8, L.superStruct + 0x40, 8, at => {
      const child = s.index.get(pointerAt(objectClass, at));
      return child !== undefined && s.klass[child] === functionClass;
    }, 'UStruct::Children');

    // FField: vtable, FFieldClass, owner, Next, NamePrivate, FlagsPrivate;
    // FProperty: ArrayDim, ElementSize, PropertyFlags, ..., Offset_Internal
    const vector = coreStruct('Vector');
    L.fieldClass = 8;
    const named = (field, offset, text) => !field.isNull() && fieldName(field.add(offset)) === text;
    for (let at = L.children + 8; at < L.children + 0x30 && L.childProperties === undefined;
      at += 8) {
      const first = vector.add(at).readPointer();
      for (const offset of [0x20, 0x28, 0x18, 0x30]) {
        try {
          if (named(first, offset, 'X')) {
            L.childProperties = at;
            L.fieldName = offset;
            break;
          }
        } catch (_error) {
          // not a field
        }
      }
    }
    if (L.childProperties === undefined)
      throw hermesError('error.unreal.unknown_layout', { what: 'UStruct::ChildProperties' });
    const x = vector.add(L.childProperties).readPointer();
    L.fieldNext = search(0x10, L.fieldName, 8,
      at => named(x.add(at).readPointer(), L.fieldName, 'Y'), 'FField::Next');
    const y = x.add(L.fieldNext).readPointer();
    const z = y.add(L.fieldNext).readPointer();
    L.arrayDim = search(L.fieldName + 8, L.fieldName + 0x30, 4, at =>
      x.add(at).readS32() === 1 && [4, 8].includes(x.add(at + 4).readS32())
      && y.add(at).readS32() === 1 && y.add(at + 4).readS32() === x.add(at + 4).readS32(),
    'FProperty::ArrayDim');
    L.elementSize = L.arrayDim + 4;
    L.propertyFlags = L.arrayDim + 8;
    const component = x.add(L.elementSize).readS32();
    L.offset = search(L.propertyFlags + 8, L.propertyFlags + 0x20, 4, at =>
      x.add(at).readS32() === 0 && y.add(at).readS32() === component
      && z.add(at).readS32() === 2 * component, 'FProperty::Offset_Internal');
    L.propertiesSize = search(L.childProperties + 8, L.childProperties + 0x20, 4,
      at => vector.add(at).readS32() === 3 * component, 'UStruct::PropertiesSize');
    L.script = L.propertiesSize + 8;  // after MinAlignment: TArray<uint8> of bytecode

    // What a property type adds to FProperty starts at its end: found as the
    // struct of FTransform's Rotation (an FQuat).
    const transform = coreStruct('Transform');
    const quat = coreStruct('Quat');
    let rotation = transform.add(L.childProperties).readPointer();
    while (!rotation.isNull() && fieldName(rotation.add(L.fieldName)) !== 'Rotation')
      rotation = rotation.add(L.fieldNext).readPointer();
    if (rotation.isNull())
      throw hermesError('error.unreal.no_rotation');
    L.extra = search((L.offset + 4 + 7) & ~7, L.offset + 0x60, 8,
      at => rotation.add(at).readPointer().equals(quat), 'the end of FProperty');

    // UFunction: FunctionFlags, NumParms, ParmsSize, ReturnValueOffset, ...
    // Func. UObject's ExecuteUbergraph(int32) is the sample: 1 parameter, 4
    // bytes, no return value. It runs Blueprint code: its Func is the
    // script interpreter (UObject::ProcessInternal).
    const ubergraph = ptr(objectClass).add(L.children).readPointer();
    if (ubergraph.isNull() || nameOfAddress(Number(ubergraph.toString())) !== 'ExecuteUbergraph')
      throw hermesError('error.unreal.no_execute_ubergraph');
    L.functionFlags = search(L.propertiesSize, 0x180, 4, at =>
      ubergraph.add(at + 4).readU8() === 1 && ubergraph.add(at + 6).readU16() === 4
      && ubergraph.add(at + 8).readU16() === 0xffff, 'UFunction::FunctionFlags');
    const inModule = address => {
      if (address.isNull())
        return false;
      const owner = Process.findModuleByAddress(address);
      return owner !== null && owner.name === module.name;
    };
    L.func = search(L.functionFlags + 0x10, L.functionFlags + 0x48, 8,
      at => inModule(ubergraph.add(at).readPointer()), 'UFunction::Func');
    L.processInternal = ubergraph.add(L.func).readPointer();
    return L;
  }

  // --- Types of properties ----------------------------------------------------------

  const CPF_PARM = 0x80, CPF_OUT_PARM = 0x100, CPF_RETURN_PARM = 0x400,
    CPF_REFERENCE_PARM = 0x8000000;
  const prefixes = new Map();

  function superOf(klass) {
    return Number(ptr(klass).add(ue.layout.superStruct).readPointer().toString());
  }

  function cppName(klass) {
    // UE's C++ name of a class: AActor for actors, UObject for the rest.
    if (klass === 0)
      return '?';
    let prefix = prefixes.get(klass);
    if (prefix === undefined) {
      prefix = 'U';
      for (let current = klass; current !== 0; current = superOf(current)) {
        if (nameOfAddress(current) === 'Actor') {
          prefix = 'A';
          break;
        }
      }
      prefixes.set(klass, prefix);
    }
    return prefix + nameOfAddress(klass);
  }

  function pointerField(field, offset) {
    return Number(field.add(offset).readPointer().toString());
  }

  function arrayInner(field) {
    // FArrayProperty's Inner; UE5 put ArrayFlags before it.
    const at = field.add(ue.layout.extra);
    const first = at.readPointer();
    return !first.isNull() && isProperty(first) ? first : at.add(Process.pointerSize).readPointer();
  }

  function propertyType(field) {
    // The C++ type of an FProperty, e.g. TArray<FVector> or AActor*.
    const L = ue.layout;
    const kind = fieldName(field.add(L.fieldClass).readPointer());
    const extra = offset => pointerField(field, L.extra + offset);
    const inner = offset => {
      const property = field.add(L.extra + offset).readPointer();
      return property.isNull() ? '?' : propertyType(property);
    };
    switch (kind) {
      case 'BoolProperty': return 'bool';
      case 'Int8Property': return 'int8';
      case 'Int16Property': return 'int16';
      case 'IntProperty': return 'int32';
      case 'Int64Property': return 'int64';
      case 'UInt16Property': return 'uint16';
      case 'UInt32Property': return 'uint32';
      case 'UInt64Property': return 'uint64';
      case 'FloatProperty': return 'float';
      case 'DoubleProperty': return 'double';
      case 'StrProperty': return 'FString';
      case 'NameProperty': return 'FName';
      case 'TextProperty': return 'FText';
      case 'ByteProperty': return extra(0) === 0 ? 'uint8' : nameOfAddress(extra(0));
      case 'EnumProperty': return nameOfAddress(extra(8)) || 'enum';
      case 'StructProperty': return `F${nameOfAddress(extra(0))}`;
      case 'ObjectProperty':
      case 'ObjectPtrProperty': return `${cppName(extra(0))}*`;
      case 'ClassProperty':
      case 'ClassPtrProperty': return `TSubclassOf<${cppName(extra(8))}>`;
      case 'WeakObjectProperty': return `TWeakObjectPtr<${cppName(extra(0))}>`;
      case 'LazyObjectProperty': return `TLazyObjectPtr<${cppName(extra(0))}>`;
      case 'SoftObjectProperty': return `TSoftObjectPtr<${cppName(extra(0))}>`;
      case 'SoftClassProperty': return `TSoftClassPtr<${cppName(extra(8))}>`;
      case 'InterfaceProperty': return `TScriptInterface<I${nameOfAddress(extra(0))}>`;
      case 'ArrayProperty': {
        const element = arrayInner(field);
        return `TArray<${element.isNull() ? '?' : propertyType(element)}>`;
      }
      case 'SetProperty': return `TSet<${inner(0)}>`;
      case 'MapProperty': return `TMap<${inner(0)}, ${inner(8)}>`;
      case 'DelegateProperty':
      case 'MulticastInlineDelegateProperty':
      case 'MulticastSparseDelegateProperty':
        return (nameOfAddress(extra(0)) || kind).replace(/__DelegateSignature$/, '');
      default: return kind.replace(/Property$/, '');
    }
  }

  function parameters(fn) {
    // [{ name, type, out, ret }] of a UFunction's parameters, in order.
    const L = ue.layout;
    const result = [];
    for (let field = ptr(fn).add(L.childProperties).readPointer(); !field.isNull();
      field = field.add(L.fieldNext).readPointer()) {
      const flags = field.add(L.propertyFlags).readU32();
      if (!(flags & CPF_PARM))
        continue;
      result.push({
        name: fieldName(field.add(L.fieldName)),
        type: propertyType(field),
        out: (flags & CPF_OUT_PARM) !== 0 && !(flags & CPF_RETURN_PARM),
        ref: (flags & CPF_REFERENCE_PARM) !== 0,
        ret: (flags & CPF_RETURN_PARM) !== 0
      });
    }
    return result;
  }

  // --- Packages: what the catalog calls assemblies --------------------------------
  // The functions of the native classes of one C++ module are in /Script/<Module>.
  // Each Blueprint lives in a package of its own (/Game/Folder/.../BP_Name);
  // they are grouped by their first folder (/Game/Folder).

  const FUNC_NATIVE = 0x400, FUNC_STATIC = 0x2000, FUNC_DELEGATE = 0x100000;
  // ECMA-335's abstract flag, which the trace understands: no code to hook
  const METHOD_ABSTRACT = 0x0400;

  function packageGroup(name) {
    if (name.startsWith('/Script/'))
      return name;
    const parts = name.split('/');
    return parts.length > 3 ? parts.slice(0, 3).join('/') : parts.slice(0, -1).join('/') || name;
  }

  function isClass(s, klass, cache) {
    // Whether an object of class ``klass`` is a class (Class, a Blueprint's
    // generated class, ...): its class derives from Class.
    let result = cache.get(klass);
    if (result === undefined) {
      result = false;
      for (let current = klass; current !== 0; current = superOf(current)) {
        if (current === ue.layout.classClass) {
          result = true;
          break;
        }
      }
      cache.set(klass, result);
    }
    return result;
  }

  function packageIndex() {
    // { group: { classes: [{ address, name, package }], packages: Set } }
    reflection();
    const s = objects();
    if (packages !== null)
      return packages;
    const classKinds = new Map();
    packages = new Map();
    for (let i = 0; i < s.address.length; i++) {
      const outer = s.outer[i];
      if (outer === 0 || !isClass(s, s.klass[i], classKinds))
        continue;
      const owner = s.index.get(outer);
      if (owner === undefined || s.outer[owner] !== 0)
        continue;  // a class inside another object
      const packageName = objectName(s, owner);
      const group = packageGroup(packageName);
      let entry = packages.get(group);
      if (entry === undefined) {
        entry = { classes: [], packages: new Set() };
        packages.set(group, entry);
      }
      entry.packages.add(packageName);
      entry.classes.push({ address: s.address[i], name: objectName(s, i), package: packageName });
    }
    return packages;
  }

  function functionsOf(klass) {
    // The UFunctions a class declares (or overrides), in declaration order.
    const L = ue.layout;
    const s = objects();
    const result = [];
    for (let field = ptr(klass).add(L.children).readPointer(); !field.isNull();
      field = field.add(L.next).readPointer()) {
      const i = s.index.get(Number(field.toString()));
      if (i !== undefined)
        result.push({ address: field, name: objectName(s, i) });
    }
    return result;
  }

  function fnv(text, hash = 0x811c9dc5) {
    for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++)
      hash = Math.imul(hash ^ text.charCodeAt(i), 0x01000193) >>> 0;
    return hash;
  }

  function token(entry, fn) {
    // Stable over restarts: object indexes are not.
    return fnv(`${entry.package}.${entry.name}:${fn.name}`) & 0x7fffffff;
  }

  function groupNamed(assembly) {
    const group = packageIndex().get(assembly);
    if (group === undefined)
      throw hermesError('error.unreal.package_not_loaded', { package: assembly });
    return group;
  }

  function assemblies() {
    const result = [];
    for (const [name, group] of packageIndex()) {
      // The build id of the catalog cache: what the group declares
      let hash = fnv(`${module.name}|${module.size}`);
      let functions = 0;
      for (const klass of group.classes) {
        for (const fn of functionsOf(klass.address)) {
          hash = fnv(`${klass.package}.${klass.name}:${fn.name};`, hash);
          functions++;
        }
      }
      if (functions > 0)
        result.push({ name, file: group.packages.values().next().value,
                      classes: group.classes.length, mvid: `${hash.toString(16)}-${functions}` });
    }
    return result;
  }

  function functionInfo(fn) {
    // { flags, code, script } of a UFunction: its FunctionFlags, Func, and
    // the size of its Blueprint bytecode.
    const L = ue.layout;
    return {
      flags: fn.add(L.functionFlags).readU32(),
      code: fn.add(L.func).readPointer(),
      script: fn.add(L.script + Process.pointerSize).readS32()
    };
  }

  function methodEntry(klass, fn) {
    // [name, parameters, return type, static, token, full signature, flags,
    // implementation flags] as the Mono adapter has them; flags only say
    // which functions have no code (METHOD_ABSTRACT).
    const params = parameters(fn.address);
    const ret = params.find(param => param.ret);
    const types = params.filter(param => !param.ret)
      .map(param => `${param.type}${param.out || param.ref ? '&' : ''}`).join(',');
    const info = functionInfo(fn.address);
    const codeless = info.code.isNull() || (info.flags & FUNC_DELEGATE) !== 0
      || (!(info.flags & FUNC_NATIVE) && info.script <= 0);
    return [
      fn.name, `(${types})`, ret === undefined ? 'void' : ret.type,
      (info.flags & FUNC_STATIC) !== 0, token(klass, fn),
      `${klass.name}:${fn.name} (${types})`, codeless ? METHOD_ABSTRACT : 0, 0
    ];
  }

  function classes(assembly) {
    // [[class name, [method entry, ...]], ...] of a package group
    const result = [];
    for (const klass of groupNamed(assembly).classes) {
      const methods = [];
      for (const fn of functionsOf(klass.address)) {
        try {
          methods.push(methodEntry(klass, fn));
        } catch (_error) {
          // freed meanwhile (a Blueprint unloaded)
        }
      }
      result.push([klass.name, methods]);
    }
    return result;
  }

  function methodsByToken(assembly, tokens) {
    // [{ className, method, entry, flags, implFlags }] for the trace; method
    // is the UFunction.
    const wanted = new Set(tokens);
    const result = [];
    for (const klass of groupNamed(assembly).classes) {
      try {
        for (const fn of functionsOf(klass.address)) {
          if (!wanted.has(token(klass, fn)))
            continue;
          const entry = methodEntry(klass, fn);
```
