`hermes/ui/widgets/assemblies.py`:

```py
"""Assembly selection: which assemblies of a Mono game the catalog and the trace read.

The window lists the assemblies the game has loaded; the ticked ones are
saved per program (see hermes.features.assemblies). The catalog and the
trace follow the saved selection at once.
"""

from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Qt, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
)
from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

from hermes.core import messages
from hermes.engines.registry import resolve_engine
from hermes.features.assemblies import missing_assemblies
from hermes.features.catalog import CatalogWorker
from hermes.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color
from hermes.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns
from hermes.ui.workers import keep_until_finished



class AssemblySelectionStore(QObject):
    """The assembly selection of the program last attached, shared by all windows."""

    # The saved selection changed
    changed = Signal()
    # A database error, as text
    failed = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, repository, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.repository = repository
        self.process_id = None
        self.selection = frozenset()

    def set_process(self, process_id):
        """Use the selection of another program (its database id)."""
        self.process_id = process_id
        self.selection = frozenset()
        if process_id is not None:
            try:
                self.selection = frozenset(self.repository.list_assemblies(process_id))
            except SQLAlchemyError as error:
                self.failed.emit(messages.describe(error))
        self.changed.emit()

    def save(self, names):
        """Save ``names`` as the selection; returns whether it worked."""
        if self.process_id is None:
            return False
        try:
            self.repository.save_assemblies(self.process_id, names)
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.failed.emit(messages.describe(error))
            return False
        self.selection = frozenset(names)
        self.changed.emit()
        return True


_NAME, _CLASSES, _KIND, _FILE = range(4)
_COLUMNS = (
    "assemblies.column_name", "assemblies.column_classes", "assemblies.column_kind",
    "assemblies.column_file",
)


class AssemblyDialog(QDialog):
    """Tick the assemblies of a Mono game to limit the catalog and the trace to.

    Not modal. Assemblies selected earlier that the game has not loaded (yet)
    are listed too, so they can be unticked.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    def __init__(self, translations, pid, store, parent=None, engine=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.pid = pid
        self.store = store
        self.engine = resolve_engine(pid, engine)
        # {name, file, classes} of the loaded assemblies; None while unknown
        self.assemblies = None
        self._checked = set(store.selection)
        self._filling = False
        self._worker = None
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["assemblies.title"].format(
            engine=self.engine.display_name))
        self.resize(820, 600)
        self._build_ui()
        self.reload()

    def _build_ui(self):
        t = self.translations
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        hint = QLabel(t["assemblies.hint"])
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        bar = QHBoxLayout()
        self.search_input = QLineEdit()
        self.search_input.setPlaceholderText(t["assemblies.search_placeholder"])
        self.search_input.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.search_input.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self._fill())
        bar.addWidget(self.search_input, 1)
        self.select_all_button = QPushButton(t["assemblies.select_all"])
        set_button_icon(self.select_all_button, "select_all")
        self.select_all_button.setToolTip(t["assemblies.select_all_tooltip"])
        self.select_all_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._check_shown(True))
        bar.addWidget(self.select_all_button)
        self.clear_button = QPushButton(t["assemblies.clear"])
        set_button_icon(self.clear_button, "deselect")
        self.clear_button.setToolTip(t["assemblies.clear_tooltip"])
        self.clear_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._check_shown(False))
        bar.addWidget(self.clear_button)
        self.reload_button = QPushButton(t["assemblies.reload"])
        set_button_icon(self.reload_button, "refresh")
        self.reload_button.setToolTip(t["assemblies.reload_tooltip"])
        self.reload_button.clicked.connect(self.reload)
        bar.addWidget(self.reload_button)
        layout.addLayout(bar)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, len(_COLUMNS))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([t[column] for column in _COLUMNS])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setWordWrap(False)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in range(len(_COLUMNS)):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(
                column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column == _FILE
                else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.resizeSection(_NAME, 260)
        header.resizeSection(_CLASSES, 80)
        header.resizeSection(_KIND, 110)
        resizable_columns(self.table)
        copy_menu(self.table, self.translations)
        self.table.itemChanged.connect(self._on_item_changed)
        layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        self.status_label = QLabel("")
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

        actions = QHBoxLayout()
        actions.addStretch()
        self.close_button = QPushButton(t["assemblies.close"])
        set_button_icon(self.close_button, "close")
        self.close_button.setAutoDefault(False)
        self.close_button.clicked.connect(self.close)
        actions.addWidget(self.close_button)
        self.save_button = QPushButton(t["assemblies.save"])
        self.save_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.save_button, "save")
        self.save_button.setToolTip(t["assemblies.save_tooltip"])
        self.save_button.setDefault(True)
        self.save_button.clicked.connect(self.save)
        actions.addWidget(self.save_button)
        layout.addLayout(actions)

    # --- Reading -------------------------------------------------------------
    def reload(self):
        """List the loaded assemblies anew, e.g. after the game loaded more."""
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.requestInterruption()
        # Only the list of assemblies: no assembly is read.
        worker = CatalogWorker(self.pid, [], engine=self.engine)
        worker.assemblies_found.connect(self._on_assemblies_found)
        worker.catalog_failed.connect(self._on_failed)
        worker.finished.connect(lambda: self._on_worker_finished(worker))
        self._worker = worker
        keep_until_finished(worker)
        self.reload_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["assemblies.loading"])
        worker.start()

    def _on_assemblies_found(self, assemblies):
        self.assemblies = sorted(assemblies, key=lambda a: a["name"].lower())
        self._fill()

    def _on_failed(self, message):
        self.assemblies = []
        self._fill()
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["assemblies.failed"].format(
            message=message))

    def _on_worker_finished(self, worker):
        if worker is self._worker:
            self._worker = None
            self.reload_button.setEnabled(True)

    # --- Display -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _rows(self):
        """(name, file, classes or None, loaded) of every assembly to list."""
        loaded = self.assemblies or []
        rows = [(a["name"], a.get("file") or "", a.get("classes"), True) for a in loaded]
        rows += [(name, "", None, False) for name in
                 missing_assemblies([a["name"] for a in loaded], self._checked)]
        words = self.search_input.text().lower().split()
        return [row for row in rows
                if all(word in f"{row[0]} {row[1]}".lower() for word in words)]

    def _fill(self):
        t = self.translations
        self._filling = True
        rows = self._rows()
        self.table.setRowCount(len(rows))
        for row, (name, file, classes, loaded) in enumerate(rows):
            framework = self.engine.is_framework_assembly(name)
            kind = t["assemblies.kind_framework" if framework else "assemblies.kind_game"]
            if not loaded:
                kind = t["assemblies.kind_missing"]
            name_item = QTableWidgetItem(name)
            name_item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, name)
            name_item.setFlags(name_item.flags() | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable)
            name_item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked if name in self._checked
                                    else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)
            classes_item = QTableWidgetItem("" if classes is None else str(classes))
            classes_item.setTextAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight
                                          | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
            kind_item = QTableWidgetItem(kind)
            if not loaded:
                kind_item.setToolTip(t["assemblies.missing_tooltip"])
            file_item = QTableWidgetItem(file)
            file_item.setToolTip(file)
            for column, item in ((_NAME, name_item), (_CLASSES, classes_item),
                                 (_KIND, kind_item), (_FILE, file_item)):
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        self._filling = False
        self._show_status()

    def _show_status(self):
        t = self.translations
        dirty = self.is_dirty()
        self.save_button.setEnabled(dirty and self.store.process_id is not None)
        if self.assemblies is None:
            return
        if self._checked:
            text = t["assemblies.count"].format(
                selected=len(self._checked), total=len(self.assemblies))
        else:
            text = t["assemblies.none_selected"].format(total=len(self.assemblies))
        if dirty:
            text += "  ·  " + t["assemblies.unsaved"]
        self.status_label.setText(text)

    def checked(self):
        """The names of the ticked assemblies."""
        return frozenset(self._checked)

    def is_dirty(self):
        """Whether the ticks differ from the saved selection."""
        return self._checked != set(self.store.selection)

    # --- Actions -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_item_changed(self, item):
        if self._filling or item.column() != _NAME:
            return
        name = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        if item.checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked:
            self._checked.add(name)
        else:
            self._checked.discard(name)
        self._show_status()

    def _check_shown(self, checked):
        """Tick or untick every assembly the search shows."""
        for name, _file, _classes, _loaded in self._rows():
            if checked:
                self._checked.add(name)
            else:
                self._checked.discard(name)
        self._fill()

    def save(self):
        """Save the ticked assemblies as the program's selection."""
        if self.store.save(self._checked):
            self._fill()

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        # No cancel: the main window also closes the dialog when the game exits.
        if self.is_dirty() and self.store.process_id is not None:
            answer = QMessageBox.question(
                self, self.windowTitle(), self.translations["assemblies.confirm_unsaved"],
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.Save | QMessageBox.StandardButton.Discard,
                QMessageBox.StandardButton.Save)
            if answer == QMessageBox.StandardButton.Save:
                self.save()
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.requestInterruption()
            self._worker = None
        super().closeEvent(event)
```

```py
"""Window of the call graph: what a C# method calls and who calls it."""

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

def method_title(method):
    """How the graph names a method: a compiler-made ``MoveNext`` by its origin."""
    owner = async_owner(method)
    if owner is not None:
        return f"{owner[0]}:{owner[1]} (async)"
    return method.signature


class CallGraphDialog(QDialog):
    """Show the calls of a method (``method``, a CatalogMethod) and its callers.

    A double click goes to a method, Back and Forward return. Callers are
    searched in the game's assemblies, or those of the assembly selection
    (``selection``); the first search reads their code, later ones come from
    the catalog cache.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes

    # CatalogMethod to log the calls of
    monitor_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, translations, pid, method, parent=None, engine=None, selection=(),
                 game=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_DeleteOnClose)
        self.translations = translations
        # Offline: a KnownGame (see hermes.features.games), answers from the cache
        self.game = game
        self.engine = resolve_engine(pid, engine) if game is None else engine
        self.method = None
        # The method of the row chosen last in either table
        self._selected = None
        self._back = []
        self._forward = []
        self._callee_request = None
        self._caller_request = None
        # Once callers were searched, they are shown for every method gone to.
        self._show_callers = False
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["calls.title"])
        self.resize(1000, 700)
        self._build_ui()
        self._worker = CallGraphWorker(pid, engine=self.engine, selection=selection, game=game)
        self._worker.callees_found.connect(self._on_callees)
        self._worker.callers_found.connect(self._on_callers)
        self._worker.request_failed.connect(self._on_failed)
        self._worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        self._worker.worker_failed.connect(self._on_worker_failed)
        keep_until_finished(self._worker)
        self._worker.start()
        if game is not None:
            self.monitor_button.setEnabled(False)
            self.monitor_button.setToolTip(self.translations["catalog.offline_no_monitor"])
        self.go_to(method)

    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        bar = QHBoxLayout()
        self.back_button = QPushButton(self.translations["calls.back"])
        set_button_icon(self.back_button, "arrow_back")
        self.back_button.clicked.connect(self.go_back)
        self.forward_button = QPushButton(self.translations["calls.forward"])
        set_button_icon(self.forward_button, "arrow_forward")
        self.forward_button.clicked.connect(self.go_forward)
        bar.addWidget(self.back_button)
        bar.addWidget(self.forward_button)
        self.title_label = SelectableText()
        bar.addWidget(self.title_label, 1)
        layout.addLayout(bar)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Vertical)
        callees = QWidget()
        callees_layout = QVBoxLayout(callees)
        callees_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        callees_label = QLabel(self.translations["calls.callees"])
        callees_label.setToolTip(self.translations["calls.callees_tooltip"])
        callees_layout.addWidget(callees_label)
        self.callees_table = self._table()
        callees_layout.addWidget(self.callees_table, 1)
        splitter.addWidget(callees)

        callers = QWidget()
        callers_layout = QVBoxLayout(callers)
        callers_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        callers_bar = QHBoxLayout()
        callers_label = QLabel(self.translations["calls.callers"])
        callers_label.setToolTip(self.translations["calls.callers_tooltip"])
        callers_bar.addWidget(callers_label)
        callers_bar.addStretch()
        self.callers_button = QPushButton(self.translations["calls.search_callers"])
        set_button_icon(self.callers_button, "manage_search")
        self.callers_button.setToolTip(self.translations["calls.search_callers_tooltip"])
        self.callers_button.clicked.connect(self.search_callers)
        callers_bar.addWidget(self.callers_button)
        callers_layout.addLayout(callers_bar)
        self.callers_progress = QProgressBar()
        self.callers_progress.hide()
        callers_layout.addWidget(self.callers_progress)
        self.callers_table = self._table()
        callers_layout.addWidget(self.callers_table, 1)
        splitter.addWidget(callers)
        splitter.setSizes([400, 260])
        layout.addWidget(splitter, 1)

        actions = QHBoxLayout()
        self.status_label = QLabel("")
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        actions.addWidget(self.status_label, 1)
        self.copy_button = QPushButton(self.translations["catalog.copy"])
        set_button_icon(self.copy_button, "content_copy")
        self.copy_button.setToolTip(self.translations["calls.copy_tooltip"])
        self.copy_button.clicked.connect(self._copy_signature)
        actions.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        self.monitor_button = QPushButton(self.translations["catalog.monitor"])
        self.monitor_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")

        self.monitor_button.clicked.connect(self._request_monitor)
        actions.addWidget(self.monitor_button)
        layout.addLayout(actions)

    def _table(self):
        table = QTableWidget(0, 3)
        table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([self.translations["calls.column_kind"],
                                         self.translations["calls.column_method"],
                                         self.translations["calls.column_assembly"]])
        table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        table.setWordWrap(False)
        table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(table)
        header = table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_KIND, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_METHOD, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_ASSEMBLY, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.resizeSection(_KIND, 130)
        header.resizeSection(_ASSEMBLY, 200)
        resizable_columns(table)
        copy_menu(table, self.translations)
        table.cellDoubleClicked.connect(lambda row, _column, table=table: self._open_row(table, row))
        table.currentCellChanged.connect(
            lambda row, _column, *_previous, table=table: self._choose(table, row))
        return table

    def _choose(self, table, row):
        item = table.item(row, _METHOD) if row >= 0 else None
        if item is not None:
            self._selected = item.data(_METHOD_ROLE)

    # --- Navigation --------------------------------------------------------------
    def go_to(self, method, remember=True):
        """Show the calls of ``method``; ``remember``: Back returns here."""
        if remember and self.method is not None:
            self._back.append(self.method)
            self._forward.clear()
        self.method = method
        self._selected = None
        self.title_label.setText(method_title(method))
        self.setWindowTitle(self.translations["calls.title_method"].format(
            method=method_title(method)))
        self._fill(self.callees_table, [])
        self._fill(self.callers_table, [])
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["calls.reading"])
        self._callee_request = self._worker.callees(method)
        self._caller_request = None
        self.callers_button.setEnabled(True)
        if self._show_callers:
            self.search_callers()
        self._update_buttons()

    def go_back(self):
        if self._back:
            self._forward.append(self.method)
            self.go_to(self._back.pop(), remember=False)

    def go_forward(self):
        if self._forward:
            self._back.append(self.method)
            self.go_to(self._forward.pop(), remember=False)

    def _update_buttons(self):
        self.back_button.setEnabled(bool(self._back))
        self.forward_button.setEnabled(bool(self._forward))

    def _open_row(self, table, row):
        item = table.item(row, _METHOD)
        if item is not None:
            self.go_to(item.data(_METHOD_ROLE))

    def search_callers(self):
        """Search the callers of the method shown (and of those gone to later)."""
        self._show_callers = True
        self.callers_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.callers_progress.setRange(0, 0)
        self.callers_progress.show()
        self._caller_request = self._worker.callers(self.method)

    # --- Answers -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_callees(self, request_id, method, calls, body):
        if request_id != self._callee_request:
            return
        rows = [(call.opcode, call.method) for call in calls]
        rows += [(f"{call.opcode} · async", call.method) for call in body]
        self._fill(self.callees_table, rows)
        key = "calls.callees_count_async" if body else "calls.callees_count"
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations[key].format(
            count=len(calls) + len(body), method=method.name))

    def _on_callers(self, request_id, _method, calls, missing):
        if request_id != self._caller_request:
            return
        self.callers_progress.hide()
        self._fill(self.callers_table, [(call.opcode, call.method) for call in calls])
        if missing:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["calls.not_searched"].format(
                count=len(missing), assemblies=", ".join(missing)))
        elif not calls:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["calls.no_callers"])

    def _on_progress(self, done, total, assembly):
        self.callers_progress.setRange(0, total)
        self.callers_progress.setValue(done)
        self.callers_progress.setFormat(self.translations["calls.indexing"].format(
            assembly=assembly, done=done, total=total).replace("%", "%%"))

    def _on_failed(self, request_id, message):
        if request_id == self._caller_request:
            self.callers_progress.hide()
            self.callers_button.setEnabled(True)
        if message == CallGraphWorker.NOT_CACHED:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["calls.not_cached"])
            return
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["calls.failed"].format(message=message))

    def _on_worker_failed(self, message):
        self.callers_progress.hide()
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["calls.failed"].format(message=message))

    def _fill(self, table, rows):
        table.setRowCount(len(rows))
        for row, (kind, method) in enumerate(rows):
            title = method_title(method)
            for column, text in ((_KIND, kind), (_METHOD, title), (_ASSEMBLY, method.assembly)):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
                item.setData(_METHOD_ROLE, method)
                if column == _METHOD:
                    item.setToolTip(method.signature)
                table.setItem(row, column, item)

    # --- Actions -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def selected_method(self):
        """The method of the row chosen last, else the one shown."""
        return self._selected or self.method

    def _request_monitor(self):
        self.monitor_requested.emit(self.selected_method())

    def _copy_signature(self):
        QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(self.selected_method().signature)

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        self._worker.requestInterruption()
        super().closeEvent(event)
```

`hermes/ui/widgets/catalog.py`:

```py
"""Searchable catalog of the C# methods of a Mono game (e.g. a Unity game)."""

import re
from datetime import datetime
from functools import lru_cache

from PySide6.QtCore import QAbstractTableModel, QModelIndex, Qt, QTimer, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QCheckBox,
    QDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QTableView,
    QVBoxLayout,
)

from hermes.engines import base as engine_base
from hermes.engines.registry import resolve_engine
from hermes.features.assemblies import missing_assemblies
from hermes.features.catalog import CachedCatalogWorker, CatalogWorker
from hermes.features.favorites import CATALOG
from hermes.features.method_call import call_capability
from hermes.ui.widgets.call_graph import CallGraphDialog
from hermes.ui.widgets.favorites import (
    FAVORITE_COLUMN,
    FAVORITE_COLUMN_KEY,
    FavoriteColumn,
    set_up_favorite_column,
)
from hermes.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon
from hermes.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns
from hermes.ui.workers import keep_until_finished


_FAVORITE, _CLASS, _METHOD, _RETURN, _STATIC, _ASSEMBLY = range(6)
_COLUMNS = (
    FAVORITE_COLUMN_KEY,
    "catalog.column_class",
    "catalog.column_method",
    "catalog.column_return",
    "catalog.column_static",
    "catalog.column_assembly",
)
# Typing pauses this long before the catalog is filtered.
FILTER_DELAY_MS = 200


@lru_cache(maxsize=256)
def _wildcard_pattern(word):
    """A search word with ``*`` (any text) or ``?`` (one character) as a regex."""
    return re.compile("".join(
        ".*" if char == "*" else "." if char == "?" else re.escape(char) for char in word))


def word_occurs(word, text):
    """Whether one search word occurs in ``text``; ``player*damage`` allows anything between."""
    if "*" in word or "?" in word:
        return _wildcard_pattern(word).search(text) is not None
    return word in text


TYPE_PREFIX = "type:"


def matches(words, method):
    """Whether every search word occurs in the method's class, name or assembly.

    A word ``type:<type>`` occurs in its parameter or return types instead.
    """
    text = f"{method.class_name}:{method.name} {method.assembly}".lower()
    types = f"{method.parameters} {method.return_type}".lower()
    return all(word_occurs(word[len(TYPE_PREFIX):], types) if word.startswith(TYPE_PREFIX)
               else word_occurs(word, text) for word in words)


class CatalogModel(FavoriteColumn, QAbstractTableModel):
    """All methods read so far; shows those matching the search.

    Sorts by a column when the view asks; column -1 is the order they were read in.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, engine, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.engine = engine
        self.methods = []
        self.visible = []
        self._words = []
        self._framework = False
        # The user's assembly selection; empty for none
        self.selection = frozenset()
        self._sort_column = -1
        self._sort_order = Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder

    # --- Qt model --------------------------------------------------------
    def rowCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(self.visible)

    def columnCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(_COLUMNS)

    def headerData(self, section, orientation, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole and orientation == Qt.Orientation.Horizontal:
            return self.translations[_COLUMNS[section]]
        return None

    def data(self, index, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid():
            return None
        if index.column() == FAVORITE_COLUMN:
            return self.favorite_data(index.row(), role)
        if role != Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
            return None
        method = self.visible[index.row()]
        return (
            None,
            method.class_name,
            f"{method.name} {method.parameters}",
            method.return_type,
            "✓" if method.static else "",
            method.assembly,
        )[index.column()]

    def sort(self, column, order=Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder):
        self._sort_column = column
        self._sort_order = order
        self._resort()

    # --- Content ---------------------------------------------------------
    def add(self, methods):
        # Only the new methods are filtered: refiltering all of them for
        # every assembly took half a minute for a few hundred assemblies.
        self.methods.extend(methods)
        shown = [method for method in methods if self._shows(method)]
        if shown:
            first = len(self.visible)
            self.beginInsertRows(QModelIndex(), first, first + len(shown) - 1)
            self.visible.extend(shown)
            self.endInsertRows()
            if self._sort_column >= 0:
                self._resort()

    def clear(self):
        self.methods = []
        self._apply()

    def set_filter(self, text, framework, selection=None):
        self._words = text.lower().split()
        self._framework = framework
        if selection is not None:
            self.selection = frozenset(selection)
        self._apply()

    def shows_assembly(self, assembly):
        """Whether methods of ``assembly`` are shown (selection, else framework switch)."""
        if self.selection:
            return assembly in self.selection
        return self._framework or not self.engine.is_framework_assembly(assembly)

    def method_at(self, row):
        return self.visible[row] if 0 <= row < len(self.visible) else None

    def favorite_item(self, row):
        return self.method_at(row)

    def _shows(self, method):
        return self.shows_assembly(method.assembly) and matches(self._words, method)

    def _apply(self):
        self.beginResetModel()
        self.visible = self._sorted(
            [method for method in self.methods if self._shows(method)])
        self.endResetModel()

    def _sorted(self, methods):
        column = self._sort_column
        if column < 0 or column >= len(_COLUMNS):
            return methods
        keys = {
            _FAVORITE: lambda method: (self.favorites is not None
                                       and self.favorites.is_favorite(method)),
            _CLASS: lambda method: method.class_name.lower(),
            _METHOD: lambda method: (method.name.lower(), method.parameters),
            _RETURN: lambda method: method.return_type.lower(),
            _STATIC: lambda method: method.static,
            _ASSEMBLY: lambda method: method.assembly.lower(),
        }
        return sorted(methods, key=keys[column],
                      reverse=self._sort_order == Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder)

    def _resort(self):
        """Sort the shown methods anew; selection and current row stay on their methods."""
        self.layoutAboutToBeChanged.emit()
        before = self.persistentIndexList()
        old = self.visible
        if self._sort_column < 0:
            # Back to the order they were read in
            self.visible = [method for method in self.methods if self._shows(method)]
        else:
            self.visible = self._sorted(old)
        rows = {id(method): row for row, method in enumerate(self.visible)}
        self.changePersistentIndexList(
            before, [self.index(rows[id(old[index.row()])], index.column())
                     if index.isValid() and index.row() < len(old) else QModelIndex()
                     for index in before])
        self.layoutChanged.emit()


class CatalogDialog(QDialog):
    """Search the classes and methods a Mono game has loaded.

    Not modal, so the scanner stays usable. Game assemblies are read when the
    dialog opens, framework assemblies only when they are to be shown. With
    an assembly selection (see hermes.ui.widgets.assemblies) only the
    selected assemblies are read and shown. Assemblies read before come from
    the catalog cache; "Reload" reads them anew.

    Offline, ``game`` (a KnownGame, see hermes.features.games) is shown from
    the catalog cache as it was read last, without a process (``pid`` None):
    nothing can be monitored or read anew then.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    # CatalogMethod to log the calls of (double click or "Monitor")
    monitor_requested = Signal(object)
    # static CatalogMethod to call ("Call …")
    call_requested = Signal(object)
    # CatalogMethod to create a method hook for
    hook_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, translations, pid, parent=None, engine=None, favorites=None,
                 assembly_selection=None, game=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.pid = pid
        self.game = game
        self.engine = resolve_engine(pid, engine) if game is None else engine
        self.model = CatalogModel(translations, self.engine, self)
        self._favorites = favorites
        self._assembly_selection = assembly_selection
        self._assemblies = []
        self._loaded = set()
        # Loaded assemblies that came from the catalog cache
        self._cached = set()
        self._failed = {}
        # Offline: assemblies whose build is not in the cache
        self._not_cached = set()
        self._error = None
        self._worker = None
        title = translations["catalog.title"].format(engine=self.engine.display_name)
        if game is not None:
            title = translations["catalog.title_offline"].format(
                title=title, game=game.name,
                time=datetime.fromtimestamp(game.updated).strftime("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M"))
        self.setWindowTitle(title)
        self.resize(1000, 640)
        self._build_ui()
        if game is not None:
            self.reload_button.hide()
        self._filter_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._filter_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._filter_timer.setInterval(FILTER_DELAY_MS)
        self._filter_timer.timeout.connect(self._apply_filter)
        if assembly_selection is not None:
            assembly_selection.changed.connect(self.reload)
        self.reload()

    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)

        bar = QHBoxLayout()
        self.search_input = QLineEdit()
        self.search_input.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["catalog.search_placeholder"])
        self.search_input.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.search_input.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self._filter_timer.start())
        bar.addWidget(self.search_input, 1)
        # "&" would mark a keyboard shortcut ("Framework _libraries"): doubled it shows.

        self.view = QTableView()

        header = self.view.horizontalHeader()
        for column in range(len(_COLUMNS)):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(
                column,
                QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column in (_CLASS, _METHOD)
                else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive,
            )
        header.resizeSection(_RETURN, 140)
        header.resizeSection(_STATIC, 70)
        header.resizeSection(_ASSEMBLY, 170)
        set_up_favorite_column(self.view, self.model, self._favorites, CATALOG)
        # A click on a column header sorts by it, a third one restores the order read in.
        header.setSortIndicatorClearable(True)
        header.setSortIndicator(-1, Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder)
        self.view.setSortingEnabled(True)
        resizable_columns(self.view)
        copy_menu(self.view, self.translations)
        self.view.selectionModel().currentRowChanged.connect(self._show_details)
        self.view.doubleClicked.connect(
            lambda index: index.column() != FAVORITE_COLUMN and self._request_monitor())
        self.model.modelReset.connect(lambda: self._show_details(QModelIndex()))
        layout.addWidget(self.view, 1)

        details = QHBoxLayout()

        self.details_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self.details_label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)
        details.addWidget(self.details_label, 1)
        self.monitor_button = QPushButton(self.translations["catalog.monitor"])
        self.monitor_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.monitor_button, "visibility")
        self.monitor_button.setToolTip(self.translations[
            "catalog.offline_no_monitor" if self.game is not None else "catalog.monitor_tooltip"])

        self.hook_button = QPushButton(self.translations["monitor.create_hook"])
        set_button_icon(self.hook_button, "webhook")
        self.hook_button.setToolTip(self.translations["monitor.create_hook_tooltip"])
        self.hook_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.hook_button.clicked.connect(self._request_hook)

        set_button_icon(self.call_button, "call_made")

            "catalog.offline_no_call" if self.game is not None else "catalog.call_tooltip"])
        self.call_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.call_button.clicked.connect(self._request_call)
        details.addWidget(self.call_button)
        self.calls_button = QPushButton(self.translations["catalog.calls"])
        set_button_icon(self.calls_button, "account_tree")

        set_button_icon(self.copy_button, "content_copy")
        self.copy_button.setToolTip(self.translations["catalog.copy_tooltip"])
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.copy_button.clicked.connect(self._copy_signature)
        details.addWidget(self.copy_button)

    # --- Reading -------------------------------------------------------------
    def selection(self):
        """The user's assembly selection; empty for none."""
        store = self._assembly_selection
        return store.selection if store is not None else frozenset()

    def reload(self, fresh=False):
        """Read the catalog again, e.g. after the game loaded more assemblies.

        ``fresh`` reads every assembly anew instead of taking it from the cache.
        """
        self._stop_worker()
        self._assemblies = []
        self._loaded.clear()
        self._cached.clear()
        self._failed.clear()
        self._not_cached.clear()
        self._error = None
        self.model.clear()
        selection = self.selection()
        self.model.set_filter(self.search_input.text(), self.framework_check.isChecked(),
                              selection)
        # The selection decides which assemblies are shown, framework ones too.
        self.framework_check.setEnabled(not selection)
        self.framework_check.setToolTip(self.translations[
            "catalog.framework_selection_tooltip" if selection else "catalog.framework_tooltip"])
        self._start_worker(None, fresh)

    def _start_worker(self, assemblies, fresh=False):
        if self.game is not None:
            worker = CachedCatalogWorker(self.game, assemblies, engine=self.engine)
        else:
            worker = CatalogWorker(self.pid, assemblies, engine=self.engine,
                                   selection=self.selection(), fresh=fresh)
        worker.assemblies_found.connect(self._on_assemblies_found)
        worker.assembly_cached.connect(self._cached.add)
        worker.assembly_loaded.connect(self._on_assembly_loaded)
        worker.assembly_failed.connect(self._on_assembly_failed)
        worker.catalog_failed.connect(self._on_failed)
        worker.finished.connect(lambda: self._on_worker_finished(worker))
        self._worker = worker
        keep_until_finished(worker)
        self.reload_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(
            self.translations["catalog.starting"].format(engine=self.engine.display_name))
        worker.start()

    def _stop_worker(self):
        if self._worker is not None:
            self._worker.requestInterruption()
            self._worker = None

    def _on_assemblies_found(self, assemblies):
        self._assemblies = assemblies
        self._show_progress()

    def _on_assembly_loaded(self, assembly, methods):
        self._loaded.add(assembly)
        self.model.add(methods)
        if self._favorites is not None:
            self._favorites.enrich_methods(methods)
        self._show_progress()

    def _on_assembly_failed(self, assembly, message):
        if message == CachedCatalogWorker.NOT_CACHED:
            self._not_cached.add(assembly)
        else:
            self._failed[assembly] = message
        self._show_progress()

    def _on_failed(self, message):
        self._error = message
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["catalog.failed"].format(message=message))

    def _on_worker_finished(self, worker):
        if worker is not self._worker:
            return
        self._worker = None
        self.reload_button.setEnabled(True)
        if self._error is None:
            self._show_summary()

    def _toggle_framework(self, shown):
        missing = [a["name"] for a in self._assemblies
                   if self.engine.is_framework_assembly(a["name"]) and a["name"] not in self._loaded]
        if shown and missing and self._worker is None and not self.selection():
            self._start_worker(missing)
        self._apply_filter()

    # --- Display -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _apply_filter(self):
        self.model.set_filter(self.search_input.text(), self.framework_check.isChecked())
        if self._worker is None and self._error is None:
            self._show_summary()

    def _show_progress(self):
        pending = [a["name"] for a in self._assemblies
                   if a["name"] not in self._loaded and a["name"] not in self._failed
                   and a["name"] not in self._not_cached
                   and self.model.shows_assembly(a["name"])]
        if pending:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["catalog.loading"].format(
                assembly=pending[0], done=len(self._loaded), total=len(self._loaded) + len(pending)
            ))

    def _show_summary(self):
        classes = {(m.assembly, m.class_name) for m in self.model.visible}
        key = "catalog.summary_one_class" if len(classes) == 1 else "catalog.summary"
        text = self.translations[key].format(
            shown=len(self.model.visible), total=len(self.model.methods),
            classes=len(classes), assemblies=len(self._loaded),
        )
        if self._cached and self.game is None:
            text += "  ·  " + self.translations["catalog.from_cache"].format(
                count=len(self._cached))
        shown_missing = sorted(name for name in self._not_cached
                               if self.model.shows_assembly(name))
        if shown_missing:
            text += "  ·  " + self.translations["catalog.not_cached"].format(
                assemblies=", ".join(shown_missing))
        selection = self.selection()
        if selection:
            text += "  ·  " + self.translations["catalog.assembly_selection"].format(
                count=len(selection))
            missing = missing_assemblies([a["name"] for a in self._assemblies], selection)
            if missing and self._assemblies:
                text += "  ·  " + self.translations["catalog.assemblies_missing"].format(
                    assemblies=", ".join(missing))
        if self._failed:
            text += "  ·  " + self.translations["catalog.assemblies_failed"].format(
                assemblies=", ".join(sorted(self._failed))
            )
        self.status_label.setText(text)

    def selected_method(self):
        index = self.view.currentIndex()
        return self.model.method_at(index.row()) if index.isValid() else None

    def _show_details(self, current, _previous=None):
        method = self.model.method_at(current.row()) if current.isValid() else None
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(method is not None)
        self.calls_button.setEnabled(method is not None
                                     and self.engine.supports(engine_base.CALL_GRAPH))
        self.monitor_button.setEnabled(method is not None
                                       and self._can_run(method, engine_base.MONITOR))
        self.hook_button.setEnabled(method is not None
                        and self._can_run(method, engine_base.METHOD_HOOKS))
        self.call_button.setEnabled(method is not None
                                    and self._can_run(method, call_capability(method)))
        if method is None:
            self.details_label.setText("")
            return
        self.details_label.setText(self.translations["catalog.details"].format(
            signature=method.signature,
            returns=method.return_type or "?",
            kind=self.translations["catalog.static" if method.static else "catalog.instance"],
            token=f"0x{method.token:08x}",
            assembly=method.assembly,
        ))

    def _can_run(self, _method, capability):
        """Whether a method can be monitored or called (``capability``): in a
        running game whose engine adapter can."""
        return self.game is None and self.engine.supports(capability)

    def _request_monitor(self):
        method = self.selected_method()
        if method is not None and self._can_run(method, engine_base.MONITOR):
            self.monitor_requested.emit(method)

    def _request_hook(self):
        method = self.selected_method()
        if method is not None and self._can_run(method, engine_base.METHOD_HOOKS):
            self.hook_requested.emit(method)

    def _request_call(self):
        method = self.selected_method()
        if method is not None and self._can_run(method, call_capability(method)):
            self.call_requested.emit(method)

    def _show_calls(self):
        """Open the call graph of the selected method in a window of its own."""
        method = self.selected_method()
        if method is None:
            return
        graph = CallGraphDialog(self.translations, self.pid, method, parent=self,
                                engine=self.engine, selection=self.selection(), game=self.game)
        graph.monitor_requested.connect(self.monitor_requested.emit)
        graph.show()

    def _copy_signature(self):
        method = self.selected_method()
        if method is not None:
            QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(method.signature)

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        self._stop_worker()
        super().closeEvent(event)
```

`hermes/ui/widgets/code_editor.py`:

```py
"""A text field for JavaScript (scripts, hook code, templates).

Fixed-width font; Tab indents by spaces, as the built-in templates are
written, rather than inserting a tab character eight characters wide.
With several lines selected Tab and Shift+Tab indent and outdent them all.
"""

import re

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QColor,
    QFont,
    QFontDatabase,
    QFontMetricsF,
    QSyntaxHighlighter,
    QTextCharFormat,
    QTextCursor,
)
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QPlainTextEdit  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

INDENT = "  "
_BLOCK_COMMENT = 1
_TEMPLATE_STRING = 2
_NUMBER = re.compile(
    r"(?:0[xX][\da-fA-F](?:_?[\da-fA-F])*|0[bB][01](?:_?[01])*|"
    r"0[oO][0-7](?:_?[0-7])*|(?:\d(?:_?\d)*(?:\.(?:\d(?:_?\d)*)?)?|"
    r"\.\d(?:_?\d)*)(?:[eE][+-]?\d(?:_?\d)*)?)n?(?![\w$])")
_KEYWORDS = frozenset({
    "async", "await", "break", "case", "catch", "class", "const", "continue",
    "debugger", "default", "delete", "do", "else", "export", "extends", "false",
    "finally", "for", "from", "function", "get", "if", "implements", "import", "in",
    "instanceof", "interface", "let", "new", "null", "of", "package", "private",
    "protected", "public", "return", "set", "static", "super", "switch", "this", "throw",
    "true", "try", "typeof", "undefined", "var", "void", "while", "with", "yield",
})
_CODE_COLORS = {
    "code_text": "#e6edf3",
    "code_keyword": "#ff7b72",
    "code_string": "#a5d6ff",
    "code_number": "#79c0ff",
    "muted": "#8b949e",
}


def _closing_quote(text, start, quote):
    escaped = False
    for position in range(start, len(text)):
        character = text[position]
        if escaped:
            escaped = False
        elif character == "\\":
            escaped = True
        elif character == quote:
            return position + 1
    return None


class JavaScriptHighlighter(QSyntaxHighlighter):
    """Highlight JavaScript tokens while keeping multiline lexical state."""

    def __init__(self, document, colors):
        super().__init__(document)
        self.set_colors(colors)

    def set_colors(self, colors):
        """Update token formats when the application's theme changes."""
        self.formats = {}
        for token, key in (("text", "code_text"), ("keyword", "code_keyword"),
                           ("string", "code_string"), ("number", "code_number"),
                           ("comment", "muted")):
            text_format = QTextCharFormat()
            text_format.setForeground(QColor(colors[key]))
            if token == "keyword":
                text_format.setFontWeight(QFont.Weight.Bold)
            self.formats[token] = text_format
        self.rehighlight()

    def highlightBlock(self, text):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        self.setFormat(0, len(text), self.formats["text"])
        position = 0
        previous_state = self.previousBlockState()
        self.setCurrentBlockState(0)

        if previous_state == _BLOCK_COMMENT:
            end = text.find("*/")
            if end < 0:
                self.setFormat(0, len(text), self.formats["comment"])
                self.setCurrentBlockState(_BLOCK_COMMENT)
                return
            self.setFormat(0, end + 2, self.formats["comment"])
            position = end + 2
        elif previous_state == _TEMPLATE_STRING:
            end = _closing_quote(text, 0, "`")
            if end is None:
                self.setFormat(0, len(text), self.formats["string"])
                self.setCurrentBlockState(_TEMPLATE_STRING)
                return
            self.setFormat(0, end, self.formats["string"])
            position = end

        while position < len(text):
            if text.startswith("//", position):
                self.setFormat(position, len(text) - position, self.formats["comment"])
                break
            if text.startswith("/*", position):
                end = text.find("*/", position + 2)
                if end < 0:
                    self.setFormat(position, len(text) - position, self.formats["comment"])
                    self.setCurrentBlockState(_BLOCK_COMMENT)
                    break
                self.setFormat(position, end + 2 - position, self.formats["comment"])
                position = end + 2
                continue

            character = text[position]
            if character in ("'", '"', "`"):
                end = _closing_quote(text, position + 1, character)
                if end is None:
                    self.setFormat(position, len(text) - position, self.formats["string"])
                    if character == "`":
                        self.setCurrentBlockState(_TEMPLATE_STRING)
                    break
                self.setFormat(position, end - position, self.formats["string"])
                position = end
                continue

            if character.isdigit() or (character == "." and position + 1 < len(text)
                                       and text[position + 1].isdigit()):
                number = _NUMBER.match(text, position)
                if number is not None:
                    self.setFormat(position, number.end() - position, self.formats["number"])
                    position = number.end()
                    continue

            if character == "$" or character == "_" or character.isalpha():
                end = position + 1
                while end < len(text):
                    next_character = text[end]
                    if not (next_character == "$" or next_character == "_"
                            or next_character.isalnum()):
                        break
                    end += 1
                if text[position:end] in _KEYWORDS:
                    self.setFormat(position, end - position, self.formats["keyword"])
                position = end
                continue

            position += 1


class CodeEditor(QPlainTextEdit):
    """QPlainTextEdit for code: fixed-width font, Tab indents by INDENT."""

    def __init__(self, text="", parent=None):
        super().__init__(text, parent)
        self.highlighter = JavaScriptHighlighter(self.document(), _CODE_COLORS)
        self.setFont(QFontDatabase.systemFont(QFontDatabase.SystemFont.FixedFont))
        # Tabs pasted from elsewhere are as wide as one indent
        self.setTabStopDistance(
            QFontMetricsF(self.font()).horizontalAdvance(" ") * len(INDENT))

    def keyPressEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Tab and not event.modifiers() & (
                Qt.KeyboardModifier.ControlModifier | Qt.KeyboardModifier.AltModifier):
            self.indent()
            return
        if event.key() == Qt.Key.Key_Backtab:
            self.outdent()
            return
        super().keyPressEvent(event)

    def _selected_blocks(self):
        """The first and last block (line) of the selection; a selection that
        ends at the start of a line leaves that line out."""
        cursor = self.textCursor()
        document = self.document()
        first = document.findBlock(cursor.selectionStart())
        last = document.findBlock(cursor.selectionEnd())
        if (last.blockNumber() > first.blockNumber()
                and cursor.selectionEnd() == last.position()):
            last = last.previous()
        return first, last

    def indent(self):
        """Tab: indent the selected lines, or insert an indent at the cursor."""
        cursor = self.textCursor()
        first, last = self._selected_blocks()
        if first == last:
            cursor.insertText(INDENT)
            return
        cursor.beginEditBlock()
        block = first
        while block.isValid() and block.blockNumber() <= last.blockNumber():
            line = QTextCursor(block)
            line.insertText(INDENT)
            block = block.next()
        cursor.endEditBlock()

    def outdent(self):
        """Shift+Tab: remove an indent (or a tab) from the start of the selected lines."""
        cursor = self.textCursor()
        first, last = self._selected_blocks()
        cursor.beginEditBlock()
        block = first
        while block.isValid() and block.blockNumber() <= last.blockNumber():
            text = block.text()
            if text.startswith("\t"):
                remove = 1
            else:
                remove = min(len(text) - len(text.lstrip(" ")), len(INDENT))
            if remove:
                line = QTextCursor(block)
                line.movePosition(QTextCursor.MoveOperation.Right,
                                  QTextCursor.MoveMode.KeepAnchor, remove)
                line.removeSelectedText()
            block = block.next()
        cursor.endEditBlock()


def apply_code_theme(colors):
    """Apply syntax colors to current and future code editors."""
    _CODE_COLORS.update({key: colors[key] for key in (
        "code_text", "code_keyword", "code_string", "code_number", "muted")})
    application = QApplication.instance()
    if application is None:
        return
    for widget in application.allWidgets():
        if isinstance(widget, CodeEditor):
            widget.highlighter.set_colors(_CODE_COLORS)
```

`hermes/ui/widgets/database_entries.py`:

```py
"""The window that deletes entries saved for processes (File > Delete saved entries).

One row per saved process (name and path). Each count of entries has a
check box; the box in front of a row ticks all of them. "Remove process"
deletes the process itself with everything saved for it. Deleting
addresses deletes their pointer scans as well.

Rows can be selected (several with Ctrl and Shift); the space key steps the
selected rows through: all their entries, also the process, nothing.
"""

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QKeySequence, QShortcut  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QDialog,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QMessageBox,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
)
from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

from hermes.db.repository.game_export import DELETABLE
from hermes.ui.widgets.dialog_buttons import dialog_button_row
from hermes.ui.widgets.table import resizable_columns, set_row_height

ROW_COLUMN, NAME_COLUMN, PLATFORM_COLUMN, PATH_COLUMN = range(4)
# Columns of the kinds of entries, then the one that removes the process
KIND_COLUMNS = {kind: 4 + index for index, kind in enumerate(DELETABLE)}
PROCESS_COLUMN = 4 + len(DELETABLE)
CHECKED, UNCHECKED = Qt.CheckState.Checked, Qt.CheckState.Unchecked
# What the space key ticks in a row, one step per press
NOTHING, ENTRIES, PROCESS = range(3)


class DeleteEntriesDialog(QDialog):
    """Tick the entries to delete per saved process, then delete them.

    ``current`` is the database id of the attached process: it cannot be
    removed, only its entries. ``deleted`` holds {process_id: {kind: count}}
    after a deletion.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, repository, current=None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.repository = repository
        self.current = current
        self.deleted = {}
        self._updating = False
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["delete_entries.title"])
        self.setMinimumWidth(900)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        hint = QLabel(translations["delete_entries.hint"])
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        headers = (["", translations["export.column_name"], translations["export.column_platform"],
                    translations["import.column_path"]]
                   + [translations[f"export.column_{kind}"] for kind in DELETABLE]
                   + [translations["delete_entries.column_process"]])
        self.table = QTableWidget(0, len(headers))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(headers)
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.ExtendedSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in range(len(headers)):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(PATH_COLUMN, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        self._sizer = resizable_columns(self.table)
        self.table.itemChanged.connect(self._on_item_changed)
        # Instead of the item view's own space key, which ticks the current box only
        space = QShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt.Key.Key_Space), self.table)
        space.setContext(Qt.ShortcutContext.WidgetShortcut)
        space.activated.connect(self.step_selected)
        layout.addWidget(self.table)

        self.summary = QLabel()
        self.summary.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.summary)
        buttons = dialog_button_row(translations, "delete_entries.button", self._delete,
                                    self.reject)
        self.delete_button = buttons.itemAt(buttons.count() - 1).widget()
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

        self.processes = []
        self._load()

    def _load(self):
        try:
            self.processes = self.repository.list_processes()
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.summary.setText(self.translations["delete_entries.failed"].format(error=error))
            self.processes = []
        self._updating = True
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.processes))
        for row, process in enumerate(self.processes):
            self.table.setItem(row, ROW_COLUMN, self._check_item(""))
            for column, value in ((NAME_COLUMN, process.name),
                                  (PLATFORM_COLUMN, process.platform),
                                  (PATH_COLUMN, process.path)):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(value)
                item.setToolTip(process.path)
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
            for kind, column in KIND_COLUMNS.items():
                count = process.counts.get(kind, 0)
                self.table.setItem(row, column, self._check_item(str(count), enabled=count > 0))
            item = self._check_item("", enabled=process.process_id != self.current)
            if process.process_id == self.current:
                item.setToolTip(self.translations["delete_entries.attached"])
            self.table.setItem(row, PROCESS_COLUMN, item)
        self._updating = False
        if not self.processes and not self.summary.text():
            self.summary.setText(self.translations["delete_entries.empty"])
        self._update_summary()

    @staticmethod
    def _check_item(text, enabled=True):
        item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
        item.setFlags(Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled
                      if enabled else Qt.ItemFlag.NoItemFlags)
        item.setCheckState(UNCHECKED)
        return item

    def _checked(self, row, column):
        item = self.table.item(row, column)
        return item is not None and item.checkState() == CHECKED

    def _set_checked(self, row, column, checked):
        item = self.table.item(row, column)
        if item.flags() & Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable:
            item.setCheckState(CHECKED if checked else UNCHECKED)

    def _on_item_changed(self, item):
        if self._updating:
            return
        self._updating = True
        row, column = item.row(), item.column()
        checked = item.checkState() == CHECKED
        if column == ROW_COLUMN:
            for kind_column in KIND_COLUMNS.values():
                self._set_checked(row, kind_column, checked)
            if not checked:
                self._set_checked(row, PROCESS_COLUMN, False)
        elif column == PROCESS_COLUMN and checked:
            # The process goes with all its entries.
            for kind_column in (ROW_COLUMN, *KIND_COLUMNS.values()):
                self._set_checked(row, kind_column, True)
        elif column in KIND_COLUMNS.values():
            if column == KIND_COLUMNS["addresses"] and checked:
                # Pointer scans belong to their addresses.
                self._set_checked(row, KIND_COLUMNS["pointer_scans"], True)
            if not checked:
                self._set_checked(row, PROCESS_COLUMN, False)
                if column == KIND_COLUMNS["pointer_scans"]:
                    self._set_checked(row, KIND_COLUMNS["addresses"], False)
        self._sync_row_box(row)
        self._updating = False
        self._update_summary()

    def _sync_row_box(self, row):
        """The row's box is ticked while every count that can be is ticked."""
        boxes = [column for column in KIND_COLUMNS.values()
                 if self.table.item(row, column).flags() & Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable]
        self.table.item(row, ROW_COLUMN).setCheckState(
            CHECKED if boxes and all(self._checked(row, column) for column in boxes)
            else UNCHECKED)

    def _stage(self, row):
        """What is ticked in ``row``: NOTHING, ENTRIES or the PROCESS too."""
        if self._checked(row, PROCESS_COLUMN):
            return PROCESS
        if self._checked(row, ROW_COLUMN) or any(
                self._checked(row, column) for column in KIND_COLUMNS.values()):
            return ENTRIES
        return NOTHING

    def _set_stage(self, row, stage):
        """Tick the row's entries (ENTRIES), its process too (PROCESS), or nothing.

        What cannot be ticked stays as it is: the attached process, counts of 0.
        """
        for column in KIND_COLUMNS.values():
            self._set_checked(row, column, stage != NOTHING)
        self._set_checked(row, PROCESS_COLUMN, stage == PROCESS)
        self._sync_row_box(row)

    def selected_rows(self):
        """The selected rows, else the current one."""
        rows = sorted({index.row() for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()})
        if not rows and self.table.currentRow() >= 0:
            rows = [self.table.currentRow()]
        return rows

    def step_selected(self):
        """The space key: tick the selected rows' entries, then their process
        too, then nothing. A step none of the rows can take (no entries, the
        attached process) is skipped."""
        rows = self.selected_rows()
        if not rows:
            return
        stage = (max(self._stage(row) for row in rows) + 1) % 3
        self._updating = True
        try:
            # NOTHING can always be reached
            for _ in range(3):
                for row in rows:
                    self._set_stage(row, stage)
                if any(self._stage(row) == stage for row in rows):
                    break
                stage = (stage + 1) % 3
        finally:
            self._updating = False
        self._update_summary()

    def selection(self):
        """[(SavedProcess, kinds, remove_process)] of the rows with something ticked."""
        chosen = []
        for row, process in enumerate(self.processes):
            kinds = [kind for kind, column in KIND_COLUMNS.items() if self._checked(row, column)]
            remove = self._checked(row, PROCESS_COLUMN)
            if kinds or remove:
                chosen.append((process, kinds, remove))
        return chosen

    def _update_summary(self):
        chosen = self.selection()
        entries = sum(process.counts.get(kind, 0)
                      for process, kinds, remove in chosen
                      for kind in (DELETABLE if remove else kinds))
        removed = sum(1 for _process, _kinds, remove in chosen if remove)
        if chosen:
            self.summary.setText(self.translations["delete_entries.summary"].format(
                entries=entries, processes=len(chosen), removed=removed))
        elif self.processes:
            self.summary.setText(self.translations["delete_entries.nothing"])
        self.delete_button.setEnabled(bool(chosen))

    def _delete(self):
        chosen = self.selection()
        if not chosen:
            return
        lines = []
        for process, kinds, remove in chosen:
            what = (self.translations["delete_entries.column_process"] if remove else
                    ", ".join(self.translations[f"export.column_{kind}"] for kind in kinds))
            lines.append(f"• {process.name} ({process.path}): {what}")
        if QMessageBox.question(
                self, self.translations["delete_entries.title"],
                self.translations["delete_entries.confirm"].format(list="\n".join(lines)),
        ) != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            for process, kinds, remove in chosen:
                self.deleted[process.process_id] = self.repository.delete_entries(
                    process.process_id, kinds, remove_process=remove)
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.summary.setText(self.translations["delete_entries.failed"].format(error=error))
            return
        self.accept()

```

```py
"""Shared dialog button-row construction."""

from PySide6.QtWidgets import QHBoxLayout, QPushButton  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from hermes.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon

# Icons of the accept buttons by their text key; others get "check".
_ACCEPT_ICONS = {
    "button.save": "save",
    "button.write": "edit",
    "button.add": "add",
    "delete_entries.button": "delete",
    "export.button": "upload",
    "import.button": "download",
    "games.open": "data_object",
    "hooks.create": "webhook",
    "process.attach": "link",
    "scripts.create": "add",
    "scripts.run_button": "play_circle",
}


def dialog_button_row(translations, accept_key, on_accept, on_cancel):
    """Build a standard cancel/accept row for a dialog."""
    row = QHBoxLayout()
    row.addStretch()

    cancel_button = QPushButton(translations["button.cancel"])
    set_button_icon(cancel_button, "close")
    cancel_button.clicked.connect(on_cancel)
    accept_button = QPushButton(translations[accept_key])
    accept_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
    set_button_icon(accept_button, _ACCEPT_ICONS.get(accept_key, "check"))
    accept_button.clicked.connect(on_accept)
    # Enter confirms the dialog instead of pressing the first button (cancel).
    cancel_button.setAutoDefault(False)
    accept_button.setDefault(True)

    row.addWidget(cancel_button)
    row.addWidget(accept_button)
    return row
```
