`hermes/ui/widgets/favorites.py`:

```py
"""Favorites: a star column for the tables of methods and functions, and their window.

The catalog, the Mono trace and the native trace show a star in their first
column; a click on it saves the method or function as a favorite of the
program (see hermes.features.favorites) or removes it. The favorites window
lists them, keeps a note for each and hands them to the monitors.
"""

from dataclasses import asdict

from PySide6.QtCore import QItemSelectionModel, QObject, Qt, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication, QKeySequence, QShortcut  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
)
from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

from hermes.engines import base as engine_base
from hermes.engines.registry import engine_by_id
from hermes.features.favorites import METHOD, favorite_key, favorite_of
from hermes.features.method_call import can_call
from hermes.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color
from hermes.ui.widgets.labels import SelectableText
from hermes.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns


# The star column comes first in every table that has one.
FAVORITE_COLUMN = 0
FAVORITE_COLUMN_KEY = "favorites.column"
STAR = "★"
NO_STAR = "☆"


class FavoriteStore(QObject):
    """The favorites of the program last attached, shared by all windows.

    Keeps the keys in memory, so the tables can ask for every row. Stays
    with the program after it exits: a game that crashed can still have its
    favorites looked at.
    """

    # The set of favorites changed (added or removed)
    changed = Signal()
    # A database error, as text
    failed = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, repository, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.repository = repository
        self.process_id = None
        self._keys = set()

    def set_process(self, process_id):
        """Show the favorites of another program (its database id)."""
        self.process_id = process_id
        self._keys = set()
        if process_id is not None:
            self._keys = {favorite.key for favorite in self.favorites()}
        self.changed.emit()

    def favorites(self):
        """The Favorites of the program, oldest first."""
        if self.process_id is None:
            return []
        try:
            return self.repository.list_favorites(self.process_id)
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.failed.emit(str(error))
            return []

    def is_favorite(self, item):
        """Whether a CatalogMethod or NativeFunction is a favorite."""
        return item is not None and favorite_key(item) in self._keys

    def enrich_methods(self, methods):
        """Update saved method metadata when a newer catalog knows more about it."""
        if self.process_id is None:
            return
        named = {favorite_key(method): method for method in methods
                 if method.argument_names}
        if not named:
            return
        favorites = {favorite.key: favorite for favorite in self.favorites()}
        updated = False
        for key, method in named.items():
            favorite = favorites.get(key)
            if favorite is None or favorite.data.get("argument_names"):
                continue
            favorite.data = asdict(method)
            try:
                self.repository.add_favorite(self.process_id, favorite)
            except SQLAlchemyError as error:
                self.failed.emit(str(error))
                return
            updated = True
        if updated:
            self.changed.emit()

    def toggle(self, item, source=""):
        """Save a CatalogMethod or NativeFunction as a favorite, or remove it; the new state."""
        if item is None or self.process_id is None:
            return False
        key = favorite_key(item)
        try:
            if key in self._keys:
                self.repository.delete_favorite(self.process_id, key)
                self._keys.discard(key)
            else:
                self.repository.add_favorite(self.process_id, favorite_of(item, source))
                self._keys.add(key)
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.failed.emit(str(error))
            return key in self._keys
        self.changed.emit()
        return key in self._keys

    def remove(self, favorite):
        """Remove a Favorite."""
        try:
            self.repository.delete_favorite(self.process_id, favorite.key)
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.failed.emit(str(error))
            return
        self._keys.discard(favorite.key)
        self.changed.emit()

    def set_note(self, favorite, note):
        """Change the note of a Favorite."""
        try:
            self.repository.set_note(favorite.favorite_id, note)
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.failed.emit(str(error))
            return
        favorite.note = note


class FavoriteColumn:
    """For table models whose first column is the star.

    The model sets ``favorites`` (a FavoriteStore or None) and implements
    ``favorite_item(row)``: the CatalogMethod or NativeFunction of a row.
    """

    favorites = None

    def favorite_item(self, row):
        raise NotImplementedError

    def favorite_data(self, row, role):
        """What the star cell of ``row`` shows for ``role``."""
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
            store = self.favorites
            return STAR if store is not None and store.is_favorite(self.favorite_item(row)) \
                else NO_STAR
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.TextAlignmentRole:
            return int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignCenter)
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole:
            return self.translations["favorites.star_tooltip"]
        return None

    def favorites_changed(self):
        """Repaint the stars."""
        rows = self.rowCount()
        if rows:
            self.dataChanged.emit(self.index(0, FAVORITE_COLUMN),
                                  self.index(rows - 1, FAVORITE_COLUMN))


def set_up_favorite_column(view, model, store, source):
    """Let a click on the star column of ``view`` mark the row's item as a
    favorite, and the space key the current row's item.

    Hides the column without a ``store``.
    """
    header = view.horizontalHeader()
    header.setSectionResizeMode(FAVORITE_COLUMN, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
    header.resizeSection(FAVORITE_COLUMN, 32)
    model.favorites = store
    if store is None:
        view.setColumnHidden(FAVORITE_COLUMN, True)
        return
    store.changed.connect(model.favorites_changed)
    view.clicked.connect(lambda index: index.column() == FAVORITE_COLUMN and store.toggle(
        model.favorite_item(index.row()), source))
    # Only while the table has the focus, not in a search field next to it
    space = QShortcut(QKeySequence(Qt.Key.Key_Space), view)
    space.setContext(Qt.ShortcutContext.WidgetShortcut)
    space.activated.connect(lambda: view.currentIndex().isValid() and store.toggle(
        model.favorite_item(view.currentIndex().row()), source))


_KIND, _STATIC, _NAME, _LOCATION, _NOTE, _SOURCE, _ADDED = range(7)
_COLUMNS = (
    "favorites.column_kind", "favorites.column_static", "favorites.column_name",
    "favorites.column_location",
    "favorites.column_note", "favorites.column_source", "favorites.column_added",
)


class FavoritesDialog(QDialog):
    """The favorites of the program: search, annotate, monitor, remove.

    Not modal. Monitoring needs the game running; without it the list stays
    readable, e.g. after the game crashed.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    # [CatalogMethod] to log the calls of
    method_monitor_requested = Signal(object)
    # [NativeFunction] to log the calls of
    native_monitor_requested = Signal(object)
    # CatalogMethod to call ("Call …"), see _callable_method
    call_requested = Signal(object)
    # CatalogMethod to create a method hook for
    method_hook_requested = Signal(object)
    # CatalogMethod to show in the call graph
    calls_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, translations, store, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.store = store
        self.attached = False
        self._shown = []
        self._filling = False
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["favorites.title"])
        self.resize(1000, 520)
        self._build_ui()
        store.changed.connect(self.refresh)
        self.refresh()

    def _build_ui(self):
        t = self.translations
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        hint = QLabel(t["favorites.hint"])
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        self.search_input = QLineEdit()
        self.search_input.setPlaceholderText(t["favorites.search_placeholder"])
        self.search_input.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.search_input.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self.refresh())
        layout.addWidget(self.search_input)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, len(_COLUMNS))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([t[column] for column in _COLUMNS])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        # Ctrl and Shift select several, e.g. to monitor them at once.
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.ExtendedSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.DoubleClicked
                                   | QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.EditKeyPressed)
        self.table.setWordWrap(False)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in range(len(_COLUMNS)):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(
                column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column in (_NAME, _NOTE)
                else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.resizeSection(_KIND, 70)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_STATIC, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Fixed)
        header.resizeSection(_STATIC, 70)
        header.resizeSection(_LOCATION, 220)
        header.resizeSection(_SOURCE, 120)
        header.resizeSection(_ADDED, 140)
        # A click on a column header sorts by it, a third one restores the order added in.
        # The rows are sorted here, not by the table: rows stand for ``_shown``.
        header.setSectionsClickable(True)
        header.setSortIndicatorShown(True)
        header.setSortIndicatorClearable(True)
        header.setSortIndicator(-1, Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder)
        header.sortIndicatorChanged.connect(lambda _column, _order: self.refresh())
        resizable_columns(self.table)
        copy_menu(self.table, self.translations, self._remove)
        self.table.itemChanged.connect(self._on_item_changed)
        self.table.itemDoubleClicked.connect(self._on_double_click)
        self.table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._show_selection)
        layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        actions = QHBoxLayout()
        self.selection_label = SelectableText()
        actions.addWidget(self.selection_label, 1)
        self.monitor_button = QPushButton(t["catalog.monitor"])
        self.monitor_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.monitor_button, "visibility")
        self.monitor_button.setToolTip(t["favorites.monitor_tooltip"])
        self.monitor_button.clicked.connect(self._request_monitor)
        actions.addWidget(self.monitor_button)
        self.hook_button = QPushButton(t["monitor.create_hook"])
        set_button_icon(self.hook_button, "webhook")
        self.hook_button.setToolTip(t["monitor.create_hook_tooltip"])
        self.hook_button.clicked.connect(self._request_hook)
        actions.addWidget(self.hook_button)
        self.call_button = QPushButton(t["catalog.call"])
        set_button_icon(self.call_button, "call_made")
        self.call_button.clicked.connect(self._request_call)
        actions.addWidget(self.call_button)
        self.calls_button = QPushButton(t["catalog.calls"])
        set_button_icon(self.calls_button, "account_tree")
        self.calls_button.setToolTip(t["catalog.calls_tooltip"])
        self.calls_button.clicked.connect(self._request_calls)
        actions.addWidget(self.calls_button)
        self.copy_button = QPushButton(t["catalog.copy"])
        set_button_icon(self.copy_button, "content_copy")
        self.copy_button.setToolTip(t["favorites.copy_tooltip"])
        self.copy_button.clicked.connect(self._copy)
        actions.addWidget(self.copy_button)
        self.remove_button = QPushButton(t["favorites.remove"])
        set_button_icon(self.remove_button, "delete")
        self.remove_button.clicked.connect(self._remove)
        actions.addWidget(self.remove_button)
        layout.addLayout(actions)

        self.status_label = QLabel("")
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

    # --- Content -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_attached(self, attached):
        """Whether the program runs, so its favorites can be monitored."""
        self.attached = attached
        self._show_selection()

    def refresh(self):
        """Show the favorites anew, keeping the selection."""
        t = self.translations
        selected = {favorite.key for favorite in self.selected_favorites()}
        current = self.selected_favorite()
        words = self.search_input.text().lower().split()
        favorites = self.store.favorites()
        self._shown = self._sorted([favorite for favorite in favorites if favorite.matches(words)])
        self._filling = True
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self._shown))
        for row, favorite in enumerate(self._shown):
            kind = t["favorites.kind_method" if favorite.kind == METHOD else "favorites.kind_native"]
            method = favorite.method() if favorite.kind == METHOD else None
            location = favorite.location
            location_tip = location
            if not favorite.lasting:
                location += "  ⚠"
                location_tip = t["favorites.address_only"]
            added = favorite.created_at.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") if favorite.created_at else ""
            for column, text, tooltip in (
                    (_KIND, kind, None),
                    (_STATIC, "✓" if method is not None and method.static else "", None),
                    (_NAME, favorite.label, favorite.signature),
                    (_LOCATION, location, location_tip),
                    (_NOTE, favorite.note, t["favorites.note_tooltip"]),
                    (_SOURCE, t.get(f"favorites.source_{favorite.source}", favorite.source),
                     None),
                    (_ADDED, added, None)):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
                if tooltip:
                    item.setToolTip(tooltip)
                if column != _NOTE:
                    item.setFlags(item.flags() & ~Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable)
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        self._filling = False
        self._select({favorite.key for favorite in self._shown} & selected,
                     current.key if current is not None else None)
        self.status_label.setText(t["favorites.count"].format(
            shown=len(self._shown), total=len(favorites)))
        self._show_selection()

    def _sorted(self, favorites):
        """``favorites`` in the order the header's sort indicator asks for."""
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        column = header.sortIndicatorSection()
        if column < 0 or column >= len(_COLUMNS):
            return favorites
        t = self.translations
        keys = {
            _KIND: lambda favorite: favorite.kind,
            _STATIC: lambda favorite: favorite.kind == METHOD and favorite.method().static,
            _NAME: lambda favorite: favorite.label.lower(),
            _LOCATION: lambda favorite: favorite.location.lower(),
            _NOTE: lambda favorite: (not favorite.note, favorite.note.lower()),
            _SOURCE: lambda favorite: t.get(f"favorites.source_{favorite.source}",
                                            favorite.source).lower(),
            _ADDED: lambda favorite: (favorite.created_at is None,
                                      favorite.created_at or 0),
        }
        return sorted(favorites, key=keys[column],
                      reverse=header.sortIndicatorOrder() == Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder)

    def _select(self, keys, current_key):
        """Select the rows of the favorites with ``keys``; ``current_key`` gets the focus."""
        selection = self.table.selectionModel()
        flags = (QItemSelectionModel.SelectionFlag.Select
                 | QItemSelectionModel.SelectionFlag.Rows)
        self.table.blockSignals(True)
        self.table.clearSelection()
        for row, favorite in enumerate(self._shown):
            if favorite.key in keys:
                selection.select(self.table.model().index(row, 0), flags)
            if favorite.key == current_key:
                selection.setCurrentIndex(self.table.model().index(row, 0),
                                          QItemSelectionModel.SelectionFlag.NoUpdate)
        self.table.blockSignals(False)

    def selected_favorite(self):
        """The favorite of the current row (the one last clicked), or None."""
        row = self.table.currentRow()
        return self._shown[row] if 0 <= row < len(self._shown) else None

    def selected_favorites(self):
        """The selected favorites, in the order of the table."""
        rows = sorted(index.row() for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows())
        return [self._shown[row] for row in rows if row < len(self._shown)]

    def _show_selection(self):
        favorites = self.selected_favorites()
        self.monitor_button.setEnabled(bool(favorites) and self.attached)
        self.monitor_button.setToolTip(self.translations[
            "favorites.monitor_tooltip" if self.attached else "favorites.not_attached"])
        hookable_method = self._hookable_method(favorites)
        self.hook_button.setEnabled(hookable_method is not None and self.attached)
        self.hook_button.setToolTip(self.translations[
            "monitor.create_hook_tooltip" if self.attached else "favorites.not_attached"])
        callable_method = self._callable_method(favorites)
        self.call_button.setEnabled(callable_method is not None and self.attached)
        self.call_button.setToolTip(self.translations[
            "favorites.not_attached" if not self.attached
            else "favorites.call_tooltip" if callable_method is not None
            else "favorites.call_static_only"])
        graphable_method = self._graphable_method(favorites)
        self.calls_button.setEnabled(graphable_method is not None and self.attached)
        self.calls_button.setToolTip(self.translations[
            "favorites.not_attached" if not self.attached else "catalog.calls_tooltip"])
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(bool(favorites))
        self.remove_button.setEnabled(bool(favorites))
        if len(favorites) == 1:
            text = favorites[0].signature
        elif favorites:
            text = self.translations["favorites.selected"].format(count=len(favorites))
        else:
            text = ""
        self.selection_label.setText(text)

    # --- Actions -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_item_changed(self, item):
        if self._filling or item.column() != _NOTE:
            return
        favorite = self._shown[item.row()] if item.row() < len(self._shown) else None
        if favorite is not None and item.text() != favorite.note:
            self.store.set_note(favorite, item.text())

    def _on_double_click(self, item):
        if item.column() != _NOTE:
            self._request_monitor()

    def _request_monitor(self):
        if not self.attached:
            return
        favorites = self.selected_favorites()
        methods = [favorite.method() for favorite in favorites if favorite.kind == METHOD]
        functions = [favorite.function() for favorite in favorites if favorite.kind != METHOD]
        if methods:
            self.method_monitor_requested.emit(methods)
        if functions:
            self.native_monitor_requested.emit(functions)

    @staticmethod
    def _callable_method(favorites):
        """The CatalogMethod of the only selected favorite if it can be called
        (static, or an instance UFunction), else None."""
        if len(favorites) != 1 or favorites[0].kind != METHOD:
            return None
        method = favorites[0].method()
        return method if can_call(method) else None

    def _request_call(self):
        method = self._callable_method(self.selected_favorites())
        if method is not None and self.attached:
            self.call_requested.emit(method)

    def _request_calls(self):
        method = self._graphable_method(self.selected_favorites())
        if method is not None and self.attached:
            self.calls_requested.emit(method)

    @staticmethod
    def _graphable_method(favorites):
        """The only selected favorite if its engine supports call graphs."""
        if len(favorites) != 1 or favorites[0].kind != METHOD:
            return None
        method = favorites[0].method()
        engine = engine_by_id(method.engine)
        return (method if engine is not None
                and engine.supports(engine_base.CALL_GRAPH) else None)

    def _request_hook(self):
        method = self._hookable_method(self.selected_favorites())
        if method is not None and self.attached:
            self.method_hook_requested.emit(method)

    @staticmethod
    def _hookable_method(favorites):
        """The only selected favorite if it is a method supported by its engine."""
        if len(favorites) != 1 or favorites[0].kind != METHOD:
            return None
        method = favorites[0].method()
        engine = engine_by_id(method.engine)
        return (method if engine is not None
                and engine.supports(engine_base.METHOD_HOOKS) else None)

    def _copy(self):
        favorites = self.selected_favorites()
        if favorites:
            QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText("\n".join(
                favorite.signature if favorite.kind == METHOD else favorite.location
                for favorite in favorites))

    def _remove(self):
        favorites = self.selected_favorites()
        if len(favorites) > 1 and QMessageBox.question(
                self, self.translations["favorites.title"],
                self.translations["favorites.remove_several"].format(count=len(favorites)),
        ) != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        for favorite in favorites:
            self.store.remove(favorite)
```

`hermes/ui/widgets/game_export.py`:

```py
"""The windows that export what is saved for a game as JSON and import it (File menu).

Export: the user picks a game (all processes of one name, see
hermes.db.repository.game_export), whether the pointer scans go along, and
the target file. The file name is made from the game's platform, its name
and today's date until the user changes it.

Import: the user picks an export file and the saved process that takes its
entries (it keeps its own path), and whether they replace its entries or
are mixed in.
"""

from datetime import date
from pathlib import Path

from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QCheckBox,
    QDialog,
    QFileDialog,
    QFormLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QRadioButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
)
from sqlalchemy.exc import SQLAlchemyError

from hermes.db.repository.game_export import (
    ImportFormatError,
    export_counts,
    export_file_name,
    read_export,
)
from hermes.ui.widgets.dialog_buttons import dialog_button_row
from hermes.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon
from hermes.ui.widgets.table import resizable_columns, set_row_height

# Columns after the game's name and platform: the counts of its entries
# Pointer scans last: the import's table leaves them out
_COUNT_COLUMNS = ("addresses", "hooks", "method_hooks", "favorites", "scripts", "pointer_scans")


class GameExportDialog(QDialog):
    """Pick a game and a file, then write the game's export there.

    ``current`` is the name of the attached process: its game is selected
    first. ``exported_path`` holds the file written last.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, repository, current=None, today=None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.repository = repository
        self.today = today or date.today()
        self.exported_path = None
        self._suggested = ""
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["export.title"])
        self.setMinimumWidth(760)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.addWidget(QLabel(translations["export.hint"]))

        headers = ["name", "platform", *_COUNT_COLUMNS]
        self.table = QTableWidget(0, len(headers))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            [translations[f"export.column_{key}"] for key in headers])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(0, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        for column in range(1, len(headers)):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        self._sizer = resizable_columns(self.table)
        self.table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._on_selection)
        layout.addWidget(self.table)

        self.pointer_scans = QCheckBox(translations["export.pointer_scans"])
        self.pointer_scans.setToolTip(translations["export.pointer_scans_tooltip"])
        self.pointer_scans.setChecked(False)
        layout.addWidget(self.pointer_scans)

        form = QFormLayout()
        folder_row = QHBoxLayout()
        self.folder = QLineEdit(str(Path.home()))
        folder_row.addWidget(self.folder)
        browse = QPushButton(translations["export.browse"])
        set_button_icon(browse, "folder_open")
        browse.clicked.connect(self._browse)
        folder_row.addWidget(browse)
        form.addRow(translations["export.folder"], folder_row)
        self.file_name = QLineEdit()
        self.file_name.setToolTip(translations["export.file_name_tooltip"])
        self.file_name.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self._update_buttons())
        form.addRow(translations["export.file_name"], self.file_name)
        layout.addLayout(form)

        self.status = QLabel()
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.status)
        buttons = dialog_button_row(translations, "export.button", self._export, self.reject)
        self.export_button = buttons.itemAt(buttons.count() - 1).widget()
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

        self.games = []
        self._load(current)

    def _load(self, current):
        try:
            self.games = self.repository.list_games()
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.status.setText(self.translations["export.failed"].format(error=error))
            self.games = []
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.games))
        for row, game in enumerate(self.games):
            values = [game.name, game.platform] + [
                str(game.counts.get(key, 0)) for key in _COUNT_COLUMNS]
            for column, value in enumerate(values):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(value)
                if column == 0:
                    item.setToolTip("\n".join(game.paths))
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        if not self.games and not self.status.text():
            self.status.setText(self.translations["export.empty"])
        names = [game.name for game in self.games]
        if names:
            self.table.selectRow(names.index(current) if current in names else 0)
        self._update_buttons()

    @property
    def selected_game(self):
        rows = self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()
        return self.games[rows[0].row()] if rows else None

    def _on_selection(self):
        game = self.selected_game
        if game is None:
            return
        scans = game.counts.get("pointer_scans", 0)
        self.pointer_scans.setEnabled(scans > 0)
        if not scans:
            self.pointer_scans.setChecked(False)
        # A name the user typed stays; the suggestion follows the game.
        if self.file_name.text() in ("", self._suggested):
            self._suggested = export_file_name(game.platform, game.name, self.today)
            self.file_name.setText(self._suggested)
        self._update_buttons()

    def _update_buttons(self):
        self.export_button.setEnabled(
            self.selected_game is not None and bool(self.file_name.text().strip()))

    def _browse(self):
        folder = QFileDialog.getExistingDirectory(
            self, self.translations["export.folder"], self.folder.text())
        if folder:
            self.folder.setText(folder)

    @property
    def target_path(self):
        name = self.file_name.text().strip()
        if not name.lower().endswith(".json"):
            name += ".json"
        return Path(self.folder.text().strip() or Path.home()).expanduser() / name

    def _export(self):
        game = self.selected_game
        if game is None:
            return
        path = self.target_path
        if path.exists() and QMessageBox.question(
                self, self.translations["export.title"],
                self.translations["export.overwrite"].format(path=path),
        ) != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            self.repository.write_export(game.name, path, self.pointer_scans.isChecked())
        except (OSError, SQLAlchemyError) as error:
            self.status.setText(self.translations["export.failed"].format(error=error))
            return
        self.exported_path = path
        self.accept()


class GameImportDialog(QDialog):
    """Pick an export file and the saved process that takes its entries.

    ``current`` is the database id of the attached process: it is selected
    first, else the first process of the file's game. ``result`` holds the
    ImportResult and ``process_id`` the target after an import.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, repository, current=None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.repository = repository
        self.current = current
        self.export = None
        self.result = None
        self.process_id = None
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["import.title"])
        self.setMinimumWidth(760)
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)

        file_row = QHBoxLayout()
        file_row.addWidget(QLabel(translations["import.file"]))
        self.path = QLineEdit()

        file_row.addWidget(self.path)

        set_button_icon(browse, "folder_open")

        layout.addWidget(self.summary)

        headers = ["name", "platform", "path", *_COUNT_COLUMNS[:-1]]
        self.table = QTableWidget(0, len(headers))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            [translations[f"import.column_{key}"] if key == "path"
             else translations[f"export.column_{key}"] for key in headers])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in range(len(headers)):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(2, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        self._sizer = resizable_columns(self.table)
        self.table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._update)
        layout.addWidget(self.table)

        self.merge = QRadioButton(translations["import.merge"])
        self.merge.setToolTip(translations["import.merge_tooltip"])
        self.merge.setChecked(True)
        self.replace = QRadioButton(translations["import.replace"])
        self.replace.setToolTip(translations["import.replace_tooltip"])
        layout.addWidget(self.merge)
        layout.addWidget(self.replace)

        self.status = QLabel()
        self.status.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.status)
        buttons = dialog_button_row(translations, "import.button", self._import, self.reject)
        self.import_button = buttons.itemAt(buttons.count() - 1).widget()
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

        self.processes = []
        self._load_processes()

    def _load_processes(self):
        try:
            self.processes = self.repository.list_processes()
        except SQLAlchemyError as error:
            self.status.setText(self.translations["import.failed"].format(error=error))
            self.processes = []
        self.table.setRowCount(len(self.processes))
        for row, process in enumerate(self.processes):
            values = [process.name, process.platform, process.path] + [
                str(process.counts.get(key, 0)) for key in _COUNT_COLUMNS[:-1]]
            for column, value in enumerate(values):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(value)
                if column == 2:
                    item.setToolTip(value)
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
        self._select_target()

    def _select_target(self):
        ids = [process.process_id for process in self.processes]
        game = None if self.export is None else self.export.get("game")
        if self.current in ids and (
                game is None or self.processes[ids.index(self.current)].name == game):
            self.table.selectRow(ids.index(self.current))
        elif game is not None and any(process.name == game for process in self.processes):
            self.table.selectRow(next(row for row, process in enumerate(self.processes)
                                      if process.name == game))
        elif self.current in ids:
            self.table.selectRow(ids.index(self.current))
        self._update()

    @property
    def selected_process(self):
        rows = self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows()
        return self.processes[rows[0].row()] if rows else None

    def _browse(self):
        path, _filter = QFileDialog.getOpenFileName(
            self, self.translations["import.title"], self.path.text() or str(Path.home()),
            self.translations["import.filter"])
        if path:
            self.load_file(path)

    def load_file(self, path):
        """Read the export in ``path`` and show what it holds."""
        self.path.setText(str(path))
        try:
            self.export = read_export(path)
        except (OSError, ImportFormatError) as error:
            self.export = None
            self.summary.setText(self.translations["import.bad_file"].format(error=error))
            self._update()
            return
        counts = export_counts(self.export)
        self.summary.setText(self.translations["import.summary"].format(
            game=self.export.get("game", "?"), platform=self.export.get("platform", "?"),
            date=str(self.export.get("exported_at", "?"))[:10],
            processes=len(self.export["processes"]), **counts))
        self._select_target()

    def _update(self):
        process = self.selected_process
        warning = ""
        if self.export is not None and process is not None:
            if process.name != self.export.get("game"):
                warning = self.translations["import.other_game"].format(
                    game=self.export.get("game"), name=process.name)
            elif process.platform != self.export.get("platform"):
                warning = self.translations["import.other_platform"].format(
                    platform=self.export.get("platform"), target=process.platform)
        self.status.setText(warning)
        self.import_button.setEnabled(self.export is not None and process is not None)

    def _import(self):
        process = self.selected_process
        if self.export is None or process is None:
            return
        replace = self.replace.isChecked()
        if replace and QMessageBox.question(
                self, self.translations["import.title"],
                self.translations["import.replace_confirm"].format(
                    name=process.name, path=process.path),
        ) != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        try:
            self.result = self.repository.import_export(self.export, process.process_id, replace)
        except (SQLAlchemyError, ValueError, TypeError) as error:
            self.status.setText(self.translations["import.failed"].format(error=error))
            return
        self.process_id = process.process_id
        self.accept()
```

`hermes/ui/widgets/gas_attributes.py`:

```py
"""The player's Gameplay Ability System attributes (Unreal games): read, set, hold.

GAS keeps an attribute's base value and its current value, the base with
the active effects (equipment, food, talents) applied; GAS computes the
current one anew and damage calculations read it through GAS. So a value
written to memory does not last. This window sets the base value through
the game's own code instead (see the Unreal adapter's ``gasSetBase``): a
damage multiplier of 3 with a +40 % bonus active becomes 4.2.

The game sets base values itself, too (loading a save, levelling up, a
respec). "Hold" adds a script to the scripts tab that sets the value again
whenever it changed; it is saved with the game's scripts and runs whenever
hermes attaches.
"""

import json

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QCheckBox,
    QDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
)

from hermes.features.scripts import ScriptSpec
from hermes.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color, theme_qcolor
from hermes.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns, set_row_height

_SET, _ATTRIBUTE, _BASE, _CURRENT, _HELD = range(5)
_COLUMNS = ("gas.column_set", "gas.column_attribute", "gas.column_base",
            "gas.column_current", "gas.column_held")
# How often "Live" reads the values
LIVE_INTERVAL_MS = 1000
# How often a hold script looks whether the game changed the value
HOLD_SECONDS = 2.0
# Labels of the hold scripts: "GAS: AttributeSetCore.Might = 14"
HOLD_PREFIX = "GAS: "
# Theme colours (see icons.theme_color) of a held and of a changed value
_HELD_COLOR = "success"
_CHANGED_COLOR = "warning"

_HOLD_SOURCE = """\
// Made by the GAS attributes window: sets the base value of the player's
// attribute again whenever the game changed it (loading, levelling up ...).
const name = {name}, value = {value};
const attribute = ctx.gas.get(name);
if (attribute === null || Math.abs(attribute.base - value) <= 1e-4 * Math.max(1, Math.abs(value)))
  return;
ctx.gas.setBase(name, value);
return `${{name}} = ${{value}}`;
"""


def hold_label(name, value):
    """The label of the script holding attribute ``name`` at ``value``."""
    return f"{HOLD_PREFIX}{name} = {format_value(value)}"


def hold_spec(name, value):
    """The script holding the player's attribute ``name`` ("Set.Attribute") at ``value``."""
    source = _HOLD_SOURCE.format(name=json.dumps(name), value=json.dumps(float(value)))
    return ScriptSpec(source, "repeat", HOLD_SECONDS, True, hold_label(name, value))


def held_value(label):
    """The value a hold script's label names, or None."""
    try:
        return float(label.rsplit(" = ", 1)[1])
    except (IndexError, ValueError):
        return None


def format_value(value):
    """A float as short as it reads (3, 1.4, 217.6), not 1.399999976."""
    return f"{value:.6g}"


def parse_value(text):
    """A number typed in either locale (1.5 or 1,5); ValueError otherwise."""
    return float(text.strip().replace(",", "."))


class GasAttributesDialog(QDialog):
    """The attribute sets of the player in an Unreal game with GAS.

    Not modal. Requests go through the scripts tab's worker (``panel``, a
    ScriptPanel), which also runs the hold scripts.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes

    def __init__(self, translations, panel, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.panel = panel
        self._worker = None
        self._pending = None  # request id of the list asked for
        self._setting = {}  # request id -> attribute name
        self._state = None
        self._problem = None  # what the status line says is wrong, if anything
        self._filling = False
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["gas.title"])
        self.resize(820, 620)
        self._build_ui()
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(LIVE_INTERVAL_MS)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self.refresh)
        self.live_check.setChecked(True)
        self.refresh()

    def _build_ui(self):
        t = self.translations
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        hint = QLabel(t["gas.hint"])
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        top = QHBoxLayout()
        self.search_input = QLineEdit()
        self.search_input.setPlaceholderText(t["gas.search_placeholder"])
        self.search_input.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.search_input.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self._fill())
        top.addWidget(self.search_input, 1)
        self.changed_check = QCheckBox(t["gas.only_changed"])
        self.changed_check.setToolTip(t["gas.only_changed_tooltip"])
        self.changed_check.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self._fill())
        top.addWidget(self.changed_check)
        self.live_check = QCheckBox(t["gas.live"])
        self.live_check.setToolTip(t["gas.live_tooltip"])
        self.live_check.toggled.connect(self._set_live)
        top.addWidget(self.live_check)
        refresh = QPushButton(t["gas.refresh"])
        set_button_icon(refresh, "refresh")
        refresh.clicked.connect(self.refresh)
        top.addWidget(refresh)
        layout.addLayout(top)

        self.table = QTableWidget(0, len(_COLUMNS))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([t[column] for column in _COLUMNS])
        self.table.horizontalHeaderItem(_BASE).setToolTip(t["gas.base_tooltip"])
        self.table.horizontalHeaderItem(_CURRENT).setToolTip(t["gas.current_tooltip"])
        self.table.horizontalHeaderItem(_HELD).setToolTip(t["gas.held_tooltip"])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.ExtendedSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.DoubleClicked
                                   | QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.EditKeyPressed
                                   | QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.AnyKeyPressed)
        self.table.setWordWrap(False)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in range(len(_COLUMNS)):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(
                column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column == _ATTRIBUTE
                else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.resizeSection(_SET, 180)
        header.resizeSection(_BASE, 110)
        header.resizeSection(_CURRENT, 110)
        header.resizeSection(_HELD, 110)
        resizable_columns(self.table)
        copy_menu(self.table, t)
        self.table.itemChanged.connect(self._on_item_changed)
        self.table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._update_buttons)
        layout.addWidget(self.table, 1)

        actions = QHBoxLayout()
        self.owner_label = QLabel("")
        self.owner_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        actions.addWidget(self.owner_label, 1)
        self.hold_button = QPushButton(t["gas.hold"])
        self.hold_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.hold_button, "push_pin")
        self.hold_button.setToolTip(t["gas.hold_tooltip"])
        self.hold_button.clicked.connect(self._hold_selected)
        actions.addWidget(self.hold_button)
        self.release_button = QPushButton(t["gas.release"])
        set_button_icon(self.release_button, "link_off")
        self.release_button.setToolTip(t["gas.release_tooltip"])
        self.release_button.clicked.connect(self._release_selected)
        actions.addWidget(self.release_button)
        layout.addLayout(actions)

        self.status_label = QLabel("")
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)
        self._update_buttons()

    # --- Requests ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _current_worker(self):
        """The scripts tab's worker, its answers connected; None when detached."""
        worker = self.panel.worker()
        if worker is not None and worker is not self._worker:
            self._worker = worker
            worker.gas_listed.connect(lambda request, state: self._on_listed(
                worker, request, state))
            worker.gas_failed.connect(lambda request, message: self._on_failed(
                worker, request, message))
            worker.gas_set.connect(lambda request, values: self._on_set(
                worker, request, values))
            worker.gas_set_failed.connect(lambda request, message: self._on_set_failed(
                worker, request, message))
            self._pending = None
            self._setting.clear()
        return worker

    def refresh(self):
        """Read the attributes anew (unless an answer is still due)."""
        if self._pending is not None:
            return
        worker = self._current_worker()
        if worker is None:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["gas.detached"])
            return
        self._pending = worker.gas_attributes()

    def _set_live(self, live):
        if live:
            self._timer.start()
        else:
            self._timer.stop()

    def set_base(self, name, value):
        """Set the base value of attribute ``name`` ("Set.Attribute"); a hold
        script of it holds the new value from now on."""
        worker = self._current_worker()
        if worker is None:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["gas.detached"])
            return
        if self.panel.scripts_labelled(f"{HOLD_PREFIX}{name} = "):
            self.panel.put_script(hold_spec(name, value), f"{HOLD_PREFIX}{name} = ")
        self._setting[worker.gas_set_base(name, value)] = name
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["gas.setting"].format(
            name=name, value=format_value(value)))

    # --- Answers -------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_listed(self, worker, request, state):
        if worker is not self._worker or request != self._pending:
            return
        self._pending = None
        self._state = state
        t = self.translations
        self.owner_label.setText("" if state is None
                                 else t["gas.owner"].format(owner=state.get("owner", "?")))
        problem = ("gas.no_player" if state is None
                   else "gas.no_setter" if not state.get("setter")
                   else "gas.no_component" if not state.get("component")
                   else "gas.no_sets" if not state.get("sets") else None)
        if problem is not None:
            self.status_label.setText(t[problem])
        elif self._problem is not None:
            self.status_label.setText("")
        self._problem = problem
        self._fill()

    def _on_failed(self, worker, request, message):
        if worker is not self._worker or request != self._pending:
            return
        self._pending = None
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["gas.failed"].format(
            message=message.splitlines()[0] if message else message))

    def _on_set(self, worker, request, values):
        if worker is not self._worker:
            return
        name = self._setting.pop(request, None)
        if name is None:
            return
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["gas.set"].format(
            name=name, base=format_value(values.get("base", 0)),
            current=format_value(values.get("current", 0))))
        self.refresh()

    def _on_set_failed(self, worker, request, message):
        if worker is not self._worker:
            return
        name = self._setting.pop(request, None)
        if name is None:
            return
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["gas.set_failed"].format(
            name=name, message=message.splitlines()[0] if message else message))
        self._fill()  # the old value again

    # --- Table ---------------------------------------------------------------------
    def rows(self):
        """``[(set, attribute dict)]`` shown, after the search and the filter."""
        if not self._state:
            return []
        words = self.search_input.text().lower().split()
        changed = self.changed_check.isChecked()
        held = self._held()
        shown = []
        for attribute_set in self._state.get("sets", []):
            for attribute in attribute_set.get("attributes", []):
                name = f"{attribute_set['name']}.{attribute['name']}"
                if words and not all(word in name.lower() for word in words):
                    continue
                if changed and name not in held and abs(
                        attribute["current"] - attribute["base"]) < 1e-6:
                    continue
                shown.append((attribute_set["name"], attribute))
        return shown

    def _held(self):
        """``{"Set.Attribute": value}`` of the attributes a hold script holds."""
        held = {}
        for spec in self.panel.scripts_labelled(HOLD_PREFIX).values():
            name = spec.label[len(HOLD_PREFIX):].rsplit(" = ", 1)[0]
            held[name] = held_value(spec.label)
        return held

    def _fill(self):
        """Show the values read last; a cell being edited keeps its text."""
        if self.table.state() == QAbstractItemView.State.EditingState:
            return
        held = self._held()
        rows = self.rows()
        selected = set(self.selected_names())
        self._filling = True
        try:
            self.table.setRowCount(len(rows))
            for row, (set_name, attribute) in enumerate(rows):
                name = f"{set_name}.{attribute['name']}"
                hold = held.get(name)
                texts = (set_name, attribute["name"], format_value(attribute["base"]),
                         format_value(attribute["current"]),
                         "" if name not in held else
                         "✓" if hold is None else f"✓ {format_value(hold)}")
                for column, text in enumerate(texts):
                    item = self.table.item(row, column)
                    if item is None:
                        item = QTableWidgetItem()
                        self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
                    item.setText(text)
                    flags = Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsSelectable | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEnabled
                    if column == _BASE:
                        flags |= Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsEditable
                    item.setFlags(flags)
                self.table.item(row, _ATTRIBUTE).setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, name)
                self.table.item(row, _HELD).setForeground(theme_qcolor(_HELD_COLOR))
                # The effects change it: shown in the colour of a changed value
                differs = abs(attribute["current"] - attribute["base"]) >= 1e-6
                # An unchanged one in the table's own text colour: no colour of its own
                current = self.table.item(row, _CURRENT)
                if differs:
                    current.setForeground(theme_qcolor(_CHANGED_COLOR))
                else:
                    current.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.ForegroundRole, None)
                if name in selected:
                    self.table.selectRow(row)
        finally:
            self._filling = False
        self._update_buttons()

    def selected_names(self):
        """The "Set.Attribute" names of the selected rows."""
        names = []
        for index in self.table.selectionModel().selectedRows():
            item = self.table.item(index.row(), _ATTRIBUTE)
            if item is not None and item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole):
                names.append(item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole))
        return names

    def _on_item_changed(self, item):
        if self._filling or item.column() != _BASE:
            return
        name = self.table.item(item.row(), _ATTRIBUTE).data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        try:
            value = parse_value(item.text())
        except ValueError:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["gas.not_a_number"].format(
                text=item.text()))
            self._fill()
            return
        self.set_base(name, value)

    def _update_buttons(self):
        names = self.selected_names()
        held = self._held()
        self.hold_button.setEnabled(bool(names))
        self.release_button.setEnabled(any(name in held for name in names))

    def _hold_selected(self):
        """Hold the selected attributes at their base value now."""
        values = {f"{set_name}.{attribute['name']}": attribute["base"]
                  for set_name, attribute in self.rows()}
        names = [name for name in self.selected_names() if name in values]
        for name in names:
            self.panel.put_script(hold_spec(name, values[name]), f"{HOLD_PREFIX}{name} = ")
        if names:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["gas.held"].format(
                count=len(names)))
        self._fill()

    def _release_selected(self):
        names = set(self.selected_names())
        for name in names:
            for script_id in self.panel.scripts_labelled(f"{HOLD_PREFIX}{name} = "):
                self.panel.remove_script(script_id)
        if names:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["gas.released"].format(
                count=len(names)))
        self._fill()

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        self._timer.stop()
        super().closeEvent(event)
```

```py
"""Window that lists the calls of hooks in debug mode."""

from datetime import datetime

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QFontDatabase  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QComboBox,
    QDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QMenu,
    QPlainTextEdit,
    QPushButton,
    QSplitter,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
)

from hermes.core import messages
from hermes.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color, theme_qcolor
from hermes.ui.widgets.table import add_copy_actions, resizable_columns, set_row_height


# Oldest entries are discarded beyond this many.
MAX_ENTRIES = 2000
# Pseudo hook id for console.log output that belongs to no hook.
CONSOLE = -1

_COLUMNS = (
    "debug.column_time",
    "debug.column_hook",
    "debug.column_thread",
    "debug.column_address",
    "debug.column_caller",
    "debug.column_old",
    "debug.column_new",
    "debug.column_result",
    "debug.column_note",
)
# Theme colours (see icons.theme_color) of the kinds of entries
_COLORS = {"error": "danger", "skipped": "muted", "kept": "warning", "applied": "success"}


def _number(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""
    if isinstance(value, float) and value.is_integer():
        return str(int(value))
    return f"{value:g}" if isinstance(value, float) else str(value)


def entry_kind(entry):
    """Classify a debug entry: error, skipped, kept, applied or log."""
    if entry.get("error"):
        return "error"
    if entry.get("skipped"):
        return "skipped"
    if entry.get("level"):
        return "log"
    return "kept" if entry.get("kept") else "applied"


class HookDebugWindow(QDialog):
    """Live protocol of hook calls; closing it ends debug mode for all hooks."""

    # Widgets are created by _build_ui called from __init__.
    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    closed = Signal()
    # From the context menu: put the address of an entry on the address list
    add_address_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.setWindowFlag(Qt.WindowType.Window)
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["debug.title"])
        self.resize(1100, 620)
        self._entries = []
        self._labels = {CONSOLE: translations["debug.console"]}
        self._dropped = 0
        self._ignored = 0
        self._build_ui()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # UI
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)

        controls = QHBoxLayout()
        self.btn_pause = QPushButton(self.translations["debug.pause"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_pause, "pause")
        self.btn_pause.setCheckable(True)
        self.btn_pause.toggled.connect(self._on_pause_toggled)
        controls.addWidget(self.btn_pause)
        clear = QPushButton(self.translations["debug.clear"])
        set_button_icon(clear, "clear_all")
        clear.clicked.connect(self.clear)
        controls.addWidget(clear)
        controls.addWidget(QLabel(self.translations["debug.filter"]))
        self.filter_combo = QComboBox()
        self.filter_combo.addItem(self.translations["debug.filter_all"], None)
        self.filter_combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(self._render)
        controls.addWidget(self.filter_combo)
        self.count_label = QLabel()
        controls.addWidget(self.count_label, 1)
        layout.addLayout(controls)

        hint = QLabel(self.translations["debug.hint"])
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Vertical)
        self.table = QTableWidget(0, len(_COLUMNS))
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([self.translations[key] for key in _COLUMNS])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.setAlternatingRowColors(True)
        self.table.setShowGrid(False)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        for column in range(len(_COLUMNS)):
            header.setSectionResizeMode(column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(len(_COLUMNS) - 1, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        resizable_columns(self.table)
        self.table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._show_details)
        self.table.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu)
        self.table.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._show_context_menu)
        splitter.addWidget(self.table)

        self.details = QPlainTextEdit()
        self.details.setReadOnly(True)
        self.details.setFont(QFontDatabase.systemFont(QFontDatabase.SystemFont.FixedFont))
        self.details.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["debug.details_placeholder"])
        splitter.addWidget(self.details)
        splitter.setSizes([440, 160])
        layout.addWidget(splitter, 1)
        self._update_count()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Public API
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_hooks(self, labels):
        """Set the hooks offered by the filter as ``{hook_id: label}``."""
        self._labels = {CONSOLE: self.translations["debug.console"], **labels}
        current = self.filter_combo.currentData()
        self.filter_combo.blockSignals(True)
        self.filter_combo.clear()
        self.filter_combo.addItem(self.translations["debug.filter_all"], None)
        for hook_id, label in labels.items():
            self.filter_combo.addItem(label, hook_id)
        self.filter_combo.addItem(self.translations["debug.console"], CONSOLE)
        self.filter_combo.setCurrentIndex(max(self.filter_combo.findData(current), 0))
        self.filter_combo.blockSignals(False)

    def add_events(self, events, dropped=None):
        """Append debug events sent by the hook agent."""
        self._dropped += sum((dropped or {}).values())
        if self.btn_pause.isChecked():
            self._ignored += len(events)
            self._update_count()
            return
        self._append(events)

    def add_console(self, level, text):
        """Append console.log output of the agent or a transform."""
        self.add_events([{
            "hookId": CONSOLE,
            "time": datetime.now().timestamp() * 1000,
            "level": level,
            "logs": [text],
        }])

    def context_menu(self, entry):
        """The context menu of a debug entry."""
        menu = QMenu(self)
        menu.addAction(
            self.translations["debug.add_address"],
            lambda: self.add_address_requested.emit(entry),
        ).setEnabled(bool(entry.get("address")) and entry.get("hookId") != CONSOLE)
        return menu

    def entries(self):
        """Return the stored debug entries, oldest first."""
        return list(self._entries)

    def clear(self):
        """Remove all entries."""
        self._entries.clear()
        self._dropped = 0
        self._ignored = 0
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        self.details.clear()
        self._update_count()

    def closeEvent(self, a0):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        """Tell the hook panel to end debug mode."""
        self.closed.emit()
        super().closeEvent(a0)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Rendering
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_pause_toggled(self, paused):
        self.btn_pause.setText(
            self.translations["debug.resume" if paused else "debug.pause"]
        )
        set_button_icon(self.btn_pause, "play_arrow" if paused else "pause")

    def _matches(self, entry):
        selected = self.filter_combo.currentData()
        return selected is None or entry.get("hookId") == selected

    def _append(self, events):
        self._entries.extend(events)
        overflow = len(self._entries) - MAX_ENTRIES
        if overflow > 0:
            del self._entries[:overflow]
        scrollbar = self.table.verticalScrollBar()
        at_bottom = scrollbar.value() >= scrollbar.maximum() - 2
        if overflow > 0:
            self._render()
        else:
            for entry in events:
                if self._matches(entry):
                    self._add_row(entry)
        if at_bottom:
            self.table.scrollToBottom()
        self._update_count()

    def _render(self):
        self.table.setRowCount(0)
        for entry in self._entries:
            if self._matches(entry):
                self._add_row(entry)
        self.details.clear()
        self._update_count()

    def _note(self, entry):
        kind = entry_kind(entry)
        logs = entry.get("logs") or []
        if kind == "error":
            return self.translations["debug.note_error"].format(
                message=messages.describe(entry["error"]).splitlines()[0]
            )
        if kind == "skipped":
            return self.translations[f"debug.skipped_{entry['skipped']}"]
        if kind == "log":
            return logs[0] if logs else ""
        note = self.translations[f"debug.note_{kind}"]
        if logs:
            key = "debug.note_log" if len(logs) == 1 else "debug.note_logs"
            note += "  ·  " + self.translations[key].format(count=len(logs), first=logs[0])
        return note

    def _add_row(self, entry):
        row = self.table.rowCount()
        self.table.insertRow(row)
        kind = entry_kind(entry)
        time = datetime.fromtimestamp(entry.get("time", 0) / 1000).strftime("%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3]
        values = (
            time,
            self._labels.get(entry.get("hookId"), f"#{entry.get('hookId')}"),
            str(entry.get("threadId", "")),
            entry.get("address") or "",
            entry.get("caller") or "",
            _number(entry.get("old")),
            _number(entry.get("new")),
            _number(entry.get("result")) if kind == "applied" else "",
            self._note(entry),
        )
        for column, text in enumerate(values):
            item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
            if column == 0:
                item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, entry)
            if column == len(values) - 1 and kind in _COLORS:
                item.setForeground(theme_qcolor(_COLORS[kind]))
            self.table.setItem(row, column, item)

    def _show_context_menu(self, position):
        row = self.table.rowAt(position.y())
        item = self.table.item(row, 0) if row >= 0 else None
        if item is None:
            return
        self.table.selectRow(row)
        menu = self.context_menu(item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole))
        add_copy_actions(menu, self.table, position, self.translations)
        menu.exec(self.table.viewport().mapToGlobal(position))

    def _show_details(self):
        row = self.table.currentRow()
        item = self.table.item(row, 0) if row >= 0 else None
        if item is None:
            self.details.clear()
            return
        entry = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
        lines = [
            f"{self.translations['debug.column_hook']}: "
            f"{self._labels.get(entry.get('hookId'), entry.get('hookId'))}",
        ]
        for key, label in (
            ("address", "debug.column_address"),
            ("caller", "debug.column_caller"),
            ("old", "debug.column_old"),
            ("new", "debug.column_new"),
            ("result", "debug.column_result"),
        ):
            if entry.get(key) is not None:
                value = entry[key]
                text = _number(value) if isinstance(value, (int, float)) else str(value)
                lines.append(f"{self.translations[label]}: {text}")
        lines.append(self._note(entry))
        if entry.get("logs"):
            lines += ["", self.translations["debug.logs"]]
            lines += [f"  {line}" for line in entry["logs"]]
        if entry.get("error"):
            lines += ["", messages.describe(entry["error"])]
        self.details.setPlainText("\n".join(lines))

    def _update_count(self):
        text = self.translations["debug.count"].format(count=len(self._entries))
        if self._dropped:
            text += "  ·  " + self.translations["debug.dropped"].format(count=self._dropped)
        if self._ignored:
            text += "  ·  " + self.translations["debug.ignored"].format(count=self._ignored)
        self.count_label.setText(text)
```

```py
# States in which a hook can be edited, paused or debugged
_LIVE = frozenset({"active", "paused", "error", "training", "reverted"})
# Lines the log below the table keeps
MAX_LOG_LINES = 2000

# Theme colours (see icons.theme_color) of the states
_STATUS_COLORS = {
    "installing": "warning",
    "training": "purple",
    "active": "success",
    "paused": "muted",
    "failed": "danger",
    "error": "danger",
    "reverted": "orange",
    "disconnected": "muted",
}


def parse_number(text):
    """Parse an int (also hex, e.g. 0x10) or a float."""
    try:
        return int(text, 0)
    except ValueError:
        return float(text)


def format_number(value):
    """Format a number for an input field."""
    if isinstance(value, float):
        return f"{value:g}"
    return str(value)


class TransformForm(QWidget):
    """Input form generated from a transform definition's parameters."""

    def __init__(self, definition, translations, values=None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.definition = definition
        self.translations = translations
        self._editors = {}
        # Parameter name -> SyntaxHint of a code parameter
        self._syntax_hints = {}
        values = values or {}

        layout = QFormLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        for parameter in definition.parameters:
            value = values.get(parameter.name, parameter.default)
            editor = self._create_editor(parameter, value)
            self._editors[parameter.name] = (parameter, editor)
            layout.addRow(parameter.label or parameter.name, editor)
            if parameter.kind == "code":
                # Run as a function body (see hermes.hooks.syntax)
                hint = SyntaxHint(translations, editor, BODY, self)
                self._syntax_hints[parameter.name] = hint
                layout.addRow("", hint)

        if definition.description:
            hint = QLabel(definition.description)
            hint.setWordWrap(True)
            layout.addRow(hint)

    def _create_editor(self, parameter, value):
        if parameter.kind == "choice":
            editor = QComboBox()
            for index, choice in enumerate(parameter.choices):
                editor.addItem(parameter.choice_label(index), choice)
            index = editor.findData(value)
            editor.setCurrentIndex(max(index, 0))
            return editor
        if parameter.kind == "code":
            editor = CodeEditor("" if value is None else str(value))
            editor.setMinimumHeight(120)
            return editor
        editor = QLineEdit("" if value is None else format_number(value))
        if parameter.optional:
            editor.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["hooks.optional"])
        return editor

    def create_transform(self):
        """Build the transform; raises ValueError with a readable message."""
        values = {}
        for name, (parameter, editor) in self._editors.items():
            label = parameter.label or name
            if parameter.kind == "choice":
                values[name] = editor.currentData()
            elif parameter.kind == "code":
                problem = self._syntax_hints[name].problem()
                if problem is not None:
                    raise ValueError(f"{label}: {problem}")
                values[name] = editor.toPlainText()
            else:
                text = editor.text().strip()
                if not text:
                    if not parameter.optional:
                        raise ValueError(
                            self.translations["hooks.required"].format(name=label)
                        )
                    values[name] = None
                    continue
                try:
                    values[name] = parse_number(text)
                except ValueError as error:
                    raise ValueError(
                        self.translations["hooks.invalid_number"].format(name=label)
                    ) from error
        return TemplateTransform(self.definition, **values)


class HookDialog(QDialog):
    # Dialogs expose their result through attributes after exec().
    # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods,too-many-instance-attributes
    """Choose a hook template and its parameters for a write or method hook.

    ``templates`` are the TransformDefinitions to choose from (the example
    templates if omitted); only those for the kind of hook are offered. When
    editing, the hook's own copy of its template is shown; if the template
    has changed since, the dialog offers to adopt it.

    With ``method`` (a method's signature) the dialog creates a method hook:
    ``address``, ``value_type`` and ``site`` are not shown then, and ``phase``
    (before or after the call) can be chosen. A write hook chooses how it is
    installed: a jump patched into the code or a hardware ``breakpoint``.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, address, value_type, site,
                 transform=None, label="", templates=None, pointer=None, method=None,
                 phase="after", breakpoint=False, parent=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,redefined-builtin
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.pointer = pointer
        self.method = method
        self.phase = phase
        self.breakpoint = breakpoint
        self.transform = None
        self.label = label
        self.caller_depth = 1
        self._editing = transform is not None
        if templates is None:
            templates = list(example_templates().values())
        kind = "value" if method is None else "method"
        templates = [template for template in templates if template.kind == kind]
        self._options, self._values, self._copy_index, self._template = (
            self._build_options(templates, transform)
        )
        self.setWindowTitle(
            translations["hooks.edit_title" if self._editing else "hooks.create_title"]
        )
        self.resize(520, 420)
        self._build_ui(address, value_type, site, label)

    @staticmethod
    def _build_options(templates, transform):
        """Return the definitions to offer, the hook's values and copy index.

        The hook's copy replaces the template it was created from; a copy whose
        template no longer exists is offered in addition.
        """
        options = list(templates)
        if transform is None:
            return options, {}, None, None
        current = as_template_transform(transform)
        copy = current.definition
        index = next(
            (
                i for i, option in enumerate(options)
                if copy.template_id is not None and option.template_id == copy.template_id
            ),
            None,
        )
        template = None
        if index is None:
            options.insert(0, copy)
            index = 0
        else:
            template = options[index]
            options[index] = copy
        return options, current.form_values(), index, template

    def _build_ui(self, address, value_type, site, label):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setSpacing(10)

        info = QLabel(
            self.translations["hooks.dialog_target"].format(
                address=address, type=value_type, site=site
            ) if self.method is None
            else self.translations["hooks.dialog_method"].format(method=self.method)
        )
        info.setWordWrap(True)
        info.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)
        layout.addWidget(info)

        form = QFormLayout()
        self.label_input = QLineEdit(label)
        self.label_input.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["hooks.label_placeholder"])
        form.addRow(self.translations["hooks.label"], self.label_input)
        if self.pointer is not None:
            target = QLabel(self.pointer.text())
            target.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('purple')};")
            target.setToolTip(self.translations["hooks.pointer_hint"])
            target.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)
            form.addRow(self.translations["hooks.pointer"], target)
        elif not self._editing and self.method is None:
            self.caller_depth_input = QSpinBox()
            self.caller_depth_input.setRange(0, MAX_CALLER_DEPTH)
            self.caller_depth_input.setValue(self.caller_depth)
            self.caller_depth_input.setSpecialValueText(
                self.translations["hooks.caller_depth_off"]
            )
            self.caller_depth_input.setToolTip(self.translations["hooks.caller_depth_hint"])
            form.addRow(self.translations["hooks.caller_depth"], self.caller_depth_input)
        if self.method is None:
            self.install_combo = QComboBox()
            for hardware in (False, True):
                key = "breakpoint" if hardware else "patch"
                self.install_combo.addItem(self.translations[f"hooks.install_{key}"], hardware)
            self.install_combo.setCurrentIndex(1 if self.breakpoint else 0)
            self.install_combo.setToolTip(self.translations["hooks.install_tooltip"])
            form.addRow(self.translations["hooks.install"], self.install_combo)
        if self.method is not None:
            self.phase_combo = QComboBox()
            for phase in PHASES:
                self.phase_combo.addItem(self.translations[f"hooks.phase_{phase}"], phase)
            self.phase_combo.setCurrentIndex(max(self.phase_combo.findData(self.phase), 0))
            self.phase_combo.setToolTip(self.translations["hooks.phase_tooltip"])
            form.addRow(self.translations["hooks.phase"], self.phase_combo)
        self.template_combo = QComboBox()
        form.addRow(self.translations["hooks.template"], self.template_combo)
        layout.addLayout(form)

        self.template_notice = QWidget()
        notice_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.template_notice)
        notice_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.template_notice_label = QLabel()
        self.template_notice_label.setWordWrap(True)
        self.template_notice_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('warning')};")
        self.btn_adopt_template = QPushButton(self.translations["hooks.template_adopt"])
        set_button_icon(self.btn_adopt_template, "sync")
        self.btn_adopt_template.clicked.connect(self._adopt_template)
        notice_layout.addWidget(self.template_notice_label, 1)
        notice_layout.addWidget(self.btn_adopt_template)
        layout.addWidget(self.template_notice)

        self.forms = QStackedWidget()
        for index, definition in enumerate(self._options):
```
