```py
def value_text(value):
    """A register value for the log: a small number, or the address and what it is."""
    number = int(value["value"], 16)
    if number < _SMALL or -_SMALL < signed(value["value"]) < 0:
        text = str(signed(value["value"]))
    else:
        text = value["value"]
    if value.get("text"):
        text += f' "{value["text"]}"'
    elif value.get("where"):
        text += f" ({value['where']})"
    return text


def registers_text(call):
    """The registers of an instruction pass that point somewhere or hold small numbers."""
    return ", ".join(f"{name}={value_text(value)}" for name, value in call["registers"])


def caller_text(call):
    return call.get("callerSymbol") or call.get("callerWhere") or call.get("caller", "")


def byte_numbers(hex_text):
    """``10 10`` for the bytes ``0a0a``."""
    return " ".join(str(byte) for byte in bytes.fromhex(hex_text))


class NativeCallModel(QAbstractTableModel):
    """The latest calls, newest last."""

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.calls = []
        self.names = {}
        self.platform = None
        self.arch = None

    def rowCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(self.calls)

    def columnCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(_CALL_COLUMNS)

    def headerData(self, section, orientation, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole and orientation == Qt.Orientation.Horizontal:
            return self.translations[_CALL_COLUMNS[section]]
        return None

    def arguments_text(self, call):
        if "registers" in call:
            return registers_text(call)
        return ", ".join(f"{argument_name(index, self.platform, self.arch)}={value_text(value)}"
                         for index, value in enumerate(call.get("args", [])))

    def data(self, index, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid() or role not in (Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole,
                                               Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole):
            return None
        call = self.calls[index.row()]
        column = index.column()
        if column == _C_TIME:
            return call_time(call)
        if column == _C_THREAD:
            return str(call.get("thread", ""))
        if column == _C_FUNCTION:
            return self.names.get(call.get("monitorId"), "?")
        if column == _C_ARGS:
            return self.arguments_text(call)
        if "registers" in call:
            return "—" if column in (_C_RESULT, _C_CHANGES) else ""
        if column == _C_RESULT:
            return value_text(call["result"])
        if column == _C_CALLER:
            return caller_text(call)
        count = len(call.get("changes", []))
        return f"{count}+" if call.get("moreChanges") else str(count)

    def set_calls(self, calls):
        self.beginResetModel()
        self.calls = list(calls[-MAX_CALLS:])
        self.endResetModel()

    def append(self, calls):
        if not calls:
            return
        overflow = len(self.calls) + len(calls) - MAX_CALLS
        if overflow > 0:
            removed = min(overflow, len(self.calls))
            self.beginRemoveRows(QModelIndex(), 0, removed - 1)
            del self.calls[:removed]
            self.endRemoveRows()
            calls = calls[-MAX_CALLS:]
        start = len(self.calls)
        self.beginInsertRows(QModelIndex(), start, start + len(calls) - 1)
        self.calls.extend(calls)
        self.endInsertRows()

    def call_at(self, row):
        return self.calls[row] if 0 <= row < len(self.calls) else None


def _table(translations, columns, stretch_column, delete=None):
    table = QTableWidget(0, len(columns))
    table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([translations[column] for column in columns])
    table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
    table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
    table.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
    table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
    table.setWordWrap(False)
    header = table.horizontalHeader()
    for column in range(len(columns)):
        header.setSectionResizeMode(
            column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column == stretch_column
            else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
    resizable_columns(table)
    copy_menu(table, translations, delete)
    return table


def _item(text, address=None, tooltip=None):
    item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
    if address is not None:
        item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, address)
    if tooltip:
        item.setToolTip(tooltip)
    return item

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    # --- Monitors --------------------------------------------------------------
    def add_function(self, function):
        """Monitor a NativeFunction of the native trace."""
        location = ({"module": function.module, "offset": function.offset} if function.module
                    else {"address": f"0x{function.address:x}"})
        # A call target of the trace: the start of a function
        self._add(location, function.label, function.signature, FUNCTION)

    def add_address(self, address):
        """Monitor what runs at ``address``: an instruction, or a function if it starts there."""
        text = f"0x{address:x}"
        self._add({"address": text}, text, text, AUTO)

    def _add_typed(self):
        text = self.location_input.text()
        try:
            location = parse_location(text)
        except ValueError:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_monitor.location_missing"])
            return
        self._add(location, text.strip(), text.strip(), self.kind_combo.currentData())

    def _add_enclosing(self):
        monitor_id = self._selected_monitor()
        function = None if monitor_id is None else self._monitors[monitor_id]["function"]
        if function is not None:
            start, name = function
            self._add({"address": start}, name, name, FUNCTION)

    def _add(self, location, label, tooltip, kind):
        key = tuple(sorted(location.items()))
        for state in self._monitors.values():
            if state["key"] == key:
                return  # monitored already
        monitor_id = self._next_id
        self._next_id += 1
        row = self.functions_table.rowCount()
        self.functions_table.insertRow(row)
        self.functions_table.setItem(row, _F_FUNCTION, _item(label, tooltip=tooltip))
        for column in (_F_LOCATION, _F_CALLS, _F_SKIPPED):
            self.functions_table.setItem(row, column, _item(""))
        self.functions_table.setItem(row, _F_STATUS, _item(
            self.translations["native_monitor.status_adding"]))
        self._monitors[monitor_id] = {"label": label, "key": key, "row": row, "address": None,
                                      "function": None}
        self.log.names[monitor_id] = label
        self._worker.add(monitor_id, location, self.arguments_spin.value(), self.dump_spin.value(),
                         kind)

    def _row_of(self, monitor_id):
        state = self._monitors.get(monitor_id)
        return None if state is None else state["row"]

    def _on_added(self, monitor_id, info):
        row = self._row_of(monitor_id)
        if row is None:
            return
        state = self._monitors[monitor_id]
        found = (info.get("address"), info.get("kind"))
        if any(other["address"] == found for other in self._monitors.values()):
            # The same function, written differently (name, module+offset, address)
            state["key"] = None
            self._worker.remove(monitor_id)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_monitor.already"].format(
                function=state["label"]))
            return
        state["address"] = found
        if info.get("symbol") and state["label"] != info["symbol"]:
            # Typed as an address: the symbol tells more.
            state["label"] = info["symbol"]
            self.log.names[monitor_id] = info["symbol"]
            self.functions_table.item(row, _F_FUNCTION).setText(info["symbol"])
        location = info.get("where") or info.get("address", "")
        self.functions_table.item(row, _F_LOCATION).setText(
            f"{location}  ({info.get('address', '')})")
        self.functions_table.item(row, _F_CALLS).setText("0")
        self.functions_table.item(row, _F_SKIPPED).setText("0")
        kind = info.get("kind", FUNCTION)
        self.functions_table.item(row, _F_STATUS).setText(
            self.translations[f"native_monitor.status_{kind}"])
        self.status_label.setText("")
        if info.get("function"):
            state["function"] = (info["function"], info["functionName"])
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_monitor.inside_function"].format(
                function=info["functionName"]))
        self._update_buttons()

    def _on_add_failed(self, monitor_id, message):
        row = self._row_of(monitor_id)
        if row is not None:
            self.functions_table.item(row, _F_STATUS).setText(
                self.translations["native_monitor.status_failed"])
            self.functions_table.item(row, _F_STATUS).setToolTip(message)
            # Not monitored: may be added again (e.g. after a typo)
            self._monitors[monitor_id]["key"] = None
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_monitor.add_failed"].format(
            message=message))

    def _selected_monitor(self):
        row = self.functions_table.currentRow()
        for monitor_id, state in self._monitors.items():
            if state["row"] == row:
                return monitor_id
        return None

    def _update_buttons(self):
        monitor_id = self._selected_monitor()
        self.remove_button.setEnabled(monitor_id is not None)
        self.function_button.setEnabled(
            monitor_id is not None and self._monitors[monitor_id]["function"] is not None)

    def _remove_selected(self):
        monitor_id = self._selected_monitor()
        if monitor_id is not None:
            self._worker.remove(monitor_id)

    def _on_removed(self, monitor_id):
        row = self._row_of(monitor_id)
        if row is None:
            return
        del self._monitors[monitor_id]
        self.functions_table.removeRow(row)
        for state in self._monitors.values():
            if state["row"] > row:
                state["row"] -= 1
        self._update_buttons()

    def _on_command_failed(self, action, message):
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.failed"].format(
            message=f"{action}: {message}"))

    def _on_worker_failed(self, message):
        self.add_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_monitor.worker_failed"].format(
            message=message))

    # --- Calls -------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_calls(self, calls, counts):
        self.log.platform = self._worker.platform
        self.log.arch = self._worker.arch
        for monitor_id, numbers in counts.items():
            row = self._row_of(monitor_id)
            if row is not None:
                self.functions_table.item(row, _F_CALLS).setText(str(numbers.get("calls", 0)))
                self.functions_table.item(row, _F_SKIPPED).setText(
                    str(numbers.get("skipped", 0)))
        if not calls or self.pause_button.isChecked():
            return
        self._calls.extend(calls)
        del self._calls[:-MAX_CALLS]
        self.log.append([call for call in calls if self._shown(call)])

    def _shown(self, call):
        return call.get("changes") or not self.changes_check.isChecked()

    def _show_calls(self):
        self.log.set_calls([call for call in self._calls if self._shown(call)])

    def _clear(self):
        self._calls = []
        self.log.set_calls([])

    def _show_call(self, current, _previous=None):
        call = self.log.call_at(current.row()) if current.isValid() else None
        self._fill_values(call)
        self._fill_changes(call)
        self._memory_address = None
        self.memory_button.setEnabled(False)
        if call is None or "registers" in call:
            self.selection_label.setText("" if call is None else
                                         self.log.names.get(call.get("monitorId"), "?"))
            return
        self.selection_label.setText(
            f"{self.log.names.get(call.get('monitorId'), '?')} ← {caller_text(call)}"
            f"  ({call.get('callerWhere') or call.get('caller', '')})")

    def _fill_values(self, call):
        table = self.values_table
        table.setRowCount(0)
        if call is None:
            return
        platform, arch = self._worker.platform, self._worker.arch
        if "registers" in call:
            rows = [tuple(register) for register in call["registers"]]
        else:
            rows = [(argument_name(index, platform, arch), value)
                    for index, value in enumerate(call.get("args", []))]
            rows.append((self.translations["monitor.column_result"], call["result"]))
        for name, value in rows:
            number = int(value["value"], 16)
            meaning = (f'"{value["text"]}"' if value.get("text") else value.get("where", ""))
            row = table.rowCount()
            table.insertRow(row)
            pointer = number if _SMALL <= number < _TOP else None
            table.setItem(row, _V_NAME, _item(name))
            table.setItem(row, _V_VALUE, _item(value["value"], pointer))
            table.setItem(row, _V_NUMBER, _item(str(signed(value["value"]))))
            table.setItem(row, _V_MEANING, _item(meaning, tooltip=meaning))
        if "registers" in call:
            return
        row = table.rowCount()
        table.insertRow(row)
        table.setItem(row, _V_NAME, _item(self.translations["monitor.column_caller"]))
        table.setItem(row, _V_VALUE, _item(call.get("caller", ""),
                                           int(call.get("caller", "0x0"), 16)))
        table.setItem(row, _V_NUMBER, _item(""))
        caller = " · ".join(text for text in (call.get("callerSymbol"),
                                              call.get("callerWhere")) if text)
        table.setItem(row, _V_MEANING, _item(caller, tooltip=caller))

    def _fill_changes(self, call):
        table = self.changes_table
        table.setRowCount(0)
        if call is None:
            return
        platform, arch = self._worker.platform, self._worker.arch
        for change in call.get("changes", []):
            row = table.rowCount()
            table.insertRow(row)
            address = int(change["address"], 16)
            numbers = change_numbers(change["before"], change["after"])
            table.setItem(row, _X_ARGUMENT, _item(argument_name(change["arg"], platform, arch)))
            table.setItem(row, _X_OFFSET, _item(f"+0x{change['offset']:x}"))
            table.setItem(row, _X_ADDRESS, _item(change["address"], address))
            table.setItem(row, _X_BEFORE, _item(change["before"]))
            table.setItem(row, _X_AFTER, _item(change["after"]))
            table.setItem(row, _X_BYTES, _item(
                f"{byte_numbers(change['before'])} → {byte_numbers(change['after'])}"))
            table.setItem(row, _X_NUMBER, _item(
                "" if numbers is None else f"{numbers[0]} → {numbers[1]}"))
        if call.get("moreChanges"):
            row = table.rowCount()
            table.insertRow(row)
            table.setItem(row, _X_ARGUMENT, _item(self.translations["native_monitor.more_changes"]))

    # --- Memory ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _pick_memory(self, table):
        """The address of the row selected in ``table`` (values or changes), if any."""
        address = None
        row = table.currentRow()
        if row >= 0:
            for column in range(table.columnCount()):
                item = table.item(row, column)
                if item is not None and item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) is not None:
                    address = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                    break
        self._memory_address = address
        self.memory_button.setEnabled(address is not None)

    def _request_memory(self):
        if self._memory_address is not None:
            self.memory_requested.emit(self._memory_address)

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        # Removing the interceptors can wait for calls in progress; do not
        # block the window for that.
        worker = self._worker
        worker.requestInterruption()
        if worker.isRunning():
            keep_until_finished(worker)
        super().closeEvent(event)

```

```py
# States of the window
_LOADING, _IDLE, _PREPARING, _READY, _RECORDING = range(5)


class NativeRowModel(TraceRowModel):
    """The functions the scenario called (TraceRows of NativeFunctions)."""

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(translations, parent)
        self.columns = tuple("native_trace.column_function" if column == "trace.column_method"
                             else column for column in self.columns)

    def method_name(self, index):
        return self.methods[index].label


class NativeSequenceModel(TraceSequenceModel):
    """The first calls of the scenario, the call instruction as the caller."""

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(translations, parent)
        self.columns = tuple("native_trace.column_function" if column == "trace.column_method"
                             else column for column in self.columns)

    def method_name(self, index):
        return self.methods[index].label


class NativeTraceDialog(QDialog):
    """Follow threads of the game with Stalker, record a baseline and a scenario, compare.

    Not modal. The worker and its Frida session live as long as the window;
    closing it stops following the threads.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    # address (int) to show in the memory viewer
    memory_requested = Signal(object)
    # NativeFunction whose calls to monitor
    monitor_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, translations, pid, parent=None, favorites=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.pid = pid
        self.wine = is_wine_process(pid)
        self._favorites = favorites
        self.functions = []
        self.baseline = None
        self.scenario = None
        self.rows = []
        self.followed_modules = set()
        self._state = _LOADING
        self._recording = None
        self._selected = None
        self._positions = {}
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["native_trace.title"])
        self.resize(1100, 760)
        self._build_ui()
        self._worker = NativeTraceWorker(pid)
        self._worker.inventory_found.connect(self._on_inventory)
        self._worker.started.connect(self._on_started)
        self._worker.began.connect(self._on_began)
        self._worker.live.connect(self._on_live)
        self._worker.recorded.connect(self._on_recorded)
        self._worker.stopped.connect(self._on_stopped)
        self._worker.command_failed.connect(self._on_command_failed)
        self._worker.worker_failed.connect(self._on_worker_failed)
        self._worker.start()
        self._worker.inventory()
        self.status_label.setText(translations["native_trace.loading"])
        self._set_state(_LOADING)

    # --- UI ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        t = self.translations

        hint = QLabel(t["native_trace.hint"])
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        layout.addWidget(hint)
        if self.wine:
            warning = QLabel(t["native_trace.wine_warning"])
            warning.setWordWrap(True)
            layout.addWidget(warning)

        scope = QHBoxLayout()
        threads = QVBoxLayout()
        threads.addWidget(QLabel(t["native_trace.threads"]))
        self.thread_list = QListWidget()

        threads.addWidget(self.thread_list)
        scope.addLayout(threads, 1)
        modules = QVBoxLayout()
        modules.addWidget(QLabel(t["native_trace.modules"]))
        self.module_list = QListWidget()
        self.module_list.setToolTip(t["native_trace.modules_tooltip"])
        modules.addWidget(self.module_list)
        scope.addLayout(modules, 1)
        scope_widget = QWidget()
        scope_widget.setLayout(scope)
        scope_widget.setMaximumHeight(180)
        layout.addWidget(scope_widget)

        self.trace_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.trace_button, "play_arrow")
        self.trace_button.clicked.connect(self._toggle_trace)
        steps.addWidget(self.trace_button)
        self.baseline_button = QPushButton(t["trace.baseline"])

        steps.addWidget(self.baseline_button)

        set_button_icon(self.scenario_button, RECORDING_ICONS["scenario"])
        self.scenario_button.setToolTip(t["trace.scenario_tooltip"])
        self.scenario_button.setCheckable(True)
        self.scenario_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._toggle_recording("scenario"))
        steps.addWidget(self.scenario_button)
        self.recording_label = QLabel("")
        steps.addWidget(self.recording_label, 1)
        layout.addLayout(steps)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Vertical)
        top = QWidget()
        top_layout = QVBoxLayout(top)
        top_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        rows_bar = QHBoxLayout()
        rows_bar.addWidget(QLabel(t["native_trace.functions"]))
        rows_bar.addStretch()
        self.game_code_check = QCheckBox(t["native_trace.game_code_only"])
        self.game_code_check.setToolTip(t["native_trace.game_code_tooltip"])
        self.game_code_check.setChecked(True)
        self.game_code_check.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self._show_results())
        rows_bar.addWidget(self.game_code_check)
        self.notable_check = QCheckBox(t["native_trace.notable_only"])
        self.notable_check.setToolTip(t["native_trace.notable_tooltip"])

        rows_bar.addWidget(self.notable_check)
        top_layout.addLayout(rows_bar)

        self.row_filter.changed.connect(self._show_rows)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.row_filter)
        self.row_model = NativeRowModel(t, self)
        self.rows_view = self._table(self.row_model, _R_METHOD, sortable=True)
        header = self.rows_view.horizontalHeader()

        sequence_header.resizeSection(_S_THREAD, 80)

    def _table(self, model, stretch_column, sortable=False):
        view = trace_table(model, stretch_column, sortable, self._favorites, NATIVE_TRACE,
                           self.translations)
        view.doubleClicked.connect(
            lambda index: index.column() != FAVORITE_COLUMN and self._request_memory())
        return view

    def _set_state(self, state):
        self._state = state
        tracing = state in (_READY, _RECORDING)
        self.thread_list.setEnabled(state == _IDLE)
        self.module_list.setEnabled(state == _IDLE)
        self.trace_button.setEnabled(state in (_IDLE, _READY))
        self.trace_button.setText(self.translations[
            "native_trace.stop" if tracing else "native_trace.start"])
        set_button_icon(self.trace_button, "stop" if tracing else "play_arrow")
        for phase, button in (("baseline", self.baseline_button),
                              ("scenario", self.scenario_button)):
            active = state == _RECORDING and self._recording == phase
            button.setEnabled(state == _READY or active)
            button.setChecked(active)
            button.setText(self.translations[f"trace.{phase}_stop" if active else f"trace.{phase}"])
            set_button_icon(button, "stop" if active else RECORDING_ICONS[phase])
        if state != _RECORDING:
            self.recording_label.setText("")

    # --- Choosing threads and modules -------------------------------------------
    def _on_inventory(self, threads, modules, _platform):
        t = self.translations
        self.thread_list.clear()
        for thread in threads:
            text = t["native_trace.thread_entry"].format(name=thread.name or "—", id=thread.id)
            if thread.load is not None:
                text += "  " + t["native_trace.thread_load"].format(percent=thread.load * 100)
            item = QListWidgetItem(text)
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, thread.id)
            item.setFlags(item.flags() | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable)
            # Idle threads wait somewhere, maybe for long: a followed thread
            # blocked in a call delays the end of the trace until it returns.
            busy = thread.active is not False
            item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked if busy else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)
            self.thread_list.addItem(item)
        self.module_list.clear()
        for module in sorted(modules, key=lambda module: (not module.game, module.name.lower())):
            item = QListWidgetItem(module.name)
            item.setToolTip(module.path)
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, module.name)
            item.setFlags(item.flags() | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable)
            item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked if module.game else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)
            self.module_list.addItem(item)
        self.status_label.setText(t["native_trace.inventory"].format(
            threads=len(self._checked(self.thread_list)), total=len(threads),
            modules=sum(module.game for module in modules)))
        self._set_state(_IDLE)

    @staticmethod
    def _checked(widget):
        return [widget.item(row).data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) for row in range(widget.count())
                if widget.item(row).checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked]

    # --- Trace -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _toggle_trace(self):
        if self._state == _IDLE:
            threads = self._checked(self.thread_list)
            modules = self._checked(self.module_list)
            if not threads or not modules:
                self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_trace.choose"])
                return
            self.followed_modules = set(modules)
            self._set_state(_PREPARING)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_trace.preparing"])
            self._worker.trace(threads, modules)
        elif self._state == _READY:
            self._set_state(_PREPARING)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_trace.stopping"])
            self._worker.stop()

    def _on_started(self, info):
        self.functions = []
        self.baseline = None
        self.scenario = None
        self._show_results()
        self._set_state(_READY)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_trace.started"].format(
            threads=info.get("threads", 0), modules=info.get("modules", 0),
            failed=info.get("failed", 0)))

    def _on_stopped(self):
        self._set_state(_IDLE)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_trace.stopped"])

    def _on_command_failed(self, action, message):
        # A failed start leaves no trace; other commands keep it.
        self._set_state(_IDLE if action in ("start", "inventory", "stop") else _READY)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.failed"].format(message=message))

    def _on_worker_failed(self, message):
        self._set_state(_IDLE)
        self.trace_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_trace.worker_failed"].format(
            message=message))

    # --- Recording -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _toggle_recording(self, phase):
        if self._state == _READY:
            self._recording = phase
            self._set_state(_RECORDING)
            self.recording_label.setText(self.translations["trace.recording_starting"])
            self._worker.begin(phase)
        elif self._state == _RECORDING and self._recording == phase:
            self.baseline_button.setEnabled(False)
            self.scenario_button.setEnabled(False)
            self._worker.finish()
        else:
            self._set_state(self._state)  # undo the click's check mark

    def _on_began(self, phase):
        self.recording_label.setText(self.translations[f"trace.recording_{phase}"])

    def _on_live(self, live):
        if self._state == _RECORDING:
            self.recording_label.setText(self.translations["native_trace.live"].format(
                phase=self.translations[f"trace.phase_{live.get('phase', '')}"],
                calls=live.get("calls", 0), functions=live.get("methods", 0)))

    def _on_recorded(self, result):
        self._recording = None
        self._set_state(_READY)
        apply_names(self.functions, result)
        seconds = result.get("duration", 0) / 1000
        if result.get("phase") == "baseline":
            self.baseline = result
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["native_trace.baseline_done"].format(
                functions=len(result.get("counts", {})), seconds=seconds)
                + self._lost_text(result))
            if self.scenario is not None:
                self._show_results()  # compare the scenario with the new baseline
            return
        self.scenario = result
        self._show_results()
        text = self.translations["native_trace.scenario_done"].format(
            functions=len(self.rows), notable=sum(row.notable for row in self.rows),
            calls=len(self.sequence_model.items), seconds=seconds)
        if result.get("dropped"):
            text += "  ·  " + self.translations["trace.dropped"].format(count=result["dropped"])
        self.status_label.setText(text + self._lost_text(result))

    def _lost_text(self, result):
        """A warning when the table of functions was full, or ''."""
        if not result.get("lost"):
            return ""
        return "\n" + self.translations["native_trace.lost"].format(count=result["lost"])

    # --- Results -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _in_game_code(self, number):
        # Code outside modules (generated at run time) counts as the game's.
        module = self.functions[number].module
        return not module or module in self.followed_modules

    def _show_results(self):
        rows = analyze(self.scenario, self.baseline) if self.scenario else []
        calls = recording_calls(self.scenario) if self.scenario else []
        if self.game_code_check.isChecked():
            rows = [row for row in rows if self._in_game_code(row.method)]
            calls = [call for call in calls if self._in_game_code(call.method)]
        self.rows = rows
        # The sequence holds the first call per thread: where the row starts
        positions = {}
        for position, call in enumerate(calls):
            positions.setdefault(call.method, position)
        self._positions = positions
        self.sequence_model.set_items(self.functions, calls)
        self._show_rows()

    def _show_rows(self):
        notable_only = self.notable_check.isChecked()
        rows = [row for row in self.rows if (row.notable or not notable_only)
                and self.row_filter.accepts(row, self.functions[row.method].signature)]
        self.row_model.set_items(self.functions, rows)
        self._selected = None
        self._show_selection()

    def _on_row_selected(self, current, _previous=None):
        row = self.row_model.item_at(current.row()) if current.isValid() else None
        if row is None:
            return
        self._selected = row.method
        self._show_selection()
        position = self._positions.get(row.method)
        if position is not None:
            index = self.sequence_model.index(position, 0)
            self.sequence_view.scrollTo(index, QAbstractItemView.ScrollHint.PositionAtCenter)

    def _on_call_selected(self, current, _previous=None):
        call = self.sequence_model.item_at(current.row()) if current.isValid() else None
        if call is not None:
            self._selected = call.method
            self._show_selection()

    def selected_function(self):
        """The NativeFunction chosen in either table, or None."""
        return self.functions[self._selected] if self._selected is not None else None

    def _show_selection(self):
        function = self.selected_function()
        self.monitor_button.setEnabled(function is not None)
        self.memory_button.setEnabled(function is not None)
        self.copy_button.setEnabled(function is not None)
        self.selection_label.setText(function.signature if function is not None else "")

    def _request_monitor(self):
        function = self.selected_function()
        if function is not None:
            self.monitor_requested.emit(function)

    def _request_memory(self):
        function = self.selected_function()
        if function is not None:
            self.memory_requested.emit(function.address)

    def _copy_address(self):
        function = self.selected_function()
        if function is not None:
            QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(f"0x{function.address:x}")

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        # Stalker lets go of the threads only when they leave its code; do
        # not block the window for that.
        worker = self._worker
        worker.requestInterruption()
        if worker.isRunning():
            keep_until_finished(worker)
        super().closeEvent(event)
```

```py
"""Object inspector: the fields of a managed object in a Mono game."""

import json
from datetime import datetime

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, QTimer, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QAbstractItemView,
    QCheckBox,
    QDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QMenu,

from hermes.core import messages
from hermes.ui import window_state
from hermes.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color, theme_qcolor
from hermes.ui.widgets.labels import SelectableText
from hermes.ui.widgets.table import add_copy_actions, copy_menu, resizable_columns, set_row_height


LIVE_INTERVAL_MS = 500

_FIELD, _TYPE, _VALUE, _OFFSET, _OPEN = range(5)
_P_NAME, _P_TYPE, _P_VALUE, _P_LINK, _P_SET = range(5)
_M_NAME, _M_PARAMS, _M_RETURNS, _M_OWNER, _M_LINK = range(5)
# Data role of the offset cell: the field's {address, valueType} (see monitor.js)
_LOCATION_ROLE = Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole + 1
# What a static field shows when it has no value to read, by its storage
_STATIC_KINDS = {"const": "inspector.static_const", "thread": "inspector.static_thread"}
# Theme colour (see icons.theme_color) of a value that could not be read
_ERROR = "danger"
# Unreal's containers, whose entries the inspector shows as fields
_CONTAINERS = ("TArray<", "TMap<", "TSet<")
# Largest height Qt allows a widget (QWIDGETSIZE_MAX)
_NO_LIMIT = 16777215


def link_label(text, on_click):
    """A table cell widget with one link."""
    # Qt's default link blue is unreadable on dark themes: the theme's accent.
    label = QLabel(f'<a href="#" style="color: {theme_color("accent")}; '
                   f'text-decoration: none;">{text}</a>')
    label.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.LinksAccessibleByMouse)
    label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignLeft | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
    label.setContentsMargins(8, 0, 8, 0)
    label.setCursor(Qt.CursorShape.PointingHandCursor)
    label.setObjectName("cell_widget")  # the row's selection shows through (styles.py)
    label.linkActivated.connect(lambda _link: on_click())
    return label


def link_width(widget, texts):
    """Column width that fits a link with any of ``texts`` in ``widget``."""
    widths = []
    for text in texts:
        label = link_label(text, lambda: None)
        label.hide()
        label.setParent(widget)  # styled like the table's cells
        label.ensurePolished()
        # The cells' font may be wider (e.g. monospace) than the label's.
        widths.append(max(label.sizeHint().width(),
                          widget.fontMetrics().horizontalAdvance(text) + 16))
        label.setParent(None)
        label.deleteLater()
    return max(widths) + 48


class InspectorSection(QWidget):
    """A part of the inspector: a header (title, its own controls) above a body.

    With a ``key`` the section folds away to its header through the button
    at the header's right; whether it is open is kept between runs (under
    ``inspector/<key>_open``, ``default`` the first time).
    """

    toggled = Signal(bool)

    def __init__(self, translations, title, tooltip, body, controls=(), key=None, default=True):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
        super().__init__()
        self.translations = translations
        self.body = body
        self.key = key
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.header = QWidget()
        header = QHBoxLayout(self.header)
        header.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        label = QLabel(title)
        label.setToolTip(tooltip)
        header.addWidget(label)
        header.addStretch()
        self.controls = list(controls)
        for control in self.controls:
            header.addWidget(control)
        self.fold_button = None
        if key is not None:
            self.fold_button = QToolButton()
            self.fold_button.setAutoRaise(True)
            self.fold_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self.set_open(not self.is_open))
            header.addWidget(self.fold_button)
        layout.addWidget(self.header)
        layout.addWidget(body, 1)
        self.is_open = True
        if key is not None:
            self.set_open(window_state.settings().value(
                f"inspector/{key}_open", default, type=bool), remember=False)

    def set_open(self, is_open, remember=True):
        """Show the body, or fold the section away to its header."""
        self.is_open = is_open
        self.body.setVisible(is_open)
        for control in self.controls:
            control.setVisible(is_open)
        # Folded, the splitter must not give it more than the header.
        self.setMaximumHeight(_NO_LIMIT if is_open else self.header.sizeHint().height())
        if self.fold_button is not None:
            set_button_icon(self.fold_button, "expand_less" if is_open else "expand_more")
            self.fold_button.setToolTip(self.translations[
                "inspector.fold" if is_open else "inspector.unfold"])
        if remember and self.key is not None:
            window_state.settings().setValue(f"inspector/{self.key}_open", is_open)
        self.toggled.emit(is_open)


class ObjectInspectorDialog(QDialog):
    """Show the fields of an object, array or struct.

    Either ``contents`` recorded at a call (``captured`` names the time) or
    the current fields of ``target``, read through ``request(target, dialog)``
    whose answer comes back through ``show_contents`` or ``show_error``. A
    field holding an object gets a link; ``open_object(target, dialog, name)``
    shows that object in a dialog of its own. ``name`` (the variable, field or
    property the object came from) and ``depth`` (1 for an object of a call,
    one more for each object opened from it) go into the window title.

    Below the fields, the object's properties (getters) can be evaluated on
    the game's main thread through ``evaluate(target, names, dialog)``; the
    values come back through ``show_properties``. A property with a setter
    can be set, and below the getters the object's methods are listed
    (``list_methods(target, dialog)``, answered through ``show_methods``) to
    call: ``call_method(target, entry, dialog, object_text)`` offers either
    in a method call dialog, whose ``call_done`` comes to ``on_call_done``.
    Getters and methods fold away.

    A field holding a number can be put on the address list, to watch,
    change or freeze its value there. A string (field or property) gets a
    link that shows it whole: ``show_text(value, name, time)``.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,too-many-arguments,too-many-public-methods
    # pylint: disable=attribute-defined-outside-init  # the _build_* helpers of _build_ui

    # {"address": int, "value_type": str, "label": str} to add to the address list
    address_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, translations, open_object, target=None, request=None,
                 contents=None, captured=None, evaluate=None, name="", depth=1, parent=None,
                 show_text=None, list_methods=None, call_method=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-positional-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.setAttribute(Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_DeleteOnClose)
        self.translations = translations
        self.target = target
        self._open_object = open_object
        self._request = request
        self._evaluate = evaluate
        self._show_text = show_text
        self._list_methods = list_methods
        self._call_method = call_method
        self._captured = captured
        self.name = name
        self.depth = depth
        self._pending = False
        # property name -> value, once evaluated
        self._property_values = {}
        # the object's instance methods once listed; None: not asked yet
        self._methods = None
        self._methods_pending = False
        # the property whose setter was called last, to show its new value
        self._setting = None
        self._type_name = "?"
        self._set_window_title("?")
        self.resize(860, 760)
        self._build_ui(live=contents is None)
        self._timer = QTimer(self)
        self._timer.setInterval(LIVE_INTERVAL_MS)
        self._timer.timeout.connect(self.refresh)
        if contents is not None:
            self.show_contents(contents)
        else:
            self.title_label.setText(target["address"])
            self.refresh()
        self._load_methods()

    def _build_ui(self, live):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        bar = QHBoxLayout()
        self.title_label = SelectableText()
        bar.addWidget(self.title_label, 1)
        self.live_check = QCheckBox(self.translations["inspector.live"])
        self.live_check.setToolTip(self.translations["inspector.live_tooltip"])
        self.live_check.toggled.connect(self._toggle_live)
        self.refresh_button = QPushButton(self.translations["inspector.refresh"])
        set_button_icon(self.refresh_button, "refresh")
        self.refresh_button.clicked.connect(self.refresh)
        self.add_address_button = QPushButton(self.translations["inspector.add_address"])
        set_button_icon(self.add_address_button, "bookmark_add")
        self.add_address_button.setToolTip(self.translations["inspector.add_address_tooltip"])
        self.add_address_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.add_address_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self.add_address(self.table.currentRow()))
        bar.addWidget(self.add_address_button)
        if live:
            bar.addWidget(self.live_check)
            bar.addWidget(self.refresh_button)
        else:
            self.live_check.hide()
            self.refresh_button.hide()
        layout.addLayout(bar)

        self.fields_section = InspectorSection(
            self.translations, self.translations["inspector.fields"],
            self.translations["inspector.fields_tooltip"], self._build_fields_table())
        self.properties_section = InspectorSection(
            self.translations, self.translations["inspector.properties"],
            self.translations["inspector.properties_tooltip"], self._build_properties_table(),
            controls=[self.evaluate_button], key="getters")
        self.methods_section = InspectorSection(
            self.translations, self.translations["inspector.methods"],
            self.translations["inspector.methods_tooltip"], self._build_methods_table(),
            controls=[self.method_filter, self.base_classes_check], key="methods",
            default=False)

        self.splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Vertical)
        self.splitter.setChildrenCollapsible(False)
        self.sections = (self.fields_section, self.properties_section, self.methods_section)
        for section in self.sections:
            self.splitter.addWidget(section)
            section.toggled.connect(self._on_section_toggled)
        self._share_space()
        layout.addWidget(self.splitter, 1)

        self.status_label = QLabel(self.translations[
            "inspector.hint" if live else "inspector.hint_captured"])
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

    def _build_fields_table(self):
        self.table = QTableWidget(0, 5)
        # One line per field: long values are shortened, not broken at a space.
        self.table.setWordWrap(False)
        self.table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            self.translations["inspector.column_field"],
            self.translations["inspector.column_type"],
            self.translations["inspector.column_value"],
            self.translations["inspector.column_offset"],
            "",
        ])
        self.table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.table)
        header = self.table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_FIELD, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_TYPE, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_VALUE, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_OFFSET, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        # Cell widgets do not count for ResizeToContents; keep a measured start width,
        # but let the user adjust it like the other columns.
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_OPEN, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.resizeSection(_OPEN, link_width(self.table, [
            self.translations["inspector.open"], self.translations["inspector.text"]]))
        header.resizeSection(_TYPE, 200)
        resizable_columns(self.table)
        self.table.cellDoubleClicked.connect(lambda row, _column: self.open_row(row))
        self.table.setContextMenuPolicy(Qt.ContextMenuPolicy.CustomContextMenu)
        self.table.customContextMenuRequested.connect(self._show_field_menu)
        self.table.currentCellChanged.connect(
            lambda row, *_args: self.add_address_button.setEnabled(
                self.address_entry(row) is not None))
        return self.table

    def _build_properties_table(self):
        self.evaluate_button = QPushButton(self.translations["inspector.evaluate_all"])
        set_button_icon(self.evaluate_button, "calculate")
        self.evaluate_button.setToolTip(self.translations["inspector.properties_tooltip"])
        self.evaluate_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self.evaluate_properties(None))
        self.evaluate_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.properties_table = QTableWidget(0, 5)
        self.properties_table.setWordWrap(False)
        self.properties_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            self.translations["inspector.column_property"],
            self.translations["inspector.column_type"],
            self.translations["inspector.column_value"],
            "",
            "",
        ])
        self.properties_table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.properties_table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.properties_table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.properties_table)
        properties_header = self.properties_table.horizontalHeader()
        properties_header.setSectionResizeMode(_P_NAME, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents)
        properties_header.setSectionResizeMode(_P_TYPE, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        properties_header.setSectionResizeMode(_P_VALUE, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        properties_header.setSectionResizeMode(_P_LINK, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        properties_header.setSectionResizeMode(_P_SET, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        properties_header.resizeSection(_P_TYPE, 200)
        properties_header.resizeSection(_P_LINK, link_width(self.properties_table, [
            self.translations["inspector.open"], self.translations["inspector.evaluate"],
            self.translations["inspector.text"]]))
        properties_header.resizeSection(_P_SET, link_width(
            self.properties_table, [self.translations["inspector.set"]]))
        resizable_columns(self.properties_table)
        copy_menu(self.properties_table, self.translations)
        return self.properties_table

    def _build_methods_table(self):
        self.method_filter = QLineEdit()
        self.method_filter.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["inspector.method_filter"])
        self.method_filter.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.method_filter.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self._filter_methods())
        self.base_classes_check = QCheckBox(self.translations["inspector.base_classes"])
        self.base_classes_check.setToolTip(self.translations["inspector.base_classes_tooltip"])
        self.base_classes_check.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self._filter_methods())
        self.methods_table = QTableWidget(0, 5)
        self.methods_table.setWordWrap(False)
        self.methods_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels([
            self.translations["inspector.column_method"],
            self.translations["inspector.column_params"],
            self.translations["inspector.column_returns"],
            self.translations["inspector.column_owner"],
            "",
        ])
        self.methods_table.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
        self.methods_table.setEditTriggers(QAbstractItemView.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers)
        self.methods_table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.methods_table)
        header = self.methods_table.horizontalHeader()
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_M_NAME, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_M_PARAMS, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_M_RETURNS, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_M_OWNER, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.setSectionResizeMode(_M_LINK, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
        header.resizeSection(_M_NAME, 200)
        header.resizeSection(_M_RETURNS, 140)
        header.resizeSection(_M_OWNER, 160)
        header.resizeSection(_M_LINK, link_width(
            self.methods_table, [self.translations["inspector.call"]]))
        resizable_columns(self.methods_table)
        copy_menu(self.methods_table, self.translations)
        self.methods_table.cellDoubleClicked.connect(lambda row, _column: self._call_row(row))
        return self.methods_table

    # --- Sections ----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _on_section_toggled(self, is_open):
        self._share_space()
        if is_open:
            self._load_methods()

    def _share_space(self):
        """Give the open sections equal parts of the height; folded ones keep their header."""
        heights = [section.header.sizeHint().height() for section in self.sections]
        total = max(sum(self.splitter.sizes()), self.height())
        folded = sum(height for section, height in zip(self.sections, heights)
                     if not section.is_open)
        opened = [section for section in self.sections if section.is_open]
        share = max(0, total - folded) // max(1, len(opened))
        self.splitter.setSizes([share if section.is_open else height
                                for section, height in zip(self.sections, heights)])

    # --- Reading -----------------------------------------------------------------
    @property
    def live(self):
        return self._captured is None

    def refresh(self):
        if self.live and not self._pending:
            self._pending = True
            self._request(self.target, self)

    def _set_window_title(self, type_name):
        # e.g. "Objekt-Inspektor - attacker (UnityEngine.GameObject) (1)"
        self.setWindowTitle(self.translations["inspector.window_title"].format(
            name=self.name or "?", type=type_name, depth=self.depth))

    def _toggle_live(self, live):
        if live:
            self._timer.start()
        else:
            self._timer.stop()

    def open_row(self, row):
        """Open the object in field ``row`` in a dialog of its own."""
        item = self.table.item(row, _FIELD)
        target = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole) if item is not None else None
        if target:
            self._open_object(target, self, item.text())

    # --- Address list ------------------------------------------------------------
    def _field_location(self, row):
        """``(address, value type or None)`` of the field in ``row``; address None if unknown."""
        item = self.table.item(row, _OFFSET) if row >= 0 else None
        location = item.data(_LOCATION_ROLE) if item is not None else None
        if not location or not location.get("address"):
            return None, None
        return int(location["address"], 16), location.get("valueType")

    def address_entry(self, row):
        """What ``address_requested`` sends for the field in ``row``, or None if no number."""
        address, value_type = self._field_location(row)
        if address is None or value_type is None:
            return None
        # e.g. "CharacterStats.BaseMight"
        owner = self._type_name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
        field = self.table.item(row, _FIELD).text()
        if self._type_name.startswith(_CONTAINERS) and self.name:
            # an entry of a TArray, TMap or TSet: "Inventory[3]", "Spread[Might (…)]"
            label = self.name + (field if field.startswith("[") else f"[{field}]")
        elif owner == "?":
            label = field
        elif field.startswith("[") and owner.endswith("[]"):
            label = owner[:-2] + field  # an element, e.g. "Int32[3]"
        else:
            label = f"{owner}.{field}"
        return {"address": address, "value_type": value_type, "label": label}

    def add_address(self, row):
        """Ask to put the field in ``row`` on the address list."""
        entry = self.address_entry(row)
        if entry is not None:
            self.address_requested.emit(entry)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["inspector.address_added"].format(
                label=entry["label"], address=f"0x{entry['address']:X}",
                type=entry["value_type"]))

    def _show_field_menu(self, position):
        row = self.table.rowAt(position.y())
        if row < 0:
            return
        address, _value_type = self._field_location(row)
        menu = QMenu(self)
        add = menu.addAction(self.translations["inspector.add_address"])
        add.setEnabled(self.address_entry(row) is not None)
        add.triggered.connect(lambda: self.add_address(row))
        copy = menu.addAction(self.translations["inspector.copy_address"])
        copy.setEnabled(address is not None)
        copy.triggered.connect(lambda: QGuiApplication.clipboard().setText(f"0x{address:X}"))
        open_object = menu.addAction(self.translations["inspector.open"])
        item = self.table.item(row, _FIELD)
        open_object.setEnabled(bool(item and item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)))
        open_object.triggered.connect(lambda: self.open_row(row))
        add_copy_actions(menu, self.table, position, self.translations)
        menu.exec(self.table.viewport().mapToGlobal(position))

    # --- Answers -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def show_contents(self, contents):
        self._pending = False
        if "error" in contents:
            self.show_error(messages.describe(contents["error"]))
            return
        fields = contents.get("fields", [])
        class_name = contents.get("name", "?")
        address = contents.get("address", "")
        instance_name = contents.get("instanceName")
        title = (f"{class_name} {json.dumps(instance_name, ensure_ascii=False)}@{address}"
                 if instance_name is not None else f"{class_name} @ {address}")
        if "length" in contents:
            title += "  ·  " + self.translations["inspector.length"].format(
                length=contents["length"])
        if not self.live:
            title += "  ·  " + self.translations["inspector.captured"].format(
                time=self._captured)
        self.title_label.setText(title)
        known = self._type_name != "?"
        self._type_name = contents.get("name", "?")
        self._set_window_title(self._type_name)
        selected = self.table.currentRow()
        self.table.setRowCount(len(fields))
        for row, field in enumerate(fields):
            value = field.get("value", {})
            static = field.get("static", False)
            # A static field without a place to read it from: a constant, a
            # thread static, or the class's static data is not known.
            unread = static and not field.get("address") and not value.get("text")
            target = None if unread else value.get("target")
            if unread:
                text = self.translations[_STATIC_KINDS.get(field.get("storage"), "inspector.static")]
            else:
                text = messages.describe(value.get("text", ""))
            texts = (
                field.get("name", ""),
                # Marked as in the properties table
                field.get("type", "") + (
                    f"  {self.translations['inspector.static']}" if static else ""),
                text,
                f"0x{field.get('offset', 0):x}",
            )
            for column, text in enumerate(texts):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
                if static:
                    item.setForeground(theme_qcolor("muted"))
                self.table.setItem(row, column, item)
            self.table.item(row, _FIELD).setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, target)
            self.table.item(row, _OFFSET).setData(_LOCATION_ROLE, {
                "address": field.get("address"), "valueType": field.get("valueType")})
            if field.get("address"):
                self.table.item(row, _OFFSET).setToolTip(
                    self.translations["inspector.static_offset"].format(address=field["address"])
                    if static else field["address"])
            self.table.removeCellWidget(row, _OPEN)
            if target:
                self.table.setCellWidget(row, _OPEN, link_label(
                    self.translations["inspector.open"], lambda row=row: self.open_row(row)))
            elif not unread and self._shows_text(value):
                self.table.setCellWidget(row, _OPEN, self._text_link(value, field.get("name", "")))
        if 0 <= selected < len(fields):
            self.table.selectRow(selected)
        self.add_address_button.setEnabled(self.address_entry(self.table.currentRow()) is not None)

        self._show_property_names(contents.get("properties", []))
        if not known:
            self._filter_methods()  # the own class is known now

    def show_error(self, message):
        self._pending = False
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["inspector.failed"].format(message=message))

    def _restore_hint(self):
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations[
            "inspector.hint" if self.live else "inspector.hint_captured"])

    # --- Properties --------------------------------------------------------------
    def _show_property_names(self, properties):
        names = [prop["name"] for prop in properties]
        if names == self._property_names():
            return
        self.properties_table.setRowCount(len(properties))
        for row, prop in enumerate(properties):
            name = QTableWidgetItem(prop["name"])
            name.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, prop)
            kind = QTableWidgetItem(prop["type"] + (
                f"  {self.translations['inspector.static']}" if prop.get("static") else ""))
            self.properties_table.setItem(row, _P_NAME, name)
            self.properties_table.setItem(row, _P_TYPE, kind)
            self.properties_table.setItem(row, _P_VALUE, QTableWidgetItem(""))
            self._show_property(row, self._property_values.get(prop["name"]))
            self.properties_table.removeCellWidget(row, _P_SET)
            if prop.get("setter") and not prop.get("static") and self._can_call():
                link = link_label(self.translations["inspector.set"],
                                  lambda prop=prop: self.set_property(prop))
                link.setToolTip(self.translations["inspector.set_tooltip"])
                self.properties_table.setCellWidget(row, _P_SET, link)
        self.evaluate_button.setEnabled(bool(properties) and self._can_evaluate())

    def _property_names(self):
        return [self.properties_table.item(row, _P_NAME).text()
                for row in range(self.properties_table.rowCount())]

    def _can_evaluate(self):
        return self._evaluate is not None and self.target is not None

    def _show_property(self, row, value):
        """Show an evaluated value (or a link to evaluate it) in ``row``."""
        name = self.properties_table.item(row, _P_NAME).text()
        item = self.properties_table.item(row, _P_VALUE)
        self.properties_table.removeCellWidget(row, _P_LINK)
        if value is None:
            item.setText("")
            if self._can_evaluate():
                self.properties_table.setCellWidget(row, _P_LINK, link_label(
                    self.translations["inspector.evaluate"],
                    lambda name=name: self.evaluate_properties([name])))
            return
        text = messages.describe(value.get("text", ""))
        item.setText(text)
        item.setToolTip(text)
        if value.get("error"):
            item.setForeground(theme_qcolor(_ERROR))
        else:
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.ForegroundRole, None)
        if value.get("target"):
            self.properties_table.setCellWidget(row, _P_LINK, link_label(
                self.translations["inspector.open"],
                lambda target=value["target"]: self._open_object(target, self, name)))
        elif self._shows_text(value):
            self.properties_table.setCellWidget(row, _P_LINK, self._text_link(value, name))

    def _shows_text(self, value):
        """Whether ``value`` is a string the text link can show whole."""
        return self._show_text is not None and bool(value.get("string"))

    def _text_link(self, value, name):
        """A link that shows the string ``value`` (of field or property ``name``) whole."""
        link = link_label(self.translations["inspector.text"], lambda: self._show_text(
            value, name, self._captured if not self.live
            else datetime.now().strftime("%H:%M:%S")))
        link.setToolTip(self.translations["inspector.text_tooltip"])
        return link

    def evaluate_properties(self, names):
        """Evaluate the named properties, or all of them for ``None``."""
        if not self._can_evaluate():
            return
        names = self._property_names() if names is None else names
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["inspector.evaluating"])
        self._evaluate(self.target, names, self)

    def show_properties(self, results):
        rows = {name: row for row, name in enumerate(self._property_names())}
        for result in results:
            self._property_values[result["name"]] = result["value"]
            if result["name"] in rows:
                self._show_property(rows[result["name"]], result["value"])
        self._restore_hint()

    def show_property_error(self, message):
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["inspector.evaluate_failed"].format(
            message=message))

    def set_property(self, prop):
        """Offer to call the setter of the property ``prop`` (an entry of the contents)."""
        self._setting = prop["name"]
        self._call_method(self.target, {
            "name": f"set_{prop['name']}", "method": prop["setter"], "owner": self._type_name,
            "params": f"{prop['type']} value", "returns": "System.Void",
        }, self, self.title_label.text())

    # --- Methods -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _can_call(self):
        return self._call_method is not None and self.target is not None

    def _load_methods(self):
        """List the object's methods once their section is open."""
        if (self._methods is not None or self._methods_pending or not self.methods_section.is_open
                or self._list_methods is None or self.target is None):
            return
        self._methods_pending = True
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["inspector.methods_loading"])
        self._list_methods(self.target, self)

    def show_methods(self, methods):
        self._methods_pending = False
        self._methods = methods
        self.methods_table.setRowCount(len(methods))
        for row, entry in enumerate(methods):
            texts = (entry["name"], entry["params"], entry["returns"], entry["owner"])
            for column, text in enumerate(texts):
                item = QTableWidgetItem(text)
                item.setToolTip(text)
                self.methods_table.setItem(row, column, item)
            self.methods_table.item(row, _M_NAME).setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, entry)
            if self._can_call():
                self.methods_table.setCellWidget(row, _M_LINK, link_label(
                    self.translations["inspector.call"], lambda row=row: self._call_row(row)))
        self._filter_methods()
        self._restore_hint()

    def show_methods_error(self, message):
        self._methods_pending = False
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["inspector.methods_failed"].format(
            message=message))

    def _filter_methods(self):
        """Show the methods matching the search, of the own class unless base classes are on."""
        text = self.method_filter.text().strip().lower()
        own_only = not self.base_classes_check.isChecked() and self._type_name != "?"
        for row in range(self.methods_table.rowCount()):
            entry = self.methods_table.item(row, _M_NAME).data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
            hidden = ((own_only and entry["owner"] != self._type_name)
                      or (text and text not in entry["name"].lower()))
            self.methods_table.setRowHidden(row, bool(hidden))

    def _call_row(self, row):
        item = self.methods_table.item(row, _M_NAME)
        if item is None or not self._can_call():
            return
        self._setting = None
        self._call_method(self.target, item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole), self,
                          self.title_label.text())

    def on_call_done(self):
        """A method called from here returned: show what it changed."""
        self.refresh()
        if self._setting is not None:
            self.evaluate_properties([self._setting])

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        self._timer.stop()
        super().closeEvent(event)
```

```py
# Rows shown in the result table; all candidates are kept and filtered.
DISPLAY_LIMIT = 2000
# Candidates added to the address list at most at once; each one is
# resolved again on every refresh of the list.
ADOPT_LIMIT = 500

# How long closing the dialog waits for a cancelled scan.
STOP_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000


class PointerScanWorker(QThread):
    """Run a pointer scan, or filter candidates, outside the GUI thread."""

    # phase ("reading", "searching", "filtering") and percent or level
    progress = Signal(str, int)
    chains_ready = Signal(object)
    failed = Signal(str)

    def __init__(self, pid, target, *, chains=None, max_depth=5, max_offset=0x1000,
                 max_results=10000, base_modules=None, aligned_values=True, parent=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        logs.log_failures(self)
        self.pid = pid
        self.target = target
        self.chains = chains
        self.max_depth = max_depth
        self.max_offset = max_offset
        self.max_results = max_results
        self.base_modules = base_modules
        self.aligned_values = aligned_values
        # Chain length up to which the results are complete if the scan
        # stopped at its memory limit, else None (set by the scan).
        self.complete_depth = None

    def run(self):
        try:
            if self.chains is None:
                result = self._scan()
            else:
                result = self._filter()
        except ScanCancelled:
            return
        except (OSError, ValueError, MemoryError) as error:
            if not self.isInterruptionRequested():
                self.failed.emit(str(error))
            return
        if result is not None and not self.isInterruptionRequested():
            self.chains_ready.emit(result)

    def _scan(self):
        pointer_map = PointerMap.build(
            self.pid,
            progress=lambda percent: self.progress.emit("reading", percent),
            cancelled=self.isInterruptionRequested,
            aligned_values=self.aligned_values,
        )
        chains = pointer_map.find_chains(
            self.target,
            max_depth=self.max_depth,
            max_offset=self.max_offset,
            max_results=self.max_results,
            base_modules=self.base_modules,
            progress=lambda level: self.progress.emit("searching", level),
            cancelled=self.isInterruptionRequested,
        )
        self.complete_depth = pointer_map.complete_depth
        return chains

    def _filter(self):
        bases = module_bases(read_mappings(self.pid))
        kept = []
        with ProcessMemory(self.pid) as memory:
            for index, chain in enumerate(self.chains):
                if self.isInterruptionRequested():
                    return None
                if resolve_chain(memory, bases, chain) == self.target:
                    kept.append(chain)
                if index % 500 == 0:
                    self.progress.emit("filtering", index * 100 // len(self.chains))
        return kept


class PointerScanDialog(QDialog):
    """Search, filter and pick a pointer chain for an address-list entry.

    The candidates are saved for the entry, so after the program was
    restarted they can be filtered with the address the value has now.

    The dialog is not modal, so the value can be searched again with the
    scanner while it is open, even after the program was restarted
    (``set_process``); ``address_source()`` returns the address
    selected there (or None). The chosen chain is emitted with
    ``chain_chosen`` and kept in ``chain``.

    # Widgets are created by _build_ui called from __init__.

    chains_adopted = Signal(object)
```
