```py
# The recording steps in their order: first the baseline, then the scenario.
RECORDING_ICONS = {"baseline": "looks_one", "scenario": "looks_two"}

# The limits come from the settings (hermes.core.settings):
# large_trace: above this many methods the trace asks first, Mono compiles them all.
# wine_trace_limit: under Wine/Proton no more than this (0: no limit): compiling
# and hooking tens of thousands of methods there froze or crashed the game
# (Mono's garbage collector waiting in SuspendThread; Frida's Windows gadget).

_R_FAVORITE, _R_ORDER, _R_METHOD, _R_CALLS, _R_RATE, _R_BASELINE, _R_VERDICT = range(7)
_ROW_COLUMNS = (
    FAVORITE_COLUMN_KEY, "trace.column_order", "trace.column_method", "trace.column_calls",
    "trace.column_rate", "trace.column_baseline", "trace.column_verdict",
)
_S_FAVORITE, _S_TIME, _S_THREAD, _S_METHOD, _S_CALLER = range(5)
# Typing in the free-text filter pauses this long before the choice is counted.
CHOICE_DELAY_MS = 200

_SEQUENCE_COLUMNS = (
    FAVORITE_COLUMN_KEY, "trace.column_time", "trace.column_thread", "trace.column_method", "trace.column_caller",
)

# States of the window
_IDLE, _PREPARING, _READY, _RECORDING = range(4)


class _TableModel(FavoriteColumn, QAbstractTableModel):
    """Read-only rows with translated column headers, the first column the star.

    Every item has a ``method``: the index of its method in ``methods``.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, columns, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.columns = columns
        self.methods = []
        self.items = []

    def rowCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(self.items)

    def columnCount(self, parent=QModelIndex()):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return 0 if parent.isValid() else len(self.columns)

    def headerData(self, section, orientation, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole and orientation == Qt.Orientation.Horizontal:
            return self.translations[self.columns[section]]
        return None

    def set_items(self, methods, items):
        self.beginResetModel()
        self.methods = methods
        self.items = items
        self.endResetModel()

    def item_at(self, row):
        return self.items[row] if 0 <= row < len(self.items) else None

    def favorite_item(self, row):
        item = self.item_at(row)
        return None if item is None else self.methods[item.method]

    def method_name(self, index):
        return short_name(self.methods[index].signature)

    def signature(self, index):
        return self.methods[index].signature


class TraceRowModel(_TableModel):
    """The methods the scenario called (TraceRows).

    Sorts by a column when the view asks; column -1 is the order of ``analyze``.
    """

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(translations, _ROW_COLUMNS, parent)
        self._unsorted = []
        self._sort_column = -1
        self._sort_order = Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder

    def set_items(self, methods, items):
        self._unsorted = list(items)
        self.methods = methods  # the method names sort by them
        super().set_items(methods, self._sorted(self._unsorted))

    def sort(self, column, order=Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder):
        self._sort_column = column
        self._sort_order = order
        self.set_items(self.methods, self._unsorted)

    def _sorted(self, rows):
        column = self._sort_column
        if column < 0 or column >= len(self.columns):
            return rows
        keys = {
            _R_FAVORITE: lambda row: (self.favorites is not None
                                      and self.favorites.is_favorite(self.methods[row.method])),
            _R_ORDER: lambda row: (row.first is None, row.first or 0),
            _R_METHOD: lambda row: self.method_name(row.method).lower(),
            _R_CALLS: lambda row: row.calls,
            _R_RATE: lambda row: row.rate,
            _R_BASELINE: lambda row: (row.baseline_rate is not None, row.baseline_rate or 0),
            _R_VERDICT: lambda row: ({NEW: 2, MORE: 1}.get(row.verdict, 0), row.factor or 0),
        }
        return sorted(rows, key=keys[column],
                      reverse=self._sort_order == Qt.SortOrder.DescendingOrder)

    def verdict_text(self, row):
        if row.verdict == NEW:
            return self.translations["trace.verdict_new"]
        if row.verdict == MORE:
            return self.translations["trace.verdict_more"].format(factor=row.factor)
        return self.translations["trace.verdict_same"]

    def data(self, index, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid():
            return None
        row = self.items[index.row()]
        column = index.column()
        if column == _R_FAVORITE:
            return self.favorite_data(index.row(), role)
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole and column == _R_METHOD:
            return self.signature(row.method)
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.TextAlignmentRole and column in (_R_ORDER, _R_CALLS, _R_RATE,
                                                                    _R_BASELINE):
            return int(Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignRight | Qt.AlignmentFlag.AlignVCenter)
        if role != Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
            return None
        if column == _R_ORDER:
            return "" if row.first is None else str(row.first + 1)
        if column == _R_METHOD:
            return self.method_name(row.method)
        if column == _R_CALLS:
            return str(row.calls)
        if column == _R_RATE:
            return f"{row.rate:.1f}"
        if column == _R_BASELINE:
            return "—" if row.baseline_rate is None else f"{row.baseline_rate:.1f}"
        return self.verdict_text(row)


class TraceSequenceModel(_TableModel):
    """The calls of the scenario in order (TraceCalls)."""

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None):
        super().__init__(translations, _SEQUENCE_COLUMNS, parent)

    def data(self, index, role=Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole):
        if not index.isValid():
            return None
        call = self.items[index.row()]
        column = index.column()
        if column == _S_FAVORITE:
            return self.favorite_data(index.row(), role)
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole and column == _S_METHOD:
            return self.signature(call.method)
        if role == Qt.ItemDataRole.ToolTipRole and column == _S_CALLER:
            return call.caller
        if role != Qt.ItemDataRole.DisplayRole:
            return None
        if column == _S_TIME:
            return f"{call.time / 1000:.3f} ms"
        if column == _S_THREAD:
            return str(call.thread)
        if column == _S_METHOD:
            return self.method_name(call.method)
        return call.caller


def trace_table(model, stretch_column, sortable=False, favorites=None, source="",
                translations=None):
    """A table of trace results: whole rows, one at a time.

    ``sortable``: a click on a column header sorts by it; until then the
    rows keep the model's order. ``favorites``: the FavoriteStore the star
    column marks the methods in, as found by ``source``. With
    ``translations`` the rows and cells can be copied (context menu).
    """
    # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
    view = QTableView()
    view.setModel(model)
    view.setSelectionBehavior(QAbstractItemView.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows)
    view.setSelectionMode(QAbstractItemView.SelectionMode.SingleSelection)
    view.setWordWrap(False)
    view.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
    header = view.horizontalHeader()
    for column in range(model.columnCount()):
        header.setSectionResizeMode(
            column, QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column == stretch_column
            else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Interactive)
    set_up_favorite_column(view, model, favorites, source)
    resizable_columns(view)
    if translations is not None:
        copy_menu(view, translations)
    if sortable:
        header.setSortIndicator(-1, Qt.SortOrder.AscendingOrder)
        view.setSortingEnabled(True)
    return view


class RowFilterBar(QWidget):
    """Narrow the rows of a trace down: by words in the name, by call count."""

    changed = Signal()

    def __init__(self, translations, parent=None, placeholder="trace.rows_name_placeholder"):
        """``placeholder`` is the catalog key of the name field's hint text."""
        super().__init__(parent)
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        self.name_input = QLineEdit()
        self.name_input.setPlaceholderText(translations[placeholder])
        self.name_input.setToolTip(translations["trace.rows_name_tooltip"])
        self.name_input.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.name_input.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self.changed.emit())
        layout.addWidget(self.name_input, 3)
        self.calls_input = QLineEdit()
        self.calls_input.setPlaceholderText(translations["trace.rows_calls_placeholder"])
        self.calls_input.setToolTip(translations["trace.rows_calls_tooltip"])
        self.calls_input.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.calls_input.textChanged.connect(self._on_calls_changed)
        layout.addWidget(self.calls_input, 1)
        self._calls = None

    def _on_calls_changed(self, text):
        try:
            self._calls = calls_filter(text)
            self.calls_input.setStyleSheet("")
        except ValueError:
            # Keep the last valid filter while the text is being typed.
            self.calls_input.setStyleSheet(f"border: 1px solid {theme_color('danger')};")
            return
        self.changed.emit()

    def accepts(self, row, text):
        """Whether to show ``row`` (a TraceRow), its function or method described by ``text``."""
        if self._calls is not None and not self._calls(row.calls):
            return False
        text = text.lower()
        return all(word in text for word in self.name_input.text().lower().split())


class TraceDialog(QDialog):
    """Hook many C# methods, record a baseline and a scenario, compare.

    Not modal. The worker and its Frida session live as long as the window;
    closing it removes the interceptors. With an assembly selection (see
    hermes.ui.widgets.assemblies) only the selected assemblies are traced.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,attribute-defined-outside-init

    # CatalogMethod to log the calls of, or to create a method hook for
    monitor_requested = Signal(object)
    hook_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, translations, pid, parent=None, engine=None, filter_repository=None,
                 favorites=None, assembly_selection=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments,too-many-positional-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.setModal(False)
        self.translations = translations
        self.pid = pid
        self.engine = resolve_engine(pid, engine)
        self.limit = (settings.get("wine_trace_limit") or None) if is_wine_process(pid) else None
        self.large = settings.get("large_trace")
        self._filter_repository = filter_repository
        self._favorites = favorites
        self._assembly_selection = assembly_selection
        # The selection changed while a trace ran: list the candidates when it ends.
        self._stale_candidates = False
        self.methods = []
        self.baseline = None
        self.scenario = None
        self.rows = []
        self._state = _IDLE
        self._recording = None
        self._selected = None
        self.setWindowTitle(self._title())
        self.resize(1100, 720)
        self._build_ui()
        self._worker = TraceWorker(pid, engine=self.engine, selection=self.selection())
        self._worker.planned.connect(self._on_planned)
        self._worker.started.connect(self._on_started)
        self._worker.progress.connect(self._on_progress)
        self._worker.began.connect(self._on_began)
        self._worker.live.connect(self._on_live)
        self._worker.recorded.connect(self._on_recorded)
        self._worker.stopped.connect(self._on_stopped)
        self._worker.ended.connect(self._on_ended)
        self._worker.command_failed.connect(self._on_command_failed)
        self._worker.worker_failed.connect(self._on_worker_failed)
        self._worker.candidates_found.connect(self._on_candidates)
        self._worker.start()
        self._worker.candidates()
        self._set_state(_IDLE)
        if assembly_selection is not None:
            assembly_selection.changed.connect(self._on_selection_changed)

    # --- UI ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        # An engine whose trace sees other calls than Mono's says which.
        hint_key = f"trace.hint_{self.engine.id}"
        hint = QLabel(self.translations[hint_key if hint_key in self.translations
                                        else "trace.hint"])
        hint.setWordWrap(True)
        hint.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        layout.addWidget(hint)

        scope = QHBoxLayout()
        self.filter_input = QLineEdit()
        self.filter_input.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["trace.filter_placeholder"])
        self.filter_input.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_tooltip"])
        self.filter_input.setClearButtonEnabled(True)
        self.filter_input.returnPressed.connect(self._toggle_trace)
        scope.addWidget(self.filter_input, 1)
        self.trace_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.start"])
        self.trace_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.trace_button, "play_arrow")
        self.trace_button.clicked.connect(self._toggle_trace)
        scope.addWidget(self.trace_button)
        layout.addLayout(scope)

        self.filter_panel = TraceFilterPanel(self.translations, self._filter_repository, self)
        self.filter_panel.selection_changed.connect(self._show_choice)
        layout.addWidget(self.filter_panel)
        self.choice_label = QLabel("")
        self.choice_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('muted')};")
        layout.addWidget(self.choice_label)
        # In the choice label's place while the method list loads
        self.loading_bar = QProgressBar()
        self.loading_bar.setTextVisible(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.loading_bar)
        self._show_loading(0, 0, "")
        # Typing pauses this long before the choice is counted again.
        self._choice_timer = QTimer(self)
        self._choice_timer.setSingleShot(True)
        self._choice_timer.setInterval(CHOICE_DELAY_MS)
        self._choice_timer.timeout.connect(self._show_choice)
        self.filter_input.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self._choice_timer.start())

        steps = QHBoxLayout()
        self.baseline_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.baseline"])
        set_button_icon(self.baseline_button, RECORDING_ICONS["baseline"])
        self.baseline_button.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.baseline_tooltip"])
        self.baseline_button.setCheckable(True)
        self.baseline_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._toggle_recording("baseline"))
        steps.addWidget(self.baseline_button)
        self.scenario_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.scenario"])
        set_button_icon(self.scenario_button, RECORDING_ICONS["scenario"])
        self.scenario_button.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.scenario_tooltip"])
        self.scenario_button.setCheckable(True)
        self.scenario_button.clicked.connect(lambda: self._toggle_recording("scenario"))
        steps.addWidget(self.scenario_button)
        self.recording_label = QLabel("")
        steps.addWidget(self.recording_label, 1)
        layout.addLayout(steps)

        splitter = QSplitter(Qt.Orientation.Vertical)
        top = QWidget()
        top_layout = QVBoxLayout(top)
        top_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        rows_bar = QHBoxLayout()
        rows_bar.addWidget(QLabel(self.translations["trace.methods"]))
        rows_bar.addStretch()
        self.notable_check = QCheckBox(self.translations["trace.notable_only"])
        self.notable_check.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.notable_tooltip"])
        self.notable_check.setChecked(True)
        self.notable_check.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self._show_rows())
        rows_bar.addWidget(self.notable_check)
        top_layout.addLayout(rows_bar)
        self.row_filter = RowFilterBar(
            self.translations, self, placeholder="trace.rows_method_placeholder")
        self.row_filter.changed.connect(self._show_rows)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.row_filter)
        self.row_model = TraceRowModel(self.translations, self)
        self.rows_view = self._table(self.row_model, _R_METHOD, sortable=True)
        header = self.rows_view.horizontalHeader()
        header.resizeSection(_R_ORDER, 60)
        header.resizeSection(_R_CALLS, 80)
        header.resizeSection(_R_RATE, 90)
        header.resizeSection(_R_BASELINE, 130)
        header.resizeSection(_R_VERDICT, 170)
        self.rows_view.selectionModel().currentRowChanged.connect(self._on_row_selected)
        top_layout.addWidget(self.rows_view, 1)
        splitter.addWidget(top)

        bottom = QWidget()
        bottom_layout = QVBoxLayout(bottom)
        bottom_layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        bottom_layout.addWidget(QLabel(self.translations["trace.sequence"]))
        self.sequence_model = TraceSequenceModel(self.translations, self)
        self.sequence_view = self._table(self.sequence_model, _S_CALLER)
        sequence_header = self.sequence_view.horizontalHeader()
        sequence_header.resizeSection(_S_TIME, 110)
        sequence_header.resizeSection(_S_THREAD, 80)
        sequence_header.resizeSection(_S_METHOD, 280)
        self.sequence_view.selectionModel().currentRowChanged.connect(self._on_call_selected)
        bottom_layout.addWidget(self.sequence_view, 1)
        splitter.addWidget(bottom)
        splitter.setSizes([330, 290])
        layout.addWidget(splitter, 1)

        actions = QHBoxLayout()
        self.selection_label = SelectableText()
        actions.addWidget(self.selection_label, 1)
        self.monitor_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.monitor"])
        set_button_icon(self.monitor_button, "visibility")
        self.monitor_button.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.monitor_tooltip"])
        self.monitor_button.clicked.connect(self._request_monitor)
        actions.addWidget(self.monitor_button)
        self.hook_button = QPushButton(self.translations["monitor.create_hook"])
        set_button_icon(self.hook_button, "webhook")
        self.hook_button.setToolTip(self.translations["monitor.create_hook_tooltip"])
        self.hook_button.clicked.connect(self._request_hook)
        actions.addWidget(self.hook_button)
        unsupported = self.translations["engine.unsupported"].format(
            engine=self.engine.display_name)
        for button, capability in ((self.monitor_button, engine_base.MONITOR),
                                   (self.hook_button, engine_base.METHOD_HOOKS)):
            if not self.engine.supports(capability):
                button.setToolTip(unsupported)
        layout.addLayout(actions)

        self.status_label = QLabel("")
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)
        self._show_selection()

    def _table(self, model, stretch_column, sortable=False):
        view = trace_table(model, stretch_column, sortable, self._favorites, TRACE,
                           self.translations)
        view.doubleClicked.connect(
            lambda index: index.column() != FAVORITE_COLUMN and self._request_monitor())
        return view

    def _set_state(self, state):
        self._state = state
        if state == _IDLE and self._stale_candidates:
            self._stale_candidates = False
            self._reload_candidates()
        tracing = state in (_READY, _RECORDING)
        self.filter_input.setEnabled(state == _IDLE)
        self.filter_panel.setEnabled(state == _IDLE)
        self.trace_button.setEnabled(state in (_IDLE, _PREPARING, _READY))
        self.trace_button.setText(self.translations[
            "trace.cancel" if state == _PREPARING else "trace.stop" if tracing else "trace.start"])
        set_button_icon(self.trace_button,
                        "close" if state == _PREPARING else "stop" if tracing else "play_arrow")
        for phase, button in (("baseline", self.baseline_button),
                              ("scenario", self.scenario_button)):
            active = state == _RECORDING and self._recording == phase
            button.setEnabled(state == _READY or active)
            button.setChecked(active)
            button.setText(self.translations[f"trace.{phase}_stop" if active else f"trace.{phase}"])
            set_button_icon(button, "stop" if active else RECORDING_ICONS[phase])
        if state != _RECORDING:
            self.recording_label.setText("")

    # --- Trace -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _words(self):
        return self.filter_input.text().lower().split()

    def _toggle_trace(self):
        if self._state == _IDLE:
            chosen = self.filter_panel.selection(self._words())
            if chosen is None:
                # The method list is still loading: let the agent choose by words.
                self._set_state(_PREPARING)
                self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.planning"])
                self._worker.plan(self._words())
                return
            if not chosen:
                self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.filters_nothing"])
                return
            if not self._may_trace(len(chosen)):
                return
            self._set_state(_PREPARING)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.preparing"].format(
                count=len(chosen)))
            self._worker.trace_selection(chosen, self._words())
        elif self._state == _PREPARING:
            self.trace_button.setEnabled(False)
            self._worker.cancel()
        elif self._state == _READY:
            self._set_state(_PREPARING)
            self._worker.stop()

    def _title(self):
        return self.translations["trace.title"].format(engine=self.engine.display_name)

    def _may_trace(self, count):
        """Whether ``count`` methods may be traced: within the limit, and confirmed."""
        if self.limit is not None and count > self.limit:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.wine_limit"].format(
                count=count, limit=self.limit))
            return False
        if count > self.large and not self._confirm_large(count):
            self.status_label.setText("")
            return False
        return True

    def selection(self):
        """The user's assembly selection; empty for none."""
        store = self._assembly_selection
        return store.selection if store is not None else frozenset()

    def _on_selection_changed(self):
        self._worker.set_selection(self.selection())
        if self._state == _IDLE:
            self._reload_candidates()
        else:
            self._stale_candidates = True

    def _reload_candidates(self):
        self._show_loading(0, 0, "")
        self.filter_panel.set_candidates(None)
        self._worker.candidates()

    def _on_candidates(self, methods, _skipped):
        self.loading_bar.hide()
        self.choice_label.show()
        self.filter_panel.set_candidates(methods)

    def _show_loading(self, done, total, assembly):
        """Show how far the method list is read: ``done`` of ``total`` assemblies."""
        self.choice_label.hide()
        self.loading_bar.show()
        # 0 of 0: busy until the worker knows the assemblies
        self.loading_bar.setRange(0, total)
        self.loading_bar.setValue(done)
        text = self.translations["trace.filters_loading"] if total == 0 else             self.translations["trace.filters_loading_progress"].format(
                done=done, total=total, assembly=assembly)
        self.loading_bar.setFormat(text.replace("%", "%%"))

    def _show_choice(self):
        chosen = self.filter_panel.selection(self._words())
        if chosen is None:
            return
        text = self.translations["trace.filters_count"].format(
            count=len(chosen), total=len(self.filter_panel.candidates))
        if self.selection():
            text += " " + self.translations["trace.assembly_selection"].format(
                count=len(self.selection()))
        if self.limit is not None and len(chosen) > self.limit:
            text += " " + self.translations["trace.filters_over_limit"].format(limit=self.limit)
        self.choice_label.setText(text)

    def _confirm_large(self, count):
        """Whether to trace ``count`` methods, more than ``self.large``."""
        answer = QMessageBox.question(
            self, self._title(),
            self.translations["trace.confirm_large"].format(count=count))
        return answer == QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes

    def _on_planned(self, plan):
        count = plan.get("methods", 0)
        if count == 0:
            self._set_state(_IDLE)
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.nothing"].format(
                assemblies=", ".join(plan.get("assemblies", [])) or "—"))
            return
        if not self._may_trace(count):
            self._set_state(_IDLE)
            return
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.preparing"].format(count=count))
        self._worker.trace(self._words())

    def _on_progress(self, step, done, total, current):
        if step == "catalog" and self.filter_panel.candidates is None:
            self._show_loading(done, total, current)
            return
        text = self.translations[f"trace.progress_{step}"].format(done=done, total=total)
        if current:
            text += f"\n{current}"
        self.status_label.setText(text)

    def _on_started(self, methods, info):
        self.methods = methods
        self.baseline = None
        self.scenario = None
        self._show_results()
        self._set_state(_READY)
        skipped = sum(info.get("skipped", {}).values())
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.started"].format(
            count=len(methods), skipped=skipped,
            failed=info.get("notCompiled", 0) + info.get("failed", 0)))

    def _on_stopped(self):
        self._set_state(_IDLE)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.stopped"])

    def _on_ended(self):
        self._set_state(_IDLE)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.ended"])

    def _on_command_failed(self, action, message):
        # A failed start leaves no trace; other commands keep it.
        self._set_state(_IDLE if action in ("plan", "trace", "start") else _READY)
        if message.endswith("cancelled"):
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.cancelled"])
            return
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.failed"].format(message=message))

    def _on_worker_failed(self, message):
        self._set_state(_IDLE)
        self.trace_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.worker_failed"].format(
            message=message))

    # --- Recording -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _toggle_recording(self, phase):
        if self._state == _READY:
            self._recording = phase
            self._set_state(_RECORDING)
            self.recording_label.setText(self.translations["trace.recording_starting"])
            self._worker.begin(phase)
        elif self._state == _RECORDING and self._recording == phase:
            self.baseline_button.setEnabled(False)
            self.scenario_button.setEnabled(False)
            self._worker.finish()
        else:
            self._set_state(self._state)  # undo the click's check mark

    def _on_began(self, phase):
        self.recording_label.setText(self.translations[f"trace.recording_{phase}"])

    def _on_live(self, live):
        if self._state == _RECORDING:
            self.recording_label.setText(self.translations["trace.live"].format(
                phase=self.translations[f"trace.phase_{live.get('phase', '')}"],
                calls=live.get("calls", 0), methods=live.get("methods", 0)))

    def _on_recorded(self, result):
        self._recording = None
        self._set_state(_READY)
        seconds = result.get("duration", 0) / 1000
        if result.get("phase") == "baseline":
            self.baseline = result
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["trace.baseline_done"].format(
                methods=len(result.get("counts", {})), seconds=seconds))
            if self.scenario is not None:
                self._show_results()  # compare the scenario with the new baseline
            return
        self.scenario = result
        self._show_results()
        text = self.translations["trace.scenario_done"].format(
            methods=len(self.rows), notable=sum(row.notable for row in self.rows),
            calls=len(self.sequence_model.items), seconds=seconds)
        if result.get("dropped"):
            text += "  ·  " + self.translations["trace.dropped"].format(count=result["dropped"])
        self.status_label.setText(text)

    # --- Results -----------------------------------------------------------------
    def _show_results(self):
        self.rows = analyze(self.scenario, self.baseline) if self.scenario else []
        calls = recording_calls(self.scenario) if self.scenario else []
        self.sequence_model.set_items(self.methods, calls)
        self._show_rows()

    def _show_rows(self):
        notable_only = self.notable_check.isChecked()
        rows = [row for row in self.rows if (row.notable or not notable_only)
                and self.row_filter.accepts(row, self.methods[row.method].signature)]
        self.row_model.set_items(self.methods, rows)
        self._selected = None
        self._show_selection()

    def _on_row_selected(self, current, _previous=None):
        row = self.row_model.item_at(current.row()) if current.isValid() else None
        if row is None:
            return
        self._selected = row.method
        self._show_selection()
        if row.first is not None:
            # Its first call in the sequence
            index = self.sequence_model.index(row.first, 0)
            self.sequence_view.scrollTo(index, QAbstractItemView.ScrollHint.PositionAtCenter)

    def _on_call_selected(self, current, _previous=None):
        call = self.sequence_model.item_at(current.row()) if current.isValid() else None
        if call is not None:
            self._selected = call.method
            self._show_selection()

    def selected_method(self):
        """The CatalogMethod chosen in either table, or None."""
        return self.methods[self._selected] if self._selected is not None else None

    def _show_selection(self):
        method = self.selected_method()
        self.monitor_button.setEnabled(method is not None
                                       and self.engine.supports(engine_base.MONITOR))
        self.hook_button.setEnabled(method is not None
                                    and self.engine.supports(engine_base.METHOD_HOOKS))
        self.selection_label.setText(method.signature if method is not None else "")

    def _request_monitor(self):
        method = self.selected_method()
        if method is not None and self.engine.supports(engine_base.MONITOR):
            self.monitor_requested.emit(method)

    def _request_hook(self):
        method = self.selected_method()
        if method is not None and self.engine.supports(engine_base.METHOD_HOOKS):
            self.hook_requested.emit(method)

    def closeEvent(self, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        # Removing thousands of interceptors takes a moment; do not block the
        # window for that.
        worker = self._worker
        worker.requestInterruption()
        if worker.isRunning():
            keep_until_finished(worker)
        super().closeEvent(event)
```

`hermes/ui/widgets/trace_filters.py`:

```py
"""Choosing the methods of a trace with filters (see hermes.features.trace_filters)."""

import itertools
from dataclasses import replace

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QCheckBox,
    QDialog,
    QFormLayout,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QLineEdit,
    QListWidget,
    QListWidgetItem,
    QMessageBox,
    QPushButton,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QWidget,
)

from hermes.features.trace_filters import BUILTIN_FILTERS, TraceFilter, select_methods
from hermes.ui.widgets.dialog_buttons import dialog_button_row
from hermes.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon, theme_color

# Methods the editor shows as examples of what a filter matches
_PREVIEW = 8
# Ids of filters kept without a repository (the database's are positive)
_unsaved_ids = itertools.count(-1, -1)


def filter_title(translations, trace_filter):
    """The name a filter is shown with (built-in ones are translated)."""
    if trace_filter.builtin:
        return translations[f"trace.filter_{trace_filter.builtin}"]
    return trace_filter.name


def filter_summary(translations, trace_filter):
    """A tooltip that says what a filter matches."""
    parts = []
    if trace_filter.words:
        parts.append(translations["trace.filter_summary_words"].format(
            words=", ".join(trace_filter.words)))
    if trace_filter.exclude:
        parts.append(translations["trace.filter_summary_exclude"].format(
            words=", ".join(trace_filter.exclude)))
    if trace_filter.numbers:
        parts.append(translations["trace.filter_numbers"])
    if trace_filter.changes:
        parts.append(translations["trace.filter_changes"])
    return "\n".join(parts)


class TraceFilterPanel(QWidget):
    """The filters to choose from, how many methods each one picks, and the total.

    ``repository`` keeps the user's filters (TraceFilterRepository); without
    one they last until the window closes.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes
    selection_changed = Signal()

    def __init__(self, translations, repository=None, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.repository = repository
        self.candidates = None
        self._user_filters = repository.list_filters() if repository is not None else []
        self._build_ui()
        self._fill()

    # --- UI ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QHBoxLayout(self)
        layout.setContentsMargins(0, 0, 0, 0)
        left = QVBoxLayout()
        title = QLabel(self.translations["trace.filters_label"])
        title.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filters_tooltip"])
        left.addWidget(title)
        self.list = QListWidget()
        self.list.setMaximumHeight(130)
        self.list.itemChanged.connect(lambda _item: self._changed())
        self.list.currentRowChanged.connect(lambda _row: self._update_buttons())
        self.list.itemDoubleClicked.connect(lambda _item: self._edit())
        left.addWidget(self.list)
        layout.addLayout(left, 1)

        right = QVBoxLayout()
        self.new_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.filter_new"])
        set_button_icon(self.new_button, "add")
        self.new_button.clicked.connect(self._new)
        self.edit_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.filter_edit"])
        set_button_icon(self.edit_button, "edit")
        self.edit_button.clicked.connect(self._edit)
        self.delete_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.filter_delete"])
        set_button_icon(self.delete_button, "delete")
        self.delete_button.clicked.connect(self._delete)
        self.check_all_button = QPushButton(self.translations["trace.filter_check_all"])
        set_button_icon(self.check_all_button, "check_box")
        self.check_all_button.clicked.connect(self._toggle_all)
        for button in (self.new_button, self.edit_button, self.delete_button,
                       self.check_all_button):
            right.addWidget(button)
        self.generated_check = QCheckBox(self.translations["trace.filter_generated"])
        self.generated_check.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_generated_tooltip"])
        self.generated_check.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self._changed(recount=True))
        right.addWidget(self.generated_check)
        right.addStretch()
        layout.addLayout(right)

    def _filters(self):
        return list(BUILTIN_FILTERS) + self._user_filters

    def _fill(self):
        checked = {self._key(item) for item in self.checked_filters()}
        self.list.blockSignals(True)
        self.list.clear()
        for trace_filter in self._filters():
            item = QListWidgetItem()
            item.setData(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole, trace_filter)
            item.setFlags(item.flags() | Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable)
            item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked if self._key(trace_filter) in checked
                               else Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)
            item.setToolTip(filter_summary(self.translations, trace_filter))
            self.list.addItem(item)
        self.list.blockSignals(False)
        self._update_counts()
        self._update_buttons()

    @staticmethod
    def _key(trace_filter):
        return trace_filter.builtin or ("user", trace_filter.filter_id, trace_filter.name)

    def _update_counts(self):
        generated = self.generated_check.isChecked()
        self.list.blockSignals(True)
        for row in range(self.list.count()):
            item = self.list.item(row)
            trace_filter = item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
            title = filter_title(self.translations, trace_filter)
            if self.candidates is not None:
                count = len(select_methods(self.candidates, [trace_filter], generated=generated))
                title = self.translations["trace.filter_with_count"].format(
                    name=title, count=count)
            item.setText(title)
        self.list.blockSignals(False)

    def _update_buttons(self):
        current = self._current()
        self.edit_button.setEnabled(current is not None)
        self.delete_button.setEnabled(current is not None and not current.builtin)
        all_checked = self._all_checked()
        key = "trace.filter_uncheck_all" if all_checked else "trace.filter_check_all"
        self.check_all_button.setText(self.translations[key])
        set_button_icon(self.check_all_button,
                        "check_box_outline_blank" if all_checked else "check_box")

    def _all_checked(self):
        return self.list.count() > 0 and len(self.checked_filters()) == self.list.count()

    def _toggle_all(self):
        """Tick every filter, or untick them all when every one is ticked already."""
        state = Qt.CheckState.Unchecked if self._all_checked() else Qt.CheckState.Checked
        self.list.blockSignals(True)
        for row in range(self.list.count()):
            self.list.item(row).setCheckState(state)
        self.list.blockSignals(False)
        self._changed()

    def _changed(self, recount=False):
        # What each filter picks only changes with the candidates, the
        # generated-code switch and the filters themselves, not with a tick.
        if recount:
            self._update_counts()
        self._update_buttons()
        self.selection_changed.emit()

    # --- State ---------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_candidates(self, methods):
        """The methods to choose from (CatalogMethods), or None while unknown."""
        self.candidates = methods
        self._update_counts()
        self.selection_changed.emit()

    def checked_filters(self):
        """The filters the user ticked."""
        return [self.list.item(row).data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)
                for row in range(self.list.count())
                if self.list.item(row).checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked]

    def include_generated(self):
        """Whether compiler-generated methods may be chosen."""
        return self.generated_check.isChecked()

    def selection(self, words=()):
        """The candidates the ticked filters and ``words`` pick (None while unknown)."""
        if self.candidates is None:
            return None
        return select_methods(self.candidates, self.checked_filters(), words,
                              generated=self.include_generated())

    def _current(self):
        item = self.list.currentItem()
        return None if item is None else item.data(Qt.ItemDataRole.UserRole)

    # --- Editing -------------------------------------------------------------
    def _new(self):
        self._open_editor(TraceFilter(""))

    def _edit(self):
        current = self._current()
        if current is None:
            return
        if current.builtin:
            # Built-in filters stay as shipped; edit a copy.
            name = self.translations["trace.filter_copy_name"].format(
                name=filter_title(self.translations, current))
            current = current.copy_as(name)
        self._open_editor(current)

    def _open_editor(self, trace_filter):
        dialog = TraceFilterDialog(self.translations, trace_filter, self.candidates,
                                   self._save, parent=self)
        dialog.exec()

    def _save(self, trace_filter):
        """Store an edited filter; raises ValueError for a duplicate name."""
        if any(other.name == trace_filter.name and other.filter_id != trace_filter.filter_id
               for other in self._user_filters):
            raise ValueError(trace_filter.name)
        if self.repository is not None:
            self.repository.save_filter(trace_filter)
            self._user_filters = self.repository.list_filters()
        else:
            if trace_filter.filter_id is None:
                trace_filter = replace(trace_filter, filter_id=next(_unsaved_ids))
            self._user_filters = sorted(
                [other for other in self._user_filters
                 if other.filter_id != trace_filter.filter_id] + [trace_filter],
                key=lambda other: other.name.lower())
        self._fill()
        self.selection_changed.emit()

    def _delete(self):
        current = self._current()
        if current is None or current.builtin:
            return
        answer = QMessageBox.question(
            self, self.translations["trace.filter_dialog_title"],
            self.translations["trace.filter_delete_confirm"].format(name=current.name))
        if answer != QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes:
            return
        if self.repository is not None:
            self.repository.delete_filter(current.filter_id)
            self._user_filters = self.repository.list_filters()
        else:
            self._user_filters = [f for f in self._user_filters
                                  if f.filter_id != current.filter_id]
        self._fill()
        self.selection_changed.emit()


class TraceFilterDialog(QDialog):
    """Create or change a user's trace filter, with a preview of what it picks.

    ``save`` stores the result and raises ValueError for a duplicate name.
    """

    # pylint: disable=too-many-instance-attributes,too-many-arguments
    def __init__(self, translations, trace_filter, candidates, save, parent=None):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-positional-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self.original = trace_filter
        self.candidates = candidates
        self._save = save
        self.result_filter = None
        self.setWindowTitle(translations["trace.filter_dialog_title"])
        self.resize(560, 420)
        self._build_ui()
        self._preview()

    def _build_ui(self):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        form = QFormLayout()
        self.name_input = QLineEdit(self.original.name)
        form.addRow(self.translations["trace.filter_name"], self.name_input)
        self.words_input = QLineEdit(", ".join(self.original.words))
        self.words_input.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_words_tooltip"])
        self.words_input.setPlaceholderText(self.translations["trace.filter_words_placeholder"])
        form.addRow(self.translations["trace.filter_words"], self.words_input)
        self.exclude_input = QLineEdit(", ".join(self.original.exclude))
        self.exclude_input.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_words_tooltip"])
        form.addRow(self.translations["trace.filter_exclude"], self.exclude_input)
        self.numbers_check = QCheckBox(self.translations["trace.filter_numbers"])
        self.numbers_check.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_numbers_tooltip"])
        self.numbers_check.setChecked(self.original.numbers)
        form.addRow("", self.numbers_check)
        self.changes_check = QCheckBox(self.translations["trace.filter_changes"])
        self.changes_check.setToolTip(self.translations["trace.filter_changes_tooltip"])
        self.changes_check.setChecked(self.original.changes)
        form.addRow("", self.changes_check)
        layout.addLayout(form)

        self.preview_label = QLabel("")
        layout.addWidget(self.preview_label)
        self.preview_list = QListWidget()
        layout.addWidget(self.preview_list, 1)
        self.error_label = QLabel("")
        self.error_label.setStyleSheet(f"color: {theme_color('danger')};")
        self.error_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.error_label)
        layout.addLayout(dialog_button_row(self.translations, "button.save",
                                           self._accept, self.reject))

        for line in (self.words_input, self.exclude_input):
            line.textChanged.connect(lambda _text: self._preview())
        for check in (self.numbers_check, self.changes_check):
            check.toggled.connect(lambda _checked: self._preview())

    def edited_filter(self):
        """The filter as the fields describe it."""
        return TraceFilter.from_text(
            self.name_input.text().strip(), self.words_input.text(), self.exclude_input.text(),
            self.numbers_check.isChecked(), self.changes_check.isChecked(),
            filter_id=self.original.filter_id, description=self.original.description)

    def _preview(self):
        self.preview_list.clear()
        if self.candidates is None:
            self.preview_label.setText(self.translations["trace.filters_loading"])
            return
        chosen = select_methods(self.candidates, [self.edited_filter()])
        self.preview_label.setText(
            self.translations["trace.filter_preview"].format(count=len(chosen)))
        for method in chosen[:_PREVIEW]:
            self.preview_list.addItem(method.signature)
        if len(chosen) > _PREVIEW:
            self.preview_list.addItem("…")

    def _accept(self):
        edited = self.edited_filter()
        if not edited.name:
            self.error_label.setText(self.translations["trace.filter_error_name"])
            return
        if not (edited.words or edited.numbers or edited.changes):
            self.error_label.setText(self.translations["trace.filter_error_empty"])
            return
        try:
            self._save(edited)
        except ValueError:
            self.error_label.setText(
                self.translations["trace.filter_error_duplicate"].format(name=edited.name))
            return
        self.result_filter = edited
        self.accept()
```

`hermes/ui/widgets/write_watch.py`:

```py
"""Live results dialog for a process-memory write (or access) watch."""

from datetime import datetime

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import (  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QDialog,
    QHBoxLayout,
    QLabel,
    QPushButton,
    QTableWidget,
    QTableWidgetItem,
    QVBoxLayout,
    QHeaderView,
)

from hermes.ui.widgets.icons import set_button_icon
from hermes.ui.widgets.table import copy_menu, resizable_columns, set_row_height


# Result table columns.
_COUNT, _PC, _SITE, _READ, _WRITE, _VALUE, _THREAD, _TIME = range(8)


class WriteWatchDialog(QDialog):
    """Display grouped write-watch hits and let the user stop monitoring.

    With ``reads`` the watch reports reads as well; the "read" and "write"
    columns tell what each instruction does with the target.
    """

    stop_requested = Signal()
    # trap PC (instruction after the write), module/offset description
    # (a Qt int has 32 bits and would cut off 64-bit addresses)
    hook_requested = Signal(object, str)
    # trap PC to monitor in the native function monitor
    monitor_requested = Signal(object)

    def __init__(self, address, size, translations, parent=None, reads=False):
        # pylint: disable=too-many-arguments
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.translations = translations
        self._rows_by_pc = {}
        self._failed = False
        self.setWindowTitle(
            translations["watch.title_access" if reads else "watch.title"].format(
                address=address
            )
        )
        self.resize(900, 460)
        self._build_ui(address, size)

    def _build_ui(self, address, size):
        layout = QVBoxLayout(self)
        target = QLabel(
            self.translations["watch.target"].format(
                address=address,
                size=size,
            )
        )
        target.setTextInteractionFlags(Qt.TextInteractionFlag.TextSelectableByMouse)
        layout.addWidget(target)

        self.status_label = QLabel(self.translations["watch.starting"])
        self.status_label.setWordWrap(True)
        layout.addWidget(self.status_label)

        self.results_table = QTableWidget(0, 8)
        self.results_table.setHorizontalHeaderLabels(
            [
                self.translations["watch.column_count"],
                self.translations["watch.column_trap_pc"],
                self.translations["watch.column_site"],
                self.translations["watch.column_read"],
                self.translations["watch.column_write"],
                self.translations["watch.column_value"],
                self.translations["watch.column_thread"],
                self.translations["watch.column_time"],
            ]
        )
        self.results_table.setSelectionBehavior(
            self.results_table.SelectionBehavior.SelectRows
        )
        self.results_table.setEditTriggers(
            self.results_table.EditTrigger.NoEditTriggers
        )
        header = self.results_table.horizontalHeader()
        if header is not None:
            for column in range(self.results_table.columnCount()):
                header.setSectionResizeMode(
                    column,
                    QHeaderView.ResizeMode.Stretch if column == _SITE
                    else QHeaderView.ResizeMode.ResizeToContents,
                )
            resizable_columns(self.results_table)
            copy_menu(self.results_table, self.translations)
        self.results_table.verticalHeader().setVisible(False)
        set_row_height(self.results_table)
        self.results_table.itemSelectionChanged.connect(self._update_hook_button)
        self.results_table.doubleClicked.connect(self._request_hook)
        layout.addWidget(self.results_table)

        buttons = QHBoxLayout()
        self.hook_button = QPushButton(self.translations["watch.create_hook"])
        self.hook_button.setObjectName("btn_primary")
        set_button_icon(self.hook_button, "webhook")
        self.hook_button.setToolTip(self.translations["watch.create_hook_tooltip"])
        self.hook_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.hook_button.clicked.connect(self._request_hook)
        buttons.addWidget(self.hook_button)
        self.monitor_button = QPushButton(self.translations["watch.monitor"])
        set_button_icon(self.monitor_button, "visibility")
        self.monitor_button.setToolTip(self.translations["watch.monitor_tooltip"])
        self.monitor_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.monitor_button.clicked.connect(self._request_monitor)
        buttons.addWidget(self.monitor_button)
        buttons.addStretch()
        self.stop_button = QPushButton(self.translations["watch.stop"])
        set_button_icon(self.stop_button, "stop")
        self.stop_button.clicked.connect(self._request_stop)
        buttons.addWidget(self.stop_button)
        close_button = QPushButton(self.translations["watch.close"])
        set_button_icon(close_button, "close")
        close_button.clicked.connect(self.close)
        buttons.addWidget(close_button)
        layout.addLayout(buttons)

    def add_hits(self, hits):
        """Append a batch of hits, grouping repeated PCs into a single row."""
        for hit in hits:
            pc = hit["pc"]
            row = self._rows_by_pc.get(pc)
            if row is None:
                row = self.results_table.rowCount()
                self.results_table.insertRow(row)
                self._rows_by_pc[pc] = row
                for column in range(self.results_table.columnCount()):
                    self.results_table.setItem(row, column, QTableWidgetItem(""))
                self.results_table.item(row, _COUNT).setText("0")
                self.results_table.item(row, _PC).setText(pc)
                self.results_table.item(row, _SITE).setText(hit.get("site", pc))
                for column in (_READ, _WRITE):
                    item = self.results_table.item(row, column)
                    # A check box the user cannot change.
                    item.setFlags(item.flags() & ~Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable)
                    item.setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Unchecked)

            if hit.get("method"):
                # JIT code of a Mono game: the C# method says more than an address.
                site_item = self.results_table.item(row, _SITE)
                site_item.setText(hit["method"])
                site_item.setToolTip(hit.get("site", pc))
            count_item = self.results_table.item(row, _COUNT)
            count_item.setText(str(int(count_item.text()) + hit.get("count", 1)))
            # Older agents report writes only.
            for column, key, default in ((_READ, "read", False), (_WRITE, "write", True)):
                if hit.get(key, default):
                    self.results_table.item(row, column).setCheckState(Qt.CheckState.Checked)
            self.results_table.item(row, _VALUE).setText(hit.get("value", ""))
            self.results_table.item(row, _THREAD).setText(str(hit.get("threadId", "")))
            self.results_table.item(row, _TIME).setText(self._hit_time(hit))
        self._update_hook_button()

    @staticmethod
    def _hit_time(hit):
        """Return the local time of a hit's last write, e.g. ``14:03:27.418``."""
        milliseconds = hit.get("time")
        moment = datetime.now() if milliseconds is None \
            else datetime.fromtimestamp(milliseconds / 1000)
        return moment.strftime("%H:%M:%S.%f")[:-3]

    def set_monitoring(self, thread_count, details=""):
        text = self.translations["watch.running"].format(
            threads=thread_count
        )
        if details:
            text = f"{text} {details}"
        self.status_label.setText(text)

    def show_warning(self, message):
        self.status_label.setText(
            self.translations["watch.warning"].format(message=message)
        )

    def show_error(self, message):
        self._failed = True
        self.status_label.setText(
            self.translations["watch.failed"].format(message=message)
        )

    def set_stopped(self):
        self.stop_button.setEnabled(False)
        if not self._failed:
            self.status_label.setText(self.translations["watch.stopped"])

    def _selected_writes(self):
        """Return whether the selected row's instruction writes the target."""
        row = self.results_table.currentRow()
        item = self.results_table.item(row, _WRITE) if row >= 0 else None
        return (self.results_table.selectionModel().hasSelection() and item is not None
                and item.checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked)

    def _update_hook_button(self):
        # Only writes can be hooked: the hook rewrites the written value.
        self.hook_button.setEnabled(self._selected_writes())
        self.monitor_button.setEnabled(self.results_table.currentRow() >= 0
                                       and self.results_table.selectionModel().hasSelection())

    def _request_monitor(self):
        row = self.results_table.currentRow()
        pc_item = self.results_table.item(row, _PC) if row >= 0 else None
        if pc_item is not None:
            self.monitor_requested.emit(int(pc_item.text(), 16))

    def _request_hook(self):
        row = self.results_table.currentRow()
        if row < 0 or not self._selected_writes():
            return
        pc_item = self.results_table.item(row, 1)
        site_item = self.results_table.item(row, 2)
        if pc_item is None:
            return
        self.hook_requested.emit(
            int(pc_item.text(), 16),
            site_item.text() if site_item is not None else pc_item.text(),
        )

    def _request_stop(self):
        self.stop_button.setEnabled(False)
        self.status_label.setText(self.translations["watch.stopping"])
        self.stop_requested.emit()
```

`hermes/ui/window_buttons.py`:

```py
"""Minimize and maximize buttons for Hermes' dialogs on Windows.

On Windows Qt gives a dialog only a close button; on Linux the window
manager decides and lets any window be maximized, by a double click on its
title too. ``add_window_buttons`` gives every dialog of Hermes the two
buttons when it first gets the focus. Qt leaves the maximize button out for
a dialog of a fixed size. Qt's own dialogs (message boxes, file dialogs)
stay as they are.

Not an event filter on the application (see activity_recorder.py): the
focus signal is enough, and changing the flags of the native window neither
hides nor re-creates it, so a modal dialog stays open.
"""

import sys

from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QDialog  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

_BUTTONS = Qt.WindowType.WindowMinMaxButtonsHint


def add_window_buttons(app):
    """Have ``app`` add the buttons to Hermes' dialogs (Windows only)."""
    if sys.platform == "win32":
        app.focusWindowChanged.connect(_on_focus_window)


def _on_focus_window(window):
    if window is None:
        return
    dialog = next((widget for widget in QApplication.topLevelWidgets()
                   if widget.windowHandle() == window), None)
    if not isinstance(dialog, QDialog) or not type(dialog).__module__.startswith("hermes."):
        return
    flags = dialog.windowFlags()
    if flags & _BUTTONS == _BUTTONS:
        return
    flags |= _BUTTONS
    # Tell the widget without re-creating it, then the native window.
    dialog.overrideWindowFlags(flags)
    window.setFlags(flags)

```

`hermes/ui/window_state.py`:

```py
"""Window sizes, splitter positions and column widths, kept between runs.

An event filter of the application (``keep_window_state``) restores, when one
of Hermes' windows is first shown, its size and the positions of its
splitters, and saves them when the window is hidden or closed. Windows that
are not modal get their position back, too; modal dialogs only their size
(Qt centres them over their parent). Column widths the user sets are kept by
the tables' column sizer (see ``resizable_columns`` in
hermes.ui.widgets.table), under a key built from the window and the table's
place in it (``view_key``).

Everything lives in QSettings("hermes-hook", "hermes-hook") under
``windows/``, ``splitters/`` and ``columns/``.
"""

import json

from PySide6.QtCore import QByteArray, QEvent, QObject, QSettings, QSize  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QSplitter, QWidget  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

# Set on a window once its state was restored
_RESTORED = "hermesStateRestored"


def settings():
    """The QSettings the state is kept in (tests point it elsewhere)."""
    return QSettings("hermes-hook", "hermes-hook")


def _is_hermes(widget):
    return type(widget).__module__.startswith("hermes.")


def _path(widget, top):
    """Where ``widget`` sits below ``top``: class names and indexes among
    siblings of the same class, e.g. ``QSplitter0/QTableWidget1``."""
    parts = []
    node = widget
    while node is not None and node is not top:
        parent = node.parent()
        siblings = [child for child in (parent.children() if parent is not None else [])
                    if type(child) is type(node)]
        index = next((i for i, child in enumerate(siblings) if child is node), 0)
        parts.append(f"{type(node).__name__}{index}")
        node = parent
    return "/".join(reversed(parts))


def view_key(view):
    """The key a table's column widths are kept under."""
    window = view.window()
    return f"{type(window).__name__}/{_path(view, window)}"


def load_columns(key, count):
    """{column: width} kept for a table with ``count`` columns, else {}."""
    try:
        data = json.loads(settings().value(f"columns/{key}", "") or "{}")
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return {}
    if data.get("count") != count:
        return {}
    return {int(column): int(width) for column, width in data.get("widths", {}).items()}


def save_columns(key, count, widths):
    """Keep the widths ({column: width}) the user gave a table's columns."""
    settings().setValue(f"columns/{key}", json.dumps(
        {"count": count, "widths": {str(column): width for column, width in widths.items()}}))


def restore_window(window):
    store = settings()
    key = type(window).__name__
    if isinstance(window, QDialog) and window.isModal():
        size = store.value(f"windows/{key}/size")
        if isinstance(size, QSize) and size.isValid():
            window.resize(size)
    else:
        geometry = store.value(f"windows/{key}/geometry")
        if isinstance(geometry, QByteArray) and not geometry.isEmpty():
            window.restoreGeometry(geometry)
    for splitter in window.findChildren(QSplitter):
        state = store.value(f"splitters/{key}/{_path(splitter, window)}")
        if isinstance(state, QByteArray) and not state.isEmpty():
            splitter.restoreState(state)


def save_window(window):
    store = settings()
    key = type(window).__name__
    store.setValue(f"windows/{key}/geometry", window.saveGeometry())
    if not window.isMaximized() and not window.isFullScreen():
        store.setValue(f"windows/{key}/size", window.size())
    for splitter in window.findChildren(QSplitter):
        store.setValue(f"splitters/{key}/{_path(splitter, window)}", splitter.saveState())


class _WindowStateKeeper(QObject):
    """Restores Hermes' windows when first shown, saves them when hidden."""

    def eventFilter(self, watched, event):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        kind = event.type()
        if kind not in (QEvent.Type.Show, QEvent.Type.Hide):
            return False
        if not isinstance(watched, QWidget) or not watched.isWindow() or not _is_hermes(watched):
            return False
        if kind == QEvent.Type.Show:
            if not watched.property(_RESTORED):
                watched.setProperty(_RESTORED, True)
                restore_window(watched)
        elif watched.property(_RESTORED):
            save_window(watched)
        return False


def keep_window_state(app):
    """Have ``app`` keep the sizes of Hermes' windows; returns the filter."""
    keeper = _WindowStateKeeper(app)
    app.installEventFilter(keeper)
    return keeper

```

`hermes/ui/workers.py`:

```py
"""Keep QThreads referenced until their thread has really ended.

A QThread destroyed while its thread still runs aborts the application. Its
``finished`` signal is emitted from the thread just before the thread ends, so
a slot of ``finished`` that drops the last reference may destroy it too early.
Workers of windows that close are kept here until then.
"""

import shiboken6  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtCore import QThread, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from hermes.attach.wine_gadget import ensure_gadget

_workers = set()


class GadgetDownloadWorker(QThread):
    """Download a Wine gadget without blocking the GUI thread."""

    progress = Signal(int, int)
    completed = Signal()

    def __init__(self, bits, parent=None):
        super().__init__(parent)
        self.bits = bits
        self.path = None
        self.error = None

    def run(self):
        try:
            self.path = ensure_gadget(self.bits, progress=self.progress.emit)
        except Exception as error:  # pylint: disable=broad-exception-caught
            self.error = str(error)
        self.completed.emit()


def keep_until_finished(worker):
    """Keep ``worker`` referenced until its thread has ended, also after its window closed."""
    _workers.add(worker)
    worker.finished.connect(lambda: _release(worker))


def _release(worker):
    if QThread.currentThread() is not worker:
        worker.wait()  # past run(): only the end of the thread is left
    _workers.discard(worker)


def running_workers():
    """The workers kept right now."""
    # One deleted by Qt (e.g. never started, with its parent gone) runs no
    # more; nor does one never started or whose thread ended before its
    # ``finished`` slot ran (no event loop ran since).
    _workers.difference_update([worker for worker in _workers
                                if not getattr(shiboken6, "isValid")(worker)
                                or not worker.isRunning()])
    return set(_workers)


def stop_workers(timeout_ms):
    """Ask every kept worker to stop and wait for each; True if all have ended."""
    workers = list(running_workers())
    for worker in workers:
        worker.requestInterruption()
    # A list, not a generator: wait for each, also after one timed out.
    return all([worker.wait(timeout_ms) for worker in workers])  # pylint: disable=use-a-generator

```

`scripts/hermes-hook.cmd`:

```cmd
@echo off
rem Start Hermes Hook from the project's virtual environment, e.g. from a
rem shortcut. Works from any working directory. Uses pythonw.exe, so no
rem console window stays open.
setlocal

for %%I in ("%~dp0..") do set "PROJECT_DIR=%%~fI"
if defined HERMES_VENV (set "VENV_DIR=%HERMES_VENV%") else (set "VENV_DIR=%PROJECT_DIR%\.venv")

if not exist "%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\pythonw.exe" (
    echo No virtual environment at %VENV_DIR% ^(see docs\getting-started\installation.md^). 1>&2
    exit /b 1
)

cd /d "%PROJECT_DIR%"
start "" "%VENV_DIR%\Scripts\pythonw.exe" -m hermes %*

```

`scripts/hermes-hook.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Start Hermes Hook from the project's virtual environment, e.g. from the
# desktop menu. Works from any working directory.
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")/.." && pwd)"
VENV_DIR="${HERMES_VENV:-$PROJECT_DIR/.venv}"

if [[ ! -f "$VENV_DIR/bin/activate" ]]; then
    echo "No virtual environment at $VENV_DIR (see docs/getting-started/installation.md)." >&2
    exit 1
fi

# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "$VENV_DIR/bin/activate"
cd "$PROJECT_DIR"
exec python -m hermes "$@"

```

`scripts/install-desktop-entry.sh`:

```sh
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Install a desktop menu entry (KDE, GNOME, ...) for the current user that
# starts Hermes Hook through scripts/hermes-hook.sh.
# Remove it again with: install-desktop-entry.sh --uninstall
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd "$(dirname "$(readlink -f "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")")/.." && pwd)"
APPS_DIR="${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/applications"
# The file name has to match DESKTOP_FILE_NAME in hermes/main.py, so that
# Wayland shows the icon of this entry.
DESKTOP_FILE="$APPS_DIR/hermes-hook.desktop"

refresh_menu() {
    command -v update-desktop-database >/dev/null && update-desktop-database "$APPS_DIR" || true
    command -v kbuildsycoca6 >/dev/null && kbuildsycoca6 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}

if [[ "${1:-}" == "--uninstall" ]]; then
    rm -f "$DESKTOP_FILE"
    refresh_menu
    echo "Removed $DESKTOP_FILE"
    exit 0
fi

chmod +x "$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hermes-hook.sh"
mkdir -p "$APPS_DIR"
cat > "$DESKTOP_FILE" <<ENTRY
[Desktop Entry]
Type=Application
Name=Hermes Hook
GenericName=Memory Scanner and Hook Engine
Comment=Linux memory scanner, hook engine and reverse engineering tool
Comment[de]=Speicherscanner, Hook-Engine und Reverse-Engineering-Werkzeug für Linux
Exec="$PROJECT_DIR/scripts/hermes-hook.sh"
Path=$PROJECT_DIR
Icon=$PROJECT_DIR/hermes/ui/resources/favicon.svg
Terminal=false
Categories=Development;Debugger;Game;
Keywords=memory;scanner;hook;trainer;cheat;
StartupWMClass=hermes-hook
ENTRY

command -v desktop-file-validate >/dev/null && desktop-file-validate "$DESKTOP_FILE" || true
refresh_menu
echo "Installed $DESKTOP_FILE"

```

`scripts/install-windows-shortcut.ps1`:

```ps1
# Install a Start menu shortcut for the current user that starts Hermes Hook
# from the project's virtual environment. Pin it to the taskbar from the Start
# menu (right click, "Pin to taskbar"); Windows does not allow scripts to pin.
# Remove it again with: install-windows-shortcut.ps1 -Uninstall
#
# Run with: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-windows-shortcut.ps1
param([switch]$Uninstall)
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"

$ProjectDir = Split-Path -Parent $PSScriptRoot
$VenvDir = if ($env:HERMES_VENV) { $env:HERMES_VENV } else { Join-Path $ProjectDir ".venv" }
$ShortcutFile = Join-Path ([Environment]::GetFolderPath("Programs")) "Hermes Hook.lnk"
$IconFile = Join-Path $env:LOCALAPPDATA "hermes-hook\hermes-hook.ico"
# Has to match WINDOWS_APP_ID in hermes/main.py, so that the pinned shortcut
# and the running window share one taskbar button.
$AppId = "hermes-hook.win"

if ($Uninstall) {
    Remove-Item -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue $ShortcutFile, $IconFile
    Write-Output "Removed $ShortcutFile"
    exit 0
}

$Pythonw = Join-Path $VenvDir "Scripts\pythonw.exe"
if (-not (Test-Path $Pythonw)) {
    Write-Error "No virtual environment at $VenvDir (see docs\getting-started\installation.md)."
}

# Shortcuts cannot use the SVG icon, so render it to an .ico with Qt.
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force (Split-Path $IconFile) | Out-Null
$env:QT_QPA_PLATFORM = "offscreen"
& (Join-Path $VenvDir "Scripts\python.exe") -c @"
import sys
from PySide6.QtGui import QGuiApplication, QIcon
app = QGuiApplication(sys.argv)
image = QIcon(sys.argv[1]).pixmap(256, 256).toImage()
sys.exit(0 if image.save(sys.argv[2], 'ICO') else 1)
"@ (Join-Path $ProjectDir "hermes\ui\resources\favicon.svg") $IconFile
if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
    Write-Warning "Cannot create $IconFile, the shortcut uses the Python icon."
    $IconFile = $Pythonw
}

# The shortcut starts pythonw.exe directly instead of hermes-hook.cmd, so no
# console window flashes up.
$Shell = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
$Shortcut = $Shell.CreateShortcut($ShortcutFile)
$Shortcut.TargetPath = $Pythonw
$Shortcut.Arguments = "-m hermes"
$Shortcut.WorkingDirectory = $ProjectDir
$Shortcut.IconLocation = "$IconFile,0"
$Shortcut.Description = "Memory scanner, hook engine and reverse engineering tool"
$Shortcut.Save()

# WScript.Shell cannot set the app ID of a shortcut, so write the property
# through IPropertyStore.
Add-Type -TypeDefinition @"
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;

public static class ShortcutAppId
{
    [ComImport, Guid("00021401-0000-0000-C000-000000000046")]
    class ShellLink { }

    [ComImport, Guid("0000010b-0000-0000-C000-000000000046"),
     InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
    interface IPersistFile
    {
        void GetClassID(out Guid classId);
        [PreserveSig] int IsDirty();
        void Load([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] string fileName, uint mode);
        void Save([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] string fileName, bool remember);
        void SaveCompleted([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] string fileName);
        void GetCurFile([MarshalAs(UnmanagedType.LPWStr)] out string fileName);
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Sequential, Pack = 4)]
    struct PropertyKey
    {
        public Guid FormatId;
        public uint PropertyId;
    }

    [StructLayout(LayoutKind.Explicit)]
    struct PropVariant
    {
        [FieldOffset(0)] public ushort VarType;
        [FieldOffset(8)] public IntPtr Value;
    }

    [ComImport, Guid("886D8EEB-8CF2-4446-8D02-CDBA1DBDCF99"),
     InterfaceType(ComInterfaceType.InterfaceIsIUnknown)]
    interface IPropertyStore
    {
        void GetCount(out uint count);
        void GetAt(uint index, out PropertyKey key);
        void GetValue(ref PropertyKey key, out PropVariant value);
        void SetValue(ref PropertyKey key, ref PropVariant value);
        void Commit();
    }

    public static void Set(string shortcutFile, string appId)
    {
        object link = new ShellLink();
        try
        {
            ((IPersistFile)link).Load(shortcutFile, 2);  // STGM_READWRITE
            // PKEY_AppUserModel_ID
            PropertyKey key = new PropertyKey
            {
                FormatId = new Guid("9F4C2855-9F79-4B39-A8D0-E1D42DE1D5F3"),
                PropertyId = 5,
            };
            PropVariant value = new PropVariant
            {
                VarType = 31,  // VT_LPWSTR
                Value = Marshal.StringToCoTaskMemUni(appId),
            };
            try
            {
                IPropertyStore store = (IPropertyStore)link;
                store.SetValue(ref key, ref value);
                store.Commit();
            }
            finally
            {
                Marshal.FreeCoTaskMem(value.Value);
            }
            ((IPersistFile)link).Save(shortcutFile, true);
        }
        finally
        {
            Marshal.ReleaseComObject(link);
        }
    }
}
"@
[ShortcutAppId]::Set($ShortcutFile, $AppId)

Write-Output "Installed $ShortcutFile"
Write-Output "Pin it from the Start menu: right click 'Hermes Hook', 'Pin to taskbar'."
```
