```py
_GAME_SOURCE = r"""
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

extern int g_gold;
void Hero_Tick(float delta);
void Hero_Loot(int amount);
void Game_Rename(int which);
int Game_Place(int steps);
int Game_Roll(int min);
int Game_Length(int x);
int Game_Gold(void);
int Game_NameLength(void);

int main(void) {
    printf("%d %p\n", getpid(), (void *)&g_gold);
    fflush(stdout);
    char cmd[32];
    int value;
    while (scanf("%31s %d", cmd, &value) == 2) {
        int answer = 0;
        if (strcmp(cmd, "tick") == 0)
            Hero_Tick(0.5f);
        else if (strcmp(cmd, "loot") == 0)
            Hero_Loot(value);
        else if (strcmp(cmd, "rename") == 0)
            Game_Rename(value);
        else if (strcmp(cmd, "place") == 0)
            answer = Game_Place(value);
        else if (strcmp(cmd, "roll") == 0)
            answer = Game_Roll(value);
        else if (strcmp(cmd, "length") == 0)
            answer = Game_Length(value);
        else if (strcmp(cmd, "hero") == 0)
            answer = Game_Gold() * 100 + Game_NameLength();
        printf("%d %d\n", g_gold, answer);
        fflush(stdout);
    }
    return 0;
}
"""


def _build(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "game_assembly.c").write_text(_GAME_ASSEMBLY_SOURCE)
    (tmp_path / "game.c").write_text(_GAME_SOURCE)
    library = tmp_path / "GameAssembly.so"
    subprocess.run(["gcc", "-O0", "-shared", "-fPIC", str(tmp_path / "game_assembly.c"),
                    "-o", str(library)], check=True)
    binary = tmp_path / "fakegame"
    subprocess.run(["gcc", "-O0", str(tmp_path / "game.c"), str(library),
                    "-Wl,-rpath,$ORIGIN", "-o", str(binary)], check=True)
    return binary


def _run(qt_app, worker, signal):
    found, failed = [], []
    signal.connect(lambda *args: found.append(args))
    worker.catalog_failed.connect(failed.append)
    worker.start()
    _wait_for(qt_app, worker.isFinished)
    qt_app.processEvents()
    assert not failed
    return found


@requires_target
def test_catalog_lists_images_classes_and_methods(tmp_path, qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from hermes.engines.registry import detect_engine
    from hermes.features.catalog import CatalogWorker

    target = _Target(_build(tmp_path))
    try:
        engine = detect_engine(target.pid)
        assert engine.id == "il2cpp"

        worker = CatalogWorker(target.pid)
        loaded = {}
        worker.assembly_loaded.connect(loaded.__setitem__)
        found = _run(qt_app, worker, worker.assemblies_found)[0][0]
        # Named without .dll, as Mono names assemblies; the build of
        # GameAssembly stands for their MVID.
        assert [(a["name"], a["file"], a["classes"]) for a in found] == [
            ("mscorlib", "mscorlib.dll", 2), ("Assembly-CSharp", "Assembly-CSharp.dll", 3)]
        assert found[0]["mvid"] and found[0]["mvid"] != found[1]["mvid"]
        # The framework is left out unless asked for.
        assert sorted(loaded) == ["Assembly-CSharp"]
        methods = {m.signature: m for m in loaded["Assembly-CSharp"]}
        assert sorted(methods) == [
            "Game.Bag`1:Add (T)", "Game.Hero:AddGold (int)", "Game.Hero:Attack ()",
            "Game.Hero:Idle (single)", "Game.Hero:Loot (int)", "Game.Hero:Place (int)",
            "Game.Hero:Rename (string)", "Game.Hero:Roll (int,single,bool)",
            "Game.Hero:Tick (single)", "Game.Hero:get_Count ()", "Game.Vec:Length ()"]
        add = methods["Game.Hero:AddGold (int)"]
        assert (add.class_name, add.name, add.parameters, add.return_type, add.static,
                add.token, add.engine, add.argument_names) == (
            "Game.Hero", "AddGold", "(int)", "System.Void", True, 0x06000001, "il2cpp",
            ("amount",))
        assert methods["Game.Bag`1:Add (T)"].class_name == "Game.Bag<T>"
    finally:
        target.close()


@requires_target
def test_trace_counts_methods_and_names_their_callers(tmp_path, qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from hermes.features.trace import NEW, SAME, TraceWorker, analyze, recording_calls

    target = _Target(_build(tmp_path))
    worker = TraceWorker(target.pid)
    planned, started, began, recorded, failed = [], [], [], [], []
    worker.planned.connect(planned.append)
    worker.started.connect(lambda methods, info: started.append((methods, info)))
    worker.began.connect(began.append)
    worker.recorded.connect(recorded.append)
    worker.command_failed.connect(lambda action, message: failed.append((action, message)))
    worker.worker_failed.connect(lambda message: failed.append(("worker", message)))

    def record(phase, *commands):
        worker.begin(phase)
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: phase in began or failed)
        began.clear()
        for command, value in commands:
            target.send(command, value)
        count = len(recorded)
        worker.finish()
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: len(recorded) > count or failed)
        assert not failed
        return recorded[-1]

    try:
        worker.start()
        worker.plan([])
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: planned or failed)
        assert not failed
        # Attack is abstract, Bag`1:Add belongs to a generic definition.
        assert planned[0] == {"methods": 9, "skipped": {"abstract": 1, "native": 0, "generic": 1},
                              "assemblies": ["Assembly-CSharp"]}

        worker.trace([])
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: started or failed)
        assert not failed
        methods, info = started[0]
        assert (info["notCompiled"], info["failed"]) == (0, 0)
        # Tick and Idle share their code: hooked once, under the first.
        assert sorted(method.name for method in methods) == [
            "AddGold", "Length", "Loot", "Place", "Rename", "Roll", "Tick", "get_Count"]

        baseline = record("baseline", ("tick", 0), ("tick", 0))
        index = {method.name: i for i, method in enumerate(methods)}
        assert {int(key): count for key, count in baseline["counts"].items()} == {
            index["Tick"]: 2}
        scenario = record("scenario", ("tick", 0), ("loot", 5), ("tick", 0))
        rows = analyze(scenario, baseline)
        assert [(methods[row.method].name, row.verdict, row.calls) for row in rows] == [
            ("Loot", NEW, 1), ("AddGold", NEW, 1), ("Tick", SAME, 2)]
        calls = {methods[call.method].name: call.caller for call in recording_calls(scenario)}
        # Code in GameAssembly is named as the C# method it belongs to.
        assert calls["AddGold"].startswith("Game.Hero:Loot+0x")
        assert calls["Loot"].startswith("fakegame+0x")
    finally:
        worker.requestInterruption()
        worker.wait(5000)
        target.close()


_NAMING_AGENT = r"""
rpc.exports = {
  ready() {
    return engine.refresh() && engine.locate(ptr(0)) !== undefined;
  },
  names() {
    const library = Process.getModuleByName('GameAssembly.so');
    const at = name => library.getExportByName(name);
    const located = engine.locate(at('Hero_Loot').add(4));
    return {
      loot: engine.describe(at('Hero_Loot').add(4)),
      tick: engine.describe(at('Hero_Tick')),
      // The abstract method's stub is no method's code.
      stub: engine.describe(at('Unresolved')),
      outside: engine.describe(Process.getModuleByName('fakegame').base),
      identity: located ? engine.identify(at('Hero_Loot').add(4)) : null
    };
  },
  async compile(identity) {
    const code = await engine.compile(identity);
    return [code.start.toString(), code.size];
  },
  address: name => Process.getModuleByName('GameAssembly.so').getExportByName(name).toString()
};
"""


@requires_target
def test_code_addresses_are_named_and_found_again(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import frida

    from hermes.engines.registry import ENGINE_AGENT_SOURCE

    target = _Target(_build(tmp_path))
    session = frida.attach(target.pid)
    try:
        script = session.create_script(ENGINE_AGENT_SOURCE + _NAMING_AGENT)
        script.load()
        api = script.exports_sync
        # The table is built on the agent's thread soon after the runtime was found.
        deadline = time.monotonic() + 5
        while not api.ready():
            assert time.monotonic() < deadline
            time.sleep(0.05)
        names = api.names()
        assert names["loot"] == "Game.Hero:Loot+0x4"
        assert names["tick"] == "Game.Hero:Tick+0x0 [shared with 1]"
        assert names["stub"] is None and names["outside"] is None
        identity = names["identity"]
        assert identity == {"engine": "il2cpp", "image": "Assembly-CSharp",
                            "file": "Assembly-CSharp.dll", "token": 0x06000004,
                            "method": "Game.Hero:Loot (int)", "offset": 4}
        start, size = api.compile(identity)
        assert start == api.address("Hero_Loot") and size > 4
        # A method that changed (another signature) is not taken for the old one.
        changed = json.loads(json.dumps(identity))
        changed["method"] = "Game.Hero:Loot (long)"
        try:
            api.compile(changed)
        except frida.core.RPCException as error:
            assert "method_changed" in str(error) or "no longer" in str(error)
        else:
            raise AssertionError("compile accepted a changed method")
        script.unload()
    finally:
        session.detach()
        target.close()


_RENAME = {"engine": "il2cpp", "image": "Assembly-CSharp", "file": None, "token": 0x06000007,
           "method": "Game.Hero:Rename (string)"}
_PLACE = {"engine": "il2cpp", "image": "Assembly-CSharp", "file": None, "token": 0x06000008,
          "method": "Game.Hero:Place (int)"}


@requires_target
def test_method_monitor_logs_arguments_and_inspects_objects(tmp_path, qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from hermes.features.monitor import MethodMonitorWorker

    target = _Target(_build(tmp_path))
    worker = MethodMonitorWorker(target.pid)
    added, calls, inspected, failed = {}, [], {}, {}
    worker.monitor_added.connect(added.__setitem__)
    worker.calls.connect(lambda events, _dropped, _counts: calls.extend(events))
    worker.inspected.connect(inspected.__setitem__)
    worker.inspect_failed.connect(failed.__setitem__)

    def inspect(value_target):
        request = worker.inspect(value_target)
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: request in inspected or request in failed)
        return inspected.get(request) or failed[request]

    try:
        worker.start()
        rename = worker.add_monitor(_RENAME, returns=False, objects=True)
        place = worker.add_monitor(_PLACE, returns=True, objects=False)
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: rename in added and place in added)
        assert (added[rename]["instance"], added[rename]["params"]) == (
            True, ["System.String name"])
        target.send("rename", 1)
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: calls)
        call = calls[0]
        assert call["monitorId"] == rename
        assert call["self"]["text"].startswith("Game.Hero@0x")
        assert call["args"][0]["text"] == '"Young Wolf"'
        # Game_Rename is no method: its code is named module+offset.
        assert call["caller"].startswith("GameAssembly.so+0x")

        calls.clear()
        # The struct result's pointer comes first: self and steps are still found.
        assert target.send("place", 4) == (0, 4)
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: any(c["monitorId"] == place for c in calls))
        call = next(c for c in calls if c["monitorId"] == place)
        assert call["self"]["text"].startswith("Game.Hero@0x")
        assert call["args"][0]["text"] == "4"
        assert call["result"]["text"] == "struct Game.Vec"

        contents = inspect(call["self"]["target"])
        assert contents["name"] == "Game.Hero"
        fields = {field["name"]: field for field in contents["fields"]}
        assert [(name, f["static"], f["value"]["text"]) for name, f in fields.items()] == [
            ("Gold", False, "30"), ("Name", False, '"Miranda"'), ("Instances", True, "7")]
        # The static field lies in the class's static data, found by its layout.
        assert fields["Instances"]["address"] is not None
        assert fields["Gold"]["valueType"] == "int32"
        # An address that holds no object is refused instead of read.
        assert "no object" in inspect({"address": "0x10"})
    finally:
        worker.requestInterruption()
        worker.wait(5000)
        target.close()


_ROLL = {"engine": "il2cpp", "image": "Assembly-CSharp", "file": None, "token": 0x0600000a,
         "method": "Game.Hero:Roll (int,single,bool)"}
_LENGTH = {"engine": "il2cpp", "image": "Assembly-CSharp", "file": None, "token": 0x0600000b,
           "method": "Game.Vec:Length ()"}


def _method_transform(source, **params):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from hermes.hooks.transforms import TemplateTransform, TransformDefinition, TransformParameter

    definition = TransformDefinition(
        "test", source, tuple(TransformParameter(name, default=value)
                              for name, value in params.items()), kind="method")
    return TemplateTransform(definition, **params)


@requires_target
def test_method_hooks_change_arguments_fields_and_results(tmp_path, qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from hermes.features.method_hooks import MethodHookSpec, MethodHookWorker

    target = _Target(_build(tmp_path))
    worker = MethodHookWorker(target.pid)
    installed, failed, errors, debug = {}, {}, {}, []
    worker.hook_installed.connect(installed.__setitem__)
    worker.hook_failed.connect(failed.__setitem__)
    worker.transform_error.connect(errors.__setitem__)
    worker.hook_debug.connect(lambda entries, _dropped: debug.extend(entries))
    before = """function (ctx) {
      ctx.args.min = 10;            // int in a register
      ctx.args.scale = 3;           // float in an xmm register
      ctx.args.crit = false;        // bool
      ctx.this.Gold = 5;            // an int field
      ctx.this.Name = "Renamed";    // a new string in a reference field
    }"""
    after = """function (ctx) {
      ctx.log(ctx.args.min, ctx.this.Gold, ctx.this.Name, ctx.static("Game.Hero.Instances"));
      return ctx.result + ctx.call("Game.Hero:get_Count");
    }"""
    try:
        worker.start()
        first = worker.add_hook(MethodHookSpec(_ROLL, _method_transform(before), phase="before"))
        second = worker.add_hook(MethodHookSpec(_ROLL, _method_transform(after)))
        struct = worker.add_hook(MethodHookSpec(
            _LENGTH, _method_transform("function (ctx) { return ctx.this.x * 10 + ctx.this.z; }")))
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: {first, second, struct} <= set(installed) | set(failed))
        assert not failed, failed
        worker.set_debug(second, True)
        time.sleep(0.2)

        # 10 * 3 without crit, plus get_Count (7) after the call
        assert target.send("roll", 5) == (0, 37)
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: debug)
        assert not errors, errors
        assert debug[0]["logs"] == ["10 5 Renamed 7"]
        assert target.send("hero", 0) == (0, 5 * 100 + len("Renamed"))
        # A struct's method: ``this`` is its data. x 4, y 1, z 2 -> 4 * 10 + 2
        assert target.send("length", 4) == (0, 42)

        removed = []
        worker.hook_removed.connect(removed.append)
        for hook_id in (first, second, struct):
            worker.remove_hook(hook_id)
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: len(removed) == 3)
        assert target.send("roll", 5) == (0, 15)
        assert target.send("length", 4) == (0, 7)
    finally:
        worker.requestInterruption()
        worker.wait(5000)
        target.close()
```

```py
"""The application log: files, counting, hooks for what nothing caught."""

import subprocess
import sys

import pytest
from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, QThread, Signal, qWarning  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from hermes.ui.widgets.log_view import read_log

@pytest.fixture(name="log_file")
def fixture_log_file(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("HERMES_LOG_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    path = logs.setup()
    hooks = sys.excepthook, threading.excepthook
    yield path
    sys.excepthook, threading.excepthook = hooks
    logs.teardown()


def _text(path):
    for handler in logs.log.handlers:
        handler.flush()
    return path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def test_setup_writes_to_the_state_directory(log_file, tmp_path):
    assert log_file == tmp_path / "hermes.log" == logs.log_path()
    logs.log.getChild("test").info("hello %s", "log")
    text = _text(log_file)
    assert "Hermes started" in text and "INFO     [MainThread] hermes.test: hello log" in text
    assert "--- Hermes started" in (tmp_path / "crash.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8")


def test_errors_are_counted_and_announced(log_file):
    heard = []
    logs.subscribe(lambda: heard.append(logs.error_count()))
    logs.log.warning("only a warning")
    assert logs.error_count() == 0
    logs.log.error("a real one")
    assert logs.error_count() == 1 and heard == [1]
    assert "ERROR    [MainThread] hermes: a real one" in _text(log_file)


def test_exceptions_nothing_caught_are_logged_not_fatal(log_file, qt_app):
    reported = []
    logs.on_unhandled(lambda summary, details: reported.append((summary, details)))
    logs.install_exception_hooks()

    class Failing(QThread):
        def run(self):
            raise ValueError("broken worker")

    worker = Failing()
    worker.start()
    assert worker.wait(2000)
    thread = threading.Thread(target=lambda: 1 / 0, name="helper")
    thread.start()
    thread.join()
    summaries = [summary for summary, _details in reported]
    assert summaries == ["ValueError: broken worker", "ZeroDivisionError: division by zero"]
    assert "raise ValueError" in reported[0][1]
    text = _text(log_file)
    assert "CRITICAL [helper] hermes: Unhandled exception in thread helper" in text
    assert "Traceback" in text and logs.error_count() == 2


def test_worker_failures_are_logged_once_per_interval(log_file):
    class Worker(QObject):
        worker_failed = Signal(str)
        hook_failed = Signal(int, str)
        progress = Signal(int)

        pid = 4711

    worker = Worker()
    logs.log_failures(worker)
    worker.worker_failed.emit("target gone")
    worker.worker_failed.emit("target gone")  # the same: once is enough
    worker.hook_failed.emit(3, "bad script")
    worker.progress.emit(5)
    text = _text(log_file)
    assert text.count("worker_failed (pid 4711): target gone") == 1
    assert "hook_failed (pid 4711): 3 | bad script" in text
    assert "progress" not in text


def test_qt_messages_go_to_the_log(log_file):
    qWarning("something odd")
    assert "WARNING  [MainThread] hermes.qt: something odd" in _text(log_file)


def test_a_crash_leaves_python_stacks_and_is_reported_next_time(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("HERMES_LOG_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    # Not dumpable (prctl PR_SET_DUMPABLE): the crash leaves no core dump
    # and no crash report of the desktop at every test run.
    no_core_dump = ("import ctypes; ctypes.CDLL(None).prctl(4, 0); "
                    if sys.platform == "linux" else "")
    crash = subprocess.run(
        [sys.executable, "-c",
         no_core_dump + "import os; from hermes.core import logs; logs.setup(); os.abort()"],
        capture_output=True, text=True, check=False)
    assert crash.returncode != 0
    stacks = (tmp_path / "crash.log").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    assert "Fatal Python error: Aborted" in stacks and "<string>" in stacks

    path = logs.setup()
    try:
        assert logs.error_count() == 1
        assert "The previous run of Hermes crashed" in _text(path)
    finally:
        logs.teardown()
    # This run did not crash: the next start is quiet.
    logs.setup()
    try:
        assert logs.error_count() == 0
    finally:
        logs.teardown()


def test_read_log_keeps_problems_with_their_tracebacks(tmp_path):

@linux_only
def test_a_log_whose_folder_was_deleted_is_written_again(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import logging
    import shutil

    folder = tmp_path / "logs"
    folder.mkdir()
    handler = logs.ReopeningFileHandler(folder / "hermes.log", encoding="utf-8")
    logger = logging.getLogger("hermes.test.folder")
    logger.propagate = False
    logger.addHandler(handler)
    try:
        logger.warning("before")

        logger.removeHandler(handler)

                                        encoding="utf-8")

    logger.propagate = False
    logger.addHandler(handler)
    try:
        for number in range(30):
            logger.warning("line %02d of a log that is rotated now and then", number)
    finally:
        logger.removeHandler(handler)
        handler.close()
```

`tests/test_memory.py`:

```py
"""Tests for process memory helpers."""

import builtins
import struct

import pytest

from hermes.core import memory as memory_module
from hermes.core.memory import write_process_value
from hermes.platform import linux


class FakeMemory:
    def __init__(self, base_address, contents):
        self.base_address = base_address
        self.contents = contents
        self.position = 0

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_args):
        return None

    def seek(self, address):
        self.position = address - self.base_address

    def write(self, value):
        end = self.position + len(value)
        self.contents[self.position:end] = value
        self.position = end
        return len(value)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("value_type", "value", "expected"),
    [
        ("int32", "0x2a", 42),
        ("double", "3.5", 3.5),
        ("uint8", "255", 255),
        ("int16", "-2", -2),
    ],
)
def test_write_process_value_encodes_and_writes_typed_data(
    monkeypatch, value_type, value, expected
):
    base_address = 0x1000
    contents = bytearray(16)
    fake_memory = FakeMemory(base_address, contents)
    opened = []

    def fake_open(path, mode, buffering):
        opened.append((path, mode, buffering))
        return fake_memory

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", fake_open)
    # The fake is /proc: use the Linux backend on every system.
    monkeypatch.setattr(memory_module, "ProcessMemory", linux.ProcessMemory)

    result = write_process_value(123, base_address + 4, value, value_type)

    formats = {"int32": "<i", "double": "<d", "uint8": "<B", "int16": "<h"}
    expected_bytes = struct.pack(formats[value_type], expected)
    assert result == expected
    assert contents[4:4 + len(expected_bytes)] == expected_bytes
    assert opened == [("/proc/123/mem", "r+b", 0)]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("value", "value_type"),
    [("invalid", "int32"), ("2147483648", "int32"), ("1", "unknown"),
     ("256", "uint8"), ("-1", "uint32")],
)
def test_write_process_value_rejects_invalid_input(value, value_type):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        write_process_value(123, 0x1000, value, value_type)
```

`tests/test_memory_view.py`:

```py
"""Tests for the memory viewer and its memory helpers."""

# pylint: disable=protected-access

import ctypes
import os
import struct

import pytest

from hermes.core.memory import UnknownModuleError, describe_address, parse_address, read_memory
from hermes.platform import read_mappings
from hermes.platform.linux import parse_maps


@pytest.fixture(name="qt_app", scope="module")
def fixture_qt_app():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    return QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])


def _unmapped_gap():
    """Return an address right behind a readable mapping that is followed by a gap."""
    mappings = read_mappings(os.getpid())
    return next(
        current.end for current, following in zip(mappings, mappings[1:])
        if following.start > current.end and "r" in current.permissions
        and not current.path.startswith("[v")
    )


def test_read_memory_reads_own_process():
    buffer = ctypes.create_string_buffer(b"hermes-hook!", 16)

    data, readable = read_memory(os.getpid(), ctypes.addressof(buffer), 12)

    assert data == b"hermes-hook!"
    assert all(readable)


def test_read_memory_marks_unmapped_bytes():
    end = _unmapped_gap()

    data, readable = read_memory(os.getpid(), end - 4, 8)

    assert list(readable) == [1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0]
    assert data[4:] == bytes(4)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("text", "expected"),
    [("0x10", 0x10), ("ff", 0xFF), (" 0X7F00 ", 0x7F00), ("game+0x1f0", 0x401F0),
     ("libfoo.so.6 + 10", 0x7F0010),
     ("0x7f55e9339000+0x244", 0x7F55E9339244), ("0x1000 + 0x20 - 8", 0x1018),
     ("game+0x1f0+0x10", 0x40200), ("game-1+0x10", 0x500010), ("game-0x10", 0x3FFF0)],
)
def test_parse_address(text, expected):
    mappings = parse_maps([
        "40000-41000 r-xp 00000000 08:01 1 /opt/game/game",
        "7f0000-7f1000 r-xp 00000000 08:01 2 /usr/lib/libfoo.so.6",
        "500000-501000 r-xp 00000000 08:01 3 /opt/game/game-1",
    ])

    assert parse_address(text, mappings) == expected


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text", ["", "xyz", "other+0x10", "0x10-0x20", "0x10+", "+0x10"])
def test_parse_address_rejects_invalid_input(text):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parse_address(text, [])


def test_parse_address_names_the_unknown_module():
    with pytest.raises(UnknownModuleError) as error:
        parse_address("other.so+0x10+0x4", [])
    assert error.value.module == "other.so"


def test_describe_address():
    mappings = parse_maps([
        "40000-41000 r-xp 00000000 08:01 1 /opt/game/game",
        "41000-42000 rw-p 00001000 08:01 1 /opt/game/game",
        "50000-60000 rw-p 00000000 00:00 0 [heap]",
    ])

    assert describe_address(mappings, 0x41010) == "game+0x1010 (rw-p)"
    assert describe_address(mappings, 0x50020) == "[heap]+0x20 (rw-p)"
    assert describe_address(mappings, 0x45000) is None


def test_viewer_shows_bytes_values_and_changes(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.ui.localization import load_translations
    from hermes.ui.widgets.memory_view import BYTES_PER_ROW, MemoryViewerDialog

    buffer = (ctypes.c_ubyte * 64)()
    address = ctypes.addressof(buffer)
    struct.pack_into("<i", buffer, 0, 1637)
    dialog = MemoryViewerDialog(load_translations("de"), os.getpid(), address)
    dialog.live.setChecked(False)  # refreshed by the test
    dialog.show()
    qt_app.processEvents()
    try:
        model = dialog.model
        column = address % BYTES_PER_ROW
        cell = lambda offset: model.index(  # pylint: disable=unnecessary-lambda-assignment
            (column + offset) // BYTES_PER_ROW, (column + offset) % BYTES_PER_ROW)

        assert model.base == address - column
        assert model.rows > 1
        assert dialog.selected_address() == address
        assert model.data(cell(0)) == "65" and model.data(cell(1)) == "06"
        assert dialog.value_labels["int32"].text() == "1637"
        assert "[anon]" in dialog.selection_label.text() or "+" in dialog.selection_label.text()

        # A byte that changes is highlighted.
        buffer[1] = 0x07
        dialog.refresh()
        assert model.data(cell(1)) == "07"
        assert model.data(cell(1), Qt.ItemDataRole.ForegroundRole) is not None
        assert model.data(cell(2), Qt.ItemDataRole.ForegroundRole) is None
        assert dialog.value_labels["int32"].text() == str(1637 + 0x100)

        # Scrolling and typed addresses.
        dialog.scroll_rows(2)
        assert model.base == address - column + 2 * BYTES_PER_ROW
        dialog.address_input.setText(hex(address + 0x20))
        dialog._go_to_input()
        assert dialog.selected_address() == address + 0x20
        dialog.address_input.setText("kein-modul+0x10")
        dialog._go_to_input()
        assert "kein-modul" in dialog.status_label.text()
    finally:
        dialog.close()


def test_viewer_shows_unreadable_memory(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from hermes.ui.localization import load_translations
    from hermes.ui.widgets.memory_view import BYTES_PER_ROW, MemoryViewerDialog

    end = _unmapped_gap()
    dialog = MemoryViewerDialog(load_translations("de"), os.getpid(), end - BYTES_PER_ROW)
    dialog.live.setChecked(False)
    qt_app.processEvents()
    try:
        assert dialog.model.data(dialog.model.index(0, 0)) != "??"
        assert dialog.model.data(dialog.model.index(1, 0)) == "??"
        dialog.view.setCurrentIndex(dialog.model.index(0, BYTES_PER_ROW - 2))
        assert dialog.value_labels["int32"].text() == "??"  # runs into the gap
        assert dialog.value_labels["int8"].text() != "??"

        dialog.set_process(None)
        assert "beendet" in dialog.status_label.text()
        assert dialog.model.data(dialog.model.index(0, 0)) == "??"
    finally:
        dialog.close()
```

```py
"""Tests for error messages in the user's language."""

import json
import re
import string
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from hermes.agent.source import MESSAGES_SOURCE
from hermes.core import messages
from hermes.attach.wine_gadget import GadgetError
from hermes.attach.wine_helper import HelperError
from hermes.ui.localization import load_translations

_HERMES = Path(messages.__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def _catalog(language):
    return json.loads((_HERMES / "ui" / "localization" / f"{language}.json")
                      .read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def _fields(template):
    return sorted(name for _, name, _, _ in string.Formatter().parse(template) if name)


def test_errors_are_english_until_a_catalog_is_chosen():
    error = GadgetError("error.gadget.load", error=HelperError("error.helper.run", error="boom"))

    assert str(error) == ("Could not load the Frida gadget into the game: "
                          "Could not run the helper: boom")
    messages.use(load_translations("de"))
    # Rendered when shown, nested errors included
    assert str(error) == ("Das Frida-Gadget konnte nicht ins Spiel geladen werden: "
                          "Hilfsprogramm konnte nicht gestartet werden: boom")


def test_error_keys_exist_in_both_catalogs_with_the_same_fields():
    english, german = _catalog("en"), _catalog("de")
    keys = {key for key in english if key.startswith("error.")}

    assert keys == {key for key in german if key.startswith("error.")}
    for key in keys:
        assert _fields(english[key]) == _fields(german[key]), key
    used = {key for path in _HERMES.rglob("*.py")
            for key in re.findall(r"""Error\(\s*"(error\.[\w.]+)\"""", path.read_text())}
    # The agents' hermesError(...) and hermesMessage(...)
    used |= {key for path in _HERMES.rglob("*.js")
             for key in re.findall(r"""hermes(?:Error|Message)\(\s*['"`](error\.[\w.]+)""",
                                   path.read_text())}
    assert used and used <= keys, used - keys


def test_unknown_keys_show_as_themselves():
    assert messages.text("error.does_not_exist") == "error.does_not_exist"


def test_agent_errors_are_rendered_in_the_users_language():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import frida

    from hermes.hooks.syntax import checker

    if not checker().available:
        pytest.skip("needs Frida's system session")
    session = frida.attach(0)
    try:
        script = session.create_script(MESSAGES_SOURCE + """
            rpc.exports.fail = () => {
              try {
                throw hermesError('error.gadget.not_present', {path: ptr(0x1234)});
              } catch (e) {
                throw hermesError('error.gadget.load', {error: e.message});
              }
            };
            rpc.exports.plain = () => { throw new Error('plain ⟧ text'); };
        """)
        script.load()
        with pytest.raises(frida.RPCException) as raised:
            script.exports_sync.fail()
        assert messages.describe(raised.value) == (
            "Could not load the Frida gadget into the game: Gadget not present: 0x1234. "
            "Enable automatic Wine/Proton gadget downloads in Settings and select the "
            "process again.")
        messages.use(load_translations("de"))
        assert messages.describe(raised.value) == (
            "Das Frida-Gadget konnte nicht ins Spiel geladen werden: "
            "Gadget nicht vorhanden: 0x1234. Aktiviere automatische Wine-/Proton-Gadget-"
            "Downloads in den Einstellungen und wähle den Prozess erneut aus.")
        with pytest.raises(frida.RPCException) as raised:
            script.exports_sync.plain()
        assert messages.describe(raised.value) == "plain ⟧ text"
        script.unload()
    finally:
        session.detach()


def test_every_trace_agent_has_its_messages():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from hermes.features.native_monitor import NativeMonitorWorker
    from hermes.features.native_trace import NativeTraceWorker
    from hermes.features.trace import AgentWorker, TraceWorker

    english = _catalog("en")
    for worker in (AgentWorker, TraceWorker, NativeTraceWorker, NativeMonitorWorker):
        for message in ("load_timeout", "agent_failed"):
            assert f"error.{worker.agent_key}.{message}" in english
```

```py
"""Calling static methods: reading the arguments typed in, the call dialog."""

import os
import struct

import pytest

from hermes.features.catalog import CatalogMethod
from hermes.features.method_call import (
    BOOLEAN,
    CHAR,
    I4,
    R4,
    R8,
    STRING,
    U1,
    VALUETYPE,
    ArgumentError,
    argument_text,
    can_call,
    parse_argument,
    supported,
)
from hermes.ui.localization import load_translations


GIVE_ITEM = CatalogMethod("Assembly-CSharp", "Scripts", "GiveItem", "(string,int)", "void",
                          True, 0x06000010, "Scripts:GiveItem (string,int)")
UPDATE = CatalogMethod("Assembly-CSharp", "Game.Loop", "Update", "()", "void",
                       False, 0x06000011, "Game.Loop:Update ()")
GIVE_HEALTH = CatalogMethod("/Script/Alabama", "AlabamaCheatManager", "GiveHealth",
                            "(float,int32&)", "void", False, 0x1234,
                            "AlabamaCheatManager:GiveHealth (float,int32&)", "unreal")


def _type(kind, name="T", **extra):
    return {"kind": kind, "byref": False, "name": name, **extra}


@pytest.fixture(name="qt_app", scope="module")
def fixture_qt_app():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    return QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])


@pytest.fixture(name="translations")
def fixture_translations():
    return load_translations("de")


def test_arguments_are_read_by_their_type():
    assert parse_argument(_type(STRING), " Sword ") == " Sword "
    assert parse_argument(_type(I4), " 1_000 ") == 1000
    assert parse_argument(_type(I4), "0x10") == 16
    assert parse_argument(_type(I4), "-5") == -5
    assert parse_argument(_type(R4), "1,5") == 1.5
    assert parse_argument(_type(BOOLEAN), "Ja") is True
    assert parse_argument(_type(CHAR), "x") == "x"
    assert parse_argument(_type(0x12), "null") is None
    assert parse_argument(_type(0x12), "0x7f00") == {"address": "0x7f00"}
    assert parse_argument(_type(I4, enumName="Game.DamageType"), "2") == 2
    attribute = _type(U1, enumName="EPrimaryAttribute",
                      enumValues={"0": "Might", "2": "Dexterity"})
    assert parse_argument(attribute, " dexterity ") == 2
    assert parse_argument(attribute, "0") == 0
    with pytest.raises(ArgumentError):
        parse_argument(attribute, "Charm")


def test_enum_names_are_the_hint_of_an_empty_argument(qt_app, translations):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from hermes.ui.widgets.method_call import MethodCallDialog

    dialog = MethodCallDialog.__new__(MethodCallDialog)  # pylint: disable=no-value-for-parameter
    dialog.translations, dialog._editors = translations, []  # pylint: disable=protected-access
    values = {"0": "Might", "1": "Constitution", "2": "Dexterity", "3": "Perception",
              "4": "Intellect"}
    editor = dialog._editor(_type(U1, "EPrimaryAttribute", enumName="EPrimaryAttribute",
                                  enumValues=values), None)  # pylint: disable=protected-access
    assert editor.placeholderText() == (
        "Might, Constitution, Dexterity, Perception, … oder Zahlenwert")
    assert editor.toolTip().splitlines()[2] == "2 = Dexterity"


def test_unreal_types_are_typed_in_as_text_and_bools():
    fstring = _type(0, "FString", engine="string")
    fname = _type(0, "FName", engine="name")
    flag = _type(0, "bool", engine="bool")
    assert all(supported(param_type) for param_type in (fstring, fname, flag))
    assert parse_argument(fstring, " Bob ") == " Bob "
    assert parse_argument(fname, "Sword_3") == "Sword_3"
    assert parse_argument(flag, "wahr") is True
    # Containers, FText and delegates cannot be typed in.
    for engine in ("array", "map", "set", "text", "weak", "interface", "other"):
        assert not supported(_type(0, "TArray<int32>", engine=engine))


def _vector(kind=R8):
    return _type(VALUETYPE, "FVector", structSize=24, fields=[
        {"name": name, "kind": kind, "offset": 8 * i} for i, name in enumerate("XYZ")])


def test_structs_of_numbers_are_typed_in_by_their_fields():
    vector = _vector()
    assert supported(vector)
    in_order = parse_argument(vector, "1, 2,5 -3")
    assert in_order["struct"] == struct.pack("<ddd", 1, 2.5, -3).hex()
    assert argument_text(in_order) == "{X=1.0, Y=2.5, Z=-3.0}"
    # By name, in any case and order; the fields not named are 0
    named = parse_argument(vector, "z = 3; x=1")
    assert named["struct"] == struct.pack("<ddd", 1, 0, 3).hex()
    # Integers and enum names, at their offsets in a larger struct
    point = _type(VALUETYPE, "FIntPoint", structSize=12, fields=[
        {"name": "X", "kind": I4, "offset": 0},
        {"name": "Kind", "kind": U1, "offset": 8, "enumValues": {"2": "Dexterity"}}])
    assert parse_argument(point, "-1 dexterity")["struct"] == "ffffffff0000000002000000"
    # Without its fields (a struct of structs, Mono's Vector3 unread) it is not supported.
    assert not supported(_type(VALUETYPE, "FTransform", structSize=96))


@pytest.mark.parametrize("text, key", [
    ("1 2", "call.error_struct_count"),
    ("X=1 2", "call.error_struct_mixed"),
    ("W=1", "call.error_struct_field"),
    ("1 zwei 3", "call.error_number"),
])
def test_wrong_struct_values_say_why(text, key, translations):
    with pytest.raises(ArgumentError) as raised:
        parse_argument(_vector(), text)
    assert raised.value.key == key
    assert translations[key].format(**raised.value.values)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("param_type, text, key", [
    (_type(I4), "viel", "call.error_integer"),
    (_type(U1), "256", "call.error_range"),
    (_type(I4), "2147483648", "call.error_range"),
    (_type(R4), "nan", "call.error_number"),
    (_type(BOOLEAN), "vielleicht", "call.error_bool"),
    (_type(CHAR), "ab", "call.error_char"),
    (_type(0x12), "Schwert", "call.error_address"),
    (_type(VALUETYPE, "UnityEngine.Vector3"), "1,2,3", "call.error_struct"),
])
def test_wrong_arguments_say_why(param_type, text, key, translations):
    with pytest.raises(ArgumentError) as raised:
        parse_argument(param_type, text)
    assert raised.value.key == key
    assert translations[key].format(**raised.value.values)


def test_guids_are_passed_in_the_byte_order_of_dotnet():
    guid = _type(VALUETYPE, "System.Guid")
    value = parse_argument(guid, " {29EA711E-B1E9-47D6-BEDA-C89DCE74B62C} ")
    # Data1 (int), Data2 and Data3 (short) little-endian, the last 8 bytes as they are
    assert value == {"struct": "1e71ea29e9b1d647bedac89dce74b62c",
                     "guid": "29ea711e-b1e9-47d6-beda-c89dce74b62c"}
    assert argument_text(value) == "29ea711e-b1e9-47d6-beda-c89dce74b62c"
    with pytest.raises(ArgumentError) as raised:
        parse_argument(guid, "pollaxe_exceptional")
    assert raised.value.key == "call.error_guid"


def test_arguments_are_logged_as_written_in_code():
    assert [argument_text(value) for value in ("Sword", 3, True, None, {"address": "0x10"})] \
        == ['"Sword"', "3", "true", "null", "0x10"]


class _FakeWorker:
    """Stands in for MethodMonitorWorker: records the requests; the test answers."""

    def __init__(self, _pid):
        # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
        from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

        class Signals(QObject):  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
            call_described = Signal(int, object)
            called = Signal(int, object)
            call_failed = Signal(int, str)
            worker_failed = Signal(str)
            inspected = Signal(int, object)
            inspect_failed = Signal(int, str)
            evaluated = Signal(int, object)
            evaluate_failed = Signal(int, str)
            methods_listed = Signal(int, object)
            methods_failed = Signal(int, str)
            text_fetched = Signal(int, object)
            text_failed = Signal(int, str)

        self.signals = Signals()
        self.call_described = self.signals.call_described
        self.called = self.signals.called
        self.call_failed = self.signals.call_failed
        self.worker_failed = self.signals.worker_failed
        self.inspected = self.signals.inspected
        self.inspect_failed = self.signals.inspect_failed
        self.evaluated = self.signals.evaluated
        self.evaluate_failed = self.signals.evaluate_failed
        self.methods_listed = self.signals.methods_listed
        self.methods_failed = self.signals.methods_failed
        self.text_fetched = self.signals.text_fetched
        self.text_failed = self.signals.text_failed
        self.requests = []

    def start(self):
        pass

    def describe_call(self, identity, instance=False):
        self.requests.append(("describe", identity, instance) if instance
                             else ("describe", identity))
        return len(self.requests)

    def call_found(self, identity, class_name, object_text, arguments):
        self.requests.append(("call_found", identity, class_name, object_text, arguments))
        return len(self.requests)

    def call(self, identity, arguments):
        self.requests.append(("call", identity, arguments))
        return len(self.requests)

    def inspect(self, target):
        self.requests.append(("inspect", target))
        return len(self.requests)

    def evaluate(self, target, names):
        self.requests.append(("evaluate", target, names))
        return len(self.requests)

    def list_methods(self, target):
        self.requests.append(("methods", target))
        return len(self.requests)

    def describe_method(self, method):
        self.requests.append(("describe_method", method))
        return len(self.requests)

    def call_on(self, target, method, arguments):
        self.requests.append(("call_on", target, method, arguments))
        return len(self.requests)

    def requestInterruption(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        pass

    def isRunning(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return False


def test_call_dialog_reads_arguments_and_logs_results(qt_app, translations, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from hermes.ui.widgets import method_call

    monkeypatch.setattr(method_call, "MethodMonitorWorker", _FakeWorker)
    monkeypatch.setattr(method_call, "_last_arguments", {})
    dialog = method_call.MethodCallDialog(translations, 1234)
    worker = dialog._worker
    dialog.set_method(GIVE_ITEM)
    assert worker.requests == [("describe", GIVE_ITEM.identity())]
    assert not dialog.call_button.isEnabled()
    worker.call_described.emit(1, {"params": [
        {"name": "itemName", "type": _type(STRING, "System.String")},
        {"name": "count", "type": _type(I4, "System.Int32")}],
        "returns": _type(0x01, "System.Void")})
    assert dialog.form.rowCount() == 2 and dialog.call_button.isEnabled()

    name, count = dialog._editors
    name.setText("Sword")
    count.setText("drei")
    dialog.call_button.click()
    assert len(worker.requests) == 1
    assert dialog.status_label.text() == "count: „drei“ ist keine Ganzzahl"

    count.setText("3")
    count.returnPressed.emit()
    assert worker.requests[1] == ("call", GIVE_ITEM.identity(), ["Sword", 3])
    assert not dialog.call_button.isEnabled()  # until the game answered
    worker.called.emit(2, {"result": None})
    assert dialog.log.toPlainText().endswith('Scripts:GiveItem("Sword", 3)  → (void)')
    assert dialog.call_button.isEnabled()

    dialog.call_button.click()
    worker.called.emit(3, {"exception": "System.NullReferenceException"})
    assert dialog.log.toPlainText().endswith("⚠ System.NullReferenceException")

    # The arguments are kept for the next time the method is shown.
    dialog.set_method(GIVE_ITEM)
    worker.call_described.emit(4, {"params": [
        {"name": "itemName", "type": _type(STRING)}, {"name": "count", "type": _type(I4)}],
        "returns": _type(0x01)})
    assert [editor.text() for editor in dialog._editors] == ["Sword", "3"]

    # A struct cannot be typed in.
    dialog.set_method(GIVE_ITEM)
    worker.call_described.emit(5, {"params": [
        {"name": "position", "type": _type(VALUETYPE, "UnityEngine.Vector3")}],
        "returns": _type(0x01)})
    assert not dialog.call_button.isEnabled()
    dialog.close()


def test_unreal_instance_functions_run_on_a_found_object(qt_app, translations, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QCheckBox  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.ui.widgets import method_call

    monkeypatch.setattr(method_call, "MethodMonitorWorker", _FakeWorker)
    monkeypatch.setattr(method_call, "_last_arguments", {})
    assert can_call(GIVE_HEALTH) and not can_call(UPDATE)  # Mono finds no objects for it
    dialog = method_call.MethodCallDialog(translations, 1234)
    worker = dialog._worker
    dialog.set_method(GIVE_HEALTH)
    assert worker.requests == [("describe", GIVE_HEALTH.identity(), True)]
    assert "AlabamaCheatManager" in dialog.hint_label.text()
    # An object field first, then the inputs; an output gets none.
    worker.call_described.emit(1, {"params": [
        {"name": "Amount", "type": _type(R4, "float")},
        {"name": "bQuiet", "type": _type(0, "bool", engine="bool")},
        {"name": "Healed", "type": _type(I4, "int32", byref=True), "out": True}],
        "returns": _type(0x01, "void")})
    assert dialog.form.rowCount() == 4
    assert "AlabamaCheatManager" in dialog.object_edit.placeholderText()
    amount, quiet = dialog._editors
    assert isinstance(quiet, QCheckBox)
    assert dialog.call_button.isEnabled()
    amount.setText("50")
    quiet.setChecked(True)
    dialog.call_button.click()
    assert worker.requests[1] == ("call_found", GIVE_HEALTH.identity(), "AlabamaCheatManager",
                                  "", [50.0, True, None])
    worker.called.emit(2, {"result": None, "outputs": [
        {"name": "Healed", "value": {"text": "35"}}], "object": {
            "text": 'UBP_CheatManager_C "BP_CheatManager_C_0"@0x7f00'}})
    assert dialog.log.toPlainText().endswith(
        'AlabamaCheatManager:GiveHealth(50.0, true) auf UBP_CheatManager_C '
        '"BP_CheatManager_C_0"@0x7f00  → (void); Healed = 35')

    # The object typed in goes with the call, and is kept with the arguments.
    dialog.object_edit.setText("BP_CheatManager_C_1")
    dialog.call_button.click()
    assert worker.requests[2][3] == "BP_CheatManager_C_1"
    dialog.set_method(GIVE_HEALTH)
    worker.call_described.emit(4, {"params": [
        {"name": "Amount", "type": _type(R4, "float")},
        {"name": "bQuiet", "type": _type(0, "bool", engine="bool")},
        {"name": "Healed", "type": _type(I4, "int32", byref=True), "out": True}],
        "returns": _type(0x01, "void")})
    assert dialog.object_edit.text() == "BP_CheatManager_C_1"
    assert dialog._editors[0].text() == "50" and dialog._editors[1].isChecked()

    # A TArray cannot be typed in; a struct of numbers can.
    dialog.set_method(GIVE_HEALTH)
    worker.call_described.emit(5, {"params": [
        {"name": "Items", "type": _type(0, "TArray<int32>", engine="array")}],
        "returns": _type(0x01, "void")})
    assert not dialog.call_button.isEnabled()
    dialog.set_method(GIVE_HEALTH)
    worker.call_described.emit(6, {"params": [{"name": "Where", "type": _vector()}],
                                   "returns": _type(0x01, "void")})
    assert dialog.call_button.isEnabled()
    assert dialog._editors[0].placeholderText().startswith("X Y Z, z. B. 1 2 3 oder X=1; Y=2")
    dialog.close()


def test_only_static_methods_can_be_called(qt_app, translations, tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from sqlalchemy import create_engine
    from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

    from hermes.db import models  # noqa: F401  pylint: disable=unused-import
    from hermes.db.base import Base
    from hermes.db.repository.favorites import FavoriteRepository
    from hermes.db.repository.hooks import HookRepository
    from hermes.ui.widgets.favorites import FavoritesDialog, FavoriteStore

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'hermes.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    store = FavoriteStore(FavoriteRepository(sessions))
    store.set_process(HookRepository(sessions).get_or_create_process("game", "/opt/game"))
    store.toggle(GIVE_ITEM, "catalog")
    store.toggle(UPDATE, "catalog")
    dialog = FavoritesDialog(translations, store)
    requested = []
    dialog.call_requested.connect(requested.append)

    dialog.table.selectRow(0)
    assert not dialog.call_button.isEnabled()  # the game does not run
    dialog.set_attached(True)
    assert dialog.call_button.isEnabled()
    dialog.call_button.click()
    assert requested == [GIVE_ITEM]
    dialog.table.selectRow(1)  # an instance method
    assert not dialog.call_button.isEnabled()
    dialog.table.selectAll()
    assert not dialog.call_button.isEnabled()
    dialog.close()
    engine.dispose()


def test_an_object_a_call_returns_opens_in_the_inspector(qt_app, translations, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from PySide6.QtCore import QUrl  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.ui.widgets import method_call

    monkeypatch.setattr(method_call, "MethodMonitorWorker", _FakeWorker)
    monkeypatch.setattr(method_call, "_last_arguments", {})
    dialog = method_call.MethodCallDialog(translations, 1234)
    worker = dialog._worker
    player = CatalogMethod("Assembly-CSharp", "GameState", "get_PlayerCharacter", "()",
                           "Player", True, 0x06001db7,
                           "GameState:get_PlayerCharacter ()")
    try:
        dialog.set_method(player)
        worker.call_described.emit(1, {"params": [], "returns": _type(0x12, "Player")})
        dialog.call_button.click()
        target = {"address": "0x7f4a1e16e930", "klass": "0x55aa"}
        worker.called.emit(2, {"result": {
            "text": 'Player "Player_New_Game(Clone)_1"@0x7f4a1e16e930', "target": target}})
        assert "Inspizieren" in dialog.log.toPlainText()
        [inspector] = dialog.inspections.inspectors
        assert inspector.target == target and worker.requests[-1] == ("inspect", target)
        worker.inspected.emit(3, {"name": "Player", "fields": [
            {"name": "Health", "type": "int", "offset": 16, "static": False,
             "value": {"text": "100"}}]})

        # The log's link opens it again, also after the first inspector closed.
        inspector.close()
        dialog.log.anchorClicked.emit(QUrl("inspect:0"))
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("inspect", target)
        assert len([shown for shown in dialog.inspections.inspectors if shown.isVisible()]) == 1

        # No object, no inspector.
        opened = len(dialog.inspections.inspectors)
        dialog.call_button.click()
        worker.called.emit(5, {"result": {"text": "42"}})
        assert len(dialog.inspections.inspectors) == opened
        assert dialog.log.toPlainText().splitlines()[-1].endswith("→ 42")
    finally:
        for shown in list(dialog.inspections.inspectors):
            shown.close()
        dialog.close()


def test_the_inspector_sets_properties_and_calls_methods(qt_app, translations, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QWidget  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.ui import window_state
    from hermes.ui.widgets import method_call
    from hermes.ui.widgets.inspection import Inspections

    monkeypatch.setattr(method_call, "_last_arguments", {})
    window = QWidget()
    worker = _FakeWorker(1234)
    inspections = Inspections(translations, worker, window)
    target = {"address": "0x7f4a1e16e930"}
    contents = {"name": "Game.Player", "address": target["address"], "fields": [], "properties": [
        {"name": "Health", "type": "System.Int32", "static": False, "setter": "0x5001"},
        {"name": "IsDead", "type": "System.Boolean", "static": False, "setter": None}]}
    inspections.inspect(target, name="player")
    [inspector] = inspections.inspectors
    try:
        assert worker.requests == [("inspect", target)]
        worker.inspected.emit(1, contents)
        # Only a property with a setter can be set.
        assert inspector.properties_table.cellWidget(0, 4) is not None
        assert inspector.properties_table.cellWidget(1, 4) is None

        # The getters fold away, and stay so; the methods are folded until
        # opened, then listed once.
        assert inspector.properties_section.is_open and not inspector.methods_section.is_open
        inspector.properties_section.fold_button.click()
        assert inspector.properties_table.isHidden()
        assert window_state.settings().value("inspector/getters_open", type=bool) is False
        inspector.methods_section.fold_button.click()
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("methods", target)
        worker.methods_listed.emit(2, [
            {"name": "Heal", "method": "0x6001", "owner": "Game.Player",
             "params": "System.Int32 amount", "returns": "System.Void"},
            {"name": "HealAll", "method": "0x6003", "owner": "Game.Player",
             "params": "", "returns": "System.Void"},
            {"name": "Destroy", "method": "0x6002", "owner": "UnityEngine.Object",
             "params": "", "returns": "System.Void"}])

        def shown():
            return [inspector.methods_table.item(row, 0).text()
                    for row in range(inspector.methods_table.rowCount())
                    if not inspector.methods_table.isRowHidden(row)]

        # The own class's methods, base classes on request; a search narrows them.
        assert shown() == ["Heal", "HealAll"]
        inspector.base_classes_check.setChecked(True)
        assert shown() == ["Heal", "HealAll", "Destroy"]
        inspector.method_filter.setText("all")
        assert shown() == ["HealAll"]

        # A method is called on the object, through the same worker; then
        # the fields are read again.
        inspector.methods_table.cellWidget(0, 4).linkActivated.emit("#")
        dialog = inspector.findChild(method_call.MethodCallDialog)
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("describe_method", "0x6001")
        assert "Game.Player:Heal (System.Int32 amount)" in dialog.signature_label.text()
        worker.call_described.emit(3, {"params": [
            {"name": "amount", "type": _type(I4, "System.Int32")}], "returns": _type(0x01)})
        dialog._editors[0].setText("25")
        dialog.call_button.click()
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("call_on", target, "0x6001", [25])
        worker.called.emit(4, {"result": None})
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("inspect", target)
        worker.inspected.emit(5, contents)

        # Setting a property calls its setter, then shows the new value.
        inspector.properties_table.cellWidget(0, 4).linkActivated.emit("#")
        assert inspector.findChild(method_call.MethodCallDialog) is dialog
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("describe_method", "0x5001")
        worker.call_described.emit(6, {"params": [
            {"name": "value", "type": _type(I4, "System.Int32")}], "returns": _type(0x01)})
        dialog._editors[0].setText("80")
        dialog.call_button.click()
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("call_on", target, "0x5001", [80])
        worker.called.emit(7, {"result": None})
        assert worker.requests[-2:] == [("inspect", target), ("evaluate", target, ["Health"])]
    finally:
        inspector.close()
        window.deleteLater()
```

`tests/test_mono.py`:

```py
"""C# methods of Mono JIT code, against a stand-in Mono runtime.

The target links ``libmonosgen-2.0.so``, which exports the part of Mono's
embedding API the agents use and contains a tiny "JIT": it emits two C#
methods into anonymous memory when the game first calls them or when
``mono_compile_method`` asks for them. ``FAKE_JIT_CONSTANT`` chooses how the
JIT encodes a constant before the gold write (``long``: movabs, 10 bytes;
``short``: mov, 5 bytes), so the write moves within its method between runs
like it can in real JIT code. ``FAKE_JIT_UPDATED`` gives the methods another
signature, as if the game had been updated.
"""

import os
import subprocess
import time

from hermes.core.pointer import PointerChain
from hermes.hooks.transforms import MultiplyTransform
from hermes.hooks.engine import HookSpec

from tests.test_hooks import (  # pylint: disable=unused-import
    _Target,
    _wait_for,
    _watch_hits,
    fixture_qt_app,
    fixture_translations,
    requires_target,
)


_FAKE_MONO_SOURCE = r"""

typedef struct Class Class;
typedef struct { const char *name; int kind; int byref; Class *klass; } Type;
typedef struct { const char *name; const char *file; const char *guid; } Image;
typedef struct { const char *name; Type *type; uint32_t offset; uint32_t flags; } Field;
struct Class {
    Type type;
    Image *image;
    int is_enum;
    Type *base;
    int is_valuetype;
    Class *parent;
    int field_count;
    Field fields[6];
    int rank;
    Class *element;
    int element_size;
    uint32_t type_flags;
    int instance;  /* a generic class bound to type arguments: no typedef row */
};
/* Like Mono: an object starts with its vtable, the vtable with its class. */
typedef struct { Class *klass; } VTable;
typedef struct { VTable *vtable; void *sync; } Object;

typedef struct {
    const char *name;
    const char *signature;
    uint32_t token;
    Class *klass;
    const char *short_name;
    uint32_t flags;
    Type *returns;
    int param_count;
    Type *params[8];
    const char *param_names[8];
    void *native;  /* "compiled" ahead: a C function */
    uint8_t *code;
    size_t size;
    const uint8_t *il;
    uint32_t il_size;
    int open;  /* of a generic class's definition: Mono cannot compile it */
} Method;

#define ADD_GOLD 0x06000001u
#define TAKE 0x06000002u
#define ROLL_DAMAGE 0x06000004u

#define SET_VALUE 0x0600000eu
#define STATIC 0x10u

/* Assembly-CSharp: Game.Inventory, Game.Loot, Game.Combat (a Unity
   component), the enum Game.DamageType, Game.DamageInfo and Game.Loop;
   mscorlib: System.Object, System.Int32, System.Int32[],
   UnityEngine.Component[] and System.InvalidOperationException;
   UnityEngine.CoreModule: UnityEngine.Object, .Component and .GameObject;
   R3.ReactiveProperty`1 (in Assembly-CSharp) and its instance for int. */
static Image game = { "Assembly-CSharp", "/game/Assembly-CSharp.dll",
                      "6F9619FF-8B86-D011-B42D-00C04FC964FF" };
static Image corlib = { "mscorlib", "/game/mscorlib.dll",
                        "0B5A6C1E-3F2D-4E7A-9C8B-1D2E3F4A5B6C" };
static Image unity = { "UnityEngine.CoreModule", "/game/UnityEngine.CoreModule.dll", NULL };
static Class classes[17];
static Type t_void = { "System.Void", 0x01 }, t_int = { "System.Int32", 0x08 },
    t_int_ref = { "System.Int32&", 0x08, 1 }, t_float = { "System.Single", 0x0c },
    t_string = { "System.String", 0x0e }, t_bool = { "System.Boolean", 0x02 },
    t_damage = { "Game.DamageType", 0x11, 0, &classes[4] },
    t_combat = { "Game.Combat", 0x12, 0, &classes[3] },
    t_info_ref = { "Game.DamageInfo&", 0x12, 1, &classes[6] },
    t_ints = { "System.Int32[]", 0x1d, 0, &classes[7] },
    t_intptr = { "System.IntPtr", 0x18 },
    t_game_object = { "UnityEngine.GameObject", 0x12, 0, &classes[10] },
    t_type = { "System.Type", 0x12 };
static Type *type_params[] = { &t_type };
static Class classes[17] = {
    { .type = { "Game.Inventory", 0x12 }, .image = &game },
    { .type = { "Game.Loot", 0x12 }, .image = &game },
    { .type = { "System.Object", 0x1c }, .image = &corlib },
    { .type = { "Game.Combat", 0x12 }, .image = &game, .parent = &classes[9],
      .field_count = 2,
      .fields = { { "Health", &t_int, 0x20 }, { "Instances", &t_int, 0, 0x10 } } },
    { .type = { "Game.DamageType", 0x11 }, .image = &game, .is_enum = 1, .base = &t_int,

      .field_count = 5,

                  { "Name", &t_string, 0x18 }, { "Owner", &t_combat, 0x20 },

    { .type = { "System.Int32[]", 0x1d }, .image = &corlib, .parent = &classes[2],

      .parent = &classes[2], .field_count = 1, .fields = { { "_message", &t_string, 0x10 } } },
    { .type = { "Game.Loop", 0x12 }, .image = &game, .parent = &classes[2] },
    /* [ComImport]: Mono hangs on Linux compiling code that uses it */
    { .type = { "UnityEngine.KnownFolders", 0x12 }, .image = &unity, .parent = &classes[2],
      .type_flags = 0x1000 },
    { .type = { "R3.ReactiveProperty<T>", 0x12 }, .image = &game, .parent = &classes[2] },
    { .type = { "R3.ReactiveProperty<int>", 0x15, 0, &classes[16] }, .image = &game,
      .parent = &classes[2], .instance = 1 },

static VTable vt_combat = { &classes[3] }, vt_info = { &classes[6] }, vt_ints = { &classes[7] },
    vt_game_object = { &classes[10] }, vt_components = { &classes[11] },
    vt_exception = { &classes[12] };
/* Unity objects: the name lives on Unity's native side, in no field. */
typedef struct GameObject GameObject;
typedef struct { Object header; void *cached_ptr; const char *name; int32_t health;
                 GameObject *game_object; } Combat;
struct GameObject { Object header; void *cached_ptr; const char *name; Combat *component; };
typedef struct { Object header; void *bounds; uintptr_t length; void *data[1]; } ComponentArray;
typedef struct { Object header; void *message; } Exception;
static int type_object_component, type_object_combat, type_object_game_object,
    type_object_other;
/* Every Combat and GameObject the game made, for FindObjectsOfType */
static Combat *live_combats[64];
static GameObject *live_game_objects[64];
static int live_count;
typedef struct { Object header; void *bounds; uintptr_t length; void *data[64]; } ObjectArray;
typedef struct { Object header; float damage; int32_t type; void *name; Combat *owner;
                 void *rolls; } DamageInfo;
typedef struct { Object header; void *bounds; uintptr_t length; int32_t data[3]; } IntArray;
void *fake_string(const char *ascii);

/* Methods mono_runtime_invoke calls: (this, params, exception) */
typedef void *(*invoke_fn)(void *self, void **params, void **exception);

static void *box_int(int32_t value) {
    uint8_t *box = calloc(1, sizeof(Object) + 8);  /* boxed value types: header, value */
    memcpy(box + sizeof(Object), &value, 4);
    return box;
}

/* string UnityEngine.Object.get_name(); Combat and GameObject keep the
   name at the same place */
static void *unity_get_name(Combat *self, void **params, void **exception) {
    (void)params; (void)exception;
    return fake_string(self->name);
}
/* GameObject UnityEngine.Component.get_gameObject() */
static void *component_get_game_object(Combat *self, void **params, void **exception) {
    (void)params; (void)exception;
    return self->game_object;
}
/* Component[] UnityEngine.GameObject.GetComponents(Type type) */
static void *game_object_get_components(GameObject *self, void **params, void **exception) {
    (void)exception;
    ComponentArray *array = calloc(1, sizeof *array);
    array->header.vtable = &vt_components;
    if (params[0] == &type_object_component) {
        array->length = 1;
        array->data[0] = self->component;
    }
    return array;
}
/* static Object[] UnityEngine.Object.FindObjectsOfType(Type type) */
static void *object_find_objects_of_type(void *self, void **params, void **exception) {
    (void)self; (void)exception;
    ObjectArray *array = calloc(1, sizeof *array);
    array->header.vtable = &vt_components;
    for (int i = 0; i < live_count; i++) {
        if (params[0] == &type_object_combat)
            array->data[array->length++] = live_combats[i];
        else if (params[0] == &type_object_game_object)
            array->data[array->length++] = live_game_objects[i];
    }
    return array;
}
/* bool Game.Combat.IsPartyMember { get; } */
static void *combat_is_party_member(Combat *self, void **params, void **exception) {
    (void)params; (void)exception;
    return box_int(strcmp(self->name, "Miranda") == 0);
}
/* int Game.Combat.Broken { get; } throws */
static void *combat_broken(Combat *self, void **params, void **exception) {
    (void)self; (void)params;
    Exception *error = calloc(1, sizeof *error);
    error->header.vtable = &vt_exception;
    error->message = fake_string("broken getter");
    *exception = error;
    return NULL;
}
/* static int Game.Combat.Count { get; } */
static void *combat_count(void *self, void **params, void **exception) {
    (void)self; (void)params; (void)exception;
    return box_int(7);
}
/* static void Game.Loop.Update(): what Unity runs every frame */
static void *loop_update(void *self, void **params, void **exception) {
    (void)self; (void)params; (void)exception;
    return NULL;
}

/* void CalcDamage(Combat other, out DamageInfo info), an instance method */
__attribute__((noipa)) void calc_damage(Combat *self, Combat *other, DamageInfo **info) {
    (void)other;
    DamageInfo *result = calloc(1, sizeof *result);
    IntArray *rolls = calloc(1, sizeof *rolls);
    rolls->header.vtable = &vt_ints;
    rolls->length = 3;
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++)
        rolls->data[i] = 3 + i;
    result->header.vtable = &vt_info;
    result->damage = 12.5f;
    result->type = 2;
    result->name = fake_string("Slash");
    result->owner = self;
    result->rolls = rolls;
    *info = result;
}

/* float RollDamage(int min, float scale, string name, bool crit,
                    DamageType type, out int roll), an instance method */
__attribute__((noipa)) float roll_damage(Object *self, int32_t min, float scale, void *name,
                                         int32_t crit, int32_t type, int32_t *roll) {
    (void)self; (void)name; (void)type;
    *roll = 42;
    return crit ? min * scale * 2 : min * scale;
}

/* void R3.ReactiveProperty<int>.set_Value(int value) */
static int32_t reactive_value;
__attribute__((noipa)) void reactive_set_value(void *self, int32_t value) {
    (void)self;
    reactive_value = value;
}

/* IL: get_Broken creates a COM object (newobj KnownFolders::.ctor), Update
   only does harmless things (a switch, ldstr, call AddGold) */
static const uint8_t broken_il[] = { 0x73, 0x0d, 0x00, 0x00, 0x06, 0x26, 0x16, 0x2a };
static const uint8_t update_il[] = {
    0x16, 0x45, 0x02, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00, 0x00,
    0x72, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x70, 0x26, 0x28, 0x01, 0x00, 0x00, 0x06, 0x2a };
/* IL code for the call graph: Loot.Take calls Inventory.AddGold (ldarg.0;

static const uint8_t add_gold_il[] = { 0x2a };
static Method methods[] = {
    { "Game.Inventory:AddGold", "Game.Inventory:AddGold (int&,int)", ADD_GOLD,
      &classes[0], "AddGold", STATIC, &t_void, 2, { &t_int_ref, &t_int }, { "gold", "amount" },
      .il = add_gold_il, .il_size = sizeof add_gold_il },
    { "Game.Loot:Take", "Game.Loot:Take (int&,int)", TAKE,
      &classes[1], "Take", STATIC, &t_void, 2, { &t_int_ref, &t_int }, { "gold", "amount" },
      .il = take_il, .il_size = sizeof take_il },
    { "System.Object:ToString", "System.Object:ToString ()", 0x06000003u,
      &classes[2], "ToString", 0, &t_string },
    { "Game.Combat:RollDamage",
      "Game.Combat:RollDamage (int,single,string,bool,Game.DamageType,int&)", ROLL_DAMAGE,
      &classes[3], "RollDamage", 0, &t_float, 6,
      { &t_int, &t_float, &t_string, &t_bool, &t_damage, &t_int_ref },
      { "min", "scale", "name", "crit", "type", "roll" }, (void *)roll_damage },
    { "Game.Combat:CalcDamage", "Game.Combat:CalcDamage (Game.Combat,Game.DamageInfo&)",
      CALC_DAMAGE, &classes[3], "CalcDamage", 0, &t_void, 2, { &t_combat, &t_info_ref },
      { "other", "info" }, (void *)calc_damage },
    { "UnityEngine.Object:get_name", "UnityEngine.Object:get_name ()", 0x06000006u,
      &classes[8], "get_name", 0, &t_string, 0, { 0 }, { 0 }, (void *)unity_get_name },
    { "Game.Combat:get_IsPartyMember", "Game.Combat:get_IsPartyMember ()", 0x06000007u,

    { "UnityEngine.KnownFolders:.ctor", "UnityEngine.KnownFolders:.ctor ()", 0x0600000du,
      &classes[14], ".ctor", 0, &t_void },
    /* The token finds the definition; only the instance has code. */
    { "R3.ReactiveProperty`1:set_Value", "R3.ReactiveProperty`1:set_Value (T)", SET_VALUE,
      &classes[15], "set_Value", 0, &t_void, 1, { &t_int }, { "value" }, .open = 1 },
    { "R3.ReactiveProperty`1<int>:set_Value", "R3.ReactiveProperty`1<int>:set_Value (int)",
      SET_VALUE, &classes[16], "set_Value", 0, &t_void, 1, { &t_int }, { "value" },
      (void *)reactive_set_value },
    { "UnityEngine.Object:FindObjectsOfType",
      "UnityEngine.Object:FindObjectsOfType (System.Type)", 0x0600000fu, &classes[8],
      "FindObjectsOfType", STATIC, &t_void, 1, { &t_type }, { "type" },
      (void *)object_find_objects_of_type },
};
#define COUNT(array) (sizeof array / sizeof *array)
static int root_domain, script_domain, thread;
static __thread void *current_domain;
static uint8_t *region;
static size_t used;

static Method *by_token(uint32_t token) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof methods / sizeof *methods; i++)
        if (methods[i].token == token)
            return &methods[i];
    return NULL;
}

static uint8_t *compile(Method *m) {
    if (m->open)
        return NULL;
    if (m->code)
        return m->code;
    if (m->native) {
        m->code = m->native;
        m->size = 16;
        return m->code;
    }
    if (!region) {
        region = mmap(NULL, 0x1000, PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC,
                      MAP_PRIVATE | MAP_ANONYMOUS, -1, 0);
        memset(region, 0xcc, 0x1000);
    }
    uint8_t *code = region + used;
    size_t n = 0;
    code[n++] = 0x55; code[n++] = 0x48; code[n++] = 0x89; code[n++] = 0xe5;
    if (m->token == ADD_GOLD) {
        const char *variant = getenv("FAKE_JIT_CONSTANT");
        if (variant && strcmp(variant, "short") == 0) {
            code[n++] = 0xb8;                               /* mov eax, imm32 */
            n += 4;
        } else {
            code[n++] = 0x48; code[n++] = 0xb8;             /* movabs rax, imm64 */
            n += 8;
        }
        code[n++] = 0x01; code[n++] = 0x37;                 /* add [rdi], esi */
        for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++)
            code[n++] = 0x90;
    } else {
        uint8_t *add = compile(by_token(ADD_GOLD));
        code[n++] = 0x48; code[n++] = 0xb8;                 /* movabs rax, add */
        memcpy(code + n, &add, 8); n += 8;
        code[n++] = 0xff; code[n++] = 0xd0;                 /* call rax */
    }
    code[n++] = 0x5d; code[n++] = 0xc3;
    m->code = code;
    m->size = n;
    used += (n + 0x3f) & ~(size_t)0x3f;
    return code;
}

__attribute__((constructor)) static void init(void) {
    if (getenv("FAKE_JIT_UPDATED"))
        for (size_t i = 0; i < sizeof methods / sizeof *methods; i++)
            methods[i].signature = "Game.Changed:Method ()";
}

/* Like Mono releasing its JIT code while the game exits */
void fake_unmap(void) { munmap(region, 0x1000); }

/* The game's side: its thread runs scripts in the child domain; it is
   Unity's main thread, the only one where get_name works. */
static pthread_t main_thread;
static int exception_object;
void fake_attach(void) {
    current_domain = &script_domain;
    main_thread = pthread_self();
}
void *mono_class_get_method_from_name(Class *k, const char *name, int count) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < COUNT(methods); i++)
        if (methods[i].klass == k && strcmp(methods[i].short_name, name) == 0
            && methods[i].param_count == count)
            return &methods[i];
    return NULL;
}
void *mono_runtime_invoke(Method *m, void *object, void **params, void **exception) {
    if (!pthread_equal(pthread_self(), main_thread)) {
        *exception = &exception_object;  /* UnityException: main thread only */
        return NULL;
    }
    return ((invoke_fn)m->native)(object, params, exception);
}
void *mono_object_get_virtual_method(void *object, Method *m) { (void)object; return m; }

/* The game's main loop runs a script method (Unity: every frame) */
void fake_tick(void) {
    void *exception = NULL;

void *fake_code(uint32_t token) { return compile(by_token(token)); }
/* The game sets a ReactiveProperty<int> */

            ((void (*)(void *, int32_t))compile(&methods[i]))(NULL, value);
}

void *mono_compile_method(void *m) {
    /* Mono only compiles for threads it knows, in the scripts' domain. */
    if (current_domain != &script_domain)
        return NULL;
    if (getenv("FAKE_JIT_SLOW"))
        usleep(atoi(getenv("FAKE_JIT_SLOW")) * 1000);  /* milliseconds */
    return compile(m);
}

void *mono_jit_info_table_find(void *domain, void *address) {
    if (domain != &script_domain)
        return NULL;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < COUNT(methods); i++)
        if (methods[i].code && (uint8_t *)address >= methods[i].code
            && (uint8_t *)address < methods[i].code + methods[i].size)
            return &methods[i];
    return NULL;
}
```
