```py
@requires_target
def test_pointer_dialog_stays_open_while_scanning(binary, qt_app, sessions, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    from hermes.db.repository.addresses import AddressRepository
    from hermes.db.repository.hooks import HookRepository
    from hermes.ui import main_window

    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "HookRepository", lambda: HookRepository(sessions))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "AddressRepository", lambda: AddressRepository(sessions))
    window = main_window.MainWindow("de")
    target = _Target(binary)
    try:
        window._current_pid = target.pid
        window._process_id = HookRepository(sessions).get_or_create_process("target", "t")
        window._refresh_timer.stop()
        window._add_tracked_address({"address": hex(target.gold), "address_value": target.gold,
                                     "type": "int32", "value": "1234"})
        window._open_pointer_scan(0)
        entry_id = window._address_meta(0)["id"]
        dialog = window._pointer_dialogs[entry_id]
        assert not dialog.isModal() and dialog.isVisible()

        # The scanner can be used meanwhile; its selection fills the address.
        dialog.take_scan_address()
        assert "zuerst ein Ergebnis" in dialog.status_label.text()
        moved = target.new_level(10)
        window._on_scan_results([{"address": moved, "type": "int32", "value": 1234}])
        window.result_table.selectRow(0)
        dialog.take_scan_address()
        assert dialog.address_input.text() == f"0x{moved:X}"

        window._open_pointer_scan(0)
        assert window._pointer_dialogs[entry_id] is dialog

        dialog._choose(_gold_chain(binary))
        qt_app.processEvents()
        assert window._address_meta(0)["pointer"] == _gold_chain(binary)
        assert window.addr_table.item(0, 1).text() == f"0x{moved:X}"
        assert entry_id not in window._pointer_dialogs
    finally:
        target.close()
        _delete_window(window)


@requires_target
def test_pointer_dialog_survives_a_restart_of_the_program(binary, qt_app, sessions,
                                                         monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access,too-many-locals
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.db.repository.addresses import AddressRepository
    from hermes.db.repository.hooks import HookRepository
    from hermes.ui import main_window

    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "HookRepository", lambda: HookRepository(sessions))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "AddressRepository", lambda: AddressRepository(sessions))

    def select(pid, name):
        """Answer the next "Select process" with this process."""
        class FakeSelection:  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
            selected_pid, selected_name, selected_path = pid, name, f"/opt/{name}"

            def __init__(self, *_args):
                pass

            @staticmethod
            def exec():
                return QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted

        monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "ProcessSelectDialog", FakeSelection)
        window._open_process_dialog()

    window = main_window.MainWindow("de")
    first = _Target(binary)
    second = None
    try:
        select(first.pid, "target")
        window._refresh_timer.stop()
        window._add_tracked_address({"address": hex(first.gold), "address_value": first.gold,
                                     "type": "int32", "value": "1234"})
        window._open_pointer_scan(0)
        entry_id = window._address_meta(0)["id"]
        dialog = window._pointer_dialogs[entry_id]
        dialog.depth_input.setValue(4)
        dialog.offset_input.setText("0x100")
        dialog.start_scan()
        dialog.wait_for_worker()
        _wait(qt_app, lambda: dialog._worker is None)
        assert _gold_chain(binary) in dialog.candidates()

        # The game is closed while a scan is running: the dialog stays open.
        from hermes.ui.widgets import pointer_scan
        monkeypatch.setattr(pointer_scan.QMessageBox, "question",
                            lambda *_args: pointer_scan.QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes)
        monkeypatch.setattr(main_window.QMessageBox, "question",
                            lambda *_args: main_window.QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes)
        dialog.start_scan()
        first.close()
        assert not window._check_process_alive()
        assert dialog.isVisible() and window._pointer_dialogs[entry_id] is dialog
        assert "beendet" in dialog.status_label.text()
        dialog.wait_for_worker()
        _wait(qt_app, lambda: dialog._worker is None)
        assert not dialog.btn_scan.isEnabled() and not dialog.btn_filter.isEnabled()

        # Restarted and attached again: filter with the new address.
        second = _Target(binary)
        select(second.pid, "target")
        assert dialog.pid == second.pid and dialog.btn_filter.isEnabled()
        # All candidates go to the address list, each with its pointer.
        candidates = dialog.candidates()
        dialog.adopt_candidates()
        assert window.addr_table.rowCount() == 1 + len(candidates)
        adopted = {window._address_meta(row)["pointer"]: window.addr_table.item(row, 1).text()
                   for row in range(1, window.addr_table.rowCount())}
        assert adopted[_gold_chain(binary)] == f"0x{second.gold:X}"
        assert str(len(candidates)) in dialog.status_label.text()
        dialog.adopt_candidates()  # nothing twice
        assert window.addr_table.rowCount() == 1 + len(candidates)
        # Several selected entries are removed at once.
        window.addr_table.clearSelection()
        for row in range(1, window.addr_table.rowCount()):
            window.addr_table.selectionModel().select(
                window.addr_table.model().index(row, 0),
                window.addr_table.selectionModel().SelectionFlag.Select
                | window.addr_table.selectionModel().SelectionFlag.Rows,
            )
        window._remove_address()
        assert window.addr_table.rowCount() == 1
        assert len(AddressRepository(sessions).list_addresses(window._process_id)) == 1

        dialog.address_input.setText(f"0x{second.gold:X}")
        dialog.start_filter()
        dialog.wait_for_worker()
        _wait(qt_app, lambda: dialog._worker is None)
        assert _gold_chain(binary) in dialog.candidates()

        # The chain is taken over by the reloaded address-list entry.
        dialog._choose(_gold_chain(binary))
        qt_app.processEvents()
        assert window._address_meta(0)["pointer"] == _gold_chain(binary)
        assert window.addr_table.item(0, 1).text() == f"0x{second.gold:X}"
        window._open_pointer_scan(0)
        dialog = window._pointer_dialogs[entry_id]

        # Removing the entry removes its candidates and closes its dialog, so
        # they are not saved again for an entry that is gone.
        asked = []
        monkeypatch.setattr(main_window.QMessageBox, "question",
                            lambda *args: asked.append(args[2])
                            or main_window.QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes)
        window.addr_table.selectRow(0)
        window._remove_address()
        assert str(len(dialog.candidates())) in asked[0]
        assert not dialog.isVisible() and not window._pointer_dialogs
        assert AddressRepository(sessions).get_pointer_scan(entry_id) is None
        window._add_tracked_address({"address": hex(second.gold), "address_value": second.gold,
                                     "type": "int32", "value": "1234"})
        window._open_pointer_scan(0)
        dialog = next(iter(window._pointer_dialogs.values()))

        # Another program: its address list has no such entry.
        select(second.pid + 1_000_000, "other")
        assert not dialog.isVisible() and not window._pointer_dialogs
    finally:
        first.close()
        if second is not None:
            second.close()
        _delete_window(window)


@requires_target
def test_scan_of_the_previous_program_is_cleared_on_a_switch(binary, qt_app, sessions,
                                                             monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    from PySide6.QtCore import QThread, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.db.repository.addresses import AddressRepository
    from hermes.db.repository.hooks import HookRepository
    from hermes.ui import main_window

    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "HookRepository", lambda: HookRepository(sessions))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "AddressRepository", lambda: AddressRepository(sessions))

    class InstantScan(QThread):
        """Finds one address at once; its results are still queued on the switch."""

        results_ready = Signal(object)
        scan_failed = Signal(str)
        scan_cancelled = Signal()
        progress_changed = Signal(int)

        def __init__(self, *_args, parent=None, **_kwargs):
            super().__init__(parent)

        def run(self):
            self.results_ready.emit([{"address": 0x1000, "type": "int32", "value": 7}])

    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "ScanWorker", InstantScan)

    def select(pid, name):
        class FakeSelection:  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
            selected_pid, selected_name, selected_path = pid, name, f"/opt/{name}"

            def __init__(self, *_args):
                pass

            @staticmethod
            def exec():
                return QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted

        monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "ProcessSelectDialog", FakeSelection)
        window._open_process_dialog()

    window = main_window.MainWindow("de")
    first, second = _Target(binary), _Target(binary)
    try:
        select(first.pid, "first")
        window._refresh_timer.stop()
        window._start_scan_worker(main_window.ScanRequest(first.pid, "int32", "exact", "7"))
        _wait(qt_app, lambda: window._scan_worker is None)
        assert window.result_table.rowCount() == 1 and window._scan_results

        window._start_scan_worker(main_window.ScanRequest(first.pid, "int32", "exact", "7"))
        window._scan_worker.wait()  # finished, its results not yet delivered
        select(second.pid, "second")
        _wait(qt_app, lambda: window._scan_worker is None)
        assert window.result_table.rowCount() == 0 and not window._scan_results
        assert window.btn_first_scan.isEnabled() and not window.btn_next_scan.isEnabled()
    finally:
        first.close()
        second.close()
        _delete_window(window)


def test_worker_finishing_after_its_dialog_was_deleted_is_harmless(qt_app, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    import threading

    from hermes.ui import workers
    from hermes.ui.widgets import pointer_scan

    release = threading.Event()

    class SlowWorker(pointer_scan.PointerScanWorker):
        """Ignores cancellation until released, like a long search step."""

        def _scan(self):
            release.wait(10)
            self.progress.emit("searching", 1)
            return [PointerChain("target", 0x10, (0x8,))]

    class Repository:  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
        @staticmethod
        def get_pointer_scan(_entry_id):
            return None

    monkeypatch.setattr(pointer_scan, "PointerScanWorker", SlowWorker)
    monkeypatch.setattr(pointer_scan, "STOP_TIMEOUT_MS", 0)
    translations = __import__("hermes.ui.localization", fromlist=["x"]).load_translations("de")
    dialog = pointer_scan.PointerScanDialog(
        translations, Repository(), 1, {"id": 1, "label": "Gold", "address": 0x1000}
    )
    dialog.setAttribute(pointer_scan.Qt.WidgetAttribute.WA_DeleteOnClose)
    dialog.show()
    dialog.start_scan()
    worker = dialog._worker
    dialog.reject()
    from PySide6.QtCore import QCoreApplication, QEvent  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
    assert not getattr(pointer_scan.shiboken6, "isValid")(dialog)

    # The worker finishes now; its callbacks must not touch the deleted dialog.
    release.set()
    worker.wait(5000)
    _wait(qt_app, lambda: worker not in workers.running_workers())
    QCoreApplication.sendPostedEvents(None, QEvent.Type.DeferredDelete)
```

```py
"""Tests for reading process information from /proc."""

import os
import subprocess

from hermes.platform.linux import is_wine_process, process_start_time, program_bits
from tests.test_hooks import linux_only


def _write_stat(root, pid, name, state, start_time):
    fields = [state] + ["0"] * 18 + [str(start_time), "0"]
    (root / str(pid)).mkdir()
    (root / str(pid) / "stat").write_text(f"{pid} ({name}) {' '.join(fields)}\n")


def test_reads_start_time_after_names_with_spaces_and_parentheses(tmp_path):
    _write_stat(tmp_path, 42, "my game) (x", "S", 123456)

    assert process_start_time(42, tmp_path) == 123456


def test_zombies_and_missing_processes_count_as_exited(tmp_path):
    _write_stat(tmp_path, 42, "game", "Z", 1)

    assert process_start_time(42, tmp_path) is None
    assert process_start_time(43, tmp_path) is None


@linux_only
def test_running_and_exited_real_process():
    assert process_start_time(os.getpid()) is not None

    child = subprocess.Popen(["sleep", "10"])
    try:
        start_time = process_start_time(child.pid)
        assert start_time is not None
        assert process_start_time(child.pid) == start_time
    finally:
        child.kill()
        child.wait()
    assert process_start_time(child.pid) is None


def _link_exe(root, pid, target):
    (root / str(pid)).mkdir()
    (root / str(pid) / "exe").symlink_to(target)


@linux_only
def test_detects_wine_and_proton_loaders(tmp_path):
    proton = "/steam/GE-Proton11-7/files/lib/wine"
    _link_exe(tmp_path, 1, f"{proton}/i386-unix/wine-preloader")
    _link_exe(tmp_path, 2, f"{proton}/x86_64-unix/wine64-preloader")
    _link_exe(tmp_path, 3, "/usr/bin/wine64")
    _link_exe(tmp_path, 4, "/games/PillarsOfEternity")
    _link_exe(tmp_path, 5, "/usr/bin/winecfg")

    assert is_wine_process(1, tmp_path)
    assert is_wine_process(2, tmp_path)
    assert is_wine_process(3, tmp_path)
    assert not is_wine_process(4, tmp_path)
    assert not is_wine_process(5, tmp_path)
    assert not is_wine_process(6, tmp_path)
    assert not is_wine_process(os.getpid())


@linux_only
def test_reads_the_bitness_of_the_program(tmp_path):
    for pid, header in ((1, b"\x7fELF\x01"), (2, b"\x7fELF\x02"), (3, b"MZ\x90\x00\x03")):
        (tmp_path / str(pid)).mkdir()
        (tmp_path / str(pid) / "exe").write_bytes(header + b"\0" * 59)

    assert program_bits(1, tmp_path) == 32
    assert program_bits(2, tmp_path) == 64
    assert program_bits(3, tmp_path) is None
    assert program_bits(4, tmp_path) is None
    assert program_bits(os.getpid()) == 64


def test_process_list_names_wine_processes_by_their_windows_program():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from hermes.ui.widgets.process_list import _resolve_display

    preloader = "/steam/Proton - Experimental/files/lib/wine/i386-unix/wine64-preloader"
    # Unreal renames the main thread, whose name the kernel reports.
    game = r"S:\steamapps\common\Avowed\Alabama\Binaries\Win64\Avowed-Win64-Shipping.exe"
    assert _resolve_display("GameThread", preloader, [game, "Alabama"], "/") == (
        "Avowed-Win64-Shipping.exe", game)
    assert _resolve_display("Avowed.exe", preloader, [r"S:\Avowed\Avowed.exe  ", ""], "/") == (
        "Avowed.exe", r"S:\Avowed\Avowed.exe")
    # A Wine helper without a Windows program keeps its name.
    assert _resolve_display("wineserver", "/usr/bin/wine64", ["/usr/bin/wine64"], "/") == (
        "wineserver", "/usr/bin/wine64")
    assert _resolve_display("bash", "/usr/bin/bash", ["bash"], "/") == ("bash", "/usr/bin/bash")
```

`tests/test_ptrace_hook.py`:

```py
"""Tests for the ptrace hook backend (Option A: value rewrite at a watchpoint)."""

import os
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from hermes.attach.ptrace_engine import WATCHPOINT_SLOTS, build_dr7, combined_dr7


def test_combined_dr7_matches_single_slot_for_slot_zero():
    assert combined_dr7({0: (4, False)}) == build_dr7(4, False)


def test_combined_dr7_arms_each_slot_independently():
    two = combined_dr7({0: (4, False), 2: (1, True)})
    assert two == combined_dr7({0: (4, False)}) | combined_dr7({2: (1, True)})
    # Enable bits for slots 0 and 2, nothing for 1 and 3.
    assert two & 0b1 and two & (1 << 4)
    assert not two & (1 << 2) and not two & (1 << 6)


@pytest.fixture(name="qt_app", scope="module")
def fixture_qt_app():
    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,import-error,no-name-in-module

    return QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])


def test_claim_address_uses_four_slots_then_refuses(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument,protected-access
    from hermes.hooks.ptrace_hook import PtraceHookWorker  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel

    worker = PtraceHookWorker(os.getpid())
    worker._read_value = lambda *args: 0  # avoid touching real memory

    slots = [worker._claim_address(0x1000 + 4 * i, "int32")["slot"]
             for i in range(WATCHPOINT_SLOTS)]
    assert sorted(slots) == list(range(WATCHPOINT_SLOTS))  # four distinct slots
    assert worker._claim_address(0x9000, "int32") is None  # no slot left
    # A second hook on an already-watched address reuses its slot.
    assert worker._claim_address(0x1000, "int32")["slot"] == slots[0]


def test_unaligned_addresses_take_no_watchpoint(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=unused-argument,protected-access,import-outside-toplevel
    from hermes.attach.ptrace_engine import watch_alignment_error
    from hermes.hooks.ptrace_hook import PtraceHookWorker

    # The kernel refuses them; a thread whose registers failed stayed stopped.
    assert watch_alignment_error(0x1002, 4) and watch_alignment_error(0x1004, 8)
    assert watch_alignment_error(0x1004, 4) is None and watch_alignment_error(0x1003, 1) is None
    worker = PtraceHookWorker(os.getpid())
    worker._read_value = lambda *args: 0
    assert worker._claim_address(0x1002, "int32") is None and not worker._slots


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# End-to-end against a real process.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_TARGET_SOURCE = """
#include <stdio.h>
#include <unistd.h>
volatile int gold = 100;
int main(void) {
  printf("%d %p\\n", (int)getpid(), (void*)&gold);
  fflush(stdout);
  char line[64];
  while (fgets(line, sizeof line, stdin)) {
    int delta = 0;
    sscanf(line, "%d", &delta);
    gold += delta;
    printf("%d\\n", gold);
    fflush(stdout);
  }
  return 0;
}
"""


def _ptrace_allowed():
    try:
        return Path("/proc/sys/kernel/yama/ptrace_scope").read_text().strip() == "0"
    except OSError:
        return True


requires_ptrace_target = pytest.mark.skipif(
    shutil.which("gcc") is None
    or not _ptrace_allowed()
    or platform.machine() != "x86_64",
    reason="needs gcc, x86-64, and ptrace_scope=0 to attach to a test process",
)


@requires_ptrace_target
def test_ptrace_hook_freezes_multiplies_and_removes(tmp_path, qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    from hermes.hooks.engine import HookSpec
    from hermes.hooks.ptrace_hook import PtraceHookWorker
    from hermes.hooks.transforms import FreezeTransform, MultiplyTransform

    source = tmp_path / "htarget.c"
    source.write_text(_TARGET_SOURCE)
    binary = tmp_path / "htarget"
    subprocess.run(["gcc", "-O2", str(source), "-o", str(binary)], check=True)

    target = subprocess.Popen(
        [str(binary)], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True
    )
    try:
        pid, address = target.stdout.readline().split()
        pid, address = int(pid), int(address, 16)
        installed, failed, errors, ready = {}, {}, {}, []
        worker = PtraceHookWorker(pid)
        worker.hook_installed.connect(lambda i, info: installed.update({i: info}))
        worker.hook_failed.connect(lambda i, message: failed.update({i: message}))
        worker.transform_error.connect(lambda i, message: errors.update({i: message}))
        worker.session_ready.connect(ready.append)
        worker.start()

        def pump(seconds):
            deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                qt_app.processEvents()
                time.sleep(0.01)

        def send(delta):
            target.stdin.write(f"{delta}\n")
            target.stdin.flush()
            return int(target.stdout.readline())

        pump(0.8)
        assert ready == ["x86-64"], ready

        hook_id = worker.add_hook(
            HookSpec(address, "int32", FreezeTransform(100), trap_pc=address)
        )
        pump(0.5)
        assert hook_id in installed and not failed

        # Freeze: every write is forced back to 100.
        assert [send(5), send(5), send(5)] == [100, 100, 100]

        # Multiply increases tenfold.
        worker.set_transform(hook_id, MultiplyTransform(10))
        pump(0.3)
        base = send(0)
        assert send(5) == base + 50

        # Removing the hook lets the value change freely again.
        worker.remove_hook(hook_id)
        pump(0.4)
        base = send(0)
        assert send(5) == base + 5

        worker.requestInterruption()
        assert worker.wait(3000)
        # The target keeps running after the hook detaches.
        assert send(1) == base + 6
        assert not errors
    finally:
        target.kill()
        target.wait()


@requires_ptrace_target
def test_ptrace_hooks_changing_keep_signals_and_new_threads(tmp_path, qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import signal

    from hermes.hooks.engine import HookSpec
    from hermes.hooks.ptrace_hook import PtraceHookWorker
    from hermes.hooks.transforms import MultiplyTransform
    from tests.test_ptrace_watch import _BUSY_SOURCE, _state

    source = tmp_path / "busy.c"
    source.write_text(_BUSY_SOURCE)
    binary = tmp_path / "busy"
    subprocess.run(["gcc", "-O2", "-pthread", str(source), "-o", str(binary)], check=True)
    target = subprocess.Popen(
        [str(binary)], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True
    )
    sent = 0

    def signal_for(seconds):
        nonlocal sent
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            os.kill(target.pid, signal.SIGUSR1)
            sent += 1
            qt_app.processEvents()
            time.sleep(0.02)

    try:
        pid, address = target.stdout.readline().split()
        pid, address = int(pid), int(address, 16)
        installed, ready = {}, []
        worker = PtraceHookWorker(pid)
        worker.hook_installed.connect(lambda i, info: installed.update({i: info}))
        worker.session_ready.connect(ready.append)
        worker.start()
        signal_for(0.5)
        assert ready
        # Each change halts and re-arms every thread (_reprogram).
        for _round in range(4):
            hook_id = worker.add_hook(
                HookSpec(address, "int32", MultiplyTransform(2), trap_pc=address))
            signal_for(0.2)
            assert hook_id in installed
            worker.remove_hook(hook_id)
            signal_for(0.2)
        worker.requestInterruption()
        signal_for(0.1)
        assert worker.wait(10000)

        time.sleep(0.2)
        assert _state(target.pid) != "T"
        target.stdin.write("count\n")
        target.stdin.flush()
        assert int(target.stdout.readline()) == sent
    finally:
        target.kill()
        target.wait()
```

`tests/test_ptrace_watch.py`:

```py
"""Tests for the ptrace-backed watch backend."""

import os
import platform
import shutil
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

import pytest

from hermes.features.ptrace_watch import build_dr7, decode_access


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("size", "reads", "expected"),
    [
        (1, False, 0x10001),
        (2, False, 0x50001),
        (4, False, 0xD0001),
        (8, False, 0x90001),
        (4, True, 0xF0001),  # read/write condition
    ],
)
def test_build_dr7_encodes_length_and_condition(size, reads, expected):
    assert build_dr7(size, reads) == expected


def test_build_dr7_rejects_unsupported_size():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unsupported watch size"):
        build_dr7(3, False)


def _ending_with(instruction, padding=60):
    # NOP padding before the instruction feeds the sync-vote heuristic.
    code = b"\x90" * padding + instruction
    return code, len(code)


def test_decode_access_tells_reads_from_writes():
    # mov [rbx+0x10], eax  -> write only
    code, pc = _ending_with(b"\x89\x43\x10")
    assert decode_access(code, pc, 64, False) == (False, True)

    # mov eax, [rbx+0x10]  -> read only (read watch active)
    code, pc = _ending_with(b"\x8b\x43\x10")
    assert decode_access(code, pc, 64, True) == (True, False)

    # add [rbx+0x10], eax  -> read and write
    code, pc = _ending_with(b"\x01\x43\x10")
    assert decode_access(code, pc, 64, True) == (True, True)


def test_decode_access_write_watch_always_reports_write():
    # A read instruction seen through a write watch still counts as a write,
    # so a real write is never hidden.
    code, pc = _ending_with(b"\x8b\x43\x10")
    assert decode_access(code, pc, 64, False) == (True, True)


def test_decode_access_handles_32_bit_code():
    code, pc = _ending_with(b"\x89\x43\x10")
    assert decode_access(code, pc, 32, False) == (False, True)


def test_decode_access_defaults_to_write_when_undecodable():
    code, pc = _ending_with(b"", padding=60)  # only NOPs, no memory operand
    assert decode_access(code, pc, 64, False) == (False, True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# End-to-end test against a real process.
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

_TARGET_SOURCE = """
#include <stdio.h>
#include <unistd.h>
volatile int gold = 100;
int main(void) {
  printf("%d %p\\n", (int)getpid(), (void*)&gold);
  fflush(stdout);
  char line[64];
  while (fgets(line, sizeof line, stdin)) {
    gold += 7;
    printf("%d\\n", gold);
    fflush(stdout);
  }
  return 0;
}
"""


def _ptrace_allowed():
    try:
        return Path("/proc/sys/kernel/yama/ptrace_scope").read_text().strip() == "0"
    except OSError:
        return True


requires_ptrace_target = pytest.mark.skipif(
    shutil.which("gcc") is None
    or not _ptrace_allowed()
    or platform.machine() != "x86_64",
    reason="needs gcc, x86-64, and ptrace_scope=0 to attach to a test process",
)


@requires_ptrace_target
def test_ptrace_watch_sees_writes_and_leaves_target_running(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=no-name-in-module

    from hermes.features.ptrace_watch import PtraceWriteWatchWorker

    source = tmp_path / "wtarget.c"
    source.write_text(_TARGET_SOURCE)
    binary = tmp_path / "wtarget"
    subprocess.run(["gcc", "-O2", str(source), "-o", str(binary)], check=True)

    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    target = subprocess.Popen(
        [str(binary)], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True
    )
    try:
        pid, address = target.stdout.readline().split()
        hits, ready, failed = [], [], []
        worker = PtraceWriteWatchWorker(int(pid), int(address, 16), 4, reads=True)
        worker.hits_ready.connect(hits.extend)
        worker.monitor_ready.connect(lambda count, _d: ready.append(count))
        worker.monitor_failed.connect(failed.append)
        worker.start()

        def pump(seconds):
            deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                app.processEvents()
                time.sleep(0.01)

        pump(1.0)
        assert ready and not failed, (ready, failed)

        target.stdin.write("x\n")
        target.stdin.flush()
        assert target.stdout.readline().strip() == "107"
        pump(0.6)

        worker.requestInterruption()
        assert worker.wait(3000)

        # The target must keep running normally after the watch detaches.
        target.stdin.write("y\n")
        target.stdin.flush()
        assert target.stdout.readline().strip() == "114"

        assert any(hit["write"] for hit in hits), hits
        assert all(hit["value"] == "6b 00 00 00" for hit in hits)  # 0x6b == 107
    finally:
        target.kill()
        target.wait()


# Threads come and go all the time, and the process counts the SIGUSR1s it
# gets: neither may be lost or left stopped while the watch attaches, runs
# and detaches.
_BUSY_SOURCE = r"""
#include <pthread.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <unistd.h>
volatile int gold = 100;
volatile sig_atomic_t signals;
static void on_signal(int sig) { (void) sig; signals++; }
static void *short_lived(void *unused) { (void) unused; gold += 0; return NULL; }
static void *spawner(void *unused) {
  (void) unused;
  for (;;) {
    pthread_t thread;
    if (pthread_create(&thread, NULL, short_lived, NULL) == 0)
      pthread_join(thread, NULL);
    usleep(200);
  }
  return NULL;
}
int main(void) {
  pthread_t thread;
  signal(SIGUSR1, on_signal);
  pthread_create(&thread, NULL, spawner, NULL);
  printf("%d %p\n", (int)getpid(), (void*)&gold);
  fflush(stdout);
  char line[64];
  while (fgets(line, sizeof line, stdin)) {
    printf("%d\n", (int)signals);
    fflush(stdout);
  }
  return 0;
}
"""


def _state(pid):
    stat = Path(f"/proc/{pid}/stat").read_text()
    return stat[stat.rindex(")") + 2]


@requires_ptrace_target
def test_ptrace_watch_keeps_signals_and_new_threads_of_the_target(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import signal

    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=no-name-in-module

    from hermes.features.ptrace_watch import PtraceWriteWatchWorker

    source = tmp_path / "busy.c"
    source.write_text(_BUSY_SOURCE)
    binary = tmp_path / "busy"
    subprocess.run(["gcc", "-O2", "-pthread", str(source), "-o", str(binary)], check=True)
    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    target = subprocess.Popen(
        [str(binary)], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, text=True
    )
    sent = 0

    def signal_for(seconds):
        nonlocal sent
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            os.kill(target.pid, signal.SIGUSR1)
            sent += 1
            app.processEvents()
            time.sleep(0.02)  # apart enough that the kernel does not merge them

    try:
        pid, address = target.stdout.readline().split()
        for _round in range(3):
            ready, failed = [], []
            worker = PtraceWriteWatchWorker(int(pid), int(address, 16), 4)
            worker.monitor_ready.connect(lambda count, _d: ready.append(count))
            worker.monitor_failed.connect(failed.append)
            worker.start()
            signal_for(0.5)
            assert ready and not failed, (ready, failed)
            worker.requestInterruption()
            signal_for(0.1)
            assert worker.wait(10000)
            signal_for(0.1)

        time.sleep(0.2)
        assert _state(target.pid) != "T"
        target.stdin.write("count\n")
        target.stdin.flush()
        assert int(target.stdout.readline()) == sent
    finally:
        target.kill()
        target.wait()
```

```py
"""Tests for running transforms outside the target process."""

import os

import pytest

from hermes.hooks.sandbox import normalize_value
from hermes.hooks.transforms import ClampTransform, MultiplyTransform


@pytest.fixture(name="sandbox", scope="module")
def fixture_sandbox():
    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module,import-outside-toplevel
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication
    from hermes.hooks.sandbox import TransformSandbox

    app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    yield TransformSandbox()
    del app


def test_runs_builtin_transforms(sandbox):
    params = {"factor": 10, "direction": "increase"}

    assert sandbox.run(MultiplyTransform.source, params, 100, 110).value == 200
    kept = sandbox.run(MultiplyTransform.source, params, 110, 100)
    assert kept.kept and kept.value is None and kept.error is None
    clamp = sandbox.run(ClampTransform.source, {"minimum": None, "maximum": 50}, 1, 99)
    assert clamp.value == 50


def test_collects_logs_and_keeps_state(sandbox):
    sandbox.reset_state()
    source = """ctx => {
      ctx.state.calls = (ctx.state.calls || 0) + 1;
      ctx.log('call', ctx.state.calls, { delta: ctx.delta });
      console.log('console');
      return ctx.new;
    }"""

    sandbox.run(source, {}, 1, 2)
    result = sandbox.run(source, {}, 1, 2)

    assert result.logs == ['call 2 {"delta":1}', "console"]
    assert result.state == '{"calls":2}'
    sandbox.reset_state()
    assert sandbox.run(source, {}, 1, 2).state == '{"calls":1}'


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("source", "message"),
    [
        ("ctx => { throw new Error('boom'); }", "boom"),
        ("ctx => 'gold'", "expected a finite number"),
        ("function (", "SyntaxError"),
        ("42", "does not evaluate to a function"),
    ],
)
def test_reports_errors(sandbox, source, message):
    result = sandbox.run(source, {}, 1, 2)

    assert result.value is None
    assert message in result.error


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("value", "value_type", "expected"),
    [
        (1e20, "int32", 2147483647),
        (-2.7, "int32", -2),
        (2**60, "int64", 2**53 - 1),
        (1.5, "float", 1.5),
        (300, "uint8", 255),
        (-5, "uint16", 0),
        (-200, "int8", -128),
        (2**60, "uint64", 2**53 - 1),
    ],
)
def test_normalizes_like_the_agent(sandbox, value, value_type, expected):
    assert sandbox.run(f"ctx => {value!r}", {}, 0, 0, value_type).value == expected
    assert normalize_value(value, value_type) == expected
```

`tests/test_scanner.py`:

```py
"""Tests for the process memory scanner."""

# pylint: disable=protected-access

import builtins
import io
import struct

import pytest
import numpy as np

from hermes.core import scanner
from hermes.core.scanner import (
    MemorySnapshot, ScanResults, ScanWorker, ValueRange, ValueRefreshWorker,
)
from hermes.core.value_types import VALUE_TYPES
from hermes.platform import linux
from hermes.platform.linux import parse_maps


class FakeMemory:
    """Small seekable memory image addressed by virtual address."""

    def __init__(self, base_address, contents):
        self.base_address = base_address
        self.contents = contents
        self.position = 0

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_args):
        return None

    def seek(self, address):
        self.position = address - self.base_address

    def read(self, size):
        if self.position < 0 or self.position >= len(self.contents):
            return b""
        result = self.contents[self.position:self.position + size]
        self.position += len(result)
        return result


def install_fake_process(monkeypatch, maps, base_address, contents):
    """Route this worker's /proc file opens to an in-memory process image."""
    def fake_open(path, mode="r", **_kwargs):
        if path == "/proc/123/maps":
            return io.StringIO(maps)
        if path == "/proc/123/mem":
            assert mode == "rb"
            return FakeMemory(base_address, contents)
        raise AssertionError(f"Unexpected file open: {path}")

    monkeypatch.setattr(builtins, "open", fake_open)
    # The fake is /proc: use the Linux backend on every system.
    monkeypatch.setattr(scanner, "read_mappings", linux.read_mappings)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scanner, "ProcessMemory", linux.ProcessMemory)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("mode", "current", "target", "upper", "previous", "expected"),
    [
        ("unknown_start", 5, None, None, None, True),
        ("exact", 7, ValueRange(7, 7), None, None, True),
        ("greater_than", 8, 7, None, None, True),
        ("less_than", 6, 7, None, None, True),
        ("between", 5, 2, 7, None, True),
        ("changed", 8, None, None, 7, True),
        ("unchanged", 7, None, None, 7, True),
        ("increased", 8, None, None, 7, True),
        ("decreased", 6, None, None, 7, True),
        ("increased", 7, None, None, 7, False),
        ("decreased", 8, None, None, 7, False),
        ("exact", 6, ValueRange(7, 7), None, None, False),
        ("exact", 6, ValueRange(5, 9), None, None, True),
        ("increased_by", 107, ValueRange(100, 100), None, 7, True),
        ("increased_by", 106, ValueRange(98, 102), None, 7, True),
        ("increased_by", 7, ValueRange(100, 100), None, 107, False),
        ("decreased_by", 7, ValueRange(100, 100), None, 107, True),
        ("changed_by", 7, ValueRange(100, 100), None, 107, True),
        ("changed_by", 107, ValueRange(100, 100), None, 7, True),
        ("changed_by", 108, ValueRange(100, 100), None, 7, False),
        ("changed", 7, None, None, 7, False),
    ],
)
def test_matches_scan_modes(mode, current, target, upper, previous, expected):
    worker = ScanWorker(123, "int32", mode)
    if previous is not None:
        previous = np.array([previous], dtype=np.int32)

    matches = worker._matches_array(np.array([current], dtype=np.int32), target, upper, previous)

    assert matches.tolist() == [expected]


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("mode", "target", "upper", "expected"),
    [
        ("exact", ValueRange(7, 7), None, [False, True, False]),
        ("exact", ValueRange(2, 7), None, [True, True, False]),
        ("greater_than", 7, None, [False, False, True]),
        ("less_than", 7, None, [True, False, False]),
        ("between", 4, 8, [False, True, False]),
        ("unknown_start", None, None, [True, True, True]),
    ],
)
def test_vectorized_filters(mode, target, upper, expected):
    worker = ScanWorker(123, "int32", mode)
    values = np.array([2, 7, 10], dtype=np.int32)

    assert worker._matches_array(values, target, upper).tolist() == expected


def test_parse_scan_value_uses_selected_numeric_format():
    assert ScanWorker._parse_scan_value("0x10", "<i") == 16
    assert ScanWorker._parse_scan_value("0.1", "<f") == struct.unpack(
        "<f", struct.pack("<f", 0.1)
    )[0]


@pytest.mark.parametrize("value", ["not-a-number", "2147483648"])

    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Invalid scan value"):

def test_first_scan_finds_exact_value_in_readable_mappings(monkeypatch):
    base_address = 0x1000
    contents = struct.pack("<iii", 1, 7, 9)
    maps = (
        "1000-100c rw-p 00000000 00:00 0\n"
        "2000-200c ---p 00000000 00:00 0\n"
    )
    install_fake_process(monkeypatch, maps, base_address, contents)
    worker = ScanWorker(123, "int32", "exact", "7")
    emitted = []
    progress = []
    worker.results_ready.connect(emitted.append)
    worker.progress_changed.connect(progress.append)

    worker.run()

    assert emitted == [[{"address": base_address + 4, "type": "int32", "value": 7}]]
    assert progress[-1] == 100


def test_first_scan_finds_values_crossing_chunk_boundary(monkeypatch):

def test_first_scan_discards_non_finite_float_candidates(monkeypatch):
    base_address = 0x1000
    contents = struct.pack("<fff", 1.5, float("nan"), float("inf"))
    maps = "1000-100c rw-p 00000000 00:00 0\n"

@pytest.mark.parametrize(

def test_refine_scan_compares_current_and_previous_values(

    maps = "1000-100c r--p 00000000 00:00 0\n"
    install_fake_process(monkeypatch, maps, 0x1000, current_values)
    previous = [
        {"address": 0x1000, "type": "int32", "value": 10},
        {"address": 0x1004, "type": "int32", "value": 15},
        {"address": 0x1008, "type": "int32", "value": 25},
    ]
    worker = ScanWorker(123, "int32", mode, previous_results=previous)
    progress = []
    worker.progress_changed.connect(progress.append)

    results = worker._refine_scan()

    assert [result["address"] for result in results] == expected_addresses
    assert progress[-1] == 100

def scan_range(text, value_type, tolerance="", rounding="exact", delta=False):
    return ValueRange.parse(text, VALUE_TYPES[value_type], tolerance, rounding, delta)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("text", "rounding", "tolerance", "inside", "outside"),
    [
        ("12.3", "exact", "", [np.float32(12.3)], [12.31, 12.29]),
        ("12.3", "exact", "0.1", [12.2, 12.4], [12.19, 12.41]),
        ("12.3", "rounded", "", [12.25, 12.3, 12.349], [12.35, 12.249]),
        ("12", "rounded", "", [11.5, 12.49], [12.5, 11.49]),
        ("12.3", "truncated", "", [12.3, 12.399], [12.4, 12.299]),
        ("-12.3", "truncated", "", [-12.3, -12.399], [-12.4, -12.299]),
        ("12.3", "rounded", "1", [11.25, 13.349], [11.249, 13.35]),
        ("1.25e1", "rounded", "", [12.45, 12.54], [12.55, 12.44]),
    ],
)
def test_float_ranges_round_and_widen_by_tolerance(text, rounding, tolerance, inside, outside):
    value_range = scan_range(text, "float", tolerance, rounding)

    assert value_range.contains(np.array(inside, dtype=np.float32)).all()
    assert not value_range.contains(np.array(outside, dtype=np.float32)).any()


def test_integer_ranges_ignore_float_rounding():
    value_range = scan_range("100", "int32", "5", "rounded")

    assert value_range == ValueRange(95, 105)


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("text", "value_type", "tolerance", "message"),
    [
        ("12", "int32", "-1", "Invalid tolerance"),
        ("12", "int32", "0.5", "Invalid tolerance"),
        ("12", "float", "abc", "Invalid tolerance"),
        ("2147483648", "int32", "", "Invalid scan value"),
        ("abc", "float", "", "Invalid scan value"),
    ],
)
def test_value_range_rejects_invalid_input(text, value_type, tolerance, message):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=message):
        scan_range(text, value_type, tolerance)


def test_value_range_change_may_exceed_the_type_range():
    value_range = scan_range("200", "int8", delta=True)

    assert value_range == ValueRange(200, 200)


@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [np.int8, np.int32, np.int64, np.uint8, np.uint64])
def test_integer_change_matches_scalars_and_arrays_alike(dtype):
    info = np.iinfo(dtype)
    previous = np.array([0, 5, info.max - 10, info.min + 10, 3], dtype=dtype)
    current = np.array([10, 15, info.max, info.min + 20, 3], dtype=dtype)
    value_range = ValueRange(9, 11)

    array_result = value_range.contains_change(current, previous)
    scalar_result = [
        value_range.contains_change(int(now), int(before))
        for now, before in zip(current, previous)
    ]

    assert array_result.tolist() == scalar_result == [True, True, True, True, False]


def test_float_change_uses_rounding_of_the_entered_value():
    value_range = scan_range("7.5", "float", rounding="rounded", delta=True)
    previous = np.array([20.0, 20.0, 20.0], dtype=np.float32)
    current = np.array([12.5, 12.47, 12.6], dtype=np.float32)

    assert value_range.contains_change(previous, current).tolist() == [True, True, False]

class FakeRegions:
    """ProcessMemory stand-in with readable regions ``{start: bytes}`` and holes between."""

    def __init__(self, regions):
        self.regions = regions

    def __call__(self, _pid):
        return self

    def __enter__(self):
        return self

    def __exit__(self, *_args):
        return None

    def read_available(self, address, size):
        for start, data in self.regions.items():
            if start <= address < start + len(data):
                return data[address - start:address - start + size]
        return b""

    def read(self, address, size):
        data = self.read_available(address, size)
        return data if len(data) == size else None


@pytest.mark.parametrize("chunk_size", [8, ScanWorker._CHUNK_SIZE])
def test_refine_reads_candidates_in_blocks_and_skips_unreadable_ones(monkeypatch, chunk_size):
    monkeypatch.setattr(scanner, "ProcessMemory", FakeRegions({
        0x1000: struct.pack("<ii", 1, 2),
        0x2000: struct.pack("<ii", 3, 4),
        0x100000: struct.pack("<i", 5),
    }))
    # 0x1800 lies in the hole between the first two regions, close enough to
    # be read together with them; 0x100000 is far away.
    addresses = [0x1000, 0x1004, 0x1800, 0x2000, 0x2004, 0x100000]
    previous = ScanResults.from_dicts(
        {"address": address, "type": "int32", "value": 0} for address in addresses
    )
    worker = ScanWorker(123, "int32", "changed", previous_results=previous)
    worker._CHUNK_SIZE = chunk_size

    results = worker._refine_scan()

    assert isinstance(results, ScanResults)
    assert [(result["address"], result["value"]) for result in results] == [
        (0x1000, 1), (0x1004, 2), (0x2000, 3), (0x2004, 4), (0x100000, 5),
    ]


def test_refine_reads_candidates_as_the_newly_chosen_type(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(scanner, "ProcessMemory", FakeRegions({
        0x1000: struct.pack("<hhhh", 7, 1, 9, 1),
    }))
    previous = [
        {"address": 0x1000, "type": "int32", "value": 7 + (1 << 16)},
        {"address": 0x1004, "type": "int32", "value": 9 + (1 << 16)},
    ]
    worker = ScanWorker(123, "int16", "exact", "9", previous_results=previous)

    assert worker._refine_scan() == [{"address": 0x1004, "type": "int16", "value": 9}]


def test_a_newly_chosen_type_reads_previous_values_from_their_bytes(monkeypatch):
    float_one = struct.unpack("<i", struct.pack("<f", 1.0))[0]
    monkeypatch.setattr(scanner, "ProcessMemory", FakeRegions({
        0x1000: struct.pack("<ii", 5, float_one) + struct.pack("<q", 7 + (3 << 32)),
    }))
    previous = [
        # Found as int32 and as float at one address: compared once, as int32.
        {"address": 0x1000, "type": "int32", "value": 5},
        {"address": 0x1000, "type": "float", "value": 7.0e-45},
        # A float of 1.0 is the int32 0x3F800000, the same bytes.
        {"address": 0x1004, "type": "float", "value": 1.0},
        # The low half of an int64.
        {"address": 0x1008, "type": "int64", "value": 6 + (3 << 32)},
    ]
    worker = ScanWorker(123, "int32", "unchanged", previous_results=previous)

    assert worker._refine_scan() == [
        {"address": 0x1000, "type": "int32", "value": 5},
        {"address": 0x1004, "type": "int32", "value": float_one},
    ]


def test_a_wider_type_keeps_candidates_only_without_a_previous_value(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(scanner, "ProcessMemory", FakeRegions({
        0x1000: struct.pack("<q", 9 + (1 << 32)),
    }))
    # Only the low 2 of the 8 bytes are known from before.
    previous = [{"address": 0x1000, "type": "int16", "value": 9}]

    changed = ScanWorker(123, "int64", "changed", previous_results=previous)
    assert changed._refine_scan() == []
    exact = ScanWorker(123, "int64", "exact", str(9 + (1 << 32)), previous_results=previous)
    assert exact._refine_scan() == [{"address": 0x1000, "type": "int64", "value": 9 + (1 << 32)}]


def test_auto_refine_keeps_each_type_and_orders_by_address(monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setattr(scanner, "ProcessMemory", FakeRegions({
        0x1000: struct.pack("<if", 5, 2.5) + struct.pack("<q", 5),
    }))
    previous = [
        {"address": 0x1008, "type": "int64", "value": 4},
        {"address": 0x1000, "type": "int32", "value": 4},
        {"address": 0x1004, "type": "float", "value": 2.5},
    ]
    worker = ScanWorker(123, "auto", "increased", previous_results=previous)

    assert worker._refine_scan() == [
        {"address": 0x1000, "type": "int32", "value": 5},
        {"address": 0x1008, "type": "int64", "value": 5},
    ]


def test_scan_results_behave_like_a_result_list():
    entries = [
        {"address": 0x2000, "type": "int32", "value": 2},
        {"address": 0x1000, "type": "double", "value": 1.5},
        {"address": 0x3000, "type": "int32", "value": 3},
    ]
    results = ScanResults.from_dicts(entries)

    assert len(results) == 3 and results
    assert results == sorted(entries, key=lambda entry: entry["address"])
    assert results[1:] == [entries[0], entries[2]]
    assert not ScanResults() and list(ScanResults()) == []


def test_small_snapshot_becomes_scan_results():
    contents = struct.pack("<iii", 1, 2, 3)
    mask = np.array([True, False, True])
    snapshot = MemorySnapshot("int32", 4, [(0x1000, contents, mask)])

    assert snapshot.to_results() == [
        {"address": 0x1000, "type": "int32", "value": 1},
        {"address": 0x1008, "type": "int32", "value": 3},
    ]
```

```py
def test_both_languages_name_the_same_script_texts():
    folder = Path(__file__).parent.parent / "hermes" / "ui" / "localization"
    keys = {language: {key for key in json.loads((folder / f"{language}.json").read_text("utf-8"))
                       if key.startswith("scripts.")}
            for language in ("en", "de")}

@pytest.mark.parametrize("language", ["en", "de"])
def test_the_dialog_builds_a_script_and_rejects_busy_loops(qt_app, language):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    from hermes.ui.widgets.scripts import ScriptDialog, timing_text

    translations = load_translations(language)
    dialog = ScriptDialog(translations)
    dialog.label_edit.setText("Heal")
    dialog.code_edit.setPlainText("ctx.find('AlabamaCheatManager').call('GiveHealth', 50);")
    dialog.mode_combo.setCurrentIndex(dialog.mode_combo.findData("repeat"))
    dialog.seconds_spin.setValue(0)
    dialog._accept()  # pylint: disable=protected-access
    assert dialog.spec is None and dialog.error_label.text()

    dialog.seconds_spin.setValue(30)
    dialog._accept()  # pylint: disable=protected-access
    assert dialog.spec == ScriptSpec("ctx.find('AlabamaCheatManager').call('GiveHealth', 50);",
                                     "repeat", 30, True, "Heal")
    assert "30" in timing_text(translations, dialog.spec)

    # Editing keeps whether the script is paused; manual scripts have no delay.
    paused = ScriptSpec("return 1;", "once", 5, False, "Later")
    dialog = ScriptDialog(translations, spec=paused)
    dialog.mode_combo.setCurrentIndex(dialog.mode_combo.findData("manual"))
    assert not dialog.seconds_spin.isEnabled()
    dialog._accept()  # pylint: disable=protected-access
    assert dialog.spec == ScriptSpec("return 1;", "manual", 0.0, False, "Later")


def test_the_address_search_folds_away_and_stays_so(qt_app, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access,unused-argument
    import shiboken6  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtCore import QSettings  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from sqlalchemy import create_engine
    from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

    from hermes.db import models  # noqa: F401  pylint: disable=unused-import
    from hermes.db.base import Base
    from hermes.db.repository.addresses import AddressRepository
    from hermes.db.repository.hooks import HookRepository
    from hermes.db.repository.scripts import ScriptRepository
    from hermes.ui import main_window

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'hermes.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "HookRepository", lambda: HookRepository(sessions))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "AddressRepository", lambda: AddressRepository(sessions))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "ScriptRepository", lambda: ScriptRepository(sessions))
    settings_file = str(tmp_path / "settings.ini")
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "QSettings",
                        lambda *_args: QSettings(settings_file, QSettings.Format.IniFormat))

    def open_window():
        window = main_window.MainWindow("de")
        window._refresh_timer.stop()
        return window

    def close(window):
        window.close()
        shiboken6.delete(window)

    try:
        window = open_window()
        file_menu = window.menuBar().actions()[0].menu()
        file_actions = file_menu.actions()
        assert file_actions[-2].isSeparator()
        assert file_actions[-1] == window.act_check_gadget
        assert window.act_check_gadget.isEnabled() == (main_window.sys.platform != "win32")
        assert not window.act_check_gadget.icon().isNull()
        assert not window._scan_area.isHidden() and window.act_scan_area.isChecked()
        window.btn_scan_area.click()
        assert window._scan_area.isHidden() and not window.act_scan_area.isChecked()
        assert window.btn_scan_area.text() == "Adresssuche einblenden"
        assert not window.btn_scan_area.icon().isNull()

        # The tab of tracked addresses counts them, like those of hooks and scripts.
        tab = window.bottom_tabs.indexOf(window._address_box)
        assert window.bottom_tabs.tabText(tab) == "Gemerkte Adressen"
        address_buttons = (window.btn_write_value, window.btn_freeze, window.btn_remove_address)
        assert not any(button.isEnabled() for button in address_buttons)
        window.addr_table.insertRow(0)
        window.addr_table.insertRow(0)
        assert window.bottom_tabs.tabText(tab) == "Gemerkte Adressen (2)"
        # The address actions need a selected address.
        assert not any(button.isEnabled() for button in address_buttons)
        window.addr_table.selectRow(0)
        assert all(button.isEnabled() for button in address_buttons)
        window.addr_table.removeRow(0)
        assert window.bottom_tabs.tabText(tab) == "Gemerkte Adressen (1)"
        assert not any(button.isEnabled() for button in address_buttons)
        window.addr_table.setRowCount(0)
        assert window.bottom_tabs.tabText(tab) == "Gemerkte Adressen"
        close(window)

        # Started again: still folded away; the menu entry shows it again.
        window = open_window()
        assert window._scan_area.isHidden() and not window.act_scan_area.isChecked()
        window.act_scan_area.trigger()
        assert not window._scan_area.isHidden()
        assert window.btn_scan_area.text() == "Adresssuche ausblenden"
        close(window)
        assert QSettings(settings_file, QSettings.Format.IniFormat).value(
            "scan_area_visible", type=bool) is True
    finally:
        engine.dispose()


def test_native_tools_ask_first_in_mono_games(qt_app, tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access,unused-argument
    import shiboken6  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QMessageBox  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from sqlalchemy import create_engine
    from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker

    from hermes.db import models  # noqa: F401  pylint: disable=unused-import
    from hermes.db.base import Base
    from hermes.db.repository.addresses import AddressRepository
    from hermes.db.repository.hooks import HookRepository
    from hermes.db.repository.scripts import ScriptRepository
    from hermes.engines.registry import engine_by_id
    from hermes.ui import main_window

    engine = create_engine(f"sqlite:///{tmp_path / 'hermes.db'}")
    Base.metadata.create_all(engine)
    sessions = sessionmaker(bind=engine)
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "HookRepository", lambda: HookRepository(sessions))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "AddressRepository", lambda: AddressRepository(sessions))
    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window, "ScriptRepository", lambda: ScriptRepository(sessions))
    answers, asked = [QMessageBox.StandardButton.No, QMessageBox.StandardButton.Yes], []

    def warning(*args):
        asked.append(args[1])
        return answers.pop(0)

    monkeypatch.setattr(main_window.QMessageBox, "warning", warning)
    window = main_window.MainWindow("de")
    window._refresh_timer.stop()
    try:
        window._current_pid = 4242
        window._engine = engine_by_id("unreal")
        assert window._confirm_native_tools("Trace") and not asked

        window._engine = engine_by_id("mono")
        window._update_catalog_button()
        assert window.act_native_trace.isEnabled()
        assert "Shadowrun Returns" in window.act_native_trace.toolTip()
        assert not window._confirm_native_tools("Trace")  # "No"
        assert window._confirm_native_tools("Trace")      # "Yes"
        assert window._confirm_native_tools("Monitor")    # not asked again
        assert asked == ["Trace", "Trace"]
    finally:
        window.close()
        shiboken6.delete(window)
        engine.dispose()


class _FakeScriptWorker:
    """Stands in for ScriptWorker: records the requests; the test answers."""

    # As ScriptWorker's: unique across workers
    _ids = itertools.count(1)

    def __init__(self, _pid, _parent=None, _language="en"):
        # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
        from PySide6.QtCore import QObject, Signal  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

        class Signals(QObject):  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
            script_added = Signal(int)
            script_updated = Signal(int)
            script_removed = Signal(int)
            script_failed = Signal(int, str)
            script_ran = Signal(int, object)
            worker_failed = Signal(str)
            inspected = Signal(int, object)
            inspect_failed = Signal(int, str)
            evaluated = Signal(int, object)
            evaluate_failed = Signal(int, str)
            methods_listed = Signal(int, object)
            methods_failed = Signal(int, str)
            text_fetched = Signal(int, object)
            text_failed = Signal(int, str)
            gas_listed = Signal(int, object)
            gas_failed = Signal(int, str)
            gas_set = Signal(int, object)
            gas_set_failed = Signal(int, str)
            options_listed = Signal(int, object)
            options_failed = Signal(int, str)
            finished = Signal()

        self.signals = Signals()
        self.script_added = self.signals.script_added
        self.script_updated = self.signals.script_updated
        self.script_removed = self.signals.script_removed
        self.script_failed = self.signals.script_failed
        self.script_ran = self.signals.script_ran
        self.worker_failed = self.signals.worker_failed
        self.inspected = self.signals.inspected
        self.inspect_failed = self.signals.inspect_failed
        self.evaluated = self.signals.evaluated
        self.evaluate_failed = self.signals.evaluate_failed
        self.methods_listed = self.signals.methods_listed
        self.methods_failed = self.signals.methods_failed
        self.text_fetched = self.signals.text_fetched
        self.text_failed = self.signals.text_failed
        self.gas_listed = self.signals.gas_listed
        self.gas_failed = self.signals.gas_failed
        self.gas_set = self.signals.gas_set
        self.gas_set_failed = self.signals.gas_set_failed
        self.options_listed = self.signals.options_listed
        self.options_failed = self.signals.options_failed
        self.finished = self.signals.finished
        self.requests = []

    def start(self):
        pass

    def isRunning(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        return True

    def requestInterruption(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        pass

    def wait(self, _timeout):
        return True

    def setParent(self, _parent):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        pass

    def deleteLater(self):  # pylint: disable=invalid-name
        pass

    def add_script(self, spec):
        self.requests.append(("add", spec))
        return next(self._ids)

    def update_script(self, script_id, spec):
        self.requests.append(("update", script_id, spec))

    def remove_script(self, script_id):
        self.requests.append(("remove", script_id))

    def run_now(self, script_id, args=None):
        self.requests.append(("run", script_id, args))

    def script_options(self, script_id, name):
        self.requests.append(("options", script_id, name))
        return len(self.requests)

    def inspect(self, target):
        self.requests.append(("inspect", target))
        return len(self.requests)

    def gas_attributes(self):
        self.requests.append(("gas_attributes",))
        return len(self.requests)

    def gas_set_base(self, name, value):
        self.requests.append(("gas_set_base", name, value))
        return len(self.requests)


def test_objects_scripts_return_open_in_the_inspector_from_the_log(qt_app, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from PySide6.QtCore import QUrl  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.ui.widgets import scripts

    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptWorker", _FakeScriptWorker)
    panel = scripts.ScriptPanel(load_translations("de"))
    try:
        panel.set_process(4242)
        script_id = panel.add_script(ScriptSpec('return ctx.call("GameState:get_PlayerCharacter");',
                                                label="Spieler"))
        worker = panel._worker
        worker.script_added.emit(script_id)
        target = {"address": "0x7f82508577e0"}
        player = {"runs": 1, "time": 0, "result": 'Player "Player_New_Game(Clone)_1"@0x7f82508577e0',
                  "target": target, "logs": [{
                      "text": 'Player "Player_New_Game(Clone)_1"@0x7f82508577e0',
                      "targets": [target]}], "error": None}

        # Neither a timed run nor one by hand opens a window: the log links it.
        worker.script_ran.emit(script_id, player)
        panel.table.selectRow(0)
        panel.btn_run.click()
        worker.script_ran.emit(script_id, {**player, "runs": 2})
        assert not panel.inspections.inspectors
        assert panel.log_view.toPlainText().count("Inspizieren") == 4

        panel.log_view.anchorClicked.emit(QUrl("inspect:0"))
        assert len(panel.inspections.inspectors) == 1
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("inspect", target)
        panel.log_view.anchorClicked.emit(QUrl("inspect:1"))
        assert len(panel.inspections.inspectors) == 2
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("inspect", target)
        assert panel.table.item(0, 4).text().startswith("Player")
    finally:
        for inspector in list(panel.inspections.inspectors if panel.inspections else []):
            inspector.close()
        panel.shutdown()
        panel.deleteLater()


@pytest.mark.parametrize("language, suffix", [("en", "(copy)"), ("de", "(Kopie)")])
def test_context_menu_creates_a_localized_script_copy(qt_app, monkeypatch, language, suffix):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access,unused-argument
    from PySide6.QtCore import QPoint  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.features.scripts import ScriptParam
    from hermes.ui.widgets import scripts

    class FakeAction:
        def __init__(self, label, callback):
            self.label = label
            self.callback = callback
            self.enabled = True

        def setEnabled(self, enabled):
            self.enabled = enabled

    class FakeMenu:
        instances = []

        def __init__(self, _parent):
            self.actions = []
            self.instances.append(self)

        def addAction(self, _icon, label, callback):
            action = FakeAction(label, callback)
            self.actions.append(action)
            return action

        def exec(self, _position):
            pass

    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptWorker", _FakeScriptWorker)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "QMenu", FakeMenu)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "add_delete_action", lambda *_args: None)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "add_copy_actions", lambda *_args: None)
    translations = load_translations(language)
    panel = scripts.ScriptPanel(translations, language=language)
    spec = ScriptSpec("return ctx.lang;", "repeat", 3, True, "Language", (
        ScriptParam("choice", "Choice", "choice", "en", 'return ["en", "de"];'),
    ))
    try:
        panel.set_process(4242)
        original_id = panel.add_script(spec)
        worker = panel._worker
        position = panel.table.visualItemRect(panel.table.item(0, 0)).center()
        panel._show_context_menu(QPoint(position))

        menu = FakeMenu.instances[-1]
        assert [action.label for action in menu.actions] == [
            translations["scripts.edit"], translations["scripts.run"],
            translations["scripts.pause"], translations["scripts.copy"],
        ]
        menu.actions[-1].callback()

        copied_id = panel._selected_id()
        copied = panel._scripts[copied_id]
        assert copied_id != original_id
        assert copied["spec"] == ScriptSpec(
            spec.source, spec.mode, spec.seconds, spec.enabled, f"Language {suffix}", spec.params)
        assert copied["runs"] == 0 and copied["last"] == "" and copied["options"] == {}
        assert worker.requests[-1] == ("add", copied["spec"])
    finally:
        panel.shutdown()
        panel.deleteLater()


def test_scripts_show_disconnected_when_their_session_ends(qt_app, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from hermes.ui.widgets import scripts

    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptWorker", _FakeScriptWorker)
    panel = scripts.ScriptPanel(load_translations("de"))
    try:
        panel.set_process(4242)
        running = panel.add_script(ScriptSpec("return 1;", label="Läuft"))
        paused = panel.add_script(ScriptSpec("return 2;", label="Pausiert", enabled=False))
        worker = panel._worker
        worker.script_added.emit(running)
        worker.script_added.emit(paused)
        assert panel.table.item(0, 2).text() == "Aktiv"

        # The session is ended in the sessions window: the worker just finishes.
        worker.finished.emit()
        assert panel._worker is None
        assert [panel.table.item(row, 2).text() for row in range(2)] == ["Getrennt"] * 2
        panel.table.selectRow(1)
        assert not panel.btn_run.isEnabled()
        assert panel.btn_toggle.text() == "Fortsetzen"

        # Resuming starts it anew in a new session, running.
        panel.btn_toggle.click()
        restarted = panel._worker
        assert restarted is not worker
        assert restarted.requests[-1][0] == "add" and restarted.requests[-1][1].enabled
        assert panel.table.item(0, 2).text() == "Getrennt"  # the other one stays
    finally:
        panel.shutdown()
        panel.deleteLater()


def test_the_dialog_defines_parameters_and_their_options(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from hermes.features.scripts import ScriptParam
    from hermes.ui.widgets.scripts import ScriptDialog

    dialog = ScriptDialog(load_translations("de"))
    dialog.code_edit.setPlainText("return ctx.args.count;")
    editor = dialog.param_editor
    editor.btn_add.click()
    editor.table.item(0, 0).setText("item")
    editor.table.item(0, 1).setText("Item")
    editor.table.cellWidget(0, 2).setCurrentIndex(3)  # a choice: its code shows
    assert editor.options_edit.isEnabled() and "return" in editor.options_edit.toPlainText()
    editor.options_edit.setPlainText('return ["ItFo_Apple", "ItFo_Pear"];')
    editor.btn_add.click()
    editor.table.item(1, 0).setText("count")
    editor.table.cellWidget(1, 2).setCurrentIndex(1)
    editor.table.item(1, 3).setText("x")
    assert not editor.options_edit.isEnabled()  # a number has no options

    # A default that is no number keeps it open, on the parameters' tab.
    dialog.tabs.setCurrentIndex(0)
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.spec is None and "count" in dialog.error_label.text()
    assert dialog.tabs.currentIndex() == 1
    editor.table.item(1, 3).setText("20")
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.spec.params == (
        ScriptParam("item", "Item", "choice", "", 'return ["ItFo_Apple", "ItFo_Pear"];'),
        ScriptParam("count", "", "number", "20"))

    # Editing shows them again; removing the choice takes its code along.
    dialog = ScriptDialog(load_translations("de"), spec=dialog.spec)
    editor = dialog.param_editor
    assert editor.table.rowCount() == 2
    editor.table.selectRow(0)
    assert editor.options_edit.toPlainText() == 'return ["ItFo_Apple", "ItFo_Pear"];'
    editor.btn_remove.click()
    dialog._accept()
    assert [param.name for param in dialog.spec.params] == ["count"]


def test_running_by_hand_asks_for_the_parameters(qt_app, monkeypatch):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.features.scripts import ScriptParam
    from hermes.ui.widgets import scripts
    from hermes.ui.widgets.script_params import ScriptRunDialog

    translations = load_translations("de")
    spec = ScriptSpec("return 1;", label="Items", params=(
        ScriptParam("item", "Item", "choice", "ItFo_Apple", "return [];"),
        ScriptParam("count", "Anzahl", "number", "1"),
        ScriptParam("all", "Alle", "bool")))
    worker = _FakeScriptWorker(4242)
    cache = {}

    # The choice's options come from the game; the last run's values are preselected.
    dialog = ScriptRunDialog(translations, spec, worker=worker, script_id=7,
                             options_cache=cache, last={"item": "ItFo_Pear", "count": 5})
    assert worker.requests == [("options", 7, "item")]
    combo = dialog._inputs["item"]
    assert not combo.isEnabled()
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.args is None and dialog.error_label.text()  # nothing to pick yet
    worker.options_listed.emit(99, [{"label": "x", "value": "y"}])  # another request's
    assert not combo.isEnabled()
    options = [{"label": "Apfel", "value": "ItFo_Apple"}, {"label": "Birne", "value": "ItFo_Pear"},
               {"label": "ItFo_Plum", "value": "ItFo_Plum"}]
    worker.options_listed.emit(1, options)
    assert [combo.itemText(i) for i in range(3)] == [
        "Apfel  (ItFo_Apple)", "Birne  (ItFo_Pear)", "ItFo_Plum"]
    assert combo.currentText() == "Birne  (ItFo_Pear)"
    assert dialog._inputs["count"].text() == "5"
    dialog._inputs["all"].setChecked(True)
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.args == {"item": "ItFo_Pear", "count": 5, "all": True}

    # A text that is no option is refused; the options are asked for only once.
    dialog = ScriptRunDialog(translations, spec, worker=worker, script_id=7, options_cache=cache)
    assert len(worker.requests) == 1
    assert dialog._inputs["item"].currentText() == "Apfel  (ItFo_Apple)"  # the default
    dialog._inputs["item"].setEditText("Bir")
    dialog._accept()
    assert dialog.args is None and "Item" in dialog.error_label.text()
    dialog.close()

    # The panel runs it with the values typed in and keeps them for the next run.
    shown = []

    class _Accepting:  # pylint: disable=too-few-public-methods
        def __init__(self, _translations, spec, **kwargs):
            shown.append((spec, kwargs))
            self.args = {"item": "ItFo_Plum", "count": 2, "all": False}

        def exec(self):
            return QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted

    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptWorker", _FakeScriptWorker)
    monkeypatch.setattr(scripts, "ScriptRunDialog", _Accepting)
    panel = scripts.ScriptPanel(translations)
    try:
        panel.set_process(4242)
        script_id = panel.add_script(spec)
        panel._worker.script_added.emit(script_id)
        panel.table.selectRow(0)
        panel.btn_run.click()
        assert panel._worker.requests[-1] == ("run", script_id, shown[0][0].default_args()
                                              | {"item": "ItFo_Plum", "count": 2})
        panel.btn_run.click()
        assert shown[1][1]["last"] == {"item": "ItFo_Plum", "count": 2, "all": False}
        assert shown[1][1]["options_cache"] is shown[0][1]["options_cache"]
    finally:
        panel.shutdown()
        panel.deleteLater()
```

`tests/test_sessions.py`:

```py
"""The session registry, its window and the shutdown dialog, with fake workers."""

import subprocess
import sys
import threading
import time

from PySide6.QtCore import QThread  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from hermes.core import sessions
from hermes.core.sessions import SESSIONS, frida_agents
from hermes.ui.widgets.sessions import SessionsDialog, ShutdownDialog, duration_text

from tests.test_hooks import _wait_for, fixture_qt_app, fixture_translations, linux_only  # pylint: disable=unused-import


class _FakeFridaSession:
    def __init__(self):
        self.detached = threading.Event()

    def detach(self):
        self.detached.set()


class _Worker(QThread):
    """Runs until asked to stop, or (``hangs``) until its session is cut."""

    def __init__(self, pid, hangs=False):
        super().__init__()
        self.pid = pid
        self.hangs = hangs
        self.frida = _FakeFridaSession()

    @sessions.tracked(sessions.HOOKS)
    def run(self):
        SESSIONS.set_frida_session(self, self.frida)
        while not self.frida.detached.is_set():
            if self.isInterruptionRequested() and not self.hangs:
                return
            time.sleep(0.01)


def _start(qt_app, worker):
    worker.start()
    _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: any(s.worker is worker and s.frida_session
                                  for s in SESSIONS.sessions()))
    return next(s for s in SESSIONS.sessions() if s.worker is worker)


def test_registry_tracks_running_workers_only(qt_app):
    worker = _Worker(4242)
    assert not SESSIONS.sessions(4242)
    session = _start(qt_app, worker)
    assert (session.kind, session.pid, session.stopping) == (sessions.HOOKS, 4242, None)
    assert SESSIONS.sessions(1) == []
    SESSIONS.stop(session)
    assert worker.wait(2000)
    assert not SESSIONS.sessions(4242)


def test_window_lists_sessions_and_cuts_a_hanging_one(qt_app, translations):
    worker = _Worker(4243, hangs=True)
    session = _start(qt_app, worker)
    # A process without Frida agents (the tests' own may have one: the
    # syntax check's, see hermes.hooks.syntax)
    clean = subprocess.Popen([sys.executable, "-c", "import time; time.sleep(30)"])
    dialog = SessionsDialog(translations, lambda: clean.pid)
    try:
        assert dialog.table.rowCount() == 1
        assert dialog.table.item(0, 0).text() == "Hooks (Frida)"
        assert dialog.table.item(0, 3).text() == "aktiv"
        assert "0 Frida-Agenten" in dialog.agents_label.text()

        dialog.table.selectRow(0)
        dialog.stop_button.click()
        assert not worker.wait(200)
        session.stopping -= 10
        dialog.refresh()
        assert dialog.table.item(0, 3).text().startswith("reagiert nicht (10 s)")
        dialog.table.selectRow(0)
        assert dialog.disconnect_button.isEnabled()
        dialog.disconnect_button.click()
        assert worker.wait(2000)
        _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: dialog.table.rowCount() == 0)
    finally:
        dialog.close()
        clean.kill()
        clean.wait()
        worker.frida.detach()
        worker.wait(2000)


def test_shutdown_waits_then_cuts_what_hangs(qt_app, translations):
    polite, stubborn = _Worker(4244), _Worker(4245, hangs=True)
    _start(qt_app, polite)
    _start(qt_app, stubborn)
    began = time.monotonic()
    # The polite one ends when asked; the stubborn one only when cut.
    result = ShutdownDialog(translations, timeout_s=0.5, grace_s=2).exec()
    assert result == QDialog.DialogCode.Accepted
    assert stubborn.frida.detached.is_set() and not polite.frida.detached.is_set()
    assert time.monotonic() - began < 2.5
    assert polite.wait(1000) and stubborn.wait(1000)


def test_shutdown_gives_up_on_a_worker_that_ignores_everything(qt_app, translations):
    class _Deaf(_Worker):
        @sessions.tracked(sessions.TRACE)
        def run(self):
            SESSIONS.set_frida_session(self, self.frida)
            while not self.release.is_set():
                time.sleep(0.01)

    deaf = _Deaf(4246)
    deaf.release = threading.Event()
    _start(qt_app, deaf)
    try:
        result = ShutdownDialog(translations, timeout_s=0.2, grace_s=0.3).exec()
        assert result == QDialog.DialogCode.Rejected
        assert SESSIONS.sessions(4246)
    finally:
        deaf.release.set()
        deaf.wait(2000)
        qt_app.processEvents()


@linux_only
def test_counts_frida_agents_in_maps(tmp_path):
    maps = tmp_path / "77" / "maps"
    maps.parent.mkdir()
    maps.write_text(
        "7f00-7f10 r--p 00000000 00:01 5 /memfd:frida-agent-64.so (deleted)\n"
        "7f10-7f20 r-xp 00010000 00:01 5 /memfd:frida-agent-64.so (deleted)\n"
        "8f00-8f10 r--p 00000000 00:01 6 /memfd:frida-agent-64.so (deleted)\n"
        "9f00-9f10 r--p 00000000 08:01 7 /usr/lib/libc.so.6\n")
    assert frida_agents(77, proc_root=str(tmp_path)) == 2
    assert frida_agents(78, proc_root=str(tmp_path)) == 0


def test_duration_text():
    assert [duration_text(s) for s in (4.9, 75, 3725)] == ["4 s", "1:15 min", "1:02 h"]


def test_workers_log_under_the_name_of_their_session(qt_app):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument
    import logging

    from hermes.core import logs

    class Named(QThread):
        pid = 4711

        def __init__(self):
            super().__init__()
            self.names = []

        @sessions.tracked(sessions.NATIVE_TRACE)
        def run(self):
            self.names.append(threading.current_thread().name)
            logs.log.info("inside")

    records = []
    handler = logging.Handler()
    handler.emit = records.append
    logs.log.addHandler(handler)
    previous = logs.log.level
    logs.log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
    worker = Named()
    try:
        worker.start()
        assert worker.wait(5000)
    finally:
        logs.log.removeHandler(handler)
        logs.log.setLevel(previous)
    name = worker.names[0]
    assert name.startswith("native_trace-") and name.split("-")[1].isdigit()
    assert [record.threadName for record in records
            if record.getMessage() in ("inside", "session native_trace started (pid 4711)",
                                       "session native_trace ended (pid 4711)")] == [name] * 3
```
