```py
def _settle(qt_app):
    # Column sizes are adjusted and saved on timers.
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import time

    from hermes.ui.widgets.table import SAVE_DELAY_MS
    deadline = time.monotonic() + (SAVE_DELAY_MS + 200) / 1000
    while time.monotonic() < deadline:
        qt_app.processEvents()


def test_windows_get_their_size_splitters_and_column_widths_back(qt_app, keeper):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,unused-argument,protected-access
    from hermes.ui.widgets.scripts import ScriptPanel
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QDialog, QVBoxLayout  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    translations = load_translations("en")

    def open_window():
        # A window of Hermes' own (the filter keeps only those) with the
        # scripts panel: a table and a splitter.
        window = QDialog()
        window.__class__ = type("ScriptsWindow", (QDialog,), {"__module__": "hermes.test"})
        layout = QVBoxLayout(window)
        panel = ScriptPanel(translations)
        layout.addWidget(panel)
        window.show()
        _settle(qt_app)
        return window, panel

    window, panel = open_window()
    window.resize(760, 480)  # wider than the panel's buttons, within the 800 px offscreen screen
    splitter = panel.table.parentWidget()
    splitter.setSizes([100, 300])
    header = panel.table.horizontalHeader()
    header.resizeSection(1, 211)  # as if the user dragged it
    _settle(qt_app)
    sizes = splitter.sizes()
    window.close()
    _settle(qt_app)

    window, panel = open_window()
    header = panel.table.horizontalHeader()
    assert (window.width(), window.height()) == (760, 480)
    assert panel.table.parentWidget().sizes() == sizes
    assert header.sectionSize(1) == 211
    window.close()
```

```py
"""Downloading Frida's Windows gadget: checked against GitHub's digest, written whole."""

import hashlib
import io
import json
import lzma
import struct

import pytest

from hermes.attach import wine_gadget
from hermes.attach.wine_gadget import GadgetError, ensure_gadget
from hermes.platform.wine import RawMemory


def _pe(machine):
    header = bytearray(0x40)
    header[:2] = b"MZ"
    struct.pack_into("<I", header, 0x3C, 0x40)
    return bytes(header) + b"PE\0\0" + struct.pack("<H", machine) + bytes(64)


def _serve(monkeypatch, dll, digest="right"):
    """Answer the release and the download as GitHub would."""
    compressed = lzma.compress(dll)
    name = "frida-gadget-1.2.3-windows-x86_64.dll.xz"
    if digest == "right":
        digest = "sha256:" + hashlib.sha256(compressed).hexdigest()
    release = {"assets": [{"name": name, "digest": digest}]}

    def urlopen(request, timeout):  # pylint: disable=unused-argument
        url = getattr(request, "full_url", request)
        body = json.dumps(release).encode() if "api.github.com" in url else compressed
        return io.BytesIO(body)

    monkeypatch.setattr(wine_gadget.urllib.request, "urlopen", urlopen)


@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
def _data_home(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", str(tmp_path))


def test_a_checked_gadget_is_written_whole(monkeypatch, tmp_path):
    dll = _pe(0x8664)
    _serve(monkeypatch, dll)
    path = ensure_gadget(64, version="1.2.3")
    assert path.read_bytes() == dll
    assert not list((tmp_path / "hermes-hook" / "gadget").glob("*.part"))


def test_download_reports_progress(monkeypatch):
    _serve(monkeypatch, _pe(0x8664))
    progress = []
    ensure_gadget(64, version="1.2.3", progress=lambda received, total:
                  progress.append((received, total)))
    assert progress[0] == (0, -1)
    assert progress[-1][0] > 0
    assert all(total == -1 for _received, total in progress)

# The ptrace loader on a native process: three threads call hot() all the
# time, another one makes threads, and the process counts the SIGUSR1s it
# gets. answer() stands in for LoadLibraryW; trap_site() is never called.
_BORROW_SOURCE = r"""
#include <pthread.h>
#include <signal.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <unistd.h>
volatile sig_atomic_t signals;
volatile int called, hot_calls;
static void on_signal(int sig) { (void) sig; signals++; }
__attribute__((noinline)) void hot(void) { hot_calls++; }
__attribute__((noinline)) long answer(void) { called++; return 42; }
__attribute__((noinline)) void trap_site(void) { __asm__ volatile("nop"); }
static void *worker(void *unused) {
  (void) unused;
  for (;;) { hot(); usleep(100); }
  return NULL;
}
static void *short_lived(void *unused) { (void) unused; return NULL; }
static void *spawner(void *unused) {
  (void) unused;
  for (;;) {
    pthread_t thread;
    if (pthread_create(&thread, NULL, short_lived, NULL) == 0)
      pthread_join(thread, NULL);
    usleep(200);
  }
  return NULL;
}
int main(void) {
  pthread_t thread;
  signal(SIGUSR1, on_signal);
  for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) pthread_create(&thread, NULL, worker, NULL);
  pthread_create(&thread, NULL, spawner, NULL);
  printf("%d %p %p %p\n", (int)getpid(), (void*)hot, (void*)answer, (void*)trap_site);
  fflush(stdout);
  char line[64];
  while (fgets(line, sizeof line, stdin)) {
    int before = hot_calls;
    usleep(50000);
    printf("%d %d %d\n", (int)signals, called, hot_calls > before);
    fflush(stdout);
  }
  return 0;
}
"""


def _can_trace():
    import platform  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import shutil  # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    try:
        with open("/proc/sys/kernel/yama/ptrace_scope", encoding="ascii") as scope:
            allowed = scope.read().strip() == "0"
    except OSError:
        allowed = True
    return allowed and shutil.which("gcc") and platform.machine() == "x86_64"


@pytest.mark.skipif(not _can_trace(), reason="needs gcc, x86-64 and ptrace_scope=0")
def test_a_borrowed_thread_calls_and_the_others_keep_their_signals(tmp_path):
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    import os
    import signal
    import subprocess
    import threading
    import time

    source = tmp_path / "borrow.c"
    source.write_text(_BORROW_SOURCE)
    binary = tmp_path / "borrow"
    subprocess.run(["gcc", "-O1", "-pthread", str(source), "-o", str(binary)], check=True)
    target = subprocess.Popen([str(binary)], stdin=subprocess.PIPE, stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
                              text=True)
    sent, stop = [0], threading.Event()

    def signal_all_the_time():
        while not stop.is_set():
            os.kill(target.pid, signal.SIGUSR1)
            sent[0] += 1
            time.sleep(0.01)  # apart enough that the kernel does not merge them

    pinger = threading.Thread(target=signal_all_the_time)
    memory = None
    try:
        pid, hot, answer, trap = (int(field, 0) for field in target.stdout.readline().split())
        memory = RawMemory(pid)
        pinger.start()
        for _round in range(3):
            tracee = wine_gadget._Tracee(pid)
            tracee.attach()
            try:
                tracee.set_breakpoints(memory, [hot])
                tid, address = tracee.catch_breakpoint(5)
                assert address == hot
                # The other workers reach hot() and wait there; what else the
                # threads report is dealt with, as the loader does while it waits.
                deadline = time.monotonic() + 0.05
                while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                    event = tracee.next_event()
                    if event is None:
                        time.sleep(0.002)
                    else:
                        tracee.service(*event)
                tracee.clear_breakpoints(memory)
                wine_gadget._call_load_library(memory, tracee, tid, answer, trap, b"x\0", 5)
            finally:
                tracee.clear_breakpoints(memory)
                tracee.detach()
            time.sleep(0.1)
        stop.set()
        pinger.join()
        time.sleep(0.2)

        stat = open(f"/proc/{pid}/stat", encoding="ascii").read()
        assert stat[stat.rindex(")") + 2] != "T"
        target.stdin.write("count\n")
        target.stdin.flush()
        signals, called, hot_runs = (int(field) for field in target.stdout.readline().split())
        assert (signals, called, hot_runs) == (sent[0], 3, 1)
    finally:
        stop.set()
        if pinger.is_alive():
            pinger.join()
        if memory is not None:
            memory.close()
        target.kill()
        target.wait()

```

```py
"""Tests for running the Windows injection helper in a game's wineserver."""

import os

import pytest

from hermes.attach import wine_helper
from hermes.attach.wine_helper import (
    HelperError,
    WineProcess,
    helper_environment,
    match_process,
    parse_list,
    read_environ,
    server_socket,
    sibling_start_times,
    wine_loader,
)
from tests.test_hooks import linux_only

# Wine and Proton run on Linux only.
pytestmark = linux_only


def _executable(path):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_text("#!/bin/sh\n")
    path.chmod(0o755)
    return path


def _fake_process(root, pid, exe, environ=b""):
    (root / str(pid)).mkdir()
    (root / str(pid) / "exe").symlink_to(exe)
    (root / str(pid) / "environ").write_bytes(environ)


def test_helpers_are_found_in_the_build_directory(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
    monkeypatch.setenv("HERMES_INJECT_DIR", str(tmp_path))
    _executable(tmp_path / "hermes-inject-x86_64.exe")
    _executable(tmp_path / "hermes-inject-x86.exe")
    assert wine_helper.helper_path(64) == tmp_path / "hermes-inject-x86_64.exe"
    assert wine_helper.helper_path(32) == tmp_path / "hermes-inject-x86.exe"
    monkeypatch.delenv("HERMES_INJECT_DIR")
    assert wine_helper.helper_dir() == wine_helper.BUILD_DIR
    assert wine_helper.BUILD_DIR.parts[-2:] == ("build", "inject")

def test_build_sh_builds_both_helpers(tmp_path):

    import subprocess

    if not (shutil.which("x86_64-w64-mingw32-gcc") and shutil.which("i686-w64-mingw32-gcc")):

                   env={**os.environ, "OUT_DIR": str(tmp_path)}, capture_output=True)

def test_matches_game_by_name_then_closest_creation_time():
    processes = [
        WineProcess(420, 1000, "ping.exe"),
        WineProcess(836, 50_000, "PING.EXE"),
        WineProcess(964, 90_045, "ping.exe"),
        WineProcess(12, 90_000, "start.exe"),
    ]

    assert match_process(processes, "ping.exe", 90_000).pid == 964
    assert match_process(processes, "ping.exe", 49_000).pid == 836
    assert match_process(processes[3:], "start.exe", None).pid == 12
    with pytest.raises(HelperError):
        match_process(processes, "game.exe", 0)


def test_same_named_processes_match_in_the_order_they_started():
    # Gothic 1 Remake: the bootstrap and the game it starts share a name, and
    # Wine registered both 0.8 s after their Unix start.
    processes = [WineProcess(320, 86_554, "G1R-Win64-Shipping.exe"),
                 WineProcess(340, 86_724, "G1R-Win64-Shipping.exe")]
    siblings = [85_920, 85_790]

    assert match_process(processes, "g1r-win64-shipping.exe", 85_920,
                         siblings_ms=siblings).pid == 340
    assert match_process(processes, "g1r-win64-shipping.exe", 85_790,
                         siblings_ms=siblings).pid == 320
    # Without the siblings, closeness alone picks the bootstrap.
    assert match_process(processes, "g1r-win64-shipping.exe", 85_920).pid == 320


@linux_only
def test_finds_the_starts_of_same_named_processes_in_the_prefix(tmp_path):
    (tmp_path / "stat").write_text("cpu 1 2 3\nbtime 1000\n")
    ticks = os.sysconf("SC_CLK_TCK")
    programs = {
        41: (r"S:\Gothic\G1R-Win64-Shipping.exe", "/pfx", 5),
        42: (r"S:\Gothic\G1R\Binaries\Win64\G1R-Win64-Shipping.exe", "/pfx", 7),
        43: (r"S:\Gothic\G1R-Win64-Shipping.exe", "/other", 9),  # another prefix
        44: (r"S:\Gothic\Launcher.exe", "/pfx", 11),
    }
    for pid, (program, prefix, start) in programs.items():
        (tmp_path / str(pid)).mkdir()
        (tmp_path / str(pid) / "cmdline").write_bytes(program.encode() + b"\0G1R\0")
        (tmp_path / str(pid) / "environ").write_bytes(f"WINEPREFIX={prefix}\0".encode())
        fields = ["S"] + ["0"] * 18 + [str(start * ticks), "0"]
        (tmp_path / str(pid) / "stat").write_text(f"{pid} (x) {' '.join(fields)}\n")

    starts = sibling_start_times(42, "g1r-win64-shipping.exe", proc_root=str(tmp_path))
    assert sorted(starts) == [1_005_000, 1_007_000]


def test_reads_architecture_and_tells_same_named_programs_apart():
    processes = parse_list("40\t90000\tping.exe\t32\r\n52\t90003\tping.exe\t64\r\n"
                           "60\t1\tsvc.exe\t0\r\n")

    assert processes[0] == WineProcess(40, 90000, "ping.exe", 32)
    assert match_process(processes, "ping.exe", 90000, bits=64).pid == 52
    assert match_process(processes, "ping.exe", 90003, bits=32).pid == 40
    # Unknown architecture (0) never rules a process out.
    assert match_process(processes, "svc.exe", 1, bits=64).pid == 60


def test_environment_copies_prefix_and_sync_but_not_wine_internals(tmp_path):
    _fake_process(tmp_path, 7, "/x/wine64-preloader",
                  b"WINEPREFIX=/games/pfx\0WINEFSYNC=1\0WINEESYNC=1\0"
                  b"WINESERVERSOCKET=16\0WINEPRELOADRESERVE=140000000-14000a000\0"
                  b"WINEDLLPATH=/container/only\0LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/container\0")
    base = {"PATH": "/usr/bin", "WINEPREFIX": "/mine", "WINEDEBUG": "+all"}

    env = helper_environment(read_environ(7, tmp_path), base)

    assert env == {"PATH": "/usr/bin", "WINEPREFIX": "/games/pfx", "WINEFSYNC": "1",
                   "WINEESYNC": "1", "WINEDEBUG": "-all"}


def test_default_prefix_is_home_wine():
    env = helper_environment({"HOME": "/home/player"}, {})

    assert env["WINEPREFIX"] == "/home/player/.wine"


def test_server_socket_is_named_after_prefix_device_and_inode(tmp_path):
    info = os.stat(tmp_path)

    socket = server_socket(tmp_path, uid=1000)

    assert str(socket) == (
        f"/tmp/.wine-1000/server-{info.st_dev:x}-{info.st_ino:x}/socket")


def test_finds_proton_wine_above_the_preloader(tmp_path):
    files = tmp_path / "Proton" / "files"
    wine = _executable(files / "bin" / "wine")
    preloader = _executable(files / "lib" / "wine" / "x86_64-unix" / "wine64-preloader")
    _fake_process(tmp_path, 7, preloader)

    assert wine_loader(7, {}, tmp_path) == wine


def test_finds_system_wine_beside_the_preloader(tmp_path):
    wine = _executable(tmp_path / "usr" / "bin" / "wine")
    preloader = _executable(tmp_path / "usr" / "bin" / "wine64-preloader")
    _fake_process(tmp_path, 7, preloader)

    assert wine_loader(7, {}, tmp_path) == wine


def test_prefers_the_game_wineloader(tmp_path):
    loader = _executable(tmp_path / "custom" / "wine")
    _executable(tmp_path / "usr" / "bin" / "wine")
    preloader = _executable(tmp_path / "usr" / "bin" / "wine64-preloader")
    _fake_process(tmp_path, 7, preloader)

    assert wine_loader(7, {"WINELOADER": str(loader)}, tmp_path) == loader


def test_no_wine_found_raises(tmp_path):
    preloader = _executable(tmp_path / "a" / "b" / "c" / "d" / "e" / "wine64-preloader")
    _fake_process(tmp_path, 7, preloader)

    with pytest.raises(HelperError):
        wine_loader(7, {}, tmp_path)
```

`tests/test_workers.py`:

```py
"""Workers kept until their thread has ended."""

import time

import shiboken6  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
from PySide6.QtCore import QThread  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

from hermes.ui import workers

from tests.test_hooks import _wait_for, fixture_qt_app  # pylint: disable=unused-import


class _Worker(QThread):
    """Runs until asked to stop."""

    def run(self):
        while not self.isInterruptionRequested():
            time.sleep(0.01)


def test_worker_is_released_only_after_its_thread_ended(qt_app):
    worker = _Worker()
    workers.keep_until_finished(worker)
    worker.start()
    assert worker in workers.running_workers()

    assert workers.stop_workers(5000)
    _wait_for(qt_app, lambda: worker not in workers.running_workers())
    assert worker.isFinished() and not worker.isRunning()


def test_stop_workers_without_workers_is_true():
    assert workers.stop_workers(0)


def test_a_worker_deleted_before_it_started_is_dropped():
    worker = _Worker()
    workers.keep_until_finished(worker)
    shiboken6.delete(worker)
    assert workers.stop_workers(0)
    assert not workers.running_workers()
```

```py
"""Tests for write-watchpoint configuration."""

import pytest

from hermes.core.value_types import watch_size_for_type
from hermes.features.write_watch import _build_agent_source


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("value_type", "expected_size"),
    [
        ("int8", 1),
        ("uint16", 2),
        ("int32", 4),
        ("float", 4),
        ("int64", 8),
        ("double", 8),
    ],
)
def test_watch_size_matches_scan_value_type(value_type, expected_size):
    assert watch_size_for_type(value_type) == expected_size


def test_watch_size_rejects_unknown_value_type():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="Unsupported watch data type"):
        watch_size_for_type("string")


def test_agent_installs_exception_handler_before_watchpoints():
    source = _build_agent_source(0x1234, 4)

    assert "ptr('0x1234')" in source
    assert "const targetSize = 4;" in source
    assert source.index("Process.setExceptionHandler") < source.index(
        "thread.setHardwareWatchpoint"
    )


def test_dialog_shows_the_time_of_the_last_write():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import os
    from datetime import datetime

    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.ui.localization import load_translations
    from hermes.ui.widgets.write_watch import WriteWatchDialog

    _app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    dialog = WriteWatchDialog("0x1000", 4, load_translations("de"))
    first = datetime(2026, 10, 17, 14, 3, 27, 418000).timestamp() * 1000
    hit = {"pc": "0x401077", "site": "game+0x1077", "value": "01", "threadId": 7}

    dialog.add_hits([{**hit, "time": first}])
    dialog.add_hits([{**hit, "count": 2, "time": first + 1500}])

    table = dialog.results_table
    assert table.horizontalHeaderItem(7).text() == "Zuletzt"
    assert table.rowCount() == 1
    assert table.item(0, 0).text() == "3"
    assert table.item(0, 7).text() == "14:03:28.918"


def test_dialog_shows_reads_and_writes_and_hooks_only_writes():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel,protected-access
    import os

    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from PySide6.QtCore import Qt  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.ui.localization import load_translations
    from hermes.ui.widgets.write_watch import WriteWatchDialog

    _app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    dialog = WriteWatchDialog("0x1000", 4, load_translations("de"), reads=True)
    dialog.add_hits([
        {"pc": "0x401077", "site": "game+0x1077", "read": True, "write": True},
        {"pc": "0x402000", "site": "game+0x2000", "read": True, "write": False},
    ])

    table = dialog.results_table
    assert dialog.windowTitle() == "Lese- und Schreibzugriffe auf 0x1000"
    assert [table.horizontalHeaderItem(column).text() for column in (3, 4)] == [
        "Lesend", "Schreibend"]
    checked = lambda row, column: (  # pylint: disable=unnecessary-lambda-assignment
        table.item(row, column).checkState() == Qt.CheckState.Checked)
    assert [checked(0, 3), checked(0, 4), checked(1, 3), checked(1, 4)] == [
        True, True, True, False]
    assert not table.item(0, 3).flags() & Qt.ItemFlag.ItemIsUserCheckable
    table.selectRow(0)
    assert dialog.hook_button.isEnabled()
    table.selectRow(1)
    assert not dialog.hook_button.isEnabled()
    # Reads and writes alike can be monitored: the instruction after the access
    assert dialog.monitor_button.isEnabled()
    monitored = []
    dialog.monitor_requested.connect(monitored.append)
    dialog.monitor_button.click()
    assert monitored == [0x402000]


def test_dialog_names_jit_code_by_its_csharp_method():
    # pylint: disable=import-outside-toplevel
    import os

    os.environ.setdefault("QT_QPA_PLATFORM", "offscreen")
    from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication  # pylint: disable=import-error,no-name-in-module

    from hermes.ui.localization import load_translations
    from hermes.ui.widgets.write_watch import WriteWatchDialog

    _app = QApplication.instance() or QApplication([])
    dialog = WriteWatchDialog("0x1000", 4, load_translations("de"))
    requested = []
    dialog.hook_requested.connect(lambda pc, site: requested.append((pc, site)))
    dialog.add_hits([{
        "pc": "0x7f0012345678", "site": "0x7f0012345678", "write": True,
        "method": "PlayerInventory:AddCurrency+0x3a",
    }])

    site = dialog.results_table.item(0, 2)
    assert site.text() == "PlayerInventory:AddCurrency+0x3a"
    assert site.toolTip() == "0x7f0012345678"
    dialog.results_table.selectRow(0)
    dialog._request_hook()  # pylint: disable=protected-access
    assert requested == [(0x7f0012345678, "PlayerInventory:AddCurrency+0x3a")]
```
